package com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.application.BidDecisionService;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.security.CurrentOrganizationResolver;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/bid-decisions"
)
@PreAuthorize(
        "isAuthenticated()"
)
public class BidDecisionController {

    private final BidDecisionService
            bidDecisionService;


    private final CurrentOrganizationResolver
            organizationResolver;


    public BidDecisionController(
            BidDecisionService bidDecisionService,
            CurrentOrganizationResolver organizationResolver
    ) {

        this.bidDecisionService =
                bidDecisionService;

        this.organizationResolver =
                organizationResolver;
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/queue"
    )
    public List<BidDecisionQueueItemResponse> queue(
            Authentication authentication,

            @RequestParam(
                    required = false
            )
            Integer minMatchScore,

            @RequestParam(
                    defaultValue = "false"
            )
            boolean includeBlocked
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .queue(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        minMatchScore,
                        includeBlocked
                );
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/overview"
    )
    public BidDecisionOverviewResponse overview(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .overview(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                )
                );
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/{tenderId}"
    )
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse workspace(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .workspace(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId
                );
    }


    @PutMapping(
            "/{tenderId}/assessment"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER','ANALYST')"
    )
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse assess(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId,
            @RequestBody
            UpdateBidAssessmentRequest request
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .assess(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId,
                        request,
                        authentication.getName()
                );
    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/{tenderId}/decision"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER')"
    )
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse decide(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId,
            @RequestBody
            SetBidDecisionRequest request
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .decide(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId,
                        request,
                        authentication.getName()
                );
    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/{tenderId}/reopen"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER')"
    )
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse reopen(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return bidDecisionService
                .reopen(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId,
                        authentication.getName()
                );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/biddecision/application/BidDecisionScoringService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.biddecision.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidAssessmentEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionScorecard;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BidDecisionScoringService {

    /*
     * 0..5 input per dimension.
     *
     * Strategic fit              25
     * Capability confidence      20
     * Commercial attractiveness  20
     * Delivery feasibility       15
     * Resource capacity          10
     * Risk confidence            10
     * -----------------------------
     * Total                     100
     */

    public BidAssessmentEvaluation evaluate(
            BidDecisionScorecard scorecard,
            int matchScore,
            boolean matchBlocked
    ) {

        validate(
                "strategicFit",
                scorecard.strategicFit()
        );

        validate(
                "capabilityConfidence",
                scorecard.capabilityConfidence()
        );

        validate(
                "commercialAttractiveness",
                scorecard.commercialAttractiveness()
        );

        validate(
                "deliveryFeasibility",
                scorecard.deliveryFeasibility()
        );

        validate(
                "resourceCapacity",
                scorecard.resourceCapacity()
        );

        validate(
                "riskConfidence",
                scorecard.riskConfidence()
        );


        int score =
                scorecard.strategicFit() * 5
                        +
                        scorecard.capabilityConfidence() * 4
                        +
                        scorecard.commercialAttractiveness() * 4
                        +
                        scorecard.deliveryFeasibility() * 3
                        +
                        scorecard.resourceCapacity() * 2
                        +
                        scorecard.riskConfidence() * 2;


        if (
                matchBlocked
        ) {

            return new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                    score,
                    BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO,
                    "Matching contains a blocker, so the recommended decision is NO-GO."
            );
        }


        if (
                matchScore < 40
        ) {

            return new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                    score,
                    BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO,
                    "Company-to-tender match is below the minimum strategic fit threshold."
            );
        }


        if (
                score >= 75
                &&
                matchScore >= 70
        ) {

            return new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                    score,
                    BidDecisionOutcome.GO,
                    "Decision score and opportunity match both support active bid pursuit."
            );
        }


        if (
                score >= 55
                &&
                matchScore >= 55
        ) {

            return new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                    score,
                    BidDecisionOutcome.HOLD,
                    "Opportunity remains viable but requires additional validation before a GO decision."
            );
        }


        return new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                score,
                BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO,
                "Decision score or opportunity match is below the recommended pursuit threshold."
        );
    }


    private void validate(
            String name,
            int value
    ) {

        if (
                value < 0
                ||
                value > 5
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    name
                            +
                            " must be between 0 and 5"
            );
        }
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/biddecision/application/BidDecisionService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.biddecision.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.BidDecisionOverviewResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.BidDecisionQueueItemResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.SetBidDecisionRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.UpdateBidAssessmentRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidAssessmentEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEventType;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionHistoryEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionScorecard;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionHistoryRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.OpportunityQueryService;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class BidDecisionService {

    private final TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    private final BidDecisionRepository
            decisionRepository;


    private final BidDecisionHistoryRepository
            historyRepository;


    private final BidDecisionScoringService
            scoringService;


    private final OpportunityQueryService
            opportunityQueryService;


    public BidDecisionService(
            TenderMatchRepository matchRepository,
            BidDecisionRepository decisionRepository,
            BidDecisionHistoryRepository historyRepository,
            BidDecisionScoringService scoringService,
            OpportunityQueryService opportunityQueryService
    ) {

        this.matchRepository =
                matchRepository;

        this.decisionRepository =
                decisionRepository;

        this.historyRepository =
                historyRepository;

        this.scoringService =
                scoringService;

        this.opportunityQueryService =
                opportunityQueryService;
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<BidDecisionQueueItemResponse> queue(
            UUID organizationId,
            Integer minimumMatchScore,
            boolean includeBlocked
    ) {

        int minimum =
                minimumMatchScore == null
                        ? 0
                        : Math.max(
                                0,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        minimumMatchScore
                                )
                        );


        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdOrderByBlockedAscTotalScoreDescEvaluatedAtDesc(
                        organizationId
                )
                .stream()

                .filter(
                        match ->
                                includeBlocked
                                ||
                                !match.isBlocked()
                )

                .filter(
                        match ->
                                match.getTotalScore()
                                        >=
                                        minimum
                )

                .limit(
                        100
                )

                .map(
                        this::queueItem
                )

                .toList();
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse workspace(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return workspaceResponse(
                match,
                decision
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse assess(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UpdateBidAssessmentRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid assessment request is required"
            );
        }


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionScorecard scorecard =
                new BidDecisionScorecard(
                        requiredScore(
                                "strategicFit",
                                request.strategicFit()
                        ),

                        requiredScore(
                                "capabilityConfidence",
                                request.capabilityConfidence()
                        ),

                        requiredScore(
                                "commercialAttractiveness",
                                request.commercialAttractiveness()
                        ),

                        requiredScore(
                                "deliveryFeasibility",
                                request.deliveryFeasibility()
                        ),

                        requiredScore(
                                "resourceCapacity",
                                request.resourceCapacity()
                        ),

                        requiredScore(
                                "riskConfidence",
                                request.riskConfidence()
                        )
                );


        BidAssessmentEvaluation evaluation =
                scoringService
                        .evaluate(
                                scorecard,
                                match.getTotalScore(),
                                match.isBlocked()
                        );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        BidDecisionEntity
                                                .create(
                                                        organizationId,
                                                        match.getTender()
                                                )
                        );


        BidDecisionOutcome currentOutcome =
                decision.getOutcome();


        decision.applyAssessment(
                scorecard,
                evaluation,
                match.getTotalScore(),
                match.getGrade(),
                clean(
                        request.rationale()
                ),
                clean(
                        request.keyRisks()
                ),
                clean(
                        request.assumptions()
                )
        );


        decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                decision
                        );


        historyRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        BidDecisionHistoryEntity
                                .create(
                                        decision,
                                        BidDecisionEventType.ASSESSMENT_UPDATED,
                                        currentOutcome,
                                        currentOutcome,
                                        decision.getDecisionScore(),
                                        actor(
                                                actor
                                        ),
                                        clean(
                                                request.rationale()
                                        )
                                )
                );


        return workspaceResponse(
                match,
                decision
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse decide(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            SetBidDecisionRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
                ||
                request.outcome() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid decision outcome is required"
            );
        }


        if (
                request.outcome()
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.PENDING
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Use the reopen operation to return a decision to PENDING"
            );
        }


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new InvalidRequestException(
                                                "Complete the bid assessment before making a final decision"
                                        )
                        );


        BidDecisionOutcome previous =
                decision.getOutcome();


        decision.decide(
                request.outcome(),
                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                decision
                        );


        historyRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        BidDecisionHistoryEntity
                                .create(
                                        decision,
                                        BidDecisionEventType.OUTCOME_CHANGED,
                                        previous,
                                        request.outcome(),
                                        decision.getDecisionScore(),
                                        actor(
                                                actor
                                        ),
                                        clean(
                                                request.note()
                                        )
                                )
                );


        return workspaceResponse(
                match,
                decision
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse reopen(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid decision was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        BidDecisionOutcome previous =
                decision.getOutcome();


        decision.reopen();


        decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                decision
                        );


        historyRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        BidDecisionHistoryEntity
                                .create(
                                        decision,
                                        BidDecisionEventType.REOPENED,
                                        previous,
                                        BidDecisionOutcome.PENDING,
                                        decision.getDecisionScore(),
                                        actor(
                                                actor
                                        ),
                                        "Decision reopened for review."
                                )
                );


        return workspaceResponse(
                match,
                decision
        );
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidDecisionOverviewResponse overview(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        List<BidDecisionEntity> decisions =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdOrderByUpdatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        double average =
                decisions
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                BidDecisionEntity::getDecisionScore
                        )
                        .average()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        Instant lastUpdated =
                decisions
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                BidDecisionEntity::getUpdatedAt
                        )
                        .max(
                                Instant::compareTo
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new BidDecisionOverviewResponse(
                matchRepository
                        .countByOrganizationId(
                                organizationId
                        ),

                decisions.size(),

                count(
                        decisions,
                        BidDecisionOutcome.PENDING
                ),

                count(
                        decisions,
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
                ),

                count(
                        decisions,
                        BidDecisionOutcome.HOLD
                ),

                count(
                        decisions,
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
                ),

                average,

                lastUpdated
        );
    }


    private long count(
            List<BidDecisionEntity> decisions,
            BidDecisionOutcome outcome
    ) {

        return decisions
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        decision ->
                                decision.getOutcome()
                                        ==
                                        outcome
                )
                .count();
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "No company-to-tender match exists for this organization and opportunity"
                                )
                );
    }


    private BidDecisionQueueItemResponse queueItem(
            TenderMatchEntity match
    ) {

        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                match.getOrganizationId(),
                                match
                                        .getTender()
                                        .getId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        BidDecisionQueueItemResponse.DecisionSummary
                summary =
                decision == null
                        ? null
                        : new BidDecisionQueueItemResponse
                                .DecisionSummary(
                                        decision.getId(),
                                        decision.getOutcome(),
                                        decision.getRecommendedOutcome(),
                                        decision.getDecisionScore(),
                                        decision.getUpdatedAt()
                                );


        return new BidDecisionQueueItemResponse(
                match.getId(),

                match
                        .getTender()
                        .getId(),

                match.getTotalScore(),

                match.getGrade(),

                match.isBlocked(),

                opportunityQueryService
                        .summaryById(
                                match
                                        .getTender()
                                        .getId()
                        ),

                summary
        );
    }


    private BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse workspaceResponse(
            TenderMatchEntity match,
            BidDecisionEntity decision
    ) {

        List<BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse.HistoryResponse>
                history =
                decision == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : historyRepository
                                .findByDecision_IdOrderByCreatedAtAsc(
                                        decision.getId()
                                )
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        event ->
                                                new BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse
                                                        .HistoryResponse(
                                                                event.getId(),
                                                                event.getEventType(),
                                                                event.getPreviousOutcome(),
                                                                event.getNewOutcome(),
                                                                event.getDecisionScore(),
                                                                event.getActor(),
                                                                event.getNote(),
                                                                event.getCreatedAt()
                                                        )
                                )
                                .toList();


        BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse.DecisionResponse
                decisionResponse =
                decision == null
                        ? null
                        : new BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse
                                .DecisionResponse(
                                        decision.getId(),
                                        decision.getOutcome(),
                                        decision.getRecommendedOutcome(),
                                        decision.getDecisionScore(),
                                        decision.getMatchScoreSnapshot(),
                                        decision.getMatchGradeSnapshot(),
                                        decision.getStrategicFit(),
                                        decision.getCapabilityConfidence(),
                                        decision.getCommercialAttractiveness(),
                                        decision.getDeliveryFeasibility(),
                                        decision.getResourceCapacity(),
                                        decision.getRiskConfidence(),
                                        decision.getRecommendationReason(),
                                        decision.getRationale(),
                                        decision.getKeyRisks(),
                                        decision.getAssumptions(),
                                        decision.getDecidedBy(),
                                        decision.getDecidedAt(),
                                        decision.getCreatedAt(),
                                        decision.getUpdatedAt()
                                );


        return new BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse(
                match
                        .getTender()
                        .getId(),

                match.getTotalScore(),

                match.getGrade(),

                match.isBlocked(),

                opportunityQueryService
                        .summaryById(
                                match
                                        .getTender()
                                        .getId()
                        ),

                decisionResponse,

                history
        );
    }


    private int requiredScore(
            String name,
            Integer value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    name
                            +
                            " is required"
            );
        }


        return value;
    }


    private String actor(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? "unknown"
                : cleaned;
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

}

        this.id =

        this.recommendationReason =
                "Assessment has not yet been completed.";

    ) {

        this.decidedBy =
                null;

        this.decidedAt =
                null;
    }

        if (id == null) {
            id = UUID.randomUUID();

        if (createdAt == null) {
            createdAt = now;
        }

        updatedAt = now;
    }

        updatedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }

)

package com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.application;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.CreateBidTaskRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.MarkBidSubmittedRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.SubmissionAuthorizationRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.UpdateBidTaskRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.UpdateSubmissionControlRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidPlanningEventEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidPlanningEventType;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidSubmissionControlEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidSubmissionReadiness;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskMilestone;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskPriority;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.SubmissionChecklistSnapshot;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.infrastructure.BidPlanningEventRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.infrastructure.BidSubmissionControlRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class BidPlanningService {

    private final TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    private final BidDecisionRepository
            decisionRepository;


    private final BidRequirementRepository
            requirementRepository;


    private final BidComplianceService
            complianceService;


    private final BidTaskRepository
            taskRepository;


    private final BidSubmissionControlRepository
            submissionControlRepository;


    private final BidPlanningEventRepository
            eventRepository;


    private final BidSubmissionReadinessEngine
            readinessEngine;


    public BidPlanningService(
            TenderMatchRepository matchRepository,
            BidDecisionRepository decisionRepository,
            BidRequirementRepository requirementRepository,
            BidComplianceService complianceService,
            BidTaskRepository taskRepository,
            BidSubmissionControlRepository submissionControlRepository,
            BidPlanningEventRepository eventRepository,
            BidSubmissionReadinessEngine readinessEngine
    ) {

        this.matchRepository =
                matchRepository;

        this.decisionRepository =
                decisionRepository;

        this.requirementRepository =
                requirementRepository;

        this.complianceService =
                complianceService;

        this.taskRepository =
                taskRepository;

        this.submissionControlRepository =
                submissionControlRepository;

        this.eventRepository =
                eventRepository;

        this.readinessEngine =
                readinessEngine;
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse workspace(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        requireMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse createTask(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            CreateBidTaskRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Task request is required"
            );
        }


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                optionalRequirement(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        request.requirementId()
                );


        BidTaskEntity task =
                BidTaskEntity
                        .create(
                                organizationId,

                                match.getTender(),

                                requirement,

                                required(
                                        request.title(),
                                        "Task title is required"
                                ),

                                clean(
                                        request.description()
                                ),

                                request.priority() == null
                                        ? BidTaskPriority.MEDIUM
                                        : request.priority(),

                                request.milestone() == null
                                        ? BidTaskMilestone.OTHER
                                        : request.milestone(),

                                clean(
                                        request.assignedTo()
                                ),

                                request.dueDate(),

                                actor(
                                        actor
                                )
                        );


        taskRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        task
                );


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.TASK_CREATED,
                task.getId(),
                actor,
                "Task created: "
                        +
                        task.getTitle()
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse updateTask(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID taskId,
            UpdateBidTaskRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Task update is required"
            );
        }


        BidTaskEntity task =
                taskRepository
                        .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                taskId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid task was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                request.requirementId() == null
                        ? task.getRequirement()
                        : optionalRequirement(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId,
                                request.requirementId()
                        );


        task.update(
                requirement,

                request.title() == null
                        ? task.getTitle()
                        : required(
                                request.title(),
                                "Task title cannot be blank"
                        ),

                request.description() == null
                        ? task.getDescription()
                        : clean(
                                request.description()
                        ),

                request.status() == null
                        ? task.getStatus()
                        : request.status(),

                request.priority() == null
                        ? task.getPriority()
                        : request.priority(),

                request.milestone() == null
                        ? task.getMilestone()
                        : request.milestone(),

                request.assignedTo() == null
                        ? task.getAssignedTo()
                        : clean(
                                request.assignedTo()
                        ),

                request.dueDate() == null
                        ? task.getDueDate()
                        : request.dueDate(),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        taskRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        task
                );


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.TASK_UPDATED,
                task.getId(),
                actor,
                "Task updated: "
                        +
                        task.getTitle()
                        +
                        " ["
                        +
                        task.getStatus()
                        +
                        "]"
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse deleteTask(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID taskId,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidTaskEntity task =
                taskRepository
                        .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                taskId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid task was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        String title =
                task.getTitle();


        taskRepository
                .delete(
                        task
                );


        taskRepository.flush();


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.TASK_DELETED,
                taskId,
                actor,
                "Task deleted: "
                        +
                        title
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse updateSubmissionControl(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UpdateSubmissionControlRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Submission-control update is required"
            );
        }


        BidSubmissionControlEntity control =
                control(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        match,
                        actor
                );


        control.updateChecklist(
                value(
                        request.portalReady(),
                        control.isPortalReady()
                ),

                value(
                        request.signaturesReady(),
                        control.isSignaturesReady()
                ),

                value(
                        request.technicalResponseReady(),
                        control.isTechnicalResponseReady()
                ),

                value(
                        request.commercialResponseReady(),
                        control.isCommercialResponseReady()
                ),

                value(
                        request.administrativePackReady(),
                        control.isAdministrativePackReady()
                ),

                value(
                        request.finalReviewReady(),
                        control.isFinalReviewReady()
                ),

                request.plannedSubmissionAt() == null
                        ? control.getPlannedSubmissionAt()
                        : request.plannedSubmissionAt(),

                request.notes() == null
                        ? control.getNotes()
                        : clean(
                                request.notes()
                        ),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        submissionControlRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        control
                );


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.SUBMISSION_CONTROL_UPDATED,
                null,
                actor,
                "Submission checklist updated"
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse authorizeSubmission(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            SubmissionAuthorizationRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Submission authorization request is required"
            );
        }


        BidSubmissionControlEntity control =
                control(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        match,
                        actor
                );


        control.authorize(
                request.authorized(),
                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        submissionControlRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        control
                );


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.SUBMISSION_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED,
                null,
                actor,
                request.authorized()
                        ? "Submission authorized"
                        : "Submission authorization revoked"
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse markSubmitted(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            MarkBidSubmittedRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Submission confirmation is required"
            );
        }


        String reference =
                required(
                        request.submissionReference(),
                        "Submission reference is required"
                );


        BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse before =
                buildWorkspace(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                !before
                        .statistics()
                        .readyForSubmission()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid cannot be marked submitted until the decision, compliance, tasks and submission checklist are all ready"
            );
        }


        BidSubmissionControlEntity control =
                submissionControlRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new InvalidRequestException(
                                                "Submission control has not been prepared"
                                        )
                        );


        control.markSubmitted(
                reference,

                clean(
                        request.notes()
                ),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        submissionControlRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        control
                );


        event(
                organizationId,
                match,
                BidPlanningEventType.SUBMITTED,
                null,
                actor,
                "Bid marked submitted with reference: "
                        +
                        reference
        );


        return buildWorkspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    private BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse buildWorkspace(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        List<BidTaskEntity> tasks =
                taskRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByDueDateAscCreatedAtAsc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        BidSubmissionControlEntity control =
                submissionControlRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        BidDecisionOutcome decisionOutcome =
                decision == null
                        ? null
                        : decision.getOutcome();


        BidComplianceMatrixResponse compliance =
                complianceService
                        .matrix(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        BidSubmissionReadiness readiness =
                readinessEngine
                        .calculate(
                                decisionOutcome,

                                compliance
                                        .statistics()
                                        .readyForSubmission(),

                                tasks
                                        .stream()
                                        .map(
                                                task ->
                                                        new BidTaskReadinessSnapshot(
                                                                task.getStatus(),
                                                                task.getPriority(),
                                                                task.getDueDate()
                                                        )
                                        )
                                        .toList(),

                                checklist(
                                        control
                                ),

                                LocalDate.now(
                                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                                )
                        );


        boolean submitted =
                control != null
                &&
                control.getSubmittedAt()
                        !=
                        null;


        boolean writable =
                decisionOutcome
                        !=
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
                &&
                !submitted;


        String lockReason =
                null;


        if (
                submitted
        ) {

            lockReason =
                    "Bid has been marked submitted. The planning workspace is frozen for auditability.";


        } else if (
                decisionOutcome
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
        ) {

            lockReason =
                    "Current bid decision is NO-GO. Reopen the decision before changing the bid plan.";
        }


        return new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse(
                tenderId,

                decisionOutcome,

                compliance
                        .statistics()
                        .readyForSubmission(),

                compliance
                        .statistics()
                        .readinessScore(),

                writable,

                lockReason,

                new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                        .Statistics(
                                readiness.readinessScore(),
                                readiness.totalTasks(),
                                readiness.openTasks(),
                                readiness.completedTasks(),
                                readiness.blockedTasks(),
                                readiness.overdueTasks(),
                                readiness.criticalOpenTasks(),
                                readiness.taskCompletionPercentage(),
                                readiness.checklistCompletionPercentage(),
                                readiness.readyForSubmission()
                        ),

                controlResponse(
                        control
                ),

                tasks
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::taskResponse
                        )
                        .toList(),

                eventRepository
                        .findTop50ByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                event ->
                                        new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                                                .Event(
                                                        event.getId(),
                                                        event.getEventType(),
                                                        event.getTaskId(),
                                                        event.getActor(),
                                                        event.getDetail(),
                                                        event.getCreatedAt()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }


    private BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse.Task taskResponse(
            BidTaskEntity task
    ) {

        boolean overdue =
                task.getStatus()
                        !=
                        BidTaskStatus.DONE
                &&
                task.getStatus()
                        !=
                        BidTaskStatus.CANCELLED
                &&
                task.getDueDate()
                        !=
                        null
                &&
                task.getDueDate()
                        .isBefore(
                                LocalDate.now(
                                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                                )
                        );


        return new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                .Task(
                        task.getId(),

                        task.getRequirement() == null
                                ? null
                                : task
                                        .getRequirement()
                                        .getId(),

                        task.getRequirement() == null
                                ? null
                                : task
                                        .getRequirement()
                                        .getTitle(),

                        task.getTitle(),

                        task.getDescription(),

                        task.getStatus(),

                        task.getPriority(),

                        task.getMilestone(),

                        task.getAssignedTo(),

                        task.getDueDate(),

                        overdue,

                        task.getCompletedAt(),

                        task.getCreatedBy(),

                        task.getUpdatedBy(),

                        task.getCreatedAt(),

                        task.getUpdatedAt()
                );
    }


    private BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse.SubmissionControl
    controlResponse(
            BidSubmissionControlEntity control
    ) {

        if (
                control == null
        ) {

            return new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                    .SubmissionControl(
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null
                    );
        }


        return new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                .SubmissionControl(
                        control.isPortalReady(),
                        control.isSignaturesReady(),
                        control.isTechnicalResponseReady(),
                        control.isCommercialResponseReady(),
                        control.isAdministrativePackReady(),
                        control.isFinalReviewReady(),
                        control.isSubmissionAuthorized(),
                        control.getPlannedSubmissionAt(),
                        control.getSubmittedAt(),
                        control.getSubmissionReference(),
                        control.getSubmittedBy(),
                        control.getNotes(),
                        control.getUpdatedBy()
                );
    }


    private SubmissionChecklistSnapshot checklist(
            BidSubmissionControlEntity control
    ) {

        if (
                control == null
        ) {

            return new SubmissionChecklistSnapshot(
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                    false
            );
        }


        return new SubmissionChecklistSnapshot(
                control.isPortalReady(),
                control.isSignaturesReady(),
                control.isTechnicalResponseReady(),
                control.isCommercialResponseReady(),
                control.isAdministrativePackReady(),
                control.isFinalReviewReady(),
                control.isSubmissionAuthorized()
        );
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "No company-to-tender match exists for this organization and opportunity"
                                )
                );
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireWritableMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                decision != null
                &&
                decision.getOutcome()
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid planning is locked because the current decision is NO-GO"
            );
        }


        BidSubmissionControlEntity control =
                submissionControlRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                control != null
                &&
                control.getSubmittedAt()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid planning is frozen because the bid has already been marked submitted"
            );
        }


        return match;
    }


    private BidRequirementEntity optionalRequirement(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID requirementId
    ) {

        if (
                requirementId == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        return requirementRepository
                .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        requirementId,
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "Linked bid requirement was not found"
                                )
                );
    }


    private BidSubmissionControlEntity control(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            TenderMatchEntity match,
            String actor
    ) {

        return submissionControlRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseGet(
                        () ->
                                BidSubmissionControlEntity
                                        .create(
                                                organizationId,
                                                match.getTender(),
                                                actor(
                                                        actor
                                                )
                                        )
                );
    }


    private void event(
            UUID organizationId,
            TenderMatchEntity match,
            BidPlanningEventType type,
            UUID taskId,
            String actor,
            String detail
    ) {

        eventRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        BidPlanningEventEntity
                                .create(
                                        organizationId,
                                        match.getTender(),
                                        type,
                                        taskId,
                                        actor(
                                                actor
                                        ),
                                        detail
                                )
                );
    }


    private boolean value(
            Boolean requested,
            boolean current
    ) {

        return requested == null
                ? current
                : requested;
    }


    private String required(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        String result =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                result == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String actor(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        return result == null
                ? "unknown"
                : result;
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/bidplanning/application/BidSubmissionReadinessEngine.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.application;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidSubmissionReadiness;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskPriority;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskReadinessSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.BidTaskStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain.SubmissionChecklistSnapshot;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BidSubmissionReadinessEngine {

    public BidSubmissionReadiness calculate(
            BidDecisionOutcome decisionOutcome,
            boolean complianceReady,
            List<BidTaskReadinessSnapshot> tasks,
            SubmissionChecklistSnapshot checklist,
            LocalDate today
    ) {

        List<BidTaskReadinessSnapshot> safeTasks =
                tasks == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : tasks;


        SubmissionChecklistSnapshot safeChecklist =
                checklist == null
                        ? new SubmissionChecklistSnapshot(
                                false,
                                false,
                                false,
                                false,
                                false,
                                false,
                                false
                        )
                        : checklist;


        LocalDate effectiveToday =
                today == null
                        ? LocalDate.now()
                        : today;


        int totalTasks =
                safeTasks.size();


        int completedTasks =
                (int)
                        safeTasks
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        this::closed
                                )
                                .count();


        int openTasks =
                totalTasks
                        -
                        completedTasks;


        int blockedTasks =
                (int)
                        safeTasks
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        task ->
                                                task.status()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidTaskStatus.BLOCKED
                                )
                                .count();


        int overdueTasks =
                (int)
                        safeTasks
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        task ->
                                                !closed(
                                                        task
                                                )
                                                &&
                                                task.dueDate()
                                                        !=
                                                        null
                                                &&
                                                task.dueDate()
                                                        .isBefore(
                                                                effectiveToday
                                                        )
                                )
                                .count();


        int criticalOpenTasks =
                (int)
                        safeTasks
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        task ->
                                                !closed(
                                                        task
                                                )
                                                &&
                                                task.priority()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidTaskPriority.CRITICAL
                                )
                                .count();


        int taskCompletion =
                totalTasks == 0
                        ? 100
                        : (int)
                                Math.round(
                                        completedTasks
                                                *
                                                100.0
                                                /
                                                totalTasks
                                );


        int checklistCompletion =
                (int)
                        Math.round(
                                safeChecklist
                                        .completedCount()
                                        *
                                        100.0
                                        /
                                        7.0
                        );


        int score =
                0;


        if (
                decisionOutcome
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
        ) {

            score +=
                    20;
        }


        if (
                complianceReady
        ) {

            score +=
                    30;
        }


        score +=
                (int)
                        Math.round(
                                taskCompletion
                                        *
                                        0.20
                        );


        score +=
                (int)
                        Math.round(
                                checklistCompletion
                                        *
                                        0.30
                        );


        score =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                score
                        )
                );


        boolean ready =
                decisionOutcome
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
                &&
                complianceReady
                &&
                openTasks == 0
                &&
                blockedTasks == 0
                &&
                overdueTasks == 0
                &&
                criticalOpenTasks == 0
                &&
                safeChecklist.complete();


        return new BidSubmissionReadiness(
                score,
                totalTasks,
                openTasks,
                completedTasks,
                blockedTasks,
                overdueTasks,
                criticalOpenTasks,
                taskCompletion,
                checklistCompletion,
                ready
        );
    }


    private boolean closed(
            BidTaskReadinessSnapshot task
    ) {

        return task.status()
                ==
                BidTaskStatus.DONE
                ||
                task.status()
                        ==
                        BidTaskStatus.CANCELLED;
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.domain;

public record SubmissionChecklistSnapshot(

        boolean portalReady,

        boolean signaturesReady,

        boolean technicalResponseReady,

        boolean commercialResponseReady,

        boolean administrativePackReady,

        boolean finalReviewReady,

        boolean submissionAuthorized

) {

    public int completedCount() {

        int result =
                0;


        if (portalReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (signaturesReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (technicalResponseReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (commercialResponseReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (administrativePackReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (finalReviewReady) {
            result++;
        }


        if (submissionAuthorized) {
            result++;
        }


        return result;
    }


    public boolean complete() {

        return completedCount()
                ==
                7;
    }

}

        extends JpaRepository<BidTaskEntity, UUID> {

    List<BidTaskEntity>
    findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByDueDateAscCreatedAtAsc(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    );


    Optional<BidTaskEntity>
    findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
            UUID taskId,
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    );

}

        "/api/v1/bid-workspaces"
)

        "isAuthenticated()"
)
public class BidWorkspaceController {

            workspaceService;

            organizationResolver;

            BidWorkspaceService workspaceService,
