===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/bidworkspace/application/BidWorkspaceService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.application;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.api.BidDocumentContentResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.api.BidWorkspaceResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.api.CreateBidDocumentRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.api.CreateBidRequirementRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.api.UpdateBidRequirementRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidDocumentCategory;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidDocumentEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementCategory;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementStatus;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure.BidDocumentRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure.BidRequirementRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.OpportunityQueryService;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;

import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class BidWorkspaceService {

    private final TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    private final BidDecisionRepository
            decisionRepository;


    private final BidDocumentRepository
            documentRepository;


    private final BidRequirementRepository
            requirementRepository;


    private final BidDocumentStorageGateway
            storageGateway;


    private final OpportunityQueryService
            opportunityQueryService;


    public BidWorkspaceService(
            TenderMatchRepository matchRepository,
            BidDecisionRepository decisionRepository,
            BidDocumentRepository documentRepository,
            BidRequirementRepository requirementRepository,
            BidDocumentStorageGateway storageGateway,
            OpportunityQueryService opportunityQueryService
    ) {

        this.matchRepository =
                matchRepository;

        this.decisionRepository =
                decisionRepository;

        this.documentRepository =
                documentRepository;

        this.requirementRepository =
                requirementRepository;

        this.storageGateway =
                storageGateway;

        this.opportunityQueryService =
                opportunityQueryService;
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidWorkspaceResponse workspace(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        List<BidDocumentEntity> documents =
                documentRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByUploadedAtDesc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        List<BidRequirementEntity> requirements =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByMandatoryDescCreatedAtAsc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        return response(
                match,
                decision,
                documents,
                requirements
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidWorkspaceResponse uploadDocument(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            CreateBidDocumentRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid-document request is required"
            );
        }


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        String originalFilename =
                required(
                        request.originalFilename(),
                        "Original filename is required"
                );


        byte[] content =
                decodeBase64(
                        request.contentBase64()
                );


        String sha256 =
                sha256(
                        content
                );


        documentRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdAndSha256(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        sha256
                )
                .ifPresent(
                        existing -> {

                            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                                    "This document already exists in the bid workspace"
                            );

                        }
                );


        BidDocumentStorageGateway.StoredBidDocument stored =
                storageGateway
                        .store(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId,
                                originalFilename,
                                content
                        );


        try {

            BidDocumentEntity document =
                    BidDocumentEntity
                            .create(
                                    organizationId,
                                    match.getTender(),
                                    request.category() == null
                                            ? BidDocumentCategory.OTHER
                                            : request.category(),
                                    originalFilename,
                                    stored.storedFilename(),
                                    clean(
                                            request.contentType()
                                    ),
                                    content.length,
                                    sha256,
                                    stored.storageKey(),
                                    clean(
                                            request.note()
                                    ),
                                    actor(
                                            actor
                                    )
                            );


            documentRepository
                    .saveAndFlush(
                            document
                    );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            storageGateway
                    .delete(
                            stored.storageKey()
                    );


            throw exception;
        }


        return workspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidDocumentContentResponse documentContent(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID documentId
    ) {

        requireMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        BidDocumentEntity document =
                requireDocument(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        documentId
                );


        byte[] content =
                storageGateway
                        .load(
                                document.getStorageKey()
                        );


        return new BidDocumentContentResponse(
                document.getId(),
                document.getOriginalFilename(),
                document.getContentType(),
                Base64
                        .getEncoder()
                        .encodeToString(
                                content
                        )
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidWorkspaceResponse deleteDocument(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID documentId
    ) {

        requireWritableMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        BidDocumentEntity document =
                requireDocument(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        documentId
                );


        List<BidRequirementEntity> requirements =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByMandatoryDescCreatedAtAsc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        for (
                BidRequirementEntity requirement :
                requirements
        ) {

            if (
                    requirement.getSourceDocument()
                            !=
                            null
                    &&
                    requirement
                            .getSourceDocument()
                            .getId()
                            .equals(
                                    documentId
                            )
            ) {

                requirement.detachSourceDocument();

                requirementRepository
                        .save(
                                requirement
                        );
            }
        }


        requirementRepository.flush();


        documentRepository
                .delete(
                        document
                );


        documentRepository.flush();


        storageGateway
                .delete(
                        document.getStorageKey()
                );


        return workspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidWorkspaceResponse createRequirement(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            CreateBidRequirementRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid-requirement request is required"
            );
        }


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDocumentEntity sourceDocument =
                optionalDocument(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        request.sourceDocumentId()
                );


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                BidRequirementEntity
                        .create(
                                organizationId,
                                match.getTender(),
                                sourceDocument,
                                required(
                                        request.title(),
                                        "Requirement title is required"
                                ),
                                clean(
                                        request.description()
                                ),
                                request.category() == null
                                        ? BidRequirementCategory.OTHER
                                        : request.category(),
                                request.mandatory() == null
                                        ||
                                        request.mandatory(),
                                clean(
                                        request.sourceReference()
                                ),
                                request.dueDate(),
                                clean(
                                        request.assignedTo()
                                ),
                                clean(
                                        request.evidenceNotes()
                                ),
                                actor(
                                        actor
                                )
                        );


        requirementRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        requirement
                );


        return workspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidWorkspaceResponse updateRequirement(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID requirementId,
            UpdateBidRequirementRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid-requirement update is required"
            );
        }


        requireWritableMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                requirementId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid requirement was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        BidDocumentEntity sourceDocument =
                request.sourceDocumentId()
                        ==
                        null
                        ? requirement.getSourceDocument()
                        : requireDocument(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId,
                                request.sourceDocumentId()
                        );


        requirement.update(
                sourceDocument,

                request.title() == null
                        ? requirement.getTitle()
                        : required(
                                request.title(),
                                "Requirement title cannot be empty"
                        ),

                request.description() == null
                        ? requirement.getDescription()
                        : clean(
                                request.description()
                        ),

                request.category() == null
                        ? requirement.getCategory()
                        : request.category(),

                request.status() == null
                        ? requirement.getStatus()
                        : request.status(),

                request.mandatory() == null
                        ? requirement.isMandatory()
                        : request.mandatory(),

                request.sourceReference() == null
                        ? requirement.getSourceReference()
                        : clean(
                                request.sourceReference()
                        ),

                request.dueDate() == null
                        ? requirement.getDueDate()
                        : request.dueDate(),

                request.assignedTo() == null
                        ? requirement.getAssignedTo()
                        : clean(
                                request.assignedTo()
                        ),

                request.evidenceNotes() == null
                        ? requirement.getEvidenceNotes()
                        : clean(
                                request.evidenceNotes()
                        ),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        requirementRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        requirement
                );


        return workspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidWorkspaceResponse deleteRequirement(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID requirementId
    ) {

        requireWritableMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                requirementId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid requirement was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        requirementRepository
                .delete(
                        requirement
                );


        requirementRepository.flush();


        return workspace(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "No company-to-tender match exists for this organization and opportunity"
                                )
                );
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireWritableMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                decision != null
                &&
                decision.getOutcome()
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid workspace is locked because the current decision is NO-GO. Reopen the decision before editing."
            );
        }


        return match;
    }


    private BidDocumentEntity requireDocument(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID documentId
    ) {

        return documentRepository
                .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        documentId,
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "Bid document was not found"
                                )
                );
    }


    private BidDocumentEntity optionalDocument(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID documentId
    ) {

        return documentId == null
                ? null
                : requireDocument(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId,
                        documentId
                );
    }


    private BidWorkspaceResponse response(
            TenderMatchEntity match,
            BidDecisionEntity decision,
            List<BidDocumentEntity> documents,
            List<BidRequirementEntity> requirements
    ) {

        int completed =
                (int)
                        requirements
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        requirement ->
                                                requirement.getStatus()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidRequirementStatus.SATISFIED
                                                ||
                                                requirement.getStatus()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidRequirementStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE
                                )
                                .count();


        int gaps =
                (int)
                        requirements
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        requirement ->
                                                requirement.getStatus()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidRequirementStatus.GAP
                                )
                                .count();


        int mandatoryGaps =
                (int)
                        requirements
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        requirement ->
                                                requirement.isMandatory()
                                                &&
                                                requirement.getStatus()
                                                        ==
                                                        BidRequirementStatus.GAP
                                )
                                .count();


        int completionPercentage =
                requirements.isEmpty()
                        ? 0
                        : (int)
                                Math.round(
                                        completed
                                                *
                                                100.0
                                                /
                                                requirements.size()
                                );


        BidDecisionOutcome decisionOutcome =
                decision == null
                        ? null
                        : decision.getOutcome();


        boolean writable =
                decisionOutcome
                        !=
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO;


        return new BidWorkspaceResponse(
                match
                        .getTender()
                        .getId(),

                match.getTotalScore(),

                match.getGrade(),

                decisionOutcome,

                writable,

                writable
                        ? null
                        : "Current decision is NO-GO. Reopen it before modifying the workspace.",

                opportunityQueryService
                        .summaryById(
                                match
                                        .getTender()
                                        .getId()
                        ),

                new BidWorkspaceResponse
                        .Statistics(
                                documents.size(),
                                requirements.size(),
                                completed,
                                gaps,
                                mandatoryGaps,
                                completionPercentage
                        ),

                documents
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::documentResponse
                        )
                        .toList(),

                requirements
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::requirementResponse
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }


    private BidWorkspaceResponse.DocumentResponse
    documentResponse(
            BidDocumentEntity document
    ) {

        return new BidWorkspaceResponse
                .DocumentResponse(
                        document.getId(),
                        document.getCategory(),
                        document.getOriginalFilename(),
                        document.getContentType(),
                        document.getSizeBytes(),
                        document.getSha256(),
                        document.getNote(),
                        document.getUploadedBy(),
                        document.getUploadedAt()
                );
    }


    private BidWorkspaceResponse.RequirementResponse
    requirementResponse(
            BidRequirementEntity requirement
    ) {

        return new BidWorkspaceResponse
                .RequirementResponse(
                        requirement.getId(),

                        requirement.getSourceDocument()
                                ==
                                null
                                ? null
                                : requirement
                                        .getSourceDocument()
                                        .getId(),

                        requirement.getSourceDocument()
                                ==
                                null
                                ? null
                                : requirement
                                        .getSourceDocument()
                                        .getOriginalFilename(),

                        requirement.getTitle(),

                        requirement.getDescription(),

                        requirement.getCategory(),

                        requirement.getStatus(),

                        requirement.isMandatory(),

                        requirement.getSourceReference(),

                        requirement.getDueDate(),

                        requirement.getAssignedTo(),

                        requirement.getEvidenceNotes(),

                        requirement.getCreatedBy(),

                        requirement.getUpdatedBy(),

                        requirement.getCreatedAt(),

                        requirement.getUpdatedAt()
                );
    }


    private byte[] decodeBase64(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                required(
                        value,
                        "Document content is required"
                );


        try {

            return Base64
                    .getDecoder()
                    .decode(
                            cleaned.getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.US_ASCII
                            )
                    );


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Document content is not valid Base64"
            );
        }
    }


    private String sha256(
            byte[] content
    ) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest
                            .getInstance(
                                    "SHA-256"
                            );


            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(
                            digest.digest(
                                    content
                            )
                    );


        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 is unavailable",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }


    private String required(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );
        }


        return cleaned;
    }


    private String actor(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? "unknown"
                : cleaned;
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure;

import java.nio.file.Path;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BidDocumentStorageSettings {

    private final Path root;

    private final long maxFileSizeBytes;


    public BidDocumentStorageSettings(

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.bid-documents.storage-root:./.tenderpilot-storage/bid-documents}"
            )
            String root,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.bid-documents.max-file-size-bytes:15728640}"
            )
            long maxFileSizeBytes

    ) {

        this.root =
                Path.of(
                        root
                )
                        .toAbsolutePath()
                        .normalize();

        this.maxFileSizeBytes =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        maxFileSizeBytes
                );
    }


    public Path root() {
        return root;
    }


    public long maxFileSizeBytes() {
        return maxFileSizeBytes;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/bidworkspace/infrastructure/LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.application.BidDocumentStorageGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import java.io.IOException;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.InvalidPathException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway
        implements BidDocumentStorageGateway {

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS =
            Set.of(
                    "pdf",
                    "doc",
                    "docx",
                    "xls",
                    "xlsx",
                    "csv",
                    "txt",
                    "rtf",
                    "odt",
                    "ods",
                    "zip",
                    "png",
                    "jpg",
                    "jpeg"
            );


    private final BidDocumentStorageSettings
            settings;


    public LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway(
            BidDocumentStorageSettings settings
    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;
    }


    @Override
    public StoredBidDocument store(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            String originalFilename,
            byte[] content
    ) {

        if (
                organizationId == null
                ||
                tenderId == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Organization and tender identifiers are required for document storage"
            );
        }


        String safeFilename =
                safeFilename(
                        originalFilename
                );


        String extension =
                extension(
                        safeFilename
                );


        if (
                !ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.contains(
                        extension
                )
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Unsupported bid-document extension: "
                            +
                            extension
            );
        }


        if (
                content == null
                ||
                content.length == 0
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid document cannot be empty"
            );
        }


        if (
                content.length
                        >
                        settings.maxFileSizeBytes()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid document exceeds the configured maximum file size"
            );
        }


        String storedFilename =
                UUID.randomUUID()
                        +
                        "."
                        +
                        extension;


        String storageKey =
                organizationId
                        +
                        "/"
                        +
                        tenderId
                        +
                        "/"
                        +
                        storedFilename;


        Path target =
                resolveSafe(
                        storageKey
                );


        try {

            Files.createDirectories(
                    target.getParent()
            );


            Files.write(
                    target,
                    content,
                    StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW,
                    StandardOpenOption.WRITE
            );


            return new StoredBidDocument(
                    storageKey,
                    storedFilename
            );


        } catch (
                IOException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to store bid document",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }


    @Override
    public byte[] load(
            String storageKey
    ) {

        Path target =
                resolveSafe(
                        storageKey
                );


        if (
                !Files.isRegularFile(
                        target
                )
        ) {

            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Stored bid document was not found"
            );
        }


        try {

            return Files.readAllBytes(
                    target
            );

        } catch (
                IOException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to read stored bid document",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }


    @Override
    public void delete(
            String storageKey
    ) {

        Path target =
                resolveSafe(
                        storageKey
                );


        try {

            Files.deleteIfExists(
                    target
            );


        } catch (
                IOException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to delete stored bid document",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }


    private Path resolveSafe(
            String storageKey
    ) {

        if (
                storageKey == null
                ||
                storageKey.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Document storage key is required"
            );
        }


        Path resolved =
                settings
                        .root()
                        .resolve(
                                storageKey
                        )
                        .normalize();


        if (
                !resolved.startsWith(
                        settings.root()
                )
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Invalid bid-document storage path"
            );
        }


        return resolved;
    }


    private String safeFilename(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
                ||
                value.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Original filename is required"
            );
        }


        try {

            String result =
                    Path.of(
                            value
                    )
                            .getFileName()
                            .toString()
                            .trim();


            if (
                    result.isBlank()
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Original filename is invalid"
                );
            }


            return result;


        } catch (
                InvalidPathException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Original filename is invalid"
            );
        }
    }


    private String extension(
            String filename
    ) {

        int dot =
                filename.lastIndexOf(
                        '.'
                );


        if (
                dot <= 0
                ||
                dot
                        ==
                        filename.length() - 1
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Bid document must include a supported file extension"
            );
        }


        return filename
                .substring(
                        dot + 1
                )
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/buyerintelligence/application/BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.application;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.BuyerBehaviorMetrics;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.DeadlineTempo;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.SupplierConcentration;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer {

    public BuyerBehaviorMetrics analyze(
            int noticeCount,
            Map<String, Integer> supplierAwardCounts,
            Map<String, Integer> cpvCounts,
            List<Integer> responseDays
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> safeSuppliers =
                supplierAwardCounts == null
                        ? Map.of()
                        : supplierAwardCounts;


        Map<String, Integer> safeCpvs =
                cpvCounts == null
                        ? Map.of()
                        : cpvCounts;


        List<Integer> safeResponseDays =
                responseDays == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : responseDays
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        value ->
                                                value != null
                                                &&
                                                value >= 0
                                )
                                .toList();


        int totalSupplierAwards =
                safeSuppliers
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        int topSupplierAwards =
                safeSuppliers
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .max()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        int topSupplierShare =
                percentage(
                        topSupplierAwards,
                        totalSupplierAwards
                );


        int hhi =
                hhi(
                        safeSuppliers
                );


        SupplierConcentration concentration =
                concentration(
                        safeSuppliers.size(),
                        hhi
                );


        int totalCpvOccurrences =
                safeCpvs
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        int topCpvOccurrences =
                safeCpvs
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .max()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        int topCpvShare =
                percentage(
                        topCpvOccurrences,
                        totalCpvOccurrences
                );


        boolean recurring =
                noticeCount >= 3
                &&
                topCpvShare >= 40;


        Integer medianDays =
                median(
                        safeResponseDays
                );


        return new BuyerBehaviorMetrics(
                topSupplierShare,
                hhi,
                concentration,
                topCpvShare,
                recurring,
                medianDays,
                tempo(
                        medianDays
                )
        );
    }


    private int percentage(
            int numerator,
            int denominator
    ) {

        if (
                denominator <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        numerator
                                *
                                100.0
                                /
                                denominator
                );
    }


    private int hhi(
            Map<String, Integer> counts
    ) {

        int total =
                counts
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        if (
                total <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        double result =
                0;


        for (
                Integer count :
                counts.values()
        ) {

            double share =
                    count
                            /
                            (double)
                                    total;


            result +=
                    share
                            *
                            share;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        result
                                *
                                10000.0
                );
    }


    private SupplierConcentration concentration(
            int supplierCount,
            int hhi
    ) {

        if (
                supplierCount <= 0
        ) {

            return SupplierConcentration.UNKNOWN;
        }


        if (
                supplierCount >= 4
                &&
                hhi < 2500
        ) {

            return SupplierConcentration.DIVERSIFIED;
        }


        if (
                hhi < 5000
        ) {

            return SupplierConcentration.MODERATE;
        }


        return SupplierConcentration.CONCENTRATED;
    }


    private Integer median(
            List<Integer> values
    ) {

        if (
                values.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        List<Integer> sorted =
                new ArrayList<>(
                        values
                );


        sorted.sort(
                Comparator.naturalOrder()
        );


        int middle =
                sorted.size()
                        /
                        2;


        if (
                sorted.size()
                        %
                        2
                        ==
                        1
        ) {

            return sorted.get(
                    middle
            );
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        (
                                sorted.get(
                                        middle - 1
                                )
                                +
                                sorted.get(
                                        middle
                                )
                        )
                                /
                                2.0
                );
    }


    private DeadlineTempo tempo(
            Integer medianDays
    ) {

        if (
                medianDays == null
        ) {

            return DeadlineTempo.UNKNOWN;
        }


        if (
                medianDays < 15
        ) {

            return DeadlineTempo.SHORT;
        }


        if (
                medianDays <= 45
        ) {

            return DeadlineTempo.STANDARD;
        }


        return DeadlineTempo.LONG;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/buyerintelligence/application/BuyerIntelligenceService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.application;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.api.BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.api.BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.BuyerBehaviorMetrics;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway.AwardRecord;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway.BuyerRecord;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway.CpvRecord;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway.SupplierRecord;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway.TenderRecord;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class BuyerIntelligenceService {

    private final BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway
            queryGateway;


    private final BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer
            behaviorAnalyzer;


    public BuyerIntelligenceService(
            BuyerAnalyticsQueryGateway queryGateway,
            BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer behaviorAnalyzer
    ) {

        this.queryGateway =
                queryGateway;

        this.behaviorAnalyzer =
                behaviorAnalyzer;
    }


    public List<BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse> search(
            String query,
            String country,
            Integer limit
    ) {

        int resolvedLimit =
                limit == null
                        ? 40
                        : Math.max(
                                1,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        limit
                                )
                        );


        return queryGateway
                .buyers(
                        query,
                        country,
                        resolvedLimit
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::summary
                )
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse::noticeCount
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse::name,
                                        Comparator.nullsLast(
                                                String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    public BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse detail(
            UUID buyerId
    ) {

        BuyerRecord buyer =
                queryGateway
                        .buyer(
                                buyerId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Buyer was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        List<TenderRecord> tenders =
                queryGateway
                        .tenders(
                                buyer.id()
                        );


        List<UUID> tenderIds =
                tenders
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                TenderRecord::id
                        )
                        .toList();


        List<CpvRecord> cpvs =
                queryGateway
                        .cpvs(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        List<AwardRecord> awards =
                queryGateway
                        .awards(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        List<SupplierRecord> suppliers =
                queryGateway
                        .suppliers(
                                awards
                                        .stream()
                                        .map(
                                                AwardRecord::id
                                        )
                                        .filter(
                                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                        )
                                        .toList()
                        );


        return new BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse(
                summary(
                        buyer,
                        tenders,
                        cpvs,
                        awards,
                        suppliers
                ),

                topCpvs(
                        cpvs
                ),

                topSuppliers(
                        suppliers
                ),

                monthlyActivity(
                        tenders
                ),

                tenders
                        .stream()
                        .limit(
                                12
                        )
                        .map(
                                tender ->
                                        new BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                                .RecentTender(
                                                        tender.id(),
                                                        tender.title(),
                                                        tender.status(),
                                                        tender.publicationDate(),
                                                        tender.submissionDeadline(),
                                                        tender.estimatedMinValue(),
                                                        tender.estimatedMaxValue(),
                                                        tender.currency()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }


    private BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse summary(
            BuyerRecord buyer
    ) {

        List<TenderRecord> tenders =
                queryGateway
                        .tenders(
                                buyer.id()
                        );


        List<UUID> tenderIds =
                tenders
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                TenderRecord::id
                        )
                        .toList();


        List<CpvRecord> cpvs =
                queryGateway
                        .cpvs(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        List<AwardRecord> awards =
                queryGateway
                        .awards(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        List<SupplierRecord> suppliers =
                queryGateway
                        .suppliers(
                                awards
                                        .stream()
                                        .map(
                                                AwardRecord::id
                                        )
                                        .filter(
                                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                        )
                                        .toList()
                        );


        return summary(
                buyer,
                tenders,
                cpvs,
                awards,
                suppliers
        );
    }


    private BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse summary(
            BuyerRecord buyer,
            List<TenderRecord> tenders,
            List<CpvRecord> cpvs,
            List<AwardRecord> awards,
            List<SupplierRecord> suppliers
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> cpvCounts =
                counts(
                        cpvs
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        CpvRecord::code
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        Map<String, Integer> supplierCounts =
                counts(
                        suppliers
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        SupplierRecord::name
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        List<Integer> responseDays =
                tenders
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::responseDays
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .toList();


        BuyerBehaviorMetrics behavior =
                behaviorAnalyzer
                        .analyze(
                                tenders.size(),
                                supplierCounts,
                                cpvCounts,
                                responseDays
                        );


        int activeNotices =
                (int)
                        tenders
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        tender ->
                                                active(
                                                        tender.status()
                                                )
                                )
                                .count();


        LocalDate lastPublication =
                tenders
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                TenderRecord::publicationDate
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .max(
                                Comparator.naturalOrder()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        CurrencyAggregate awardAggregate =
                awardAggregate(
                        awards
                );


        CurrencyAggregate estimateAggregate =
                estimateAggregate(
                        tenders
                );


        return new BuyerIntelligenceSummaryResponse(
                buyer.id(),

                buyer.name(),

                buyer.category(),

                buyer.countryCode(),

                buyer.city(),

                tenders.size(),

                activeNotices,

                awards.size(),

                awardAggregate.value(),

                awardAggregate.currency(),

                estimateAggregate.value(),

                estimateAggregate.currency(),

                lastPublication,

                behavior.recurringProcurement(),

                behavior.topCpvSharePercentage(),

                behavior.supplierConcentration(),

                behavior.topSupplierSharePercentage(),

                behavior.supplierHhi(),

                behavior.medianResponseDays(),

                behavior.deadlineTempo()
        );
    }


    private List<BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse.CpvInsight>
    topCpvs(
            List<CpvRecord> cpvs
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> counts =
                counts(
                        cpvs
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        CpvRecord::code
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        Map<String, String> descriptions =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                CpvRecord cpv :
                cpvs
        ) {

            if (
                    cpv.code() != null
                    &&
                    cpv.description() != null
            ) {

                descriptions.putIfAbsent(
                        cpv.code(),
                        cpv.description()
                );
            }
        }


        int total =
                counts
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        return counts
                .entrySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Map.Entry
                                .<String, Integer>comparingByValue()
                                .reversed()
                )
                .limit(
                        10
                )
                .map(
                        entry ->
                                new BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .CpvInsight(
                                                entry.getKey(),

                                                descriptions.get(
                                                        entry.getKey()
                                                ),

                                                entry.getValue(),

                                                percentage(
                                                        entry.getValue(),
                                                        total
                                                )
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private List<BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse.SupplierInsight>
    topSuppliers(
            List<SupplierRecord> suppliers
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> counts =
                counts(
                        suppliers
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        SupplierRecord::name
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        int total =
                counts
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        return counts
                .entrySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Map.Entry
                                .<String, Integer>comparingByValue()
                                .reversed()
                )
                .limit(
                        10
                )
                .map(
                        entry ->
                                new BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .SupplierInsight(
                                                entry.getKey(),

                                                entry.getValue(),

                                                percentage(
                                                        entry.getValue(),
                                                        total
                                                )
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private List<BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse.MonthlyActivity>
    monthlyActivity(
            List<TenderRecord> tenders
    ) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                int month = 1;
                month <= 12;
                month++
        ) {

            counts.put(
                    month,
                    0
            );
        }


        for (
                TenderRecord tender :
                tenders
        ) {

            if (
                    tender.publicationDate()
                            ==
                            null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            counts.compute(
                    tender
                            .publicationDate()
                            .getMonthValue(),

                    (
                            key,
                            current
                    ) ->
                            current == null
                                    ? 1
                                    : current + 1
            );
        }


        return counts
                .entrySet()
                .stream()
                .map(
                        entry ->
                                new BuyerIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .MonthlyActivity(
                                                entry.getKey(),
                                                entry.getValue()
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private Map<String, Integer> counts(
            List<String> values
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                String value :
                values
        ) {

            if (
                    value == null
                    ||
                    value.isBlank()
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            String normalized =
                    value.trim();


            result.compute(
                    normalized,

                    (
                            key,
                            current
                    ) ->
                            current == null
                                    ? 1
                                    : current + 1
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private CurrencyAggregate awardAggregate(
            List<AwardRecord> awards
    ) {

        Map<String, BigDecimal> totals =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                AwardRecord award :
                awards
        ) {

            if (
                    award.amount() == null
                    ||
                    award.currency() == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            String currency =
                    award
                            .currency()
                            .toUpperCase(
                                    Locale.ROOT
                            );


            totals.merge(
                    currency,
                    award.amount(),
                    BigDecimal::add
            );
        }


        if (
                totals.size() != 1
        ) {

            return new CurrencyAggregate(
                    null,
                    totals.isEmpty()
                            ? null
                            : "MIXED"
            );
        }


        Map.Entry<String, BigDecimal> entry =
                totals
                        .entrySet()
                        .iterator()
                        .next();


        return new CurrencyAggregate(
                entry.getValue(),
                entry.getKey()
        );
    }


    private CurrencyAggregate estimateAggregate(
            List<TenderRecord> tenders
    ) {

        Map<String, List<BigDecimal>> byCurrency =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                TenderRecord tender :
                tenders
        ) {

            BigDecimal midpoint =
                    midpoint(
                            tender
                                    .estimatedMinValue(),

                            tender
                                    .estimatedMaxValue()
                    );


            if (
                    midpoint == null
                    ||
                    tender.currency() == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            byCurrency
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            tender
                                    .currency()
                                    .toUpperCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    ),

                            ignored ->
                                    new java.util.ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(
                            midpoint
                    );
        }


        if (
                byCurrency.size() != 1
        ) {

            return new CurrencyAggregate(
                    null,
                    byCurrency.isEmpty()
                            ? null
                            : "MIXED"
            );
        }


        Map.Entry<String, List<BigDecimal>> entry =
                byCurrency
                        .entrySet()
                        .iterator()
                        .next();


        BigDecimal total =
                entry
                        .getValue()
                        .stream()
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );


        BigDecimal average =
                total.divide(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                entry
                                        .getValue()
                                        .size()
                        ),
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );


        return new CurrencyAggregate(
                average,
                entry.getKey()
        );
    }


    private BigDecimal midpoint(
            BigDecimal min,
            BigDecimal max
    ) {

        if (
                min == null
                &&
                max == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                min == null
        ) {

            return max;
        }


        if (
                max == null
        ) {

            return min;
        }


        return min
                .add(
                        max
                )
                .divide(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                2
                        ),
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }


    private Integer responseDays(
            TenderRecord tender
    ) {

        if (
                tender.publicationDate() == null
                ||
                tender.submissionDeadline() == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        long days =
                Duration
                        .between(
                                tender
                                        .publicationDate()
                                        .atStartOfDay()
                                        .toInstant(
                                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                                        ),

                                tender.submissionDeadline()
                        )
                        .toDays();


        if (
                days < 0
                ||
                days > Integer.MAX_VALUE
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        return (int)
                days;
    }


    private boolean active(
            String status
    ) {

        if (
                status == null
        ) {

            return false;
        }


        String normalized =
                status
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return normalized.equals(
                "PUBLISHED"
        )
                ||
                normalized.equals(
                        "OPEN"
                )
                ||
                normalized.equals(
                        "ACTIVE"
                );
    }


    private int percentage(
            int numerator,
            int denominator
    ) {

        if (
                denominator <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        numerator
                                *
                                100.0
                                /
                                denominator
                );
    }


    private record CurrencyAggregate(

            BigDecimal value,

            String currency

    ) {
    }

}

    public List<BuyerRecord> buyers(
            String query,
            String country,
            int limit
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        StringBuilder sql =
                new StringBuilder(
                        "select "
                );


        sql.append(
                q(
                        schema.buyerId()
                )
        )
                .append(
                        " as buyer_id, "
                )
                .append(
                        q(
                                schema.buyerName()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " as buyer_name, "
                )
                .append(
                        projection(
                                schema.buyerCategory(),
                                "buyer_category"
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        ", "
                )
                .append(
                        projection(
                                schema.buyerCountry(),
                                "buyer_country"
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        ", "
                )
                .append(
                        projection(
                                schema.buyerCity(),
                                "buyer_city"
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " from "
                )
                .append(
                        q(
                                schema.buyerTable()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " where 1 = 1"
                );


        List<Object> args =
                new ArrayList<>();


        String cleanQuery =
                clean(
                        query
                );


        if (
                cleanQuery != null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and lower("
            )
                    .append(
                            q(
                                    schema.buyerName()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") like lower(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    "%"
                            +
                            cleanQuery
                            +
                            "%"
            );
        }


        String cleanCountry =
                clean(
                        country
                );


        if (
                cleanCountry != null
                &&
                schema.buyerCountry()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and upper("
            )
                    .append(
                            q(
                                    schema.buyerCountry()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") = upper(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    cleanCountry
            );
        }


        sql.append(
                " order by lower("
        )
                .append(
                        q(
                                schema.buyerName()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        ") asc limit ?"
                );


        args.add(
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                limit
                        )
                )
        );


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql.toString(),
                        args.toArray()
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::buyer
                )
                .toList();
    }


    public Optional<BuyerRecord> buyer(

    public List<TenderRecord> tenders(
            UUID buyerId
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        String publication =
                projection(
                        schema.tenderPublicationDate(),
                        "publication_date"
                );


        String deadline =
                projection(
                        schema.tenderDeadline(),
                        "submission_deadline"
                );


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.tenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_id, "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.tenderTitle()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_title, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.tenderStatus(),
                                "tender_status"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        publication
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        deadline
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.tenderMinValue(),
                                "estimated_min_value"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.tenderMaxValue(),
                                "estimated_max_value"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.tenderCurrency(),
                                "tender_currency"
                        )
                        +
                        " from "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.tenderTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " where "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.tenderBuyerId()
                        )
                        +
                        " = ?";


        List<TenderRecord> result =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                sql,
                                buyerId

    public List<CpvRecord> cpvs(

                !schema.cpvAvailable()

            return List.of();
