                "select "

    private String projection(
            String column,
            String alias
    ) {

        return column == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : q(
                        column
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String q(
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                ||
                !identifier.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid database identifier"
            );
        }


        return "\""
                +
                identifier
                +
                "\"";
    }


    private String placeholders(
            int count
    ) {

        return String.join(
                ",",
                java.util.Collections.nCopies(
                        count,
                        "?"
                )
        );
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        return UUID.fromString(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private BigDecimal decimal(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof BigDecimal decimal
        ) {

            return decimal;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }


        return new BigDecimal(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private LocalDate date(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate date
        ) {

            return date;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Date date
        ) {

            return date.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp
                    .toLocalDateTime()
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime localDateTime
        ) {

            return localDateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime offsetDateTime
        ) {

            return offsetDateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant
                    .atOffset(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    )
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        return LocalDate.parse(
                value.toString()
                        .substring(
                                0,
                                10
                        )
        );
    }


    private Instant instant(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime offsetDateTime
        ) {

            return offsetDateTime.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime localDateTime
        ) {

            return localDateTime
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate
                    .atStartOfDay()
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        return Instant.parse(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private int comparePublication(
            LocalDate left,
            LocalDate right
    ) {

        if (
                left == null
                &&
                right == null
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        if (
                left == null
        ) {

            return -1;
        }


        if (
                right == null
        ) {

            return 1;
        }


        return left.compareTo(
                right
        );
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value.trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }

    }

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private volatile Schema
            cached;


    public ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;
    }


    public Schema schema() {

        Schema current =
                cached;


        if (
                current != null
        ) {

            return current;
        }


        synchronized (
                this
        ) {

            if (
                    cached == null
            ) {

                cached =
                        inspect();
            }


            return cached;
        }
    }


    private Schema inspect() {

        String buyerTable =
                requiredTable(
                        List.of(
                                "procurement_buyers",
                                "buyers"
                        ),
                        "canonical buyer table"
                );


        String tenderTable =
                requiredTable(
                        List.of(
                                "procurement_tenders",
                                "tenders"
                        ),
                        "canonical tender table"
                );


        String cpvTable =
                optionalTable(
                        List.of(
                                "procurement_tender_cpvs",
                                "procurement_tender_cpv_codes",
                                "tender_cpvs",
                                "procurement_cpvs"
                        )
                );

                                "procurement_awards",

                                "procurement_award_suppliers",
                                "award_suppliers",

                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        supplierTable,
                        List.of(
                                "name",
                                "supplier_name",
                                "legal_name"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String requiredTable(
            List<String> candidates,
            String description
    ) {

        String result =
                optionalTable(
                        candidates
                );


        if (
                result == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to discover "
                            +
                            description
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String optionalTable(
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            List<String> rows =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .query(
                                    """
                                    select table_name
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                    order by table_name
                                    """,

                                    (
                                            rs,
                                            rowNumber
                                    ) ->
                                            rs.getString(
                                                    1
                                            ),

                                    candidate
                            );


            if (
                    !rows.isEmpty()
            ) {

                return rows.getFirst();
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private String requiredColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        String result =
                optionalColumn(
                        table,
                        candidates
                );


        if (
                result == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to discover required column on "
                            +
                            table
                            +
                            ": "
                            +
                            candidates
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String optionalColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        if (
                table == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        Set<String> available =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        jdbcTemplate
                                .query(
                                        """
                                        select column_name
                                        from information_schema.columns
                                        where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                        """,

                                        (
                                                rs,
                                                rowNumber
                                        ) ->
                                                rs.getString(
                                                        1
                                                ),

                                        table
                                )
                );


        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            for (
                    String actual :
                    available
            ) {

                if (
                        actual
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                )
                                .equals(
                                        candidate
                                                .toLowerCase(
                                                        Locale.ROOT
                                                )
                                )
                ) {

                    return actual;
                }
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    public record Schema(

            String buyerTable,

            String buyerId,

            String buyerName,

            String buyerCategory,

            String buyerCountry,

            String buyerCity,

            String tenderTable,

            String tenderId,

            String tenderBuyerId,

            String tenderTitle,

            String tenderStatus,

            String tenderPublicationDate,

            String tenderDeadline,

            String tenderMinValue,

            String tenderMaxValue,

            String tenderCurrency,

            String cpvTable,

            String cpvTenderId,

            String cpvCode,

            String cpvDescription,

            String awardTable,

            String awardId,

            String awardTenderId,

            String awardAmount,

            String awardCurrency,

            String supplierTable,

            String supplierAwardId,

            String supplierName

    ) {

        public boolean cpvAvailable() {

            return cpvTable != null
                    &&
                    cpvTenderId != null
                    &&
                    cpvCode != null;
        }


        public boolean awardsAvailable() {

            return awardTable != null
                    &&
                    awardId != null
                    &&
                    awardTenderId != null;
        }


        public boolean suppliersAvailable() {

            return awardsAvailable()
                    &&
                    supplierTable != null
                    &&
                    supplierAwardId != null
                    &&
                    supplierName != null;
        }

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/common/api/ApiExceptionHandler.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.common.api;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ConflictException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ForbiddenOperationException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.validation.FieldError;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(
            ConflictException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> conflict(

            ConflictException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        return response(

                HttpStatus.CONFLICT,

                exception.getMessage(),

                request,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    @ExceptionHandler(
            ApiAuthenticationException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> authentication(

            ApiAuthenticationException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        return response(

                HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,

                exception.getMessage(),

                request,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    @ExceptionHandler(
            ForbiddenOperationException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> forbidden(

            ForbiddenOperationException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        return response(

                HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,

                exception.getMessage(),

                request,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    @ExceptionHandler(
            InvalidRequestException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> invalidRequest(

            InvalidRequestException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        return response(

                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,

                exception.getMessage(),

                request,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    @ExceptionHandler(
            ResourceNotFoundException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> notFound(

            ResourceNotFoundException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        return response(

                HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,

                exception.getMessage(),

                request,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    @ExceptionHandler(
            MethodArgumentNotValidException.class
    )
    ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> validation(

            MethodArgumentNotValidException exception,

            HttpServletRequest request

    ) {

        List<FieldViolation> violations =

                exception
                        .getBindingResult()
                        .getFieldErrors()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::mapFieldError
                        )
                        .toList();


        return response(

                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,

                "Validation failed",

                request,

                violations

        );

    }


    private FieldViolation mapFieldError(
            FieldError error
    ) {

        return new FieldViolation(

                error.getField(),

                error.getDefaultMessage()
                        == null

                        ? "Invalid value"

                        : error.getDefaultMessage()

        );

    }


    private ResponseEntity<ApiErrorResponse> response(

            HttpStatus status,

            String message,

            HttpServletRequest request,

            List<FieldViolation> violations

    ) {

        return ResponseEntity
                .status(
                        status
                )
                .body(
                        new ApiErrorResponse(

                                Instant.now(),

                                status.value(),

                                status.getReasonPhrase(),

                                message,

                                request.getRequestURI(),

                                violations

                        )
                );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/company/application/CompanyProfileService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.company.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.company.api.CompanyProfileResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.company.api.MatchingProfileResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.company.api.UpdateCompanyProfileRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.BuyerType;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.CertificationValue;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.CompanyProfileEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.OperatingRegionValue;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.ReferenceProjectValue;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.TargetCpvValue;

import com.tenderpilot.company.infrastructure.CompanyProfileRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.tenant.CurrentPrincipal;
import com.tenderpilot.tenant.CurrentPrincipalService;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.net.URI;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CompanyProfileService {

    private final CompanyProfileRepository
            companyProfileRepository;


    private final CurrentPrincipalService
            currentPrincipalService;


    private final ProfileCompletenessCalculator
            completenessCalculator;


    public CompanyProfileService(

            CompanyProfileRepository companyProfileRepository,

            CurrentPrincipalService currentPrincipalService,

            ProfileCompletenessCalculator completenessCalculator

    ) {

        this.companyProfileRepository =
                companyProfileRepository;

        this.currentPrincipalService =
                currentPrincipalService;

        this.completenessCalculator =
                completenessCalculator;

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public CompanyProfileResponse current() {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        return companyProfileRepository
                .findByOrganizationId(
                        principal.organizationId()
                )
                .map(
                        this::map
                )
                .orElseGet(
                        () ->
                                empty(
                                        principal.organizationId()
                                )
                );

    }


    @Transactional
    public CompanyProfileResponse upsert(
            UpdateCompanyProfileRequest request
    ) {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        validate(
                request
        );


        CompanyProfileEntity profile =

                companyProfileRepository
                        .findByOrganizationId(
                                principal.organizationId()
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        CompanyProfileEntity
                                                .create(
                                                        principal.organizationId()
                                                )
                        );


        profile.update(

                cleanRequired(
                        request.legalName()
                ),

                cleanOptional(
                        request.tradingName()
                ),

                cleanRequired(
                        request.industry()
                ),

                cleanRequired(
                        request.description()
                ),

                normalizeWebsite(
                        request.websiteUrl()
                ),

                upper(
                        request.countryCode()
                ),

                cleanRequired(
                        request.headquartersCity()
                ),

                request.employeeBand(),

                request.annualRevenueBand(),

                request.preferredMinContractValue(),

                request.preferredMaxContractValue(),

                upperOptional(
                        request.preferredCurrency()
                ),

                request.yearsExperience(),

                request.minimumNoticeDays(),

                normalizeStrings(
                        request.capabilities()
                ),

                normalizeRegions(
                        request.operatingRegions()
                ),

                normalizeCpvs(
                        request.targetCpvs()
                ),

                normalizeCertifications(
                        request.certifications()
                ),

                normalizeReferences(
                        request.referenceProjects()
                ),

                normalizeBuyerTypes(
                        request.preferredBuyerTypes()
                ),

                normalizeStrings(
                        request.excludedKeywords()
                )

        );


        CompanyProfileEntity saved =

                companyProfileRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                profile
                        );


        return map(
                saved
        );

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public MatchingProfileResponse matchingSnapshot() {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        CompanyProfileEntity profile =

                companyProfileRepository
                        .findByOrganizationId(
                                principal.organizationId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                profile == null
        ) {

            return new MatchingProfileResponse(

                    principal.organizationId(),

                    null,

                    0,

                    false,

                    null,

                    null,

                    null,

                    null,

                    null,

                    null,

                    null,

                    List.of(),

                    List.of(),

                    List.of(),

                    List.of(),

                    List.of(),

                    List.of(),

                    List.of()

            );

        }


        CompanyProfileResponse.ProfileCompletenessResponse
                completeness =

                completenessCalculator
                        .calculate(
                                profile
                        );


        boolean ready =

                completeness.score()
                        >= 60

                &&
                !profile
                        .getCapabilities()
                        .isEmpty()

                &&
                !profile
                        .getOperatingRegions()
                        .isEmpty()

                &&
                !profile
                        .getTargetCpvs()
                        .isEmpty();


        return new MatchingProfileResponse(

                profile.getOrganizationId(),

                profile.getId(),

                completeness.score(),

                ready,

                profile.getIndustry(),

                profile.getCountryCode(),

                profile.getPreferredMinContractValue(),

                profile.getPreferredMaxContractValue(),

                profile.getPreferredCurrency(),

                profile.getYearsExperience(),

                profile.getMinimumNoticeDays(),

                profile.getCapabilities(),

                profile
                        .getOperatingRegions()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .OperatingRegionResponse(

                                                        value.getCountryCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionName()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getTargetCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .TargetCpvResponse(

                                                        value.getCode(),

                                                        value.getLabel()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getCertifications()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                CertificationValue::getName
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getReferenceProjects()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new MatchingProfileResponse
                                                .ReferenceSignal(

                                                        value.getProjectName(),

                                                        value.getClientName(),

                                                        value.getCountryCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionName(),

                                                        value.getContractValue(),

                                                        value.getCurrency(),

                                                        value.getDescription()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile.getPreferredBuyerTypes(),

                profile.getExcludedKeywords()

        );

    }


    private void validate(
            UpdateCompanyProfileRequest request
    ) {

        BigDecimal minimum =
                request.preferredMinContractValue();


        BigDecimal maximum =
                request.preferredMaxContractValue();


        if (
                minimum != null
                &&
                maximum != null
                &&
                minimum.compareTo(
                        maximum
                )
                >
                0
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Preferred minimum contract value cannot exceed the maximum contract value"
            );

        }


        if (
                (
                        minimum != null
                        ||
                        maximum != null
                )
                &&
                cleanOptional(
                        request.preferredCurrency()
                )
                ==
                null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Preferred currency is required when a contract-value range is configured"
            );

        }


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.CertificationInput
                        certification :
                request.certifications()
        ) {

            if (
                    certification.validFrom()
                            != null

                    &&
                    certification.expiresOn()
                            != null

                    &&
                    certification
                            .validFrom()
                            .isAfter(
                                    certification.expiresOn()
                            )
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Certification validity start date cannot be after its expiration date"
                );

            }

        }


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.ReferenceProjectInput
                        project :
                request.referenceProjects()
        ) {

            if (
                    project.startedOn()
                            != null

                    &&
                    project.completedOn()
                            != null

                    &&
                    project
                            .startedOn()
                            .isAfter(
                                    project.completedOn()
                            )
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Reference project start date cannot be after its completion date"
                );

            }


            if (
                    project.contractValue()
                            != null

                    &&
                    cleanOptional(
                            project.currency()
                    )
                    ==
                    null
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Reference project currency is required when a contract value is configured"
                );

            }

        }

    }


    private List<String> normalizeStrings(
            List<String> values
    ) {

        Map<String, String> distinct =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                String value :
                values
        ) {

            String cleaned =
                    cleanRequired(
                            value
                    );


            distinct.putIfAbsent(

                    cleaned
                            .toLowerCase(
                                    Locale.ROOT
                            ),

                    cleaned

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct.values()
        );

    }


    private List<OperatingRegionValue> normalizeRegions(
            List<UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.OperatingRegionInput>
                    values
    ) {

        Map<String, OperatingRegionValue> distinct =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.OperatingRegionInput value :
                values
        ) {

            OperatingRegionValue normalized =

                    new OperatingRegionValue(

                            upper(
                                    value.countryCode()
                            ),

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.regionCode()
                            )
                                    .toUpperCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    ),

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.regionName()
                            )

                    );


            String key =

                    normalized.getCountryCode()
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            normalized.getRegionCode();


            distinct.putIfAbsent(
                    key,
                    normalized
            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct.values()
        );

    }


    private List<TargetCpvValue> normalizeCpvs(
            List<UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.TargetCpvInput>
                    values
    ) {

        Map<String, TargetCpvValue> distinct =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.TargetCpvInput value :
                values
        ) {

            String code =
                    value.code()
                            .trim();


            distinct.putIfAbsent(

                    code,

                    new TargetCpvValue(

                            code,

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.label()
                            )

                    )

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct.values()
        );

    }


    private List<CertificationValue> normalizeCertifications(
            List<UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.CertificationInput>
                    values
    ) {

        List<CertificationValue> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.CertificationInput value :
                values
        ) {

            result.add(

                    new CertificationValue(

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.name()
                            ),

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.issuer()
                            ),

                            cleanOptional(
                                    value.certificateNumber()
                            ),

                            value.validFrom(),

                            value.expiresOn()

                    )

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );

    }


    private List<ReferenceProjectValue> normalizeReferences(
            List<UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.ReferenceProjectInput>
                    values
    ) {

        List<ReferenceProjectValue> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                UpdateCompanyProfileRequest.ReferenceProjectInput value :
                values
        ) {

            result.add(

                    new ReferenceProjectValue(

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.projectName()
                            ),

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.clientName()
                            ),

                            upper(
                                    value.countryCode()
                            ),

                            cleanOptional(
                                    value.regionName()
                            ),

                            value.contractValue(),

                            upperOptional(
                                    value.currency()
                            ),

                            value.startedOn(),

                            value.completedOn(),

                            cleanRequired(
                                    value.description()
                            )

                    )

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );

    }


    private List<BuyerType> normalizeBuyerTypes(
            List<BuyerType> values
    ) {

        Set<BuyerType> distinct =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        values
                );


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct
        );

    }


    private String normalizeWebsite(
            String website
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                cleanOptional(
                        website
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        try {

            URI uri =
                    URI.create(
                            cleaned
                    );


            if (
                    !(
                            "http"
                                    .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                            uri.getScheme()
                                    )

                            ||
                            "https"
                                    .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                            uri.getScheme()
                                    )
                    )
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Website URL must use http or https"
                );

            }


            if (
                    uri.getHost()
                            ==
                            null
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Website URL must contain a valid host"
                );

            }


            return uri.toString();


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Website URL is invalid"
            );

        }

    }


    private CompanyProfileResponse map(
            CompanyProfileEntity profile
    ) {

        CompanyProfileResponse.ProfileCompletenessResponse
                completeness =

                completenessCalculator
                        .calculate(
                                profile
                        );


        return new CompanyProfileResponse(

                true,

                profile.getOrganizationId(),

                profile.getId(),

                profile.getLegalName(),

                profile.getTradingName(),

                profile.getIndustry(),

                profile.getDescription(),

                profile.getWebsiteUrl(),

                profile.getCountryCode(),

                profile.getHeadquartersCity(),

                profile.getEmployeeBand(),

                profile.getAnnualRevenueBand(),

                profile.getPreferredMinContractValue(),

                profile.getPreferredMaxContractValue(),

                profile.getPreferredCurrency(),

                profile.getYearsExperience(),

                profile.getMinimumNoticeDays(),

                profile.getCapabilities(),

                profile
                        .getOperatingRegions()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .OperatingRegionResponse(

                                                        value.getCountryCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionName()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getTargetCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .TargetCpvResponse(

                                                        value.getCode(),

                                                        value.getLabel()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getCertifications()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .CertificationResponse(

                                                        value.getName(),

                                                        value.getIssuer(),

                                                        value.getCertificateNumber(),

                                                        value.getValidFrom(),

                                                        value.getExpiresOn(),

                                                        certificationStatus(
                                                                value.getExpiresOn()
                                                        )

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile
                        .getReferenceProjects()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CompanyProfileResponse
                                                .ReferenceProjectResponse(

                                                        value.getProjectName(),

                                                        value.getClientName(),

                                                        value.getCountryCode(),

                                                        value.getRegionName(),

                                                        value.getContractValue(),

                                                        value.getCurrency(),

                                                        value.getStartedOn(),

                                                        value.getCompletedOn(),

                                                        value.getDescription()

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                profile.getPreferredBuyerTypes(),

                profile.getExcludedKeywords(),

                completeness,

                profile.getCreatedAt(),

                profile.getUpdatedAt()

        );

    }


    private CompanyProfileResponse empty(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        return CompanyProfileResponse
                .empty(

                        organizationId,

                        completenessCalculator
                                .calculate(
                                        null
                                )

                );

    }


    private String certificationStatus(
            LocalDate expiresOn
    ) {

        if (
                expiresOn == null
        ) {

            return "UNKNOWN";

        }


        if (
                expiresOn.isBefore(
                        LocalDate.now()
                )
        ) {

            return "EXPIRED";

        }


        return "ACTIVE";

    }


    private String cleanRequired(
            String value
    ) {

        return value
                .trim()
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\s+",
                        " "
                );

    }


    private String cleanOptional(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }


    private String upper(
            String value
    ) {

        return cleanRequired(
                value
        )
                .toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }


    private String upperOptional(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                cleanOptional(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? null
                : cleaned.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.company.application;

import com.tenderpilot.company.api.CompanyProfileResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.company.domain.CompanyProfileEntity;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class ProfileCompletenessCalculator {

    public CompanyProfileResponse.ProfileCompletenessResponse calculate(
            CompanyProfileEntity profile
    ) {

        if (
                profile == null
        ) {

            return new CompanyProfileResponse
                    .ProfileCompletenessResponse(

                            0,

                            emptySections()

                    );

        }


        List<CompanyProfileResponse.CompletenessSectionResponse>
                sections =
                new ArrayList<>();


        int identity =
                0;

        identity += present(
                profile.getLegalName()
        )
                ? 4
                : 0;

        identity += present(
                profile.getIndustry()
        )
                ? 4
                : 0;

        identity += present(
                profile.getDescription()
        )
                ? 4
                : 0;

        identity += present(
                profile.getCountryCode()
        )
                ? 4
                : 0;

        identity += present(
                profile.getHeadquartersCity()
        )
                ? 4
                : 0;


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "identity",
                        "Company identity",
                        identity,
                        20
                )
        );


        int commercial =
                0;

        commercial +=
                profile.getPreferredMinContractValue()
                        != null
                        ? 4
                        : 0;

        commercial +=
                profile.getPreferredMaxContractValue()
                        != null
                        ? 4
                        : 0;

        commercial +=
                present(
                        profile.getPreferredCurrency()
                )
                        ? 2
                        : 0;

        commercial +=
                profile.getYearsExperience()
                        != null
                        ? 3
                        : 0;

        commercial +=
                profile.getMinimumNoticeDays()
                        != null
                        ? 2
                        : 0;


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "commercial",
                        "Commercial strategy",
                        commercial,
                        15
                )
        );


        int capabilities =

                Math.min(
                        20,
                        profile
                                .getCapabilities()
                                .size()
                                *
                                4
                );


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "capabilities",
                        "Capabilities",
                        capabilities,
                        20
                )
        );


        int regions =

                Math.min(
                        10,
                        profile
                                .getOperatingRegions()
                                .size()
                                *
                                5
                );


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "geography",
                        "Operating geography",
                        regions,
                        10
                )
        );


        int cpvs =

                Math.min(
                        10,
                        profile
                                .getTargetCpvs()
                                .size()
                                *
                                2
                );


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "cpv",
                        "Target CPV codes",
                        cpvs,
                        10
                )
        );


        int certifications =

                Math.min(
                        10,
                        profile
                                .getCertifications()
                                .size()
                                *
                                5
                );


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "certifications",
                        "Certifications",
                        certifications,
                        10
                )
        );


        int references =

                Math.min(
                        15,
                        profile
                                .getReferenceProjects()
                                .size()
                                *
                                5
                );


        sections.add(
                section(
                        "references",
                        "Reference projects",
                        references,
                        15
                )
        );


        int total =

                sections
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                CompanyProfileResponse
                                        .CompletenessSectionResponse
                                        ::points
                        )
                        .sum();


        return new CompanyProfileResponse
                .ProfileCompletenessResponse(

                        total,

                        List.copyOf(
                                sections
                        )

                );

    }


    private List<
            CompanyProfileResponse.CompletenessSectionResponse
            > emptySections() {

        return List.of(

                section(
                        "identity",
                        "Company identity",
                        0,
                        20
                ),

                section(
                        "commercial",
                        "Commercial strategy",
                        0,
                        15
                ),

                section(
                        "capabilities",
                        "Capabilities",
                        0,
                        20
                ),

                section(
                        "geography",
                        "Operating geography",
                        0,
                        10
                ),

                section(
                        "cpv",
                        "Target CPV codes",
                        0,
                        10
                ),

                section(
                        "certifications",
                        "Certifications",
                        0,
                        10
                ),

                section(
                        "references",
                        "Reference projects",
                        0,
                        15
                )

        );

    }


    private CompanyProfileResponse.CompletenessSectionResponse
    section(

            String key,

            String label,

            int points,

            int maximum

    ) {

        return new CompanyProfileResponse
                .CompletenessSectionResponse(

                        key,

                        label,

                        points,

                        maximum

                );

    }


    private boolean present(
            String value
    ) {

        return value != null
                &&
                !value.isBlank();

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.company.domain;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Embeddable;

import java.time.LocalDate;

@Embeddable
public class CertificationValue {

    @Column(
            name = "certification_name",
            nullable = false,
            length = 180
    )
    private String name;


    @Column(
            name = "issuer",
            nullable = false,
            length = 180
    )
    private String issuer;


    @Column(
            name = "certificate_number",
            length = 160
    )
    private String certificateNumber;


    @Column(
            name = "valid_from"
    )
    private LocalDate validFrom;


    @Column(
            name = "expires_on"
    )
    private LocalDate expiresOn;


    protected CertificationValue() {
    }


    public CertificationValue(

            String name,

            String issuer,

            String certificateNumber,

            LocalDate validFrom,

            LocalDate expiresOn

    ) {

        this.name =
                name;

        this.issuer =
                issuer;

        this.certificateNumber =
                certificateNumber;

        this.validFrom =
                validFrom;

        this.expiresOn =
                expiresOn;

    }


    public String getName() {

        return name;

    }


    public String getIssuer() {

        return issuer;

    }


    public String getCertificateNumber() {

        return certificateNumber;

    }


    public LocalDate getValidFrom() {

        return validFrom;

    }


    public LocalDate getExpiresOn() {

        return expiresOn;

    }

}

            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant updatedAt;


    protected CompanyProfileEntity() {
    }


    private CompanyProfileEntity(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        this.id =
                UUID.randomUUID();

        this.organizationId =
                organizationId;

    }

            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        return new CompanyProfileEntity(
                organizationId
        );

    }


    public void update(

            String legalName,

            String tradingName,

            String industry,

            String description,

            String websiteUrl,

            String countryCode,

            String headquartersCity,

            EmployeeBand employeeBand,

            AnnualRevenueBand annualRevenueBand,

            BigDecimal preferredMinContractValue,

            BigDecimal preferredMaxContractValue,

            String preferredCurrency,

            Integer yearsExperience,

            Integer minimumNoticeDays,

            List<String> capabilities,

            List<OperatingRegionValue> operatingRegions,

            List<TargetCpvValue> targetCpvs,

            List<CertificationValue> certifications,

            List<ReferenceProjectValue> referenceProjects,

            List<BuyerType> preferredBuyerTypes,

            List<String> excludedKeywords

    ) {

        this.legalName =
                legalName;

        this.tradingName =
                tradingName;

        this.industry =
                industry;

    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {

        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        if (
                id == null
        ) {

            id =
                    UUID.randomUUID();

        }


        createdAt =
                createdAt == null
                        ? now
                        : createdAt;

        updatedAt =
                now;

    }


    @PreUpdate
    void beforeUpdate() {

        updatedAt =
                Instant.now();

    }

package com.tenderpilot.compliance.api;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.application.BidComplianceService;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.security.CurrentOrganizationResolver;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/compliance"
)
@PreAuthorize(
        "isAuthenticated()"
)
public class BidComplianceController {

    private final BidComplianceService
            complianceService;


    private final CurrentOrganizationResolver
            organizationResolver;


    public BidComplianceController(
            BidComplianceService complianceService,
            CurrentOrganizationResolver organizationResolver
    ) {

        this.complianceService =
                complianceService;

        this.organizationResolver =
                organizationResolver;
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/bid-workspaces/{tenderId}"
    )
    public BidComplianceMatrixResponse matrix(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return complianceService
                .matrix(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId
                );
    }


    @PutMapping(
            "/bid-workspaces/{tenderId}/requirements/{requirementId}"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER','ANALYST')"
    )
    public BidComplianceMatrixResponse review(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId,
            @PathVariable
            UUID requirementId,
            @RequestBody
            UpdateComplianceReviewRequest request
    ) {

        return complianceService
                .review(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId,
                        requirementId,
                        request,
                        authentication.getName()
                );
    }

}
