===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/compliance/application/BidComplianceService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.compliance.application;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementStatus;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure.BidRequirementRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.api.BidComplianceMatrixResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.api.UpdateComplianceReviewRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.BidComplianceReviewEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceReadiness;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRequirementSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRiskLevel;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceVerdict;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.EvidenceStrength;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.infrastructure.BidComplianceReviewRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class BidComplianceService {

    private final TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    private final BidDecisionRepository
            decisionRepository;


    private final BidRequirementRepository
            requirementRepository;


    private final BidComplianceReviewRepository
            reviewRepository;


    private final ComplianceReadinessEngine
            readinessEngine;


    public BidComplianceService(
            TenderMatchRepository matchRepository,
            BidDecisionRepository decisionRepository,
            BidRequirementRepository requirementRepository,
            BidComplianceReviewRepository reviewRepository,
            ComplianceReadinessEngine readinessEngine
    ) {

        this.matchRepository =
                matchRepository;

        this.decisionRepository =
                decisionRepository;

        this.requirementRepository =
                requirementRepository;

        this.reviewRepository =
                reviewRepository;

        this.readinessEngine =
                readinessEngine;
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BidComplianceMatrixResponse matrix(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        requireMatch(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );


        return buildMatrix(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public BidComplianceMatrixResponse review(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID requirementId,
            UpdateComplianceReviewRequest request,
            String actor
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireWritableMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                request == null
                ||
                request.verdict() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Compliance verdict is required"
            );
        }


        BidRequirementEntity requirement =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByIdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                requirementId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Bid requirement was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        NormalizedReview normalized =
                normalizeReview(
                        request
                );


        BidComplianceReviewEntity review =
                reviewRepository
                        .findByRequirement_IdAndOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                requirementId,
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        BidComplianceReviewEntity
                                                .create(
                                                        organizationId,
                                                        match.getTender(),
                                                        requirement
                                                )
                        );


        review.review(
                normalized.verdict(),

                normalized.riskLevel(),

                normalized.evidenceStrength(),

                clean(
                        request.reviewRationale()
                ),

                clean(
                        request.mitigationAction()
                ),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        reviewRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        review
                );


        BidRequirementStatus synchronizedStatus =
                requirementStatus(
                        normalized.verdict()
                );


        requirement.update(
                requirement.getSourceDocument(),

                requirement.getTitle(),

                requirement.getDescription(),

                requirement.getCategory(),

                synchronizedStatus,

                requirement.isMandatory(),

                requirement.getSourceReference(),

                requirement.getDueDate(),

                requirement.getAssignedTo(),

                requirement.getEvidenceNotes(),

                actor(
                        actor
                )
        );


        requirementRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        requirement
                );


        return buildMatrix(
                organizationId,
                tenderId
        );
    }


    private BidComplianceMatrixResponse buildMatrix(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        List<BidRequirementEntity> requirements =
                requirementRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_IdOrderByMandatoryDescCreatedAtAsc(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        Map<UUID, BidComplianceReviewEntity> reviews =
                new HashMap<>();


        for (
                BidComplianceReviewEntity review :
                reviewRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
        ) {

            reviews.put(
                    review
                            .getRequirement()
                            .getId(),
                    review
            );
        }


        List<ComplianceRequirementSnapshot> snapshots =
                requirements
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                requirement ->
                                        snapshot(
                                                requirement,
                                                reviews.get(
                                                        requirement.getId()
                                                )
                                        )
                        )
                        .toList();


        ComplianceReadiness readiness =
                readinessEngine
                        .calculate(
                                snapshots
                        );


        int reviewed =
                (int)
                        snapshots
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        snapshot ->
                                                snapshot.verdict()
                                                        !=
                                                        ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED
                                )
                                .count();


        int mandatory =
                (int)
                        requirements
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        BidRequirementEntity::isMandatory
                                )
                                .count();


        int compliant =
                count(
                        snapshots,
                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT
                );


        int partial =
                count(
                        snapshots,
                        ComplianceVerdict.PARTIAL
                );


        int nonCompliant =
                count(
                        snapshots,
                        ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT
                );


        int unassessed =
                count(
                        snapshots,
                        ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        BidDecisionOutcome outcome =
                decision == null
                        ? null
                        : decision.getOutcome();


        boolean writable =
                outcome
                        !=
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO;


        List<BidComplianceMatrixResponse.Row> rows =
                requirements
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                requirement ->
                                        row(
                                                requirement,
                                                reviews.get(
                                                        requirement.getId()
                                                )
                                        )
                        )
                        .toList();


        return new BidComplianceMatrixResponse(
                tenderId,

                outcome,

                writable,

                writable
                        ? null
                        : "Current bid decision is NO-GO. Reopen the decision before changing compliance reviews.",

                new BidComplianceMatrixResponse
                        .Statistics(
                                requirements.size(),

                                reviewed,

                                mandatory,

                                compliant,

                                partial,

                                nonCompliant,

                                unassessed,

                                readiness.mandatoryBlockerCount(),

                                readiness.mandatoryIncompleteCount(),

                                readiness.criticalRiskCount(),

                                readiness.readinessScore(),

                                readiness.readyForSubmission()
                        ),

                rows
        );
    }


    private BidComplianceMatrixResponse.Row row(
            BidRequirementEntity requirement,
            BidComplianceReviewEntity review
    ) {

        ComplianceRequirementSnapshot snapshot =
                snapshot(
                        requirement,
                        review
                );


        return new BidComplianceMatrixResponse
                .Row(
                        requirement.getId(),

                        requirement.getTitle(),

                        requirement.getDescription(),

                        requirement.getCategory(),

                        requirement.getStatus(),

                        requirement.isMandatory(),

                        requirement.getSourceDocument()
                                ==
                                null
                                ? null
                                : requirement
                                        .getSourceDocument()
                                        .getId(),

                        requirement.getSourceDocument()
                                ==
                                null
                                ? null
                                : requirement
                                        .getSourceDocument()
                                        .getOriginalFilename(),

                        requirement.getSourceReference(),

                        requirement.getDueDate(),

                        requirement.getAssignedTo(),

                        requirement.getEvidenceNotes(),

                        snapshot.verdict(),

                        snapshot.riskLevel(),

                        snapshot.evidenceStrength(),

                        readinessEngine
                                .rowScore(
                                        snapshot.verdict(),
                                        snapshot.riskLevel(),
                                        snapshot.evidenceStrength()
                                ),

                        readinessEngine
                                .priority(
                                        snapshot
                                ),

                        readinessEngine
                                .nextAction(
                                        snapshot
                                ),

                        review == null
                                ? null
                                : review.getReviewRationale(),

                        review == null
                                ? null
                                : review.getMitigationAction(),

                        review == null
                                ? null
                                : review.getReviewedBy(),

                        review == null
                                ? null
                                : review.getReviewedAt()
                );
    }


    private ComplianceRequirementSnapshot snapshot(
            BidRequirementEntity requirement,
            BidComplianceReviewEntity review
    ) {

        if (
                review == null
        ) {

            return new ComplianceRequirementSnapshot(
                    requirement.isMandatory(),
                    ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED,
                    ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED,
                    EvidenceStrength.NONE
            );
        }


        return new ComplianceRequirementSnapshot(
                requirement.isMandatory(),
                review.getVerdict(),
                review.getRiskLevel(),
                review.getEvidenceStrength()
        );
    }


    private int count(
            List<ComplianceRequirementSnapshot> snapshots,
            ComplianceVerdict verdict
    ) {

        return (int)
                snapshots
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                snapshot ->
                                        snapshot.verdict()
                                                ==
                                                verdict
                        )
                        .count();
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "No company-to-tender match exists for this organization and opportunity"
                                )
                );
    }


    private TenderMatchEntity requireWritableMatch(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                requireMatch(
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                );


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                decisionRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                decision != null
                &&
                decision.getOutcome()
                        ==
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Compliance matrix is locked because the current bid decision is NO-GO"
            );
        }


        return match;
    }


    private NormalizedReview normalizeReview(
            UpdateComplianceReviewRequest request
    ) {

        ComplianceVerdict verdict =
                request.verdict();


        if (
                verdict
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED
        ) {

            return new NormalizedReview(
                    verdict,
                    ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED,
                    EvidenceStrength.NONE
            );
        }


        if (
                verdict
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE
        ) {

            return new NormalizedReview(
                    verdict,
                    ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED,
                    EvidenceStrength.NONE
            );
        }


        if (
                request.riskLevel() == null
                ||
                request.riskLevel()
                        ==
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Risk level must be assessed for reviewed requirements"
            );
        }


        EvidenceStrength evidenceStrength =
                request.evidenceStrength() == null
                        ? EvidenceStrength.NONE
                        : request.evidenceStrength();


        if (
                (
                        verdict
                                ==
                                ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT
                        ||
                        verdict
                                ==
                                ComplianceVerdict.PARTIAL
                )
                &&
                evidenceStrength
                        ==
                        EvidenceStrength.NONE
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Compliant or partial requirements require supporting evidence strength"
            );
        }


        return new NormalizedReview(
                verdict,
                request.riskLevel(),
                evidenceStrength
        );
    }


    private BidRequirementStatus requirementStatus(
            ComplianceVerdict verdict
    ) {

        return switch (
                verdict
        ) {

            case UNASSESSED ->
                    BidRequirementStatus.NOT_REVIEWED;

            case COMPLIANT ->
                    BidRequirementStatus.SATISFIED;

            case PARTIAL ->
                    BidRequirementStatus.IN_PROGRESS;

            case NON_COMPLIANT ->
                    BidRequirementStatus.GAP;

            case NOT_APPLICABLE ->
                    BidRequirementStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE;
        };
    }


    private String actor(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? "unknown"
                : cleaned;
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }


    private record NormalizedReview(

            ComplianceVerdict verdict,

            ComplianceRiskLevel riskLevel,

            EvidenceStrength evidenceStrength

    ) {
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/compliance/application/ComplianceReadinessEngine.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.compliance.application;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.CompliancePriority;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceReadiness;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRequirementSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRiskLevel;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceVerdict;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.EvidenceStrength;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class ComplianceReadinessEngine {

    public ComplianceReadiness calculate(
            List<ComplianceRequirementSnapshot> requirements
    ) {

        if (
                requirements == null
                ||
                requirements.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return new ComplianceReadiness(
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    false
            );
        }


        double weightedPoints =
                0;

        double totalWeight =
                0;


        int mandatoryBlockers =
                0;

        int mandatoryIncomplete =
                0;

        int criticalRisks =
                0;


        for (
                ComplianceRequirementSnapshot requirement :
                requirements
        ) {

            double weight =
                    requirement.mandatory()
                            ? 2.0
                            : 1.0;


            weightedPoints +=
                    rowScore(
                            requirement.verdict(),
                            requirement.riskLevel(),
                            requirement.evidenceStrength()
                    )
                            *
                            weight;


            totalWeight +=
                    weight;


            if (
                    requirement.mandatory()
                    &&
                    requirement.verdict()
                            ==
                            ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT
            ) {

                mandatoryBlockers++;
            }


            if (
                    requirement.mandatory()
                    &&
                    requirement.verdict()
                            !=
                            ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT
                    &&
                    requirement.verdict()
                            !=
                            ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE
            ) {

                mandatoryIncomplete++;
            }


            if (
                    requirement.riskLevel()
                            ==
                            ComplianceRiskLevel.CRITICAL
                    &&
                    requirement.verdict()
                            !=
                            ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE
            ) {

                criticalRisks++;
            }
        }


        int score =
                totalWeight == 0
                        ? 0
                        : (int)
                                Math.round(
                                        weightedPoints
                                                /
                                                totalWeight
                                );


        score =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                score
                        )
                );


        boolean ready =
                score >= 80
                &&
                mandatoryBlockers == 0
                &&
                mandatoryIncomplete == 0
                &&
                criticalRisks == 0;


        return new ComplianceReadiness(
                score,
                mandatoryBlockers,
                mandatoryIncomplete,
                criticalRisks,
                ready
        );
    }


    public int rowScore(
            ComplianceVerdict verdict,
            ComplianceRiskLevel riskLevel,
            EvidenceStrength evidenceStrength
    ) {

        int base =
                switch (
                        verdict
                ) {

                    case COMPLIANT ->
                            100;

                    case PARTIAL ->
                            60;

                    case NON_COMPLIANT ->
                            0;

                    case UNASSESSED ->
                            20;

                    case NOT_APPLICABLE ->
                            100;
                };


        if (
                verdict
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE
        ) {

            return 100;
        }


        int evidencePenalty =
                switch (
                        evidenceStrength
                ) {

                    case STRONG ->
                            0;

                    case MODERATE ->
                            5;

                    case WEAK ->
                            15;

                    case NONE ->
                            (
                                    verdict
                                            ==
                                            ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT
                                    ||
                                    verdict
                                            ==
                                            ComplianceVerdict.PARTIAL
                            )
                                    ? 25
                                    : 0;
                };


        int riskPenalty =
                switch (
                        riskLevel
                ) {

                    case UNASSESSED, LOW ->
                            0;

                    case MEDIUM ->
                            5;

                    case HIGH ->
                            12;

                    case CRITICAL ->
                            20;
                };


        return Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                        100,
                        base
                                -
                                evidencePenalty
                                -
                                riskPenalty
                )
        );
    }


    public CompliancePriority priority(
            ComplianceRequirementSnapshot requirement
    ) {

        if (
                requirement.mandatory()
                &&
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT
        ) {

            return CompliancePriority.BLOCKER;
        }


        if (
                requirement.riskLevel()
                        ==
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.CRITICAL
        ) {

            return CompliancePriority.CRITICAL;
        }


        if (
                requirement.mandatory()
                &&
                (
                        requirement.verdict()
                                ==
                                ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED
                        ||
                        requirement.verdict()
                                ==
                                ComplianceVerdict.PARTIAL
                )
        ) {

            return CompliancePriority.HIGH;
        }


        if (
                requirement.riskLevel()
                        ==
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.HIGH
        ) {

            return CompliancePriority.HIGH;
        }


        if (
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT
                &&
                requirement.evidenceStrength()
                        ==
                        EvidenceStrength.STRONG
        ) {

            return CompliancePriority.LOW;
        }


        return CompliancePriority.MEDIUM;
    }


    public String nextAction(
            ComplianceRequirementSnapshot requirement
    ) {

        if (
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE
        ) {

            return "No further compliance action is required.";
        }


        if (
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED
        ) {

            return "Review the requirement and record a compliance verdict.";
        }


        if (
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT
        ) {

            return requirement.mandatory()
                    ? "Resolve this mandatory compliance gap before submission."
                    : "Resolve or formally accept this compliance gap.";
        }


        if (
                requirement.verdict()
                        ==
                        ComplianceVerdict.PARTIAL
        ) {

            return "Complete the outstanding response and supporting evidence.";
        }


        if (
                requirement.riskLevel()
                        ==
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.CRITICAL
                ||
                requirement.riskLevel()
                        ==
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.HIGH
        ) {

            return "Mitigate the identified compliance risk and re-review.";
        }


        if (
                requirement.evidenceStrength()
                        ==
                        EvidenceStrength.NONE
                ||
                requirement.evidenceStrength()
                        ==
                        EvidenceStrength.WEAK
        ) {

            return "Strengthen the supporting evidence before final submission.";
        }


        return "Requirement is compliance-ready; preserve the supporting evidence.";
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.domain.BidRequirementEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.ManyToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.OneToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.PrePersist;
import jakarta.persistence.PreUpdate;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import jakarta.persistence.UniqueConstraint;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "organization_bid_compliance_reviews",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(
                name = "uk_bid_compliance_requirement",
                columnNames = {
                        "requirement_id"
                }
        )
)
public class BidComplianceReviewEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;


    @Column(
            name = "organization_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private UUID organizationId;


    @ManyToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "tender_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private TenderEntity tender;


    @OneToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "requirement_id",
            nullable = false,
            unique = true
    )
    private BidRequirementEntity requirement;


    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(
            name = "verdict",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private ComplianceVerdict verdict;


    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(
            name = "risk_level",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private ComplianceRiskLevel riskLevel;


    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(
            name = "evidence_strength",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private EvidenceStrength evidenceStrength;


    @Column(
            name = "review_rationale",
            length = 3000
    )
    private String reviewRationale;


    @Column(
            name = "mitigation_action",
            length = 3000
    )
    private String mitigationAction;


    @Column(
            name = "reviewed_by",
            nullable = false,
            length = 320
    )
    private String reviewedBy;


    @Column(
            name = "reviewed_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant reviewedAt;


    @Column(
            name = "created_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant createdAt;


    @Column(
            name = "updated_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant updatedAt;


    protected BidComplianceReviewEntity() {
    }


    private BidComplianceReviewEntity(
            UUID organizationId,
            TenderEntity tender,
            BidRequirementEntity requirement
    ) {

        this.id =
                UUID.randomUUID();

        this.organizationId =
                organizationId;

        this.tender =
                tender;

        this.requirement =
                requirement;

        this.verdict =
                ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED;

        this.riskLevel =
                ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED;

        this.evidenceStrength =
                EvidenceStrength.NONE;

        this.reviewedBy =
                "unknown";

        this.reviewedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }


    public static BidComplianceReviewEntity create(
            UUID organizationId,
            TenderEntity tender,
            BidRequirementEntity requirement
    ) {

        return new BidComplianceReviewEntity(
                organizationId,
                tender,
                requirement
        );
    }


    public void review(
            ComplianceVerdict verdict,
            ComplianceRiskLevel riskLevel,
            EvidenceStrength evidenceStrength,
            String reviewRationale,
            String mitigationAction,
            String reviewedBy
    ) {

        this.verdict =
                verdict;

        this.riskLevel =
                riskLevel;

        this.evidenceStrength =
                evidenceStrength;

        this.reviewRationale =
                reviewRationale;

        this.mitigationAction =
                mitigationAction;

        this.reviewedBy =
                reviewedBy;

        this.reviewedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }


    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {

        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        if (
                id == null
        ) {

            id =
                    UUID.randomUUID();
        }


        if (
                createdAt == null
        ) {

            createdAt =
                    now;
        }


        if (
                reviewedAt == null
        ) {

            reviewedAt =
                    now;
        }


        updatedAt =
                now;
    }


    @PreUpdate
    void beforeUpdate() {

        updatedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }


    public UUID getId() {
        return id;
    }


    public UUID getOrganizationId() {
        return organizationId;
    }


    public TenderEntity getTender() {
        return tender;

    public BidRequirementEntity getRequirement() {

    }

        return reviewRationale;
    }


    public String getMitigationAction() {
        return mitigationAction;
    }


    public String getReviewedBy() {
        return reviewedBy;
    }


    public Instant getReviewedAt() {
        return reviewedAt;
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.config;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.CorsRegistry;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;

@Configuration
public class WebConfiguration
        implements WebMvcConfigurer {

    private final CorsProperties corsProperties;


    public WebConfiguration(
            CorsProperties corsProperties
    ) {

        this.corsProperties =
                corsProperties;

    }


    @Override
    public void addCorsMappings(
            CorsRegistry registry
    ) {

        registry
                .addMapping(
                        "/api/**"
                )

                .allowedOrigins(
                        corsProperties
                                .allowedOrigins()
                                .toArray(
                                        String[]::new
                                )
                )

                .allowedMethods(
                        "GET",
                        "POST",
                        "PUT",
                        "PATCH",
                        "DELETE",
                        "OPTIONS"
                )

                .allowedHeaders(
                        "*"
                )

                .allowCredentials(
                        true
                )

                .maxAge(
                        3600
                );

    }

}

            int openTasks,

            int completedTasks,

            int overdueTasks,

            int blockedTasks,

            int criticalOpenTasks,

            boolean readyForSubmission,

            boolean submitted

    ) {
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/dashboard/application/DashboardCommandCenterService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.dashboard.application;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.api.DashboardCommandCenterResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardActionPriority;
import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardMarketSignal;
import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardMatchObservation;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class DashboardCommandCenterService {

    private final DashboardMatchGateway
            matchGateway;


    private final DashboardBidOperationalGateway
            operationalGateway;


    private final DashboardPublicMarketGateway
            publicMarketGateway;


    public DashboardCommandCenterService(
            DashboardMatchGateway matchGateway,
            DashboardBidOperationalGateway operationalGateway,
            DashboardPublicMarketGateway publicMarketGateway
    ) {

        this.matchGateway =
                matchGateway;

        this.operationalGateway =
                operationalGateway;

        this.publicMarketGateway =
                publicMarketGateway;
    }


    public DashboardCommandCenterResponse commandCenter(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        LocalDate today =
                LocalDate.now(
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                );


        List<DashboardMatchObservation> matches =
                matchGateway
                        .matches(
                                organizationId
                        );


        List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards =
                matches
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                match ->
                                        card(
                                                organizationId,
                                                match,
                                                today
                                        )
                        )
                        .sorted(
                                portfolioComparator()
                        )
                        .toList();


        DashboardMarketSignal market =
                marketSignal(
                        today
                );


        return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse(
                Instant.now(),

                summary(
                        cards
                ),

                new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                        .MarketContext(
                                market.available(),
                                market.noticeCount(),
                                market.activeNoticeCount(),
                                market.uniqueBuyerCount(),
                                market.uniqueObservedSupplierCount(),
                                market.buyerConcentration(),
                                market.supplierConcentration(),
                                market.leadingCpv(),
                                market.leadingCpvSharePercentage(),
                                market.awardCoveragePercentage()
                        ),

                actions(
                        cards
                ),

                cards
        );
    }


    private DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card(
            UUID organizationId,
            DashboardMatchObservation match,
            LocalDate today
    ) {

        DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot operational =
                operationalGateway
                        .snapshot(
                                organizationId,
                                match.tenderId()
                        );


        Long daysToDeadline =
                match.submissionDeadline() == null
                        ? null
                        : ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(
                                today,

                                match
                                        .submissionDeadline()
                                        .atOffset(
                                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                                        )
                                        .toLocalDate()
                        );


        return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                .BidCard(
                        match.tenderId(),
                        match.buyerId(),
                        match.tenderTitle(),
                        match.buyerName(),
                        match.matchScore(),
                        match.matchGrade(),
                        match.blocked(),
                        normalizedOutcome(
                                operational.decisionOutcome()
                        ),
                        match.submissionDeadline(),
                        daysToDeadline,
                        operational.complianceReady(),
                        operational.complianceReadinessScore(),
                        operational.openTasks(),
                        operational.completedTasks(),
                        operational.overdueTasks(),
                        operational.blockedTasks(),
                        operational.criticalOpenTasks(),
                        operational.readyForSubmission(),
                        operational.submitted()
                );
    }


    private DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Summary summary(
            List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards
    ) {

        int highPotential =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        card ->
                                                !card.matchBlocked()
                                                &&
                                                card.matchScore()
                                                        >=
                                                        70
                                )
                                .count();


        int blockedMatches =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                                .BidCard::matchBlocked
                                )
                                .count();


        int go =
                countOutcome(
                        cards,
                        "GO"
                );


        int hold =
                countOutcome(
                        cards,
                        "HOLD"
                );


        int noGo =
                countOutcome(
                        cards,
                        "NO_GO"
                );


        int pending =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        card ->
                                                card.decisionOutcome() == null
                                                ||
                                                card.decisionOutcome()
                                                        .equals(
                                                                "PENDING"
                                                        )
                                )
                                .count();


        int complianceReady =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                                .BidCard::complianceReady
                                )
                                .count();


        int readyForSubmission =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                                .BidCard::readyForSubmission
                                )
                                .count();


        int submitted =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                                .BidCard::submitted
                                )
                                .count();


        int openTasks =
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                        .BidCard::openTasks
                        )
                        .sum();


        int overdueTasks =
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                        .BidCard::overdueTasks
                        )
                        .sum();


        int blockedTasks =
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                        .BidCard::blockedTasks
                        )
                        .sum();


        int criticalTasks =
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                        .BidCard::criticalOpenTasks
                        )
                        .sum();


        int deadlines7 =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        this::activeDeadline
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        card ->
                                                card.daysToDeadline()
                                                        <=
                                                        7
                                )
                                .count();


        int deadlines30 =
                (int)
                        cards
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        this::activeDeadline
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        card ->
                                                card.daysToDeadline()
                                                        <=
                                                        30
                                )
                                .count();


        return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                .Summary(
                        cards.size(),
                        highPotential,
                        blockedMatches,
                        go,
                        hold,
                        noGo,
                        pending,
                        complianceReady,
                        readyForSubmission,
                        submitted,
                        openTasks,
                        overdueTasks,
                        blockedTasks,
                        criticalTasks,
                        deadlines7,
                        deadlines30
                );
    }


    private List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action> actions(
            List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards
    ) {

        List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card :
                cards
        ) {

            DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action action =
                    action(
                            card
                    );


            if (
                    action != null
            ) {

                result.add(
                        action
                );
            }
        }


        return result
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action>comparingInt(
                                        action ->
                                                priorityRank(
                                                        action.priority()
                                                )
                                )
                                .thenComparingLong(
                                        action ->
                                                deadlineRank(
                                                        action.tenderId(),
                                                        cards
                                                )
                                )
                )
                .limit(
                        12
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action action(
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card
    ) {

        if (
                card.submitted()
                ||
                "NO_GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String workspace =
                "/bid-workspaces/"
                        +
                        card.tenderId();


        if (
                card.overdueTasks()
                        >
                        0
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.CRITICAL,
                            "OVERDUE_WORK",
                            "Resolve overdue bid work",
                            card.overdueTasks()
                                    +
                                    " overdue task"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.overdueTasks()
                                    )
                                    +
                                    " on "
                                    +
                                    card.title(),
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    );
        }


        if (
                card.daysToDeadline() != null
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline()
                        <
                        0
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.CRITICAL,
                            "DEADLINE_PASSED",
                            "Review expired bid deadline",
                            "The recorded submission deadline has passed for "
                                    +
                                    card.title(),
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                    );
        }


        if (
                card.readyForSubmission()
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.HIGH,
                            "READY_FOR_SUBMISSION",
                            "Complete final human submission",
                            card.title()
                                    +
                                    " has cleared the TenderPilot readiness gate.",
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    );
        }


        if (
                card.daysToDeadline() != null
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline()
                        >=
                        0
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline()
                        <=
                        7
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.HIGH,
                            "UPCOMING_DEADLINE",
                            "Deadline approaching",
                            card.title()
                                    +
                                    " is due in "
                                    +
                                    card.daysToDeadline()
                                    +
                                    " day"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.daysToDeadline()
                                    ),
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                    );
        }


        if (
                card.criticalOpenTasks()
                        >
                        0
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.HIGH,
                            "CRITICAL_TASKS",
                            "Resolve critical bid tasks",
                            card.criticalOpenTasks()
                                    +
                                    " critical open task"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.criticalOpenTasks()
                                    )
                                    +
                                    " remain on "
                                    +
                                    card.title(),
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    );
        }


        if (
                "GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
                &&
                !card.complianceReady()
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.HIGH,
                            "COMPLIANCE_NOT_READY",
                            "Close compliance gaps",
                            card.title()
                                    +
                                    " is GO but compliance readiness is "
                                    +
                                    card.complianceReadinessScore()
                                    +
                                    "%.",
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                                    +
                                    "/compliance"
                    );
        }


        if (
                !card.matchBlocked()
                &&
                card.matchScore()
                        >=
                        70
                &&
                (
                        card.decisionOutcome() == null
                        ||
                        "PENDING".equals(
                                card.decisionOutcome()
                        )
                )
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.MEDIUM,
                            "BID_DECISION_REQUIRED",
                            "Make a bid decision",
                            card.title()
                                    +
                                    " has a "
                                    +
                                    card.matchScore()
                                    +
                                    "% match score and remains undecided.",
                            card.tenderId(),
                            "/bid-decisions"
                    );
        }


        if (
                "GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
                &&
                card.complianceReady()
                &&
                card.openTasks()
                        >
                        0
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.MEDIUM,
                            "OPEN_BID_WORK",
                            "Advance remaining bid work",
                            card.openTasks()
                                    +
                                    " open task"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.openTasks()
                                    )
                                    +
                                    " remain on "
                                    +
                                    card.title(),
                            card.tenderId(),
                            workspace
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    );
        }


        if (
                card.matchBlocked()
        ) {

            return new DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                    .Action(
                            DashboardActionPriority.LOW,
                            "BLOCKED_MATCH",
                            "Review blocked opportunity",
                            card.title()
                                    +
                                    " is blocked by the matching policy.",
                            card.tenderId(),
                            "/matches"
                    );
        }


        return null;
    }


    private DashboardMarketSignal marketSignal(
            LocalDate today
    ) {

        try {

            return publicMarketGateway
                    .snapshot(
                            today.minusDays(
                                    30
                            ),
                            today
                    );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            return DashboardMarketSignal
                    .unavailable();
        }
    }


    private Comparator<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard>
    portfolioComparator() {

        return Comparator
                .<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard>comparingInt(
                        card ->
                                card.submitted()
                                        ? 1
                                        : 0
                )
                .thenComparingInt(
                        card ->
                                "NO_GO".equals(
                                        card.decisionOutcome()
                                )
                                        ? 1
                                        : 0
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                .BidCard::overdueTasks,

                        Comparator.reverseOrder()
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        card ->
                                card.daysToDeadline() == null
                                        ? Long.MAX_VALUE
                                        : card.daysToDeadline()
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                .BidCard::matchScore,

                        Comparator.reverseOrder()
                );
    }


    private int countOutcome(
            List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards,
            String outcome
    ) {

        return (int)
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                card ->
                                        outcome.equals(
                                                card.decisionOutcome()
                                        )
                        )
                        .count();
    }


    private boolean activeDeadline(
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card
    ) {

        return !card.submitted()
                &&
                !"NO_GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline() != null
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline()
                        >=
                        0;
    }


    private int priorityRank(
            DashboardActionPriority priority
    ) {

        return switch (
                priority
        ) {

            case CRITICAL ->
                    0;

            case HIGH ->
                    1;

            case MEDIUM ->
                    2;

            case LOW ->
                    3;
        };
    }


    private long deadlineRank(
            UUID tenderId,
            List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards
    ) {

        return cards
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        card ->
                                card.tenderId()
                                        .equals(
                                                tenderId
                                        )
                )
                .map(
                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                .BidCard::daysToDeadline
                )
                .filter(
                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(
                        Long.MAX_VALUE
                );
    }


    private String normalizedOutcome(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private String plural(
            long count
    ) {

        return count == 1
                ? ""
                : "s";
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.dashboard.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.application.BidPlanningService;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.application.DashboardBidOperationalGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BidPlanningDashboardAdapter
        implements DashboardBidOperationalGateway {

    private final BidPlanningService
            bidPlanningService;


    public BidPlanningDashboardAdapter(
            BidPlanningService bidPlanningService
    ) {

        this.bidPlanningService =
                bidPlanningService;
    }


    @Override
    public DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot snapshot(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse workspace =
                bidPlanningService
                        .workspace(
                                organizationId,
                                tenderId
                        );


        return new DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot(
                workspace.decisionOutcome() == null
                        ? null
                        : workspace
                                .decisionOutcome()
                                .name(),

                workspace.complianceReady(),

                workspace.complianceReadinessScore(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .openTasks(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .completedTasks(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .overdueTasks(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .blockedTasks(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .criticalOpenTasks(),

                workspace
                        .statistics()
                        .readyForSubmission(),

                workspace
                        .submissionControl()
                        .submittedAt()
                        !=
                        null
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/dashboard/infrastructure/DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.dashboard.infrastructure;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private volatile Schema
            cached;


    public DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;
    }


    public Schema schema() {

        Schema current =
                cached;


        if (
                current != null
        ) {

            return current;
        }


        synchronized (
                this
        ) {

            if (
                    cached == null
            ) {

                cached =
                        inspect();
            }


            return cached;
        }
    }


    private Schema inspect() {

        String table =
                requiredTable(
                        List.of(
                                "organization_tender_matches"
                        )
                );


        return new Schema(
                table,

                requiredColumn(
                        table,
                        List.of(
                                "organization_id"
                        )
                ),

                requiredColumn(
                        table,
                        List.of(
                                "tender_id"
                        )
                ),

                requiredSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "score",
                                "total_score",
                                "match_score"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "score"
                        )
                ),

                requiredSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "grade",
                                "match_grade"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "grade"
                        )
                ),

                requiredSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "blocked",
                                "is_blocked"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "block"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String requiredTable(
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            List<String> result =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .query(
                                    """
                                    select table_name
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                    order by table_name
                                    """,

                                    (
                                            rs,
                                            rowNumber
                                    ) ->
                                            rs.getString(
                                                    1
                                            ),

                                    candidate
                            );


            if (
                    !result.isEmpty()
            ) {

                return result.getFirst();
            }
        }


        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unable to discover organization tender match table"
        );
    }


    private String requiredColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        String result =
                optionalColumn(
                        table,
                        candidates
                );


        if (
                result == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to discover required dashboard column on "
                            +
                            table
                            +
                            ": "
                            +
                            candidates
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String requiredSemanticColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> exactCandidates,
            List<String> semanticTokens
    ) {

        String exact =
                optionalColumn(
                        table,
                        exactCandidates
                );


        if (
                exact != null
        ) {

            return exact;
        }


        List<String> available =
                columns(
                        table
                );


        List<String> matches =
                available
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                column -> {

                                    String normalized =
                                            column
                                                    .toLowerCase(
                                                            Locale.ROOT
                                                    );


                                    return semanticTokens
                                            .stream()
                                            .map(
                                                    token ->
                                                            token.toLowerCase(
                                                                    Locale.ROOT
                                                            )
                                            )
                                            .allMatch(
                                                    normalized::contains
                                            );
                                }
                        )
                        .toList();


        if (
                matches.size() == 1
        ) {

            return matches.getFirst();
        }


        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unable to uniquely discover dashboard column on "
                        +
                        table
                        +
                        " for semantic tokens "
                        +
                        semanticTokens
                        +
                        ". Matches="
                        +
                        matches
        );
    }


    private String optionalColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        Set<String> available =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        columns(
                                table
                        )
                );


        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            for (
                    String actual :
                    available
            ) {

                if (
                        actual
                                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                        candidate
                                )
                ) {

                    return actual;
                }
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private List<String> columns(
            String table
    ) {

        return jdbcTemplate
                .query(
                        """
                        select column_name
                        from information_schema.columns
                        where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                        order by ordinal_position
                        """,

                        (
                                rs,
                                rowNumber
                        ) ->
                                rs.getString(
                                        1
                                ),

                        table
                );
    }


    public record Schema(

            String matchTable,

            String organizationId,

            String tenderId,

            String score,

            String grade,

            String blocked

    ) {
    }

}
