package com.tenderpilot.dashboard.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.application.DashboardMatchGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardMatchObservation;

import java.sql.Timestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class JdbcDashboardMatchGateway
        implements DashboardMatchGateway {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private final DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector
            dashboardSchemaInspector;


    private final ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector
            procurementSchemaInspector;


    public JdbcDashboardMatchGateway(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate,
            DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector dashboardSchemaInspector,
            ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector procurementSchemaInspector
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;

        this.dashboardSchemaInspector =
                dashboardSchemaInspector;

        this.procurementSchemaInspector =
                procurementSchemaInspector;
    }


    @Override
    public List<DashboardMatchObservation> matches(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        var dashboard =
                dashboardSchemaInspector
                        .schema();


        var procurement =
                procurementSchemaInspector
                        .schema();


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.tenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.score()
                        )
                        +
                        " as match_score, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.grade()
                        )
                        +
                        " as match_grade, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.blocked()
                        )
                        +
                        " as match_blocked, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                procurement.tenderTitle()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_title, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "t",
                                procurement.tenderDeadline(),
                                "submission_deadline"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        column(
                                "b",
                                procurement.buyerId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as buyer_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "b",
                                procurement.buyerName()
                        )
                        +
                        " as buyer_name "
                        +
                        "from "
                        +
                        q(
                                dashboard.matchTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " m "
                        +
                        "join "
                        +
                        q(
                                procurement.tenderTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " t on "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.tenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " = "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                procurement.tenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " join "
                        +
                        q(
                                procurement.buyerTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " b on "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                procurement.tenderBuyerId()
                        )
                        +
                        " = "
                        +
                        column(
                                "b",
                                procurement.buyerId()
                        )
                        +
                        " where "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.organizationId()
                        )
                        +
                        " = ? "
                        +
                        "order by "
                        +
                        column(
                                "m",
                                dashboard.score()
                        )
                        +
                        " desc, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                procurement.tenderTitle()
                        )
                        +
                        " asc";


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql,
                        organizationId
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::observation
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private DashboardMatchObservation observation(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {

        return new DashboardMatchObservation(
                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_id"
                        )
                ),

                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_id"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_title"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_name"
                        )
                ),

                instant(
                        row.get(
                                "submission_deadline"
                        )
                ),

                integer(
                        row.get(
                                "match_score"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "match_grade"
                        )
                ),

                bool(
                        row.get(
                                "match_blocked"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String projection(
            String alias,
            String identifier,
            String projectionAlias
    ) {

        return identifier == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        projectionAlias
                : column(
                        alias,
                        identifier
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        projectionAlias;
    }


    private String column(
            String alias,
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                alias == null
                ||
                !alias.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid SQL alias"
            );
        }


        return alias
                +
                "."
                +
                q(
                        identifier
                );
    }


    private String q(
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                ||
                !identifier.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid SQL identifier"
            );
        }


        return "\""
                +
                identifier
                +
                "\"";
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        return UUID.fromString(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private int integer(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return number.intValue();
        }


        return Integer.parseInt(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private boolean bool(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return false;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Boolean bool
        ) {

            return bool;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return number.intValue() != 0;
        }


        return Boolean.parseBoolean(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private Instant instant(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate
                    .atStartOfDay()
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        return Instant.parse(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/dataoperations/application/DataOperationsService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.application;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.api.DataOperationsResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunObservation;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunOutcome;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.SourceHealthAnalysis;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.SourceHealthStatus;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class DataOperationsService {

    private static final List<String> CORE_SOURCES =
            List.of(
                    "TED",
                    "BOAMP",
                    "DECP"
            );


    private final IngestionRunGateway
            ingestionRunGateway;


    private final SourceHealthAnalyzer
            healthAnalyzer;


    public DataOperationsService(
            IngestionRunGateway ingestionRunGateway,
            SourceHealthAnalyzer healthAnalyzer
    ) {

        this.ingestionRunGateway =
                ingestionRunGateway;

        this.healthAnalyzer =
                healthAnalyzer;
    }


    public DataOperationsResponse overview(
            Integer historyLimit
    ) {

        int resolvedHistoryLimit =
                historyLimit == null
                        ? 50
                        : Math.max(
                                10,
                                Math.min(
                                        200,
                                        historyLimit
                                )
                        );


        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        List<IngestionRunObservation> allRuns =
                ingestionRunGateway
                        .recentRuns(
                                5000
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        run.source() != null
                                        &&
                                        run.startedAt() != null
                        )
                        .toList();


        Map<String, List<IngestionRunObservation>> bySource =
                runsBySource(
                        allRuns
                );


        Set<String> sourceNames =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        CORE_SOURCES
                );


        sourceNames.addAll(
                bySource.keySet()
        );


        List<SourceHealthAnalysis> analyses =
                sourceNames
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                source ->
                                        healthAnalyzer
                                                .analyze(
                                                        source,
                                                        bySource.getOrDefault(
                                                                source,
                                                                List.of()
                                                        ),
                                                        now
                                                )
                        )
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator
                                        .<SourceHealthAnalysis>comparingInt(
                                                analysis ->
                                                        healthRank(
                                                                analysis.health()
                                                        )
                                        )
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                SourceHealthAnalysis::source
                                        )
                        )
                        .toList();


        return new DataOperationsResponse(
                now,

                summary(
                        analyses,
                        allRuns,
                        now
                ),

                analyses
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::sourceResponse
                        )
                        .toList(),

                allRuns
                        .stream()
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator
                                        .comparing(
                                                IngestionRunObservation::startedAt
                                        )
                                        .reversed()
                        )
                        .limit(
                                resolvedHistoryLimit
                        )
                        .map(
                                this::runResponse
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }


    private DataOperationsResponse.Summary summary(
            List<SourceHealthAnalysis> analyses,
            List<IngestionRunObservation> runs,
            Instant now
    ) {

        Instant oneDayAgo =
                now.minus(
                        Duration.ofDays(
                                1
                        )
                );


        Instant sevenDaysAgo =
                now.minus(
                        Duration.ofDays(
                                7
                        )
                );


        List<IngestionRunObservation> runs24h =
                runs
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        !run
                                                .startedAt()
                                                .isBefore(
                                                        oneDayAgo
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        List<IngestionRunObservation> runs7d =
                runs
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        !run
                                                .startedAt()
                                                .isBefore(
                                                        sevenDaysAgo
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        int failures24h =
                (int)
                        runs24h
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        run ->
                                                healthAnalyzer.outcome(
                                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                                        run.finishedAt()
                                                )
                                                        ==
                                                        IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
                                )
                                .count();


        int successes7d =
                (int)
                        runs7d
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        run ->
                                                healthAnalyzer.outcome(
                                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                                        run.finishedAt()
                                                )
                                                        ==
                                                        IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS
                                )
                                .count();


        int failures7d =
                (int)
                        runs7d
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        run ->
                                                healthAnalyzer.outcome(
                                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                                        run.finishedAt()
                                                )
                                                        ==
                                                        IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
                                )
                                .count();


        int terminal7d =
                successes7d
                        +
                        failures7d;


        Integer successRate =
                terminal7d == 0
                        ? null
                        : (int)
                                Math.round(
                                        successes7d
                                                *
                                                100.0
                                                /
                                                terminal7d
                                );


        return new DataOperationsResponse
                .Summary(
                        analyses.size(),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.HEALTHY
                        ),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.DEGRADED
                        ),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.UNHEALTHY
                        ),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.STALE
                        ),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.RUNNING
                        ),

                        healthCount(
                                analyses,
                                SourceHealthStatus.UNKNOWN
                        ),

                        runs24h.size(),

                        failures24h,

                        runs7d.size(),

                        successRate
                );
    }


    private int healthCount(
            List<SourceHealthAnalysis> analyses,
            SourceHealthStatus health
    ) {

        return (int)
                analyses
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                analysis ->
                                        analysis.health()
                                                ==
                                                health
                        )
                        .count();
    }


    private DataOperationsResponse.Source sourceResponse(
            SourceHealthAnalysis analysis
    ) {

        return new DataOperationsResponse
                .Source(
                        analysis.source(),
                        analysis.health(),
                        analysis.runCount7Days(),
                        analysis.successCount7Days(),
                        analysis.failureCount7Days(),
                        analysis.successRate7Days(),
                        analysis.failureStreak(),
                        analysis.lastStartedAt(),
                        analysis.lastFinishedAt(),
                        analysis.lastSuccessAt(),
                        analysis.lastFailureAt(),
                        analysis.importedCount7Days(),
                        analysis.rejectedCount7Days()
                );
    }


    private DataOperationsResponse.RecentRun runResponse(
            IngestionRunObservation run
    ) {

        Long duration =
                durationSeconds(
                        run.startedAt(),
                        run.finishedAt()
                );


        return new DataOperationsResponse
                .RecentRun(
                        normalizedSource(
                                run.source()
                        ),

                        healthAnalyzer
                                .outcome(
                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                        run.finishedAt()
                                ),

                        run.rawStatus(),

                        run.startedAt(),

                        run.finishedAt(),

                        duration,

                        run.importedCount(),

                        run.rejectedCount()
                );
    }


    private Long durationSeconds(
            Instant started,
            Instant finished
    ) {

        if (
                started == null
                ||
                finished == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        long seconds =
                Duration
                        .between(
                                started,
                                finished
                        )
                        .getSeconds();


        return seconds < 0
                ? null
                : seconds;
    }


    private Map<String, List<IngestionRunObservation>> runsBySource(
            List<IngestionRunObservation> runs
    ) {

        Map<String, List<IngestionRunObservation>> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                IngestionRunObservation run :
                runs
        ) {

            String source =
                    normalizedSource(
                            run.source()
                    );


            if (
                    source == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            result
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            source,
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(
                            run
                    );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String normalizedSource(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private int healthRank(
            SourceHealthStatus health
    ) {

        return switch (
                health
        ) {

            case UNHEALTHY ->
                    0;

            case DEGRADED ->
                    1;

            case STALE ->
                    2;

            case RUNNING ->
                    3;

            case UNKNOWN ->
                    4;

            case HEALTHY ->
                    5;
        };
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.application;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunObservation;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunOutcome;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.SourceHealthAnalysis;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.SourceHealthStatus;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class SourceHealthAnalyzer {

    private static final Duration HEALTHY_WINDOW =
            Duration.ofHours(
                    48
            );


    private static final Duration DEGRADED_SUCCESS_WINDOW =
            Duration.ofDays(
                    1
            );


    private static final Duration ANALYTICS_WINDOW =
            Duration.ofDays(
                    7
            );


    public SourceHealthAnalysis analyze(
            String source,
            List<IngestionRunObservation> observations,
            Instant now
    ) {

        List<IngestionRunObservation> runs =
                observations == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : observations
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        observation ->
                                                observation != null
                                                &&
                                                observation.startedAt() != null
                                )
                                .sorted(
                                        Comparator
                                                .comparing(
                                                        IngestionRunObservation::startedAt
                                                )
                                                .reversed()
                                )
                                .toList();


        if (
                runs.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return new SourceHealthAnalysis(
                    source,
                    SourceHealthStatus.UNKNOWN,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    null,
                    0,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    0,
                    0
            );
        }


        Instant sevenDaysAgo =
                now.minus(
                        ANALYTICS_WINDOW
                );


        List<IngestionRunObservation> recent =
                runs
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        !run
                                                .startedAt()
                                                .isBefore(
                                                        sevenDaysAgo
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        int successes =
                (int)
                        recent
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        run ->
                                                outcome(
                                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                                        run.finishedAt()
                                                )
                                                        ==
                                                        IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS
                                )
                                .count();


        int failures =
                (int)
                        recent
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        run ->
                                                outcome(
                                                        run.rawStatus(),
                                                        run.finishedAt()
                                                )
                                                        ==
                                                        IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
                                )
                                .count();


        int terminalRuns =
                successes
                        +
                        failures;


        Integer successRate =
                terminalRuns == 0
                        ? null
                        : (int)
                                Math.round(
                                        successes
                                                *
                                                100.0
                                                /
                                                terminalRuns
                                );


        Instant lastSuccess =
                runs
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        outcome(
                                                run.rawStatus(),
                                                run.finishedAt()
                                        )
                                                ==
                                                IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS
                        )
                        .map(
                                run ->
                                        run.finishedAt() == null
                                                ? run.startedAt()
                                                : run.finishedAt()
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        Instant lastFailure =
                runs
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                run ->
                                        outcome(
                                                run.rawStatus(),
                                                run.finishedAt()
                                        )
                                                ==
                                                IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
                        )
                        .map(
                                run ->
                                        run.finishedAt() == null
                                                ? run.startedAt()
                                                : run.finishedAt()
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        IngestionRunObservation latest =
                runs.getFirst();


        IngestionRunOutcome latestOutcome =
                outcome(
                        latest.rawStatus(),
                        latest.finishedAt()
                );


        SourceHealthStatus health =
                health(
                        latestOutcome,
                        latest,
                        lastSuccess,
                        now
                );


        return new SourceHealthAnalysis(
                source,

                health,

                recent.size(),

                successes,

                failures,

                successRate,

                failureStreak(
                        runs
                ),

                latest.startedAt(),

                latest.finishedAt(),

                lastSuccess,

                lastFailure,

                recent
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                IngestionRunObservation::importedCount
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                Long::longValue
                        )
                        .sum(),

                recent
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                IngestionRunObservation::rejectedCount
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                Long::longValue
                        )
                        .sum()
        );
    }


    public IngestionRunOutcome outcome(
            String rawStatus,
            Instant finishedAt
    ) {

        if (
                rawStatus == null
                ||
                rawStatus.isBlank()
        ) {

            return finishedAt == null
                    ? IngestionRunOutcome.RUNNING
                    : IngestionRunOutcome.UNKNOWN;
        }


        String value =
                rawStatus
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return switch (
                value
        ) {

            case
                    "SUCCESS",
                    "SUCCEEDED",
                    "COMPLETED",
                    "COMPLETE",
                    "DONE" ->

                    IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS;


            case
                    "FAILED",
                    "FAILURE",
                    "ERROR",
                    "ERRORED" ->

                    IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE;


            case
                    "RUNNING",
                    "STARTED",
                    "IN_PROGRESS",
                    "PROCESSING" ->

                    IngestionRunOutcome.RUNNING;


            default ->
                    IngestionRunOutcome.UNKNOWN;
        };
    }


    private SourceHealthStatus health(
            IngestionRunOutcome latestOutcome,
            IngestionRunObservation latest,
            Instant lastSuccess,
            Instant now
    ) {

        if (
                latestOutcome
                        ==
                        IngestionRunOutcome.RUNNING
        ) {

            return SourceHealthStatus.RUNNING;
        }


        if (
                latestOutcome
                        ==
                        IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
        ) {

            if (
                    lastSuccess != null
                    &&
                    !lastSuccess.isBefore(
                            now.minus(
                                    DEGRADED_SUCCESS_WINDOW
                            )
                    )
            ) {

                return SourceHealthStatus.DEGRADED;
            }


            return SourceHealthStatus.UNHEALTHY;
        }


        if (
                latestOutcome
                        ==
                        IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS
        ) {

            Instant reference =
                    latest.finishedAt() == null
                            ? latest.startedAt()
                            : latest.finishedAt();


            if (
                    !reference.isBefore(
                            now.minus(
                                    HEALTHY_WINDOW
                            )
                    )
            ) {

                return SourceHealthStatus.HEALTHY;
            }


            return SourceHealthStatus.STALE;
        }


        return SourceHealthStatus.UNKNOWN;
    }


    private int failureStreak(
            List<IngestionRunObservation> runs
    ) {

        int result =
                0;


        for (
                IngestionRunObservation run :
                runs
        ) {

            IngestionRunOutcome outcome =
                    outcome(
                            run.rawStatus(),
                            run.finishedAt()
                    );


            if (
                    outcome
                            ==
                            IngestionRunOutcome.RUNNING
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            if (
                    outcome
                            ==
                            IngestionRunOutcome.FAILURE
            ) {

                result++;

                continue;
            }


            if (
                    outcome
                            ==
                            IngestionRunOutcome.SUCCESS
            ) {

                break;
            }
        }


        return result;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/dataoperations/infrastructure/IngestionRunSchemaInspector.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.infrastructure;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class IngestionRunSchemaInspector {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private volatile Schema
            cached;


    public IngestionRunSchemaInspector(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;
    }


    public Schema schema() {

        Schema current =
                cached;


        if (
                current != null
        ) {

            return current;
        }


        synchronized (
                this
        ) {

            if (
                    cached == null
            ) {

                cached =
                        inspect();
            }


            return cached;
        }
    }


    private Schema inspect() {

        String table =
                requiredTable(
                        List.of(
                                "data_source_ingestion_runs"
                        )
                );


        return new Schema(
                table,

                requiredSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "source",
                                "data_source",
                                "source_name"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "source"
                        )
                ),

                optionalSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "status",
                                "run_status",
                                "ingestion_status"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "status"
                        )
                ),

                requiredSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "started_at",
                                "start_time",
                                "started_on",
                                "started"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "start"
                        )
                ),

                optionalSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "finished_at",
                                "completed_at",
                                "ended_at",
                                "finish_time",
                                "end_time"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "finish"
                        )
                ),

                optionalSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "records_imported",
                                "imported_count",
                                "imported_records",
                                "accepted_count",
                                "success_count"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "import"
                        )
                ),

                optionalSemanticColumn(
                        table,

                        List.of(
                                "records_rejected",
                                "rejected_count",
                                "rejected_records",
                                "failure_count",
                                "failed_count"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "reject"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String requiredTable(
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            List<String> result =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .query(
                                    """
                                    select table_name
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                    order by table_name
                                    """,

                                    (
                                            rs,
                                            rowNumber
                                    ) ->
                                            rs.getString(
                                                    1
                                            ),

                                    candidate
                            );


            if (
                    !result.isEmpty()
            ) {

                return result.getFirst();
            }
        }


        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unable to discover ingestion run table"
        );
    }


    private String requiredSemanticColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> exactCandidates,
            List<String> semanticTokens
    ) {

        String value =
                optionalSemanticColumn(
                        table,
                        exactCandidates,
                        semanticTokens
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to uniquely discover required ingestion column on "
                            +
                            table
                            +
                            " using "
                            +
                            semanticTokens
            );
        }


        return value;
    }


    private String optionalSemanticColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> exactCandidates,
            List<String> semanticTokens
    ) {

        String exact =
                optionalColumn(
                        table,
                        exactCandidates
                );


        if (
                exact != null
        ) {

            return exact;
        }


        List<String> matches =
                columns(
                        table
                )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                column -> {

                                    String normalized =
                                            column
                                                    .toLowerCase(
                                                            Locale.ROOT
                                                    );


                                    return semanticTokens
                                            .stream()
                                            .map(
                                                    token ->
                                                            token.toLowerCase(
                                                                    Locale.ROOT
                                                            )
                                            )
                                            .allMatch(
                                                    normalized::contains
                                            );
                                }
                        )
                        .toList();


        if (
                matches.size() == 1
        ) {

            return matches.getFirst();
        }


        return null;
    }


    private String optionalColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        Set<String> available =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        columns(
                                table
                        )
                );


        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            for (
                    String actual :
                    available
            ) {

                if (
                        actual.equalsIgnoreCase(
                                candidate
                        )
                ) {

                    return actual;
                }
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private List<String> columns(
            String table
    ) {

        return jdbcTemplate
                .query(
                        """
                        select column_name
                        from information_schema.columns
                        where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                        order by ordinal_position
                        """,

                        (
                                rs,
                                rowNumber
                        ) ->
                                rs.getString(
                                        1
                                ),

                        table
                );
    }


    public record Schema(

            String table,

            String source,

            String status,

            String startedAt,

            String finishedAt,

            String importedCount,

            String rejectedCount

    ) {
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/dataoperations/infrastructure/JdbcIngestionRunGateway.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.application.IngestionRunGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunObservation;

import java.sql.Timestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class JdbcIngestionRunGateway
        implements IngestionRunGateway {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private final IngestionRunSchemaInspector
            schemaInspector;


    public JdbcIngestionRunGateway(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate,
            IngestionRunSchemaInspector schemaInspector
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;

        this.schemaInspector =
                schemaInspector;
    }


    @Override
    public List<IngestionRunObservation> recentRuns(
            int limit
    ) {

        IngestionRunSchemaInspector.Schema schema =
                schemaInspector
                        .schema();


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.source()
                        )
                        +
                        " as source, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.status(),
                                "run_status"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.startedAt()
                        )
                        +
                        " as started_at, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.finishedAt(),
                                "finished_at"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.importedCount(),
                                "imported_count"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                schema.rejectedCount(),
                                "rejected_count"
                        )
                        +
                        " from "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.table()
                        )
                        +
                        " order by "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.startedAt()
                        )
                        +
                        " desc limit ?";


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql,
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                Math.min(
                                        5000,
                                        limit
                                )
                        )
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::observation
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private IngestionRunObservation observation(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {

        return new IngestionRunObservation(
                string(
                        row.get(
                                "source"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "run_status"
                        )
                ),

                instant(
                        row.get(
                                "started_at"
                        )
                ),

                instant(
                        row.get(
                                "finished_at"
                        )
                ),

                number(
                        row.get(
                                "imported_count"
                        )
                ),

                number(
                        row.get(
                                "rejected_count"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String projection(
            String identifier,
            String alias
    ) {

        return identifier == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : q(
                        identifier
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String q(
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                ||
                !identifier.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid SQL identifier"
            );
        }


        return "\""
                +
                identifier
                +
                "\"";
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private Long number(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return number.longValue();
        }


        return Long.valueOf(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private Instant instant(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate
                    .atStartOfDay()
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        return Instant.parse(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.api;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.BoampDataSourceService;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.BoampIngestionService;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.DecpDataSourceService;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.DecpIngestionService;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.TedDataSourceService;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.application.TedIngestionService;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/data-sources")
public class DataSourceController {

    private final TedDataSourceService
            tedDataSourceService;

    private final TedIngestionService
            tedIngestionService;

    private final BoampDataSourceService
            boampDataSourceService;

    private final BoampIngestionService
            boampIngestionService;

    private final DecpDataSourceService
            decpDataSourceService;

    private final DecpIngestionService
            decpIngestionService;

    public DataSourceController(
            TedDataSourceService tedDataSourceService,
            TedIngestionService tedIngestionService,
            BoampDataSourceService boampDataSourceService,
            BoampIngestionService boampIngestionService,
            DecpDataSourceService decpDataSourceService,
            DecpIngestionService decpIngestionService
    ) {

        this.tedDataSourceService =
                tedDataSourceService;

        this.tedIngestionService =
                tedIngestionService;

        this.boampDataSourceService =
                boampDataSourceService;

        this.boampIngestionService =
                boampIngestionService;

        this.decpDataSourceService =
                decpDataSourceService;

        this.decpIngestionService =
                decpIngestionService;
    }

    @GetMapping("/ted")
    public TedDataSourceStatusResponse tedStatus() {
        return tedDataSourceService.status();
    }

    @PostMapping("/ted/sync")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('OWNER')")
    public TedSyncResponse syncTed(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "7")
            int days,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "25")
            int limit
    ) {

        return tedIngestionService
                .syncRecent(days, limit);
    }

    @GetMapping("/boamp")
    public BoampDataSourceStatusResponse
    boampStatus() {
        return boampDataSourceService.status();
    }

    @PostMapping("/boamp/sync")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('OWNER')")
    public BoampSyncResponse syncBoamp(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "7")
            int days,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "25")
            int limit
    ) {

        return boampIngestionService
                .syncRecent(days, limit);
    }

    @GetMapping("/decp")
    public DecpDataSourceStatusResponse
    decpStatus() {
        return decpDataSourceService.status();
    }

    @PostMapping("/decp/sync")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('OWNER')")
    public DecpSyncResponse syncDecp(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "7")
            int days,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "25")
            int limit
    ) {

        return decpIngestionService
                .syncRecent(days, limit);
    }
}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.application;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.api.BoampDataSourceStatusResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampSettings;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.domain.IngestionRunEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.infrastructure.IngestionRunRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderSourceRecordEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderSourceRecordRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class BoampDataSourceService {

    private final BoampSettings
            settings;


    private final TenderSourceRecordRepository
            sourceRecordRepository;


    private final IngestionRunRepository
            ingestionRunRepository;


    public BoampDataSourceService(

            BoampSettings settings,

            TenderSourceRecordRepository sourceRecordRepository,

            IngestionRunRepository ingestionRunRepository

    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.sourceRecordRepository =
                sourceRecordRepository;

        this.ingestionRunRepository =
                ingestionRunRepository;

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public BoampDataSourceStatusResponse status() {

        long count =

                sourceRecordRepository
                        .countBySource(
                                ProcurementSource.BOAMP
                        );


        Instant lastSeen =

                sourceRecordRepository
                        .findTop1BySourceOrderByLastSeenAtDesc(
                                ProcurementSource.BOAMP
                        )
                        .map(
                                TenderSourceRecordEntity
                                        ::getLastSeenAt
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        BoampDataSourceStatusResponse.LastRunResponse
                lastRun =

                ingestionRunRepository
                        .findTop1BySourceOrderByStartedAtDesc(
                                ProcurementSource.BOAMP
                        )
                        .map(
                                this::mapRun
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new BoampDataSourceStatusResponse(

                "BOAMP",

                "Explore API 2.1",

                settings.baseUrl(),

                settings.recordsPath(),

                settings.datasetId(),

                false,

                settings.manualSyncEnabled(),

                count,

                lastSeen,

                lastRun

        );

    }


    private BoampDataSourceStatusResponse.LastRunResponse mapRun(
            IngestionRunEntity run
    ) {

        return new BoampDataSourceStatusResponse
                .LastRunResponse(

                        run.getId(),

                        run.getStatus(),

                        run.getQueryText(),

                        run.getRequestedLimit(),

                        run.getDiscoveredCount(),

                        run.getProcessedCount(),

                        run.getFailedCount(),

                        run.getStartedAt(),

                        run.getCompletedAt(),

                        run.getLastError()

                );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/application/BoampIngestionService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.api.BoampSyncResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampNotice;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampNoticeMapper;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampQueryFactory;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampSearchGateway;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampSearchPage;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampSearchRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampSettings;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.domain.IngestionRunEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.infrastructure.IngestionRunRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderImportService;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class BoampIngestionService {

    private final BoampSearchGateway
            searchGateway;


    private final BoampQueryFactory
            queryFactory;


    private final BoampNoticeMapper
            noticeMapper;


    private final CanonicalTenderImportService
            canonicalImportService;


    private final IngestionRunRepository
            ingestionRunRepository;


    private final BoampSettings
            settings;


    public BoampIngestionService(

            BoampSearchGateway searchGateway,

            BoampQueryFactory queryFactory,

            BoampNoticeMapper noticeMapper,

            CanonicalTenderImportService canonicalImportService,

            IngestionRunRepository ingestionRunRepository,

            BoampSettings settings

    ) {

        this.searchGateway =
                searchGateway;

        this.queryFactory =
                queryFactory;

        this.noticeMapper =
                noticeMapper;

        this.canonicalImportService =
                canonicalImportService;

        this.ingestionRunRepository =
                ingestionRunRepository;

        this.settings =
                settings;

    }


    public BoampSyncResponse syncRecent(

            int lookbackDays,

            int requestedLimit

    ) {

        if (
                !settings.manualSyncEnabled()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Manual BOAMP synchronization is disabled"
            );

        }


        int days =

                Math.max(

                        1,

                        Math.min(
                                31,
                                lookbackDays
                        )

                );


        int limit =

                Math.max(

                        1,

                        Math.min(

                                requestedLimit,

                                settings.maxLimit()

                        )

                );


        String where =

                queryFactory
                        .recentPublications(
                                days
                        );


        IngestionRunEntity run =

                ingestionRunRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(

                                IngestionRunEntity
                                        .start(

                                                ProcurementSource.BOAMP,

                                                where,

                                                limit

                                        )

                        );


        try {

            BoampSearchPage page =

                    searchGateway
                            .search(

                                    new BoampSearchRequest(

                                            where,

                                            0,

                                            limit

                                    )

                            );


            int processed =
                    0;


            int failed =
                    0;


            String lastError =
                    null;


            for (
                    BoampNotice notice :
                    page.notices()
            ) {

                try {

                    canonicalImportService
                            .upsert(

                                    noticeMapper
                                            .map(
                                                    notice
                                            )

                            );


                    processed++;


                } catch (
                        RuntimeException exception
                ) {

                    failed++;


                    lastError =
                            safeMessage(
                                    exception
                            );

                }

            }


            run.complete(

                    page.notices()
                            .size(),

                    processed,

                    failed,

                    lastError

            );


            run =
                    ingestionRunRepository
                            .saveAndFlush(
                                    run
                            );


            return BoampSyncResponse
                    .from(
                            run
                    );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            run.fail(
                    safeMessage(
                            exception
                    )
            );


            ingestionRunRepository
                    .saveAndFlush(
                            run
                    );


            throw exception;

        }

    }


    public BoampSyncResponse syncDefaults() {

        return syncRecent(

                settings.defaultLookbackDays(),

                settings.defaultLimit()

        );

    }


    private String safeMessage(
            Throwable throwable
    ) {

        if (
                throwable == null
        ) {

            return "Unknown BOAMP ingestion error";

        }


        String message =
                throwable.getMessage();


        if (
                message == null
                ||
                message.isBlank()
        ) {

            return throwable
                    .getClass()
                    .getSimpleName();

        }


        return message;

    }

}

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class DecpDataSourceService {

    private final DecpSettings settings;

    private final TenderSourceRecordRepository
            sourceRecordRepository;

    private final IngestionRunRepository
            ingestionRunRepository;

    public DecpDataSourceService(
            DecpSettings settings,
            TenderSourceRecordRepository sourceRecordRepository,
            IngestionRunRepository ingestionRunRepository
    ) {

        this.settings = settings;

        this.sourceRecordRepository =
                sourceRecordRepository;

        this.ingestionRunRepository =

    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public DecpDataSourceStatusResponse status() {

        long count =
                sourceRecordRepository
                        .countBySource(
                                ProcurementSource.DECP
                        );

                sourceRecordRepository
                        .findTop1BySourceOrderByLastSeenAtDesc(

                                TenderSourceRecordEntity

                        )

                lastRun =

                        )

                "DECP",
                "Explore API 2.1",

                settings.recordsPath(),
                settings.datasetId(),
                false,
                settings.manualSyncEnabled(),
                count,
                lastSeen,
                lastRun
        );

    ) {

                        run.getQueryText(),
                        run.getRequestedLimit(),
                        run.getDiscoveredCount(),
                        run.getProcessedCount(),
                        run.getFailedCount(),
                        run.getStartedAt(),
                        run.getCompletedAt(),
                        run.getLastError()
                );
    }

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/application/DecpIngestionService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.api.DecpSyncResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpAwardMapper;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpAwardRecord;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpCanonicalContractImportService;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpMappedContract;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpQueryFactory;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpSearchGateway;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpSearchPage;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpSearchRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp.DecpSettings;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.domain.IngestionRunEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.datasource.infrastructure.IngestionRunRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class DecpIngestionService {

    private final DecpSearchGateway searchGateway;

    private final DecpQueryFactory queryFactory;

    private final DecpAwardMapper mapper;

    private final DecpCanonicalContractImportService
            canonicalContractImportService;

    private final IngestionRunRepository
            ingestionRunRepository;

    private final DecpSettings settings;

    public DecpIngestionService(
            DecpSearchGateway searchGateway,
            DecpQueryFactory queryFactory,
            DecpAwardMapper mapper,
            DecpCanonicalContractImportService
                    canonicalContractImportService,
            IngestionRunRepository ingestionRunRepository,
            DecpSettings settings
    ) {

        this.searchGateway = searchGateway;
        this.queryFactory = queryFactory;
        this.mapper = mapper;

        this.canonicalContractImportService =
                canonicalContractImportService;

        this.ingestionRunRepository =
                ingestionRunRepository;

        this.settings = settings;
    }

    public DecpSyncResponse syncRecent(
            int lookbackDays,
            int requestedLimit
    ) {

        if (!settings.manualSyncEnabled()) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Manual DECP synchronization is disabled"
            );
        }

        int days =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(
                                31,
                                lookbackDays
                        )
                );

        int limit =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(
                                requestedLimit,
                                settings.maxLimit()
                        )
                );

        String where =
                queryFactory
                        .recentPublications(days);

        IngestionRunEntity run =
                ingestionRunRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                IngestionRunEntity
                                        .start(
                                                ProcurementSource.DECP,
                                                where,
                                                limit
                                        )
                        );

        try {

            DecpSearchPage page =
                    searchGateway
                            .search(
                                    new DecpSearchRequest(
                                            where,
                                            0,
                                            limit
                                    )
                            );

            int processed = 0;
            int failed = 0;
            String lastError = null;

            for (
                    DecpAwardRecord sourceRecord :
                    page.records()
            ) {

                try {

                    DecpMappedContract mapped =
                            mapper.map(sourceRecord);

                    canonicalContractImportService
                            .upsert(mapped);

                    processed++;

                } catch (
                        RuntimeException exception
                ) {

                    failed++;

                    lastError =
                            safeMessage(exception);
                }
            }

            run.complete(
                    page.records().size(),
                    processed,
                    failed,
                    lastError
            );

            run =
                    ingestionRunRepository
                            .saveAndFlush(run);

            return DecpSyncResponse.from(run);

        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            run.fail(
                    safeMessage(exception)
            );

            ingestionRunRepository
                    .saveAndFlush(run);

            throw exception;
        }
    }

    public DecpSyncResponse syncDefaults() {

        return syncRecent(
                settings.defaultLookbackDays(),
                settings.defaultLimit()
        );
    }

    private String safeMessage(
            Throwable throwable
    ) {

        if (throwable == null) {
            return "Unknown DECP ingestion error";
        }

        String message =
                throwable.getMessage();

        return message == null
                ||
                message.isBlank()
                ? throwable
                        .getClass()
                        .getSimpleName()
                : message;
    }
}
