        }

    }


    public TedSyncResponse syncDefaults() {

        return syncRecent(

                settings.defaultLookbackDays(),

                settings.defaultLimit()

        );

    }


    private String safeMessage(
            Throwable throwable
    ) {

        if (
                throwable == null
        ) {

            return "Unknown ingestion error";

        }


        String message =
                throwable.getMessage();


        if (
                message == null
                ||
                message.isBlank()
        ) {

            return throwable
                    .getClass()
                    .getSimpleName();

        }


        return message;

    }

}

@Component
public class BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer {

    private static final Map<String, Region>
            REGIONS =
            buildRegions();


    public Region normalize(
            String rawDepartment
    ) {

        String department =
                normalizeDepartment(
                        rawDepartment
                );


        if (
                department == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        Region known =
                REGIONS.get(
                        department
                );


        if (
                known != null
        ) {

            return known;

        }


        return new Region(

                department,

                "FR",

                "Département "
                        +
                        department

        );

    }


    private String normalizeDepartment(
            String raw
    ) {

        if (
                raw == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String value =

                raw
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        if (
                value.isBlank()
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        if (
                value.matches(
                        "\\d"
                )
        ) {

            value =
                    "0"
                            +
                            value;

        }


        return value;

    }

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.BuyerCategory;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ContractNature;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementProcedure;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;

import java.text.Normalizer;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;

import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BoampNoticeMapper {

    private final BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer
            geographyNormalizer;


    public BoampNoticeMapper(
            BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer geographyNormalizer
    ) {

        this.geographyNormalizer =
                geographyNormalizer;

    }


    public CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest map(
            BoampNotice notice
    ) {

        if (
                notice == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "BOAMP notice is required"
            );

        }


        String externalId =
                require(

                        notice.externalId(),

                        "BOAMP announcement identifier is required"

                );


        LocalDate publicationDate =
                notice.publicationDate();


        if (
                publicationDate == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "BOAMP publication date is required"
            );

        }


        String title =
                clean(
                        notice.object()
                );


        if (
                title == null
        ) {

            title =
                    "BOAMP notice "
                            +
                            externalId;

        }


        String buyerName =
                clean(
                        notice.buyerName()
                );


        if (
                buyerName == null
        ) {

            buyerName =
                    "Acheteur public BOAMP";

        }


        BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer.Region
                region =

                geographyNormalizer
                        .normalize(
                                notice.departmentCode()
                        );


        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput>
                locations =

                region == null

                        ? List.of()

                        : List.of(

                                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                        .LocationInput(

                                                "FR",

                                                region.regionCode(),

                                                region.regionName(),

                                                null

                                        )

                        );


        BigDecimal estimatedValue =
                notice.estimatedValue();


        String currency =
                normalizeCurrency(
                        notice.currency()
                );


        if (
                estimatedValue != null
                &&
                currency == null
        ) {

            currency =
                    "EUR";

        }


        String finalBuyerName =
                buyerName;


        CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.BuyerInput
                buyerInput =

                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                        .BuyerInput(

                                buyerCanonicalKey(
                                        finalBuyerName
                                ),

                                finalBuyerName,

                                mapBuyerCategory(
                                        finalBuyerName
                                ),

                                "FR",

                                null,

                                null,

                                null

                        );


        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.CpvInput>
                cpvs =

                safeList(
                        notice.cpvCodes()
                )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                value ->
                                        value != null
                                        &&
                                        value.matches(
                                                "\\d{8}"
                                        )
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                                .CpvInput(

                                                        value,

                                                        "CPV "
                                                                +
                                                                value

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        return new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest(

                ProcurementSource.BOAMP,

                externalId,

                clean(
                        notice.sourceSchema()
                ),

                clean(
                        notice.noticeType()
                ),

                urlOrNull(
                        notice.sourceUrl()
                ),

                fingerprint(
                        notice
                ),

                publicationDate
                        .atStartOfDay(
                                ZoneId.of(
                                        "Europe/Paris"
                                )
                        )
                        .toInstant(),

                buyerInput,

                title,

                title,

                mapStatus(
                        notice.noticeType()
                ),

                mapProcedure(
                        notice.procedure()
                ),

                mapNature(
                        notice.nature()
                ),

                publicationDate,

                notice.responseDeadline(),

                estimatedValue,

                estimatedValue,

                currency,

                "FR",

                region == null
                        ? null
                        : region.regionCode(),

                region == null
                        ? null
                        : region.regionName(),

                false,

                false,

                true,

                cpvs,

                locations,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    private ProcurementStatus mapStatus(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                normalizedText(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "attribution"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "resultat"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "award"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementStatus.AWARDED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "rectific"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "modification"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementStatus.UPDATED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "annulation"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "cancel"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementStatus.CANCELLED;

        }


        return ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED;

    }


    private ProcurementProcedure mapProcedure(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                normalizedText(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "partenariat d innovation"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.INNOVATION_PARTNERSHIP;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "dialogue"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_DIALOGUE;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "avec negociation"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "appel d offres avec negociation"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_WITH_NEGOTIATION;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "restreint"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.RESTRICTED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "ouvert"
                )
                ||
                value.equals(
                        "open"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.OPEN;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "concours"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.DESIGN_CONTEST;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "sans publicite"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "sans mise en concurrence"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "direct"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.DIRECT_AWARD;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "negoc"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.NEGOTIATED;

        }


        return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;

    }


    private ContractNature mapNature(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                normalizedText(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return ContractNature.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "travaux"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "works"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.WORKS;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "service"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.SERVICES;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "fourniture"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "suppl"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.SUPPLIES;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "mixte"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "mixed"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.MIXED;

        }


        return ContractNature.OTHER;

    }


    private BuyerCategory mapBuyerCategory(
            String buyerName
    ) {

        String value =
                normalizedText(
                        buyerName
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "universite"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "ecole"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "academie"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.EDUCATION;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "hopital"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "chu"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "centre hospitalier"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "sante"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.HEALTHCARE;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "office public de l habitat"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "oph "
                )
                ||
                value.endsWith(
                        " oph"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.SOCIAL_HOUSING;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "mairie"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "commune"
                )
                ||
                value.startsWith(
                        "ville "
                )
                ||
                value.equals(
                        "ville"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "departement"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "region "
                )
                ||
                value.startsWith(
                        "region "
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "metropole"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "communaute"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.LOCAL_AUTHORITY;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "ministere"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "etat "
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "transport"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "sncf"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.TRANSPORT;

        }


        return BuyerCategory.PUBLIC_AGENCY;

    }


    private String buyerCanonicalKey(
            String buyerName
    ) {

        return "BOAMP-BUYER:"
                +
                sha256(
                        normalizeIdentifier(
                                buyerName
                        )
                )
                        .substring(
                                0,
                                24
                        );

    }


    private String fingerprint(
            BoampNotice notice
    ) {

        return sha256(

                String.join(

                        "|",

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.externalId()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.internalId()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.sourceSchema()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.object()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.publicationDate()
                                        ==
                                        null

                                        ? null

                                        : notice
                                                .publicationDate()
                                                .toString()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.sourceUrl()
                        )

                )

        );

    }


    private String sha256(
            String value
    ) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =

                    MessageDigest
                            .getInstance(
                                    "SHA-256"
                            );


            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(

                            digest.digest(

                                    value.getBytes(
                                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )

                            )

                    );


        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(

                    "SHA-256 is unavailable",

                    exception

            );

        }

    }


    private String normalizeIdentifier(
            String value
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizedText(
                        value
                );


        return normalized == null
                ? "unknown"
                : normalized;

    }


    private String normalizedText(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String decomposed =

                Normalizer.normalize(

                        cleaned,

                        Normalizer.Form.NFD

                );


        return decomposed
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\p{M}+",
                        ""
                )
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }


    private String normalizeCurrency(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String upper =
                cleaned.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );


        return upper.matches(
                "[A-Z]{3}"
        )
                ? upper
                : null;

    }


    private String urlOrNull(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        return cleaned.startsWith(
                "https://"
        )
                ||
                cleaned.startsWith(
                        "http://"
                )

                ? cleaned

                : null;

    }


    private String require(

            String value,

            String message

    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );

        }


        return cleaned;

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =

                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }


    private String nullSafe(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;

    }


    private <T> List<T> safeList(
            List<T> values
    ) {

        return values == null
                ? List.of()
                : values;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BoampQueryFactory {

    private final Clock clock;


    public BoampQueryFactory() {

        this(
                Clock.systemUTC()
        );

    }


    BoampQueryFactory(
            Clock clock
    ) {

        this.clock =
                clock;

    }


    public String recentPublications(
            int lookbackDays
    ) {

        int bounded =

                Math.max(

                        1,

                        Math.min(
                                31,
                                lookbackDays
                        )

                );


        LocalDate end =
                LocalDate.now(
                        clock
                );


        LocalDate start =
                end.minusDays(
                        bounded
                                -
                                1L
                );


        return "dateparution IN [date'"
                +
                start
                +
                "'..date'"
                +
                end
                +
                "']";

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp;

import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException;

@Component
public class BoampSearchClient
        implements BoampSearchGateway {

    private final BoampSettings settings;

    private final BoampSearchResponseParser parser;

    private final RestClient restClient;


    public BoampSearchClient(

            BoampSettings settings,

            BoampSearchResponseParser parser

    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.parser =
                parser;

        this.restClient =

                RestClient
                        .builder()
                        .baseUrl(
                                settings.baseUrl()
                        )
                        .build();

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings(
            "rawtypes"
    )
    public BoampSearchPage search(
            BoampSearchRequest request
    ) {

        try {

            Map response =

                    restClient
                            .get()
                            .uri(
                                    uriBuilder ->

                                            uriBuilder

                                                    .path(
                                                            settings.recordsPath()
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "where",
                                                            request.where()
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "order_by",
                                                            "dateparution desc"
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "limit",
                                                            request.limit()
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "offset",
                                                            request.offset()
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "lang",
                                                            "fr"
                                                    )

                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "timezone",
                                                            "Europe/Paris"
                                                    )

                                                    .build()
                            )
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(
                                    Map.class
                            );


            if (
                    response == null
            ) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "BOAMP API returned an empty response"
                );

            }


            return parser.parse(
                    response
            );


        } catch (
                RestClientException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(

                    "BOAMP Explore API request failed",

                    exception

            );

        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneId;

import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BoampSearchResponseParser {

    private static final Pattern RAW_CPV_PATTERN =

            Pattern.compile(

                    "(?i)(?:cpv|classification)[^0-9]{0,120}([0-9]{8})"

            );


    public BoampSearchPage parse(
            Object root
    ) {

        List<?> rawResults =

                listValue(

                        findDirect(

                                root,

                                "results",
                                "records"

                        )

                );


        List<BoampNotice> notices =

                rawResults
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::unwrapRecord
                        )
                        .map(
                                this::parseRecord
                        )
                        .filter(
                                notice ->
                                        notice.externalId()
                                                !=
                                                null
                        )
                        .toList();


        long total =

                longValue(

                        findDirect(

                                root,

                                "total_count",
                                "totalCount",
                                "nhits"

                        ),

                        notices.size()

                );


        return new BoampSearchPage(

                total,

                notices

        );

    }


    private Object unwrapRecord(
            Object raw
    ) {

        if (
                !(raw instanceof Map<?, ?> map)
        ) {

            return raw;

        }


        Object record =
                directMapValue(
                        map,
                        "record"
                );


        if (
                record instanceof Map<?, ?> recordMap
        ) {

            Object fields =
                    directMapValue(
                            recordMap,
                            "fields"
                    );


            if (
                    fields instanceof Map<?, ?>
            ) {

                return fields;

            }


            return record;

        }


        Object fields =
                directMapValue(
                        map,
                        "fields"
                );


        return fields instanceof Map<?, ?>
                ? fields
                : raw;

    }


    private BoampNotice parseRecord(
            Object record
    ) {

        String idWeb =
                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "idweb"

                        )

                );


        String id =
                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "id"

                        )

                );


        String externalId =

                clean(
                        idWeb
                );


        if (
                externalId == null
        ) {

            externalId =
                    clean(
                            id
                    );

        }


        String object =

                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "objet",
                                "object"

                        )

                );


        LocalDate publicationDate =

                localDate(

                        firstText(

                                findRecursive(

                                        record,

                                        "dateparution"

                                )

                        )

                );


        Instant deadline =

                instant(

                        firstText(

                                findRecursive(

                                        record,

                                        "datelimitereponse"

                                )

                        )

                );


        String buyerName =

                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "nomacheteur"

                        )

                );


        String procedure =

                firstNonBlank(

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "procedure_libelle"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "procedure_categorise"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "type_procedure"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "soustype_procedure"
                                )
                        )

                );


        String nature =

                firstNonBlank(

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "type_marche_facette"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "type_marche"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "nature_categorise_libelle"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "nature_libelle"
                                )
                        )

                );


        String noticeType =

                firstNonBlank(

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "type_avis"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "famille_libelle"
                                )
                        )

                );


        String sourceSchema =

                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "source_schema"

                        )

                );


        String sourceUrl =

                firstText(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "url_avis"

                        )

                );


        String department =

                firstNonBlank(

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "code_departement_prestation"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "code_departement"
                                )
                        )

                );


        List<String> cpvCodes =
                cpvCodes(
                        record
                );


        BigDecimal estimatedValue =

                decimalValue(

                        findRecursive(

                                record,

                                "montant_estime",
                                "montant",
                                "valeur_estimee",
                                "estimated_value",
                                "estimatedvalue"

                        )

                );


        String currency =

                firstNonBlank(

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "devise"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "currency"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findRecursive(
                                        record,
                                        "monnaie"
                                )
                        )

                );


        return new BoampNotice(

                clean(
                        externalId
                ),

                clean(
                        id
                ),

                clean(
                        object
                ),

                publicationDate,

                deadline,

                clean(
                        buyerName
                ),

                clean(
                        procedure
                ),

                clean(
                        nature
                ),

                clean(
                        noticeType
                ),

                clean(
                        sourceSchema
                ),

                clean(
                        sourceUrl
                ),

                clean(
                        department
                ),

                cpvCodes,

                estimatedValue,

                normalizeCurrency(
                        currency
                )

        );

    }


    private List<String> cpvCodes(
            Object record
    ) {

        Set<String> cpvs =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        collectCpvValues(

                record,

                cpvs

        );


        Object rawDonnees =

                findRecursive(

                        record,

                        "donnees",
                        "DONNEES"

                );


        for (
                String raw :
                textValues(
                        rawDonnees
                )
        ) {

            Matcher matcher =

                    RAW_CPV_PATTERN
                            .matcher(
                                    raw
                            );


            while (
                    matcher.find()
            ) {

                cpvs.add(
                        matcher.group(
                                1
                        )
                );

            }

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                cpvs
        );

    }


    private void collectCpvValues(

            Object node,

            Set<String> cpvs

    ) {

        if (
                node instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                    map.entrySet()
            ) {

                String key =

                        entry.getKey()
                                ==
                                null

                                ? ""

                                : normalizeKey(
                                        entry
                                                .getKey()
                                                .toString()
                                );


                if (
                        key.contains(
                                "cpv"
                        )
                ) {

                    for (
                            String value :
                            textValues(
                                    entry.getValue()
                            )
                    ) {

                        String digits =

                                value.replaceAll(
                                        "[^0-9]",
                                        ""
                                );


                        if (
                                digits.length()
                                        >=
                                        8
                        ) {

                            cpvs.add(
                                    digits.substring(
                                            0,
                                            8
                                    )
                            );

                        }

                    }

                }


                collectCpvValues(

                        entry.getValue(),

                        cpvs

                );

            }


            return;

        }


        if (
                node instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    list
            ) {

                collectCpvValues(
                        value,
                        cpvs
                );

            }

        }

    }


    private Object findDirect(

            Object node,

            String... keys

    ) {

        if (
                !(node instanceof Map<?, ?> map)
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        for (
                String key :
                keys
        ) {

            Object value =
                    directMapValue(
                            map,
                            key
                    );


            if (
                    value != null
            ) {

                return value;

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private Object findRecursive(

            Object node,

            String... keys

    ) {

        Set<String> wanted =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                String key :
                keys
        ) {

            wanted.add(
                    normalizeKey(
                            key
                    )
            );

        }


        return findRecursive0(

                node,

                wanted

        );

    }


    private Object findRecursive0(

            Object node,

            Set<String> wanted

    ) {

        if (
                node instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                    map.entrySet()
            ) {

                if (
                        entry.getKey()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        wanted.contains(
                                normalizeKey(
                                        entry
                                                .getKey()
                                                .toString()
                                )
                        )
                ) {

                    return entry.getValue();

                }

            }


            for (
                    Object value :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                Object found =

                        findRecursive0(

                                value,

                                wanted

                        );


                if (
                        found != null
                ) {

                    return found;

                }

            }

        }


        if (
                node instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    list
            ) {

                Object found =

                        findRecursive0(

                                value,

                                wanted

                        );


                if (
                        found != null
                ) {

                    return found;

                }

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private Object directMapValue(

            Map<?, ?> map,

            String key

    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeKey(
                        key
                );


        for (
                Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                map.entrySet()
        ) {

            if (
                    entry.getKey()
                            !=
                            null
                    &&
                    normalizeKey(
                            entry
                                    .getKey()
                                    .toString()
                    )
                            .equals(
                                    normalized
                            )
            ) {

                return entry.getValue();

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private String normalizeKey(
            String value
    ) {

        return value
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "[^a-z0-9]",
                        ""
                );

    }


    private List<?> listValue(
            Object value
    ) {

        return value instanceof List<?> list
                ? list
                : List.of();

    }


    private String firstText(
            Object value
    ) {

        List<String> values =
                textValues(
                        value
                );


        return values.isEmpty()
                ? null
                : values.getFirst();

    }


    private List<String> textValues(
            Object value
    ) {

        List<String> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        collectText(

                value,

                result

        );


        return result
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::clean
                )
                .filter(
                        item ->
                                item != null
                )
                .toList();

    }


    private void collectText(

            Object value,

            List<String> target

    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof String text
        ) {

            target.add(
                    text
            );

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number
                ||
                value instanceof Boolean
        ) {

            target.add(
                    value.toString()
            );

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object item :
                    list
            ) {

                collectText(
                        item,
                        target
                );

            }


            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Object item :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                collectText(
                        item,
                        target
                );

            }

        }

    }


    private LocalDate localDate(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        try {

            return LocalDate.parse(
                    value
            );

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            try {

                return OffsetDateTime
                        .parse(
                                value
                        )
                        .toLocalDate();

            } catch (
                    DateTimeParseException ignoredAgain
            ) {

                return null;

            }

        }

    }


    private Instant instant(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        try {

            return Instant.parse(
                    value
            );

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            // Continue.

        }


        try {

            return OffsetDateTime
                    .parse(
                            value
                    )
                    .toInstant();

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            // Continue.

        }


        try {

            return LocalDateTime
                    .parse(
                            value
                    )
                    .atZone(
                            ZoneId.of(
                                    "Europe/Paris"
                            )
                    )
                    .toInstant();

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            // Continue.

        }


        try {

            return LocalDate
                    .parse(
                            value
                    )
                    .atTime(
                            23,
                            59
                    )
                    .atZone(
                            ZoneId.of(
                                    "Europe/Paris"
                            )
                    )
                    .toInstant();

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            return null;

        }

    }


    private BigDecimal decimalValue(
            Object value
    ) {

        String text =
                firstText(
                        value
                );


        if (
                text == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =

                text
                        .replace(
                                " ",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replace(
                                "€",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replace(
                                ",",
                                "."
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "[^0-9.\\-]",
                                ""
                        );


        if (
                cleaned.isBlank()
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        try {

            return new BigDecimal(
                    cleaned
            );

        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {

            return null;

        }

    }


    private String normalizeCurrency(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String upper =
                cleaned.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );


        if (
                upper.equals(
                        "€"
                )
        ) {

            return "EUR";

        }


        return upper.matches(
                "[A-Z]{3}"
        )
                ? upper
                : null;

    }


    private long longValue(

            Object value,

            long fallback

    ) {

        String text =
                firstText(
                        value
                );


        if (
                text == null
        ) {

            return fallback;

        }


        try {

            return Long.parseLong(
                    text
            );

        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {

            return fallback;

        }

    }


    private String firstNonBlank(
            String... values
    ) {

        for (
                String value :
                values
        ) {

            String cleaned =
                    clean(
                            value
                    );


            if (
                    cleaned != null
            ) {

                return cleaned;

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =

                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BoampSettings {

    private final String baseUrl;

    private final String recordsPath;

    private final String datasetId;

    private final int defaultLookbackDays;

    private final int defaultLimit;

    private final int maxLimit;

    private final boolean manualSyncEnabled;


    public BoampSettings(

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.base-url:https://boamp-datadila.opendatasoft.com}"
            )
            String baseUrl,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.records-path:/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/boamp/records}"
            )
            String recordsPath,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.dataset-id:boamp}"
            )
            String datasetId,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.default-lookback-days:7}"
            )
            int defaultLookbackDays,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.default-limit:25}"
            )
            int defaultLimit,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.max-limit:100}"
            )
            int maxLimit,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.boamp.manual-sync-enabled:true}"
            )
            boolean manualSyncEnabled

    ) {

        this.baseUrl =
                stripTrailingSlash(
                        baseUrl
                );

        this.recordsPath =
                normalizePath(
                        recordsPath
                );

        this.datasetId =
                datasetId.trim();

        this.defaultLookbackDays =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        defaultLookbackDays
                );

        this.defaultLimit =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        defaultLimit
                );

        this.maxLimit =
                Math.max(

                        1,

                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                maxLimit
                        )

                );

        this.manualSyncEnabled =
                manualSyncEnabled;

    }


    private String stripTrailingSlash(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                value.trim();


        while (
                result.endsWith(
                        "/"
                )
        ) {

            result =
                    result.substring(
                            0,
                            result.length()
                                    -
                                    1
                    );

        }


        return result;

    }


    private String normalizePath(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                value.trim();


        return result.startsWith(
                "/"
        )
                ? result
                : "/" + result;

    }


    public String baseUrl() {

        return baseUrl;

    }


    public String recordsPath() {

        return recordsPath;

    }


    public String datasetId() {

        return datasetId;

    }


    public int defaultLookbackDays() {

        return defaultLookbackDays;

    }


    public int defaultLimit() {

        return defaultLimit;

    }


    public int maxLimit() {

        return maxLimit;

    }


    public boolean manualSyncEnabled() {

        return manualSyncEnabled;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.application.CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ContractNature;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementProcedure;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpAwardMapper {

    private final DecpSettings settings;

    private final DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer
            locationNormalizer;

    private final DecpBuyerClassifier
            buyerClassifier;

    public DecpAwardMapper(
            DecpSettings settings,
            DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer locationNormalizer,
            DecpBuyerClassifier buyerClassifier
    ) {
        this.settings = settings;
        this.locationNormalizer =
                locationNormalizer;
        this.buyerClassifier =
                buyerClassifier;
    }

    public DecpMappedContract map(
            DecpAwardRecord record
    ) {

        if (record == null) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "DECP award record is required"
            );
        }

        String externalId =
                require(
                        record.externalId(),
                        "DECP contract identifier is required"
                );

        LocalDate publicationDate =
                record.publicationDate() != null
                        ? record.publicationDate()
                        : record.notificationDate();

        if (publicationDate == null) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "DECP publication or notification date is required"
            );
        }

        String title =
                clean(record.object());

        if (title == null) {
            title =
                    "French awarded public contract "
                            +
                            externalId;
        }

        String buyerId =
                clean(record.buyerId());

        String buyerName =
                clean(record.buyerName());

        if (buyerName == null) {

            buyerName =
                    buyerId == null
                            ? "French public buyer"
                            : "Public buyer " + buyerId;
        }

        String buyerCanonicalKey =
                buyerId == null
                        ? "DECP-BUYER:"
                                +
                                sha256(buyerName)
                                        .substring(0, 24)
                        : "DECP-BUYER:"
                                +
                                buyerId;

        DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer.NormalizedLocation
                location =
                locationNormalizer
                        .normalize(
                                record.executionPlaceCode(),
                                record.executionPlaceType(),
                                record.executionPlaceName()
                        );

        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput>
                locations =
                location == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : List.of(
                                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                        .LocationInput(
                                                location.countryCode(),
                                                location.regionCode(),
                                                location.regionName(),
                                                location.city()
                                        )
                        );

        String cpv =
                normalizeCpv(
                        record.cpvCode()
                );

        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.CpvInput>
                cpvs =
                cpv == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : List.of(
                                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                        .CpvInput(
                                                cpv,
                                                "CPV " + cpv
                                        )
                        );

        String upstream =
                clean(
                        record.upstreamSource()
                );

        String externalVersion =
                publicationDate
                        +
                        (
                                upstream == null
                                        ? ""
                                        : ":" + upstream
                        );

        CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest tender =
                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest(
                        ProcurementSource.DECP,

                        externalId,

                        externalVersion,

                        "AWARDED_CONTRACT",

                        settings.datasetPageUrl(),

                        fingerprint(record),

                        publicationDate
                                .atStartOfDay(
                                        ZoneId.of(
                                                "Europe/Paris"
                                        )
                                )
                                .toInstant(),

                        new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                .BuyerInput(
                                        buyerCanonicalKey,
                                        buyerName,
                                        buyerClassifier
                                                .classify(
                                                        buyerName
                                                ),
                                        "FR",
                                        location == null
                                                ? null
                                                : location.city(),
                                        buyerId,
                                        null
                                ),

                        title,

                        title,

                        ProcurementStatus.AWARDED,

                        mapProcedure(
                                record.procedure()
                        ),

                        mapContractNatureFromCpv(
                                cpv
                        ),

                        publicationDate,

                        null,

                        /*
                         * DECP montant is an AWARD value.
                         * It must never become an estimated
                         * tender value.
                         */
                        null,

                        null,

                        null,

                        "FR",

                        location == null
                                ? null
                                : location.regionCode(),

                        location == null
                                ? null
                                : location.regionName(),

                        clean(
                                record.frameworkAgreementId()
                        ) != null,

                        false,

                        false,

                        cpvs,

                        locations,

                        List.of()
                );

        CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest award =
                new CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest(
                        record.notificationDate(),

                        record.awardedAmount(),

                        record.awardedAmount() == null
                                ? null
                                : "EUR",

                        record.durationMonths(),

                        clean(record.priceForm()),

                        record.offersReceived(),

                        clean(
                                record.frameworkAgreementId()
                        ),

                        clean(
                                record.socialConsiderations()
                        ),

                        clean(
                                record.environmentalConsiderations()
                        ),

                        clean(
                                record.executionModalities()
                        ),

                        clean(
                                record.operatorGroupType()
                        ),

                        clean(
                                record.subcontractingDeclared()
                        ),

                        safeList(
                                record.suppliers()
                        )
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        supplier ->
                                                new CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest
                                                        .SupplierInput(
                                                                clean(
                                                                        supplier.identifier()
                                                                ),
                                                                clean(
                                                                        supplier.identifierType()
                                                                ),
                                                                clean(
                                                                        supplier.legalName()
                                                                )
                                                        )
                                )
                                .toList()
                );

        return new DecpMappedContract(
                tender,
                award
        );
    }

    private ProcurementProcedure mapProcedure(
            String value
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalized(value);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("dialogue")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_DIALOGUE;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("innovation")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.INNOVATION_PARTNERSHIP;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("avec negociation")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_WITH_NEGOTIATION;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("restreint")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.RESTRICTED;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("ouvert")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.OPEN;
        }

        if (
                normalized.contains("sans publicite")
                ||
                normalized.contains(
                        "sans mise en concurrence"
                )
        ) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.DIRECT_AWARD;
        }

        if (normalized.contains("negoc")) {
            return ProcurementProcedure.NEGOTIATED;
        }

        return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;
    }

    private ContractNature mapContractNatureFromCpv(
            String cpv
    ) {

        if (
                cpv == null
                ||
                cpv.length() < 2
        ) {
            return ContractNature.OTHER;
        }

        int division;

        try {
            division =
                    Integer.parseInt(
                            cpv.substring(0, 2)
                    );
        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {
            return ContractNature.OTHER;
        }

        if (division == 45) {
            return ContractNature.WORKS;
        }

        if (
                division >= 50
                &&
                division <= 98
        ) {
            return ContractNature.SERVICES;
        }

        if (
                division >= 3
                &&
                division <= 44
        ) {
            return ContractNature.SUPPLIES;
        }

        if (division == 48) {
            return ContractNature.SUPPLIES;
        }

        return ContractNature.OTHER;
    }

    private String normalizeCpv(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned = clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String digits =
                cleaned.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9]",
                        ""
                );

        return digits.length() >= 8
                ? digits.substring(0, 8)
                : null;
    }

    private String fingerprint(
            DecpAwardRecord record
    ) {

        return sha256(
                String.join(
                        "|",

                        nullSafe(
                                record.externalId()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                record.object()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                dateText(
                                        record.publicationDate()
                                )
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                dateText(
                                        record.notificationDate()
                                )
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                record.awardedAmount() == null
                                        ? null
                                        : record
                                                .awardedAmount()
                                                .toPlainString()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                record.upstreamSource()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private String dateText(LocalDate value) {
        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String sha256(String value) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest.getInstance(
                            "SHA-256"
                    );

            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(
                            digest.digest(
                                    value.getBytes(
                                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )
                            )
                    );

        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 is unavailable",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private String normalized(String value) {

        String cleaned = clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return Normalizer
                .normalize(
                        cleaned,
                        Normalizer.Form.NFD
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\p{M}+",
                        ""
                )
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private String require(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        String cleaned = clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(message);
        }

        return cleaned;
    }

    private String clean(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private String nullSafe(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value;
    }

    private <T> List<T> safeList(
            List<T> values
    ) {
        return values == null
                ? List.of()
                : values;
    }
}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/decp/DecpBuyerClassifier.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.BuyerCategory;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpBuyerClassifier {

    public BuyerCategory classify(
            String buyerName
    ) {

        String value =
                normalize(buyerName);

        if (value == null) {
            return BuyerCategory.OTHER;
        }

        if (
                value.startsWith("ville ")
                ||
                value.equals("ville")
                ||
                value.contains("commune")
                ||
                value.contains("mairie")
                ||
                value.contains("departement")
                ||
                value.startsWith("region ")
                ||
                value.contains("metropole")
                ||
                value.contains("communaute ")
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.LOCAL_AUTHORITY;
        }

        if (
                value.contains("ministere")
                ||
                value.startsWith("etat ")
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT;
        }

        if (
                value.contains("universite")
                ||
                value.contains("academie")
                ||
                value.contains("ecole")
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.EDUCATION;
        }

        if (
                value.contains("hopital")
                ||
                value.contains("centre hospitalier")
                ||
                value.startsWith("chu ")
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.HEALTHCARE;
        }

        if (
                value.contains(
                        "office public de l habitat"
                )
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.SOCIAL_HOUSING;
        }

        if (
                value.contains("transport")
                ||
                value.contains("sncf")
        ) {
            return BuyerCategory.TRANSPORT;
        }

        return BuyerCategory.PUBLIC_AGENCY;
    }

    private String normalize(
            String value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");

        if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return Normalizer
                .normalize(
                        cleaned,
                        Normalizer.Form.NFD
                )
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}+", "")
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}
