package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderImportService;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.application.CanonicalAwardImportService;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class DecpCanonicalContractImportService {

    private final CanonicalTenderImportService
            tenderImportService;

    private final CanonicalAwardImportService
            awardImportService;

    public DecpCanonicalContractImportService(
            CanonicalTenderImportService tenderImportService,
            CanonicalAwardImportService awardImportService
    ) {
        this.tenderImportService =
                tenderImportService;

        this.awardImportService =
                awardImportService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public UUID upsert(
            DecpMappedContract mapped
    ) {

        UUID tenderId =
                tenderImportService
                        .upsert(
                                mapped.tender()
                        );

        awardImportService
                .upsert(
                        tenderId,
                        mapped.award()
                );

        return tenderId;
    }
}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/decp/DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import com.tenderpilot.datasource.boamp.BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer;

import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer {

    private final BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer
            departmentRegionNormalizer;

    public DecpExecutionLocationNormalizer(
            BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer departmentRegionNormalizer
    ) {
        this.departmentRegionNormalizer =
                departmentRegionNormalizer;
    }

    public NormalizedLocation normalize(
            String rawCode,
            String rawType,
            String rawName
    ) {

        String code = clean(rawCode);
        String name = clean(rawName);

        if (
                code == null
                &&
                name == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        String department =
                deriveDepartment(code);

        BoampDepartmentRegionNormalizer.Region region =
                departmentRegionNormalizer
                        .normalize(department);

        String city =
                isMunicipalType(rawType)
                        ? name
                        : null;

        if (region == null) {
            return new NormalizedLocation(
                    "FR",
                    department,
                    name,
                    city
            );
        }

        return new NormalizedLocation(
                "FR",
                region.regionCode(),
                region.regionName(),
                city
        );
    }

    private String deriveDepartment(
            String code
    ) {

        if (code == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                code.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (
                normalized.startsWith("2A")
                ||
                normalized.startsWith("2B")
        ) {
            return normalized.substring(0, 2);
        }

        String digits =
                normalized.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9]",
                        ""
                );

        if (
                digits.length() >= 3
                &&
                (
                        digits.startsWith("97")
                        ||
                        digits.startsWith("98")
                )
        ) {
            return digits.substring(0, 3);
        }

        if (digits.length() >= 2) {
            return digits.substring(0, 2);
        }

        return digits.isBlank()
                ? null
                : digits;
    }

    private boolean isMunicipalType(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned = clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String normalized =
                cleaned.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return normalized.contains("commune")
                ||
                normalized.contains("postal");
    }

    private String clean(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    public record NormalizedLocation(
            String countryCode,
            String regionCode,
            String regionName,
            String city
    ) {
    }
}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/decp/DecpQueryFactory.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpQueryFactory {

    private final Clock clock;

    public DecpQueryFactory() {
        this(Clock.systemUTC());
    }

    DecpQueryFactory(Clock clock) {
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    public String recentPublications(
            int lookbackDays
    ) {

        int bounded =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(31, lookbackDays)
                );

        LocalDate end =
                LocalDate.now(clock);

        LocalDate start =
                end.minusDays(
                        bounded - 1L
                );

        return "datepublicationdonnees IN [date'"
                +
                start
                +
                "'..date'"
                +
                end
                +
                "']";
    }
}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/decp/DecpSearchClient.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException;

@Component
public class DecpSearchClient
        implements DecpSearchGateway {

    private final DecpSettings settings;
    private final DecpSearchResponseParser parser;
    private final RestClient restClient;

    public DecpSearchClient(
            DecpSettings settings,
            DecpSearchResponseParser parser
    ) {

        this.settings = settings;
        this.parser = parser;

        this.restClient =
                RestClient
                        .builder()
                        .baseUrl(
                                settings.baseUrl()
                        )
                        .build();
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    public DecpSearchPage search(
            DecpSearchRequest request
    ) {

        try {

            Map response =
                    restClient
                            .get()
                            .uri(
                                    builder ->
                                            builder
                                                    .path(
                                                            settings.recordsPath()
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "where",
                                                            request.where()
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "order_by",
                                                            "datepublicationdonnees desc"
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "limit",
                                                            request.limit()
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "offset",
                                                            request.offset()
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "lang",
                                                            "fr"
                                                    )
                                                    .queryParam(
                                                            "timezone",
                                                            "Europe/Paris"
                                                    )
                                                    .build()
                            )
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(Map.class);

            if (response == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "DECP Explore API returned an empty response"
                );
            }

            return parser.parse(response);

        } catch (
                RestClientException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "DECP Explore API request failed",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/datasource/decp/DecpSearchResponseParser.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpSearchResponseParser {

    public DecpSearchPage parse(
            Object root
    ) {

        List<?> rawRecords =
                asList(
                        direct(
                                root,
                                "results",
                                "records"
                        )
                );

        List<DecpAwardRecord> records =
                rawRecords
                        .stream()
                        .map(this::unwrap)
                        .map(this::parseRecord)
                        .filter(
                                record ->
                                        record.externalId()
                                                != null
                        )
                        .toList();

        long total =
                longValue(
                        direct(
                                root,
                                "total_count",
                                "totalCount",
                                "nhits"
                        ),
                        records.size()
                );

        return new DecpSearchPage(
                total,
                records
        );
    }

    private Object unwrap(Object raw) {

        if (!(raw instanceof Map<?, ?> map)) {
            return raw;
        }

        Object record =
                mapValue(map, "record");

        if (record instanceof Map<?, ?> recordMap) {

            Object fields =
                    mapValue(
                            recordMap,
                            "fields"
                    );

            if (fields instanceof Map<?, ?>) {
                return fields;
            }
        }

        Object fields =
                mapValue(map, "fields");

        return fields instanceof Map<?, ?>
                ? fields
                : raw;
    }

    private DecpAwardRecord parseRecord(
            Object record
    ) {

        return new DecpAwardRecord(
                text(
                        recursive(record, "id")
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(record, "nature")
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(record, "objet")
                ),

                normalizeCpv(
                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        record,
                                        "codecpv",
                                        "codeCPV"
                                )
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "procedure"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "acheteur_id",
                                "acheteurid"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "acheteur_nom",
                                "acheteurnom"
                        )
                ),

                integer(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "dureemois",
                                "dureeMois"
                        )
                ),

                date(
                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        record,
                                        "datenotification",
                                        "dateNotification"
                                )
                        )
                ),

                date(
                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        record,
                                        "datepublicationdonnees",
                                        "datePublicationDonnees"
                                )
                        )
                ),

                decimal(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "montant"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "formeprix",
                                "formePrix"
                        )
                ),

                integer(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "offresrecues",
                                "offresRecues"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "idaccordcadre",
                                "idAccordCadre"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "lieuexecution_code",
                                "lieuExecutionCode"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "lieuexecution_typecode",
                                "lieuExecutionTypeCode"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "lieuexecution_nom",
                                "lieuExecutionNom"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "considerationssociales",
                                "considerationsSociales"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "considerationsenvironnementales",
                                "considerationsEnvironnementales"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "modalitesexecution",
                                "modalitesExecution"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "typegroupementoperateurs",
                                "typeGroupementOperateurs"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "soustraitancedeclaree",
                                "sousTraitanceDeclaree"
                        )
                ),

                text(
                        recursive(
                                record,
                                "source"
                        )
                ),

                suppliers(record)
        );
    }

    private List<DecpSupplierData> suppliers(
            Object record
    ) {

        Map<String, DecpSupplierData> unique =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (int index = 1; index <= 5; index++) {

            String identifier =
                    text(
                            recursive(
                                    record,
                                    "titulaire_id_" + index
                            )
                    );

            String identifierType =
                    text(
                            recursive(
                                    record,
                                    "titulaire_typeidentifiant_" + index
                            )
                    );

            String legalName =
                    text(
                            recursive(
                                    record,
                                    "titulaire_denominationsociale_" + index
                            )
                    );

            addSupplier(
                    unique,
                    identifier,
                    identifierType,
                    legalName
            );
        }

        Object nested =
                recursive(
                        record,
                        "titulaires"
                );

        if (nested instanceof List<?> values) {

            for (Object value : values) {

                addSupplier(
                        unique,

                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        value,
                                        "id"
                                )
                        ),

                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        value,
                                        "typeidentifiant",
                                        "typeIdentifiant"
                                )
                        ),

                        text(
                                recursive(
                                        value,
                                        "denominationsociale",
                                        "denominationSociale"
                                )
                        )
                );
            }
        }

        return List.copyOf(
                unique.values()
        );
    }

    private void addSupplier(
            Map<String, DecpSupplierData> unique,
            String identifier,
            String identifierType,
            String legalName
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                &&
                legalName == null
        ) {
            return;
        }

        String key =
                nullSafe(identifier)
                        +
                        "|"
                        +
                        nullSafe(identifierType)
                        +
                        "|"
                        +
                        nullSafe(legalName);

        unique.putIfAbsent(
                key,
                new DecpSupplierData(
                        identifier,
                        identifierType,
                        legalName
                )
        );
    }

    private Object direct(
            Object root,
            String... keys
    ) {

        if (!(root instanceof Map<?, ?> map)) {
            return null;
        }

        for (String key : keys) {

            Object result =
                    mapValue(map, key);

            if (result != null) {
                return result;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Object recursive(
            Object node,
            String... keys
    ) {

        for (String key : keys) {

            Object result =
                    recursiveOne(
                            node,
                            normalizeKey(key)
                    );

            if (result != null) {
                return result;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Object recursiveOne(
            Object node,
            String wanted
    ) {

        if (node instanceof Map<?, ?> map) {

            for (
                    Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                    map.entrySet()
            ) {

                if (
                        entry.getKey() != null
                        &&
                        normalizeKey(
                                entry.getKey()
                                        .toString()
                        )
                                .equals(wanted)
                ) {
                    return entry.getValue();
                }
            }

            for (Object value : map.values()) {

                Object result =
                        recursiveOne(
                                value,
                                wanted
                        );

                if (result != null) {
                    return result;
                }
            }
        }

        if (node instanceof List<?> values) {

            for (Object value : values) {

                Object result =
                        recursiveOne(
                                value,
                                wanted
                        );

                if (result != null) {
                    return result;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Object mapValue(
            Map<?, ?> map,
            String key
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeKey(key);

        for (
                Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                map.entrySet()
        ) {

            if (
                    entry.getKey() != null
                    &&
                    normalizeKey(
                            entry.getKey()
                                    .toString()
                    )
                            .equals(normalized)
            ) {
                return entry.getValue();
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private String normalizeKey(
            String value
    ) {

        return value
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replaceAll(
                        "[^a-z0-9]",
                        ""
                );
    }

    private List<?> asList(Object value) {

        return value instanceof List<?> list
                ? list
                : List.of();
    }

    private String text(Object value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof List<?> values) {

            return values.isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : text(values.getFirst());
        }

        String cleaned =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private LocalDate date(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(value);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {

            if (value.length() >= 10) {

                try {
                    return LocalDate.parse(
                            value.substring(0, 10)
                    );
                } catch (
                        DateTimeParseException ignoredAgain
                ) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }
    }

    private Integer integer(Object value) {

        String cleaned = text(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        cleaned =
                cleaned.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9\\-]",
                        ""
                );

        if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return Integer.valueOf(cleaned);
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private BigDecimal decimal(Object value) {

        String cleaned = text(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        cleaned =
                cleaned
                        .replace(" ", "")
                        .replace(",", ".")
                        .replaceAll(
                                "[^0-9.\\-]",
                                ""
                        );

        if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return new BigDecimal(cleaned);
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private long longValue(
            Object value,
            long fallback
    ) {

        String cleaned = text(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return fallback;
        }

        try {
            return Long.parseLong(cleaned);
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private String normalizeCpv(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String digits =
                value.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9]",
                        ""
                );

        return digits.length() >= 8
                ? digits.substring(0, 8)
                : null;
    }

    private String nullSafe(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value;
    }
}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.decp;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DecpSettings {

    private final String baseUrl;
    private final String recordsPath;
    private final String datasetId;
    private final int defaultLookbackDays;
    private final int defaultLimit;
    private final int maxLimit;
    private final boolean manualSyncEnabled;

    public DecpSettings(
            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.base-url:https://data.economie.gouv.fr}"
            )
            String baseUrl,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.records-path:/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/decp-2022-marches-valides/records}"
            )
            String recordsPath,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.dataset-id:decp-2022-marches-valides}"
            )
            String datasetId,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.default-lookback-days:7}"
            )
            int defaultLookbackDays,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.default-limit:25}"
            )
            int defaultLimit,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.max-limit:100}"
            )
            int maxLimit,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.decp.manual-sync-enabled:true}"
            )
            boolean manualSyncEnabled
    ) {

        this.baseUrl =
                removeTrailingSlash(baseUrl);

        this.recordsPath =
                normalizePath(recordsPath);

        this.datasetId =
                datasetId.trim();

        this.defaultLookbackDays =
                Math.max(1, defaultLookbackDays);

        this.defaultLimit =
                Math.max(1, defaultLimit);

        this.maxLimit =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(100, maxLimit)
                );

        this.manualSyncEnabled =
                manualSyncEnabled;
    }

    private String removeTrailingSlash(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        while (cleaned.endsWith("/")) {
            cleaned =
                    cleaned.substring(
                            0,
                            cleaned.length() - 1
                    );
        }

        return cleaned;
    }

    private String normalizePath(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        return cleaned.startsWith("/")
                ? cleaned
                : "/" + cleaned;
    }

    public String datasetPageUrl() {

        return baseUrl
                +
                "/explore/dataset/"
                +
                datasetId
                +
                "/";
    }

    public String baseUrl() {
        return baseUrl;
    }

    public String recordsPath() {
        return recordsPath;
    }

    public String datasetId() {
        return datasetId;
    }

    public int defaultLookbackDays() {
        return defaultLookbackDays;
    }

    public int defaultLimit() {
        return defaultLimit;
    }

    public int maxLimit() {
        return maxLimit;
    }

    public boolean manualSyncEnabled() {
        return manualSyncEnabled;
    }
}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.domain;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.PrePersist;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "data_source_ingestion_runs"
)
public class IngestionRunEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            name = "source",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private ProcurementSource source;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            name = "status",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private IngestionRunStatus status;


    @Column(
            name = "query_text",
            nullable = false,
            length = 2000
    )
    private String queryText;


    @Column(
            name = "requested_limit",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int requestedLimit;


    @Column(
            name = "discovered_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int discoveredCount;


    @Column(
            name = "processed_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int processedCount;


    @Column(
            name = "failed_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int failedCount;


    @Column(
            name = "started_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant startedAt;


    @Column(
            name = "completed_at"
    )
    private Instant completedAt;


    @Column(
            name = "last_error",
            length = 1500
    )
    private String lastError;


    protected IngestionRunEntity() {
    }


    private IngestionRunEntity(

            ProcurementSource source,

            String queryText,

            int requestedLimit

    ) {

        this.id =
                UUID.randomUUID();

        this.source =
                source;

        this.status =
                IngestionRunStatus.RUNNING;

        this.queryText =
                queryText;

        this.requestedLimit =
                requestedLimit;

        this.startedAt =
                Instant.now();

    }


    public static IngestionRunEntity start(

            ProcurementSource source,

            String queryText,

            int requestedLimit

    ) {

        return new IngestionRunEntity(

                source,

                queryText,

                requestedLimit

        );

    }


    public void complete(

            int discoveredCount,

            int processedCount,

            int failedCount,

            String lastError

    ) {

        this.discoveredCount =
                discoveredCount;

        this.processedCount =
                processedCount;

        this.failedCount =
                failedCount;

        this.lastError =
                truncate(
                        lastError
                );


        if (
                failedCount == 0
        ) {

            this.status =
                    IngestionRunStatus.COMPLETED;

        } else if (
                processedCount > 0
        ) {

            this.status =
                    IngestionRunStatus.PARTIAL;

        } else {

            this.status =
                    IngestionRunStatus.FAILED;

        }


        this.completedAt =
                Instant.now();

    }


    public void fail(
            String error
    ) {

        this.status =
                IngestionRunStatus.FAILED;

        this.lastError =
                truncate(
                        error
                );

        this.completedAt =
                Instant.now();

    }


    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {

        if (
                id == null
        ) {

            id =
                    UUID.randomUUID();

        }


        if (
                status == null
        ) {

            status =
                    IngestionRunStatus.RUNNING;

        }


        if (
                startedAt == null
        ) {

            startedAt =
                    Instant.now();

        }

    }


    private String truncate(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        return value.length()
                <=
                1500

                ? value

                : value.substring(
                        0,
                        1500
                );

    }


    public UUID getId() {

        return id;

    }


    public ProcurementSource getSource() {

        return source;

    }


    public IngestionRunStatus getStatus() {

        return status;

    }


    public String getQueryText() {

        return queryText;

    }


    public int getRequestedLimit() {

        return requestedLimit;

    }


    public int getDiscoveredCount() {

        return discoveredCount;

    }


    public int getProcessedCount() {

        return processedCount;

    }


    public int getFailedCount() {

        return failedCount;

    }


    public Instant getStartedAt() {

        return startedAt;

    }


    public Instant getCompletedAt() {

        return completedAt;

    }


    public String getLastError() {

        return lastError;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TedCountryCodeNormalizer {

    private static final Map<String, String>
            ALPHA3_TO_ALPHA2 =

            Map.ofEntries(

                    Map.entry("AUT", "AT"),
                    Map.entry("BEL", "BE"),
                    Map.entry("BGR", "BG"),
                    Map.entry("HRV", "HR"),
                    Map.entry("CYP", "CY"),
                    Map.entry("CZE", "CZ"),
                    Map.entry("DNK", "DK"),
                    Map.entry("EST", "EE"),
                    Map.entry("FIN", "FI"),
                    Map.entry("FRA", "FR"),
                    Map.entry("DEU", "DE"),
                    Map.entry("GRC", "GR"),
                    Map.entry("HUN", "HU"),
                    Map.entry("IRL", "IE"),
                    Map.entry("ITA", "IT"),
                    Map.entry("LVA", "LV"),
                    Map.entry("LTU", "LT"),
                    Map.entry("LUX", "LU"),
                    Map.entry("MLT", "MT"),
                    Map.entry("NLD", "NL"),
                    Map.entry("POL", "PL"),
                    Map.entry("PRT", "PT"),
                    Map.entry("ROU", "RO"),
                    Map.entry("SVK", "SK"),
                    Map.entry("SVN", "SI"),
                    Map.entry("ESP", "ES"),
                    Map.entry("SWE", "SE"),

                    Map.entry("ISL", "IS"),
                    Map.entry("LIE", "LI"),
                    Map.entry("NOR", "NO"),

                    Map.entry("GBR", "GB"),
                    Map.entry("CHE", "CH")

            );


    public String normalize(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String normalized =

                value
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        if (
                normalized.length()
                        ==
                        2
                &&
                normalized.matches(
                        "[A-Z]{2}"
                )
        ) {

            return normalized;

        }


        return ALPHA3_TO_ALPHA2
                .get(
                        normalized
                );

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.BuyerCategory;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ContractNature;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementProcedure;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TedNoticeMapper {

    private final TedCountryCodeNormalizer
            countryCodeNormalizer;


    public TedNoticeMapper(
            TedCountryCodeNormalizer countryCodeNormalizer
    ) {

        this.countryCodeNormalizer =
                countryCodeNormalizer;

    }


    public CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest map(
            TedSearchNotice notice
    ) {

        if (
                notice == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "TED notice is required"
            );

        }


        String externalId =
                require(
                        notice.externalId(),
                        "TED publication number is required"
                );


        LocalDate publicationDate =
                notice.publicationDate();


        if (
                publicationDate == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "TED publication date is required"
            );

        }


        TedBuyerData buyer =
                notice.buyer();


        String buyerName =

                buyer == null
                        ? null
                        : clean(
                                buyer.name()
                        );


        if (
                buyerName == null
        ) {

            buyerName =
                    "TED contracting authority";

        }


        String buyerCountry =

                buyer == null
                        ? null
                        : countryCodeNormalizer
                                .normalize(
                                        buyer.countryCode()
                                );


        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput>
                locations =

                mapLocations(
                        notice.locations()
                );


        String tenderCountry =

                locations.isEmpty()

                        ? buyerCountry

                        : locations
                                .getFirst()
                                .countryCode();


        if (
                tenderCountry == null
        ) {

            tenderCountry =
                    "EU";

        }


        String primaryRegionCode =

                locations.isEmpty()
                        ? null
                        : locations
                                .getFirst()
                                .regionCode();


        String primaryRegionName =
                primaryRegionCode;


        BigDecimal estimatedValue =
                notice.estimatedValue();


        String currency =
                normalizeCurrency(
                        notice.currency()
                );


        if (
                estimatedValue != null
                &&
                currency == null
        ) {

            // Keep the canonical record truthful rather than inventing currency.
            estimatedValue =
                    null;

        }


        String title =
                clean(
                        notice.title()
                );


        if (
                title == null
        ) {

            title =
                    "TED notice "
                            +
                            externalId;

        }


        String description =
                clean(
                        notice.description()
                );


        if (
                description == null
        ) {

            description =
                    title;

        }


        CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.BuyerInput
                buyerInput =

                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                        .BuyerInput(

                                buyerCanonicalKey(

                                        buyerCountry,

                                        buyer == null
                                                ? null
                                                : buyer.identifier(),

                                        buyerName

                                ),

                                buyerName,

                                mapBuyerCategory(
                                        buyer == null
                                                ? null
                                                : buyer.legalType()
                                ),

                                buyerCountry == null
                                        ? tenderCountry
                                        : buyerCountry,

                                buyer == null
                                        ? null
                                        : clean(
                                                buyer.city()
                                        ),

                                buyer == null
                                        ? null
                                        : clean(
                                                buyer.identifier()
                                        ),

                                buyer == null
                                        ? null
                                        : urlOrNull(
                                                buyer.websiteUrl()
                                        )

                        );


        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.CpvInput>
                cpvs =

                safeList(
                        notice.cpvCodes()
                )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                value ->
                                        value != null
                                        &&
                                        value.matches(
                                                "\\d{8}"
                                        )
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .map(
                                value ->
                                        new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                                                .CpvInput(

                                                        value,

                                                        "CPV "
                                                                +
                                                                value

                                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        Instant deadline =
                submissionDeadline(
                        notice
                );


        return new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest(

                ProcurementSource.TED,

                externalId,

                clean(
                        notice.externalVersion()
                ),

                clean(
                        notice.noticeType()
                ),

                urlOrNull(
                        notice.sourceUrl()
                ),

                fingerprint(
                        notice
                ),

                publicationDate
                        .atStartOfDay(
                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                        )
                        .toInstant(),

                buyerInput,

                title,

                description,

                ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED,

                mapProcedure(
                        notice.procedureType()
                ),

                mapNature(
                        notice.contractNature()
                ),

                publicationDate,

                deadline,

                estimatedValue,

                estimatedValue,

                currency,

                tenderCountry,

                primaryRegionCode,

                primaryRegionName,

                notice.frameworkAgreement(),

                false,

                notice.electronicSubmission(),

                cpvs,

                locations,

                List.of()

        );

    }


    private List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput>
    mapLocations(
            List<TedLocationData> values
    ) {

        List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput>
                result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                TedLocationData value :
                safeList(
                        values
                )
        ) {

            String country =
                    countryCodeNormalizer
                            .normalize(
                                    value.countryCode()
                            );


            if (
                    country == null
            ) {

                continue;

            }


            result.add(

                    new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                            .LocationInput(

                                    country,

                                    clean(
                                            value.regionCode()
                                    ),

                                    clean(
                                            value.regionCode()
                                    ),

                                    clean(
                                            value.city()
                                    )

                            )

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );

    }


    private Instant submissionDeadline(
            TedSearchNotice notice
    ) {

        List<LocalDate> dates =
                safeList(
                        notice.deadlineDates()
                );


        if (
                dates.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        LocalDate earliest =

                dates.stream()
                        .min(
                                LocalDate::compareTo
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (
                earliest == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        LocalTime time =

                notice.deadlineTime()
                        == null

                        ? LocalTime.of(
                                23,
                                59
                        )

                        : notice.deadlineTime();


        return earliest
                .atTime(
                        time
                )
                .toInstant(
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                );

    }


    private ProcurementProcedure mapProcedure(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                lower(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "open"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.OPEN;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "restrict"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.RESTRICTED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "dialog"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_DIALOGUE;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "innovation"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.INNOVATION_PARTNERSHIP;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "design"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.DESIGN_CONTEST;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "negotiat"
                )
                &&
                (
                        value.contains(
                                "competition"
                        )
                        ||
                        value.contains(
                                "call"
                        )
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.COMPETITIVE_WITH_NEGOTIATION;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "negotiat"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.NEGOTIATED;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "direct"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "without prior"
                )
        ) {

            return ProcurementProcedure.DIRECT_AWARD;

        }


        return ProcurementProcedure.OTHER;

    }


    private ContractNature mapNature(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                lower(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return ContractNature.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "work"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.WORKS;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "service"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.SERVICES;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "suppl"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "goods"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.SUPPLIES;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "mixed"
                )
        ) {

            return ContractNature.MIXED;

        }


        return ContractNature.OTHER;

    }


    private BuyerCategory mapBuyerCategory(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                lower(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.OTHER;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "local"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "regional"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "rauth"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.LOCAL_AUTHORITY;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "central"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "cga"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "education"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "school"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "university"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.EDUCATION;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "health"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "hospital"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.HEALTHCARE;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "housing"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.SOCIAL_HOUSING;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "utilit"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.UTILITIES;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "transport"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.TRANSPORT;

        }


        if (
                value.contains(
                        "public"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "body"
                )
                ||
                value.contains(
                        "agency"
                )
        ) {

            return BuyerCategory.PUBLIC_AGENCY;

        }


        return BuyerCategory.OTHER;

    }


    private String buyerCanonicalKey(

            String country,

            String identifier,

            String buyerName

    ) {

        String raw =

                clean(
                        identifier
                );


        if (
                raw == null
        ) {

            raw =
                    buyerName;

        }


        return "TED-BUYER:"
                +
                (
                        country == null
                                ? "EU"
                                : country
                )
                +
                ":"
                +
                sha256(
                        raw
                )
                        .substring(
                                0,
                                24
                        );

    }


    private String fingerprint(
            TedSearchNotice notice
    ) {

        String source =

                String.join(

                        "|",

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.externalId()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.externalVersion()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.noticeType()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.title()
                        ),

                        nullSafe(
                                notice.publicationDate()
                                        == null
                                        ? null
                                        : notice
                                                .publicationDate()
                                                .toString()
                        )

                );


        return sha256(
                source
        );

    }


    private String sha256(
            String value
    ) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =

                    MessageDigest
                            .getInstance(
                                    "SHA-256"
                            );


            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(

                            digest.digest(

                                    value.getBytes(
                                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )

                            )

                    );


        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(

                    "SHA-256 is unavailable",

                    exception

            );

        }

    }


    private String normalizeCurrency(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String upper =
                cleaned.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );


        return upper.matches(
                "[A-Z]{3}"
        )
                ? upper
                : null;

    }


    private String urlOrNull(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        return cleaned.startsWith(
                "https://"
        )
                ||
                cleaned.startsWith(
                        "http://"
                )

                ? cleaned

                : null;

    }


    private String require(

            String value,

            String message

    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        if (
                cleaned == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );

        }


        return cleaned;

    }


    private String lower(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                clean(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? null
                : cleaned.toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }


    private String nullSafe(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;

    }


    private <T> List<T> safeList(
            List<T> values
    ) {

        return values == null
                ? List.of()
                : values;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TedQueryFactory {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter
            TED_DATE =

            DateTimeFormatter
                    .BASIC_ISO_DATE;


    private final Clock clock;


    public TedQueryFactory() {

        this(
                Clock.systemUTC()
        );

    }


    TedQueryFactory(
            Clock clock
    ) {

        this.clock =
                clock;

    }


    public String recentPublications(
            int lookbackDays
    ) {

        int boundedDays =

                Math.max(

                        1,

                        Math.min(
                                lookbackDays,
                                31
                        )

                );


        LocalDate end =
                LocalDate.now(
                        clock
                );


        LocalDate start =

                end.minusDays(
                        boundedDays
                                -
                                1L
                );


        return "PD = ("
                +
                TED_DATE.format(
                        start
                )
                +
                " <> "
                +
                TED_DATE.format(
                        end
                )
                +
                ")";

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.http.MediaType;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException;

@Component
public class TedSearchClient
        implements TedSearchGateway {

    private static final List<String>
            SEARCH_FIELDS =

            List.of(

                    "publication-number",
                    "notice-version",
                    "notice-type",

                    "title-proc",
                    "notice-title",
                    "description-proc",

                    "publication-date",

                    "buyer-name",
                    "buyer-identifier",
                    "buyer-country",
                    "buyer-city",
                    "buyer-internet-address",
                    "buyer-legal-type",

                    "procedure-type",

                    "contract-nature-main-proc",
                    "contract-nature",

                    "estimated-value-proc",
                    "estimated-value-cur-proc",

                    "deadline-receipt-tender-date-lot",
                    "deadline-receipt-tender-time-lot",

                    "classification-cpv",

                    "place-of-performance-country-proc",
                    "place-of-performance-subdiv-proc",
                    "place-of-performance-city-proc",

                    "framework-agreement-lot",
                    "electronic-submission-lot"

            );


    private final TedSettings settings;

    private final TedSearchResponseParser parser;

    private final RestClient restClient;


    public TedSearchClient(

            TedSettings settings,

            TedSearchResponseParser parser

    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.parser =
                parser;

        this.restClient =

                RestClient
                        .builder()
                        .baseUrl(
                                settings.baseUrl()
                        )
                        .build();

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings(
            "rawtypes"
    )
    public TedSearchPage search(
            TedSearchRequest request
    ) {

        Map<String, Object> body =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        body.put(
                "query",
                request.expertQuery()
        );

        body.put(
                "fields",
                SEARCH_FIELDS
        );

        body.put(
                "page",
                request.page()
        );

        body.put(
                "limit",
                request.limit()
        );

        body.put(
                "checkQuerySyntax",
                true
        );

        body.put(
                "paginationMode",
                "PAGE_NUMBER"
        );


        try {

            Map response =

                    restClient
                            .post()
                            .uri(
                                    settings.searchPath()
                            )
                            .contentType(
                                    MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON
                            )
                            .body(
                                    body
                            )
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(
                                    Map.class
                            );


            if (
                    response == null
            ) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "TED Search API returned an empty response"
                );

            }


            return parser.parse(
                    response
            );


        } catch (
                RestClientException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(

                    "TED Search API request failed",

                    exception

            );

        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;

import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TedSearchResponseParser {

    public TedSearchPage parse(
            Object root
    ) {

        List<?> rawNotices =
                locateNoticeArray(
                        root
                );


        List<TedSearchNotice> notices =

                rawNotices
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::parseNotice
                        )
                        .filter(
                                notice ->
                                        notice.externalId()
                                                !=
                                                null
                        )
                        .toList();


        long total =
                firstLong(

                        findValue(

                                root,

                                "total",
                                "totalCount",
                                "totalNoticeCount",
                                "totalNotices",
                                "totalResults"

                        ),

                        notices.size()

                );


        return new TedSearchPage(

                total,

                notices

        );

    }


    private TedSearchNotice parseNotice(

    ) {

        String externalId =

                                "publicationNumber",
                                "ND"

                        )

                );


        String externalVersion =

                firstText(

                        findValue(

                                item,

                                "notice-version",
                                "noticeVersion"

                        )

                );


        String noticeType =

                firstText(

                        findValue(

                                item,

                                "notice-type",
                                "noticeType"

                        )

                );


        String title =

                firstText(

                        findValue(

                                item,

                                "title-proc",
                                "notice-title",
                                "noticeTitle",
                                "title"

                        )

                );


        String description =

                firstText(

                        findValue(

                                item,

                                "description-proc",
                                "description"

                        )

                );


        LocalDate publicationDate =

                firstDate(

                        findValue(

                                item,

                                "publication-date",
                                "publicationDate",
                                "PD"

                        )

                );


        TedBuyerData buyer =

                new TedBuyerData(

                        firstText(
                                findValue(
                                        item,
                                        "buyer-name",
                                        "buyerName",
                                        "AU"
                                )
                        ),

                                        "buyer-identifier",
                                        "buyerIdentifier",
                                        "BI"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findValue(
                                        item,
                                        "buyer-country",
                                        "buyerCountry",
                                        "CY"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findValue(
                                        item,
                                        "buyer-city",
                                        "buyerCity",
                                        "TW"
                                )
                        ),

                        firstText(
                                findValue(
                                        item,
                                        "buyer-internet-address",

                                )
