    private List<TedLocationData> buildLocations(

            List<String> countries,

            List<String> regions,

            List<String> cities

    ) {

        int size =

                Math.max(

                        countries.size(),

                        Math.max(
                                regions.size(),
                                cities.size()
                        )

                );


        if (
                size == 0
        ) {

            return List.of();

        }


        List<TedLocationData> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        Set<String> seen =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                int index = 0;
                index < size;
                index++
        ) {

            String country =
                    itemAt(
                            countries,
                            index
                    );


            String region =
                    itemAt(
                            regions,
                            index
                    );


            String city =
                    itemAt(
                            cities,
                            index
                    );


            String key =

                    nullSafe(
                            country
                    )
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(
                                    region
                            )
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(
                                    city
                            );


            if (
                    seen.add(
                            key
                    )
            ) {

                result.add(

                        new TedLocationData(

                                clean(
                                        country
                                ),

                                clean(
                                        region
                                ),

                                clean(
                                        city
                                )

                        )

                );

            }

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );

    }


    private String itemAt(

            List<String> values,

            int index

    ) {

        if (
                index >=
                values.size()
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        return values.get(
                index
        );

    }


    private List<?> locateNoticeArray(
            Object root
    ) {

        Object known =

                findValue(

                        root,

                        "notices",
                        "results",
                        "items"

                );


        if (
                known instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            return list;

        }


        List<?> discovered =
                firstObjectList(
                        root
                );


        return discovered == null
                ? List.of()
                : discovered;

    }


    private List<?> firstObjectList(
            Object node
    ) {

        if (
                node instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            boolean hasMap =

                    list.stream()
                            .anyMatch(
                                    value ->
                                            value instanceof Map<?, ?>
                            );


            if (
                    hasMap
            ) {

                return list;

            }


            for (
                    Object value :
                    list
            ) {

                List<?> result =
                        firstObjectList(
                                value
                        );


                if (
                        result != null
                ) {

                    return result;

                }

            }


            return null;

        }


        if (
                node instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                List<?> result =
                        firstObjectList(
                                value
                        );


                if (
                        result != null
                ) {

                    return result;

                }

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private Object findValue(

            Object node,

            String... keys

    ) {

        Set<String> normalizedKeys =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                String key :
                keys
        ) {

            normalizedKeys.add(
                    normalizeKey(
                            key
                    )
            );

        }


        return findValueRecursive(

                node,

                normalizedKeys

        );

    }


    private Object findValueRecursive(

            Object node,

            Set<String> normalizedKeys

    ) {

        if (
                node instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                    map.entrySet()
            ) {

                if (
                        entry.getKey()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        normalizedKeys.contains(
                                normalizeKey(
                                        entry
                                                .getKey()
                                                .toString()
                                )
                        )
                ) {

                    return entry.getValue();

                }

            }


            for (
                    Object value :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                Object found =

                        findValueRecursive(

                                value,

                                normalizedKeys

                        );


                if (
                        found != null
                ) {

                    return found;

                }

            }

        }


        if (
                node instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    list
            ) {

                Object found =

                        findValueRecursive(

                                value,

                                normalizedKeys

                        );


                if (
                        found != null
                ) {

                    return found;

                }

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private String normalizeKey(
            String value
    ) {

        return value
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "[^a-z0-9]",
                        ""
                );

    }


    private String firstText(
            Object value
    ) {

        List<String> values =
                textValues(
                        value
                );


        return values.isEmpty()
                ? null
                : values.getFirst();

    }


    private List<String> textValues(
            Object value
    ) {

        List<String> result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        collectText(

                value,

                result

        );


        return result
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::clean
                )
                .filter(
                        item ->
                                item != null
                )
                .distinct()
                .toList();

    }


    private void collectText(

            Object value,

            List<String> result

    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof String string
        ) {

            result.add(
                    string
            );

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number
                ||
                value instanceof Boolean
        ) {

            result.add(
                    value.toString()
            );

            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object item :
                    list
            ) {

                collectText(
                        item,
                        result
                );

            }


            return;

        }


        if (
                value instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            Object english =

                    firstMapValue(

                            map,

                            "eng",
                            "en",
                            "ENG",
                            "EN"

                    );


            if (
                    english != null
            ) {

                collectText(
                        english,
                        result
                );


                for (
                        Object item :
                        map.values()
                ) {

                    if (
                            item != english
                    ) {

                        collectText(
                                item,
                                result
                        );

                    }

                }


                return;

            }


            for (
                    Object item :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                collectText(
                        item,
                        result
                );

            }

        }

    }


    private Object firstMapValue(

            Map<?, ?> map,

            String... keys

    ) {

        for (
                String key :
                keys
        ) {

            for (
                    Map.Entry<?, ?> entry :
                    map.entrySet()
            ) {

                if (
                        entry.getKey()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        entry
                                .getKey()
                                .toString()
                                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                        key
                                )
                ) {

                    return entry.getValue();

                }

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private LocalDate firstDate(
            Object value
    ) {

        for (
                String text :
                textValues(
                        value
                )
        ) {

            LocalDate parsed =
                    parseDate(
                            text
                    );


            if (
                    parsed != null
            ) {

                return parsed;

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private LocalDate parseDate(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =
                value.trim();


        List<DateTimeFormatter> formatters =

                List.of(

                        DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE,

                        DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE

                );


        for (
                DateTimeFormatter formatter :
                formatters
        ) {

            try {

                return LocalDate.parse(

                        cleaned,

                        formatter

                );

            } catch (
                    DateTimeParseException ignored
            ) {

                // Try the next format.

            }

        }


        try {

            return OffsetDateTime
                    .parse(
                            cleaned
                    )
                    .toLocalDate();

        } catch (
                DateTimeParseException ignored
        ) {

            return null;

        }

    }


    private LocalTime firstTime(
            Object value
    ) {

        for (
                String text :
                textValues(
                        value
                )
        ) {

            try {

                return LocalTime.parse(
                        text
                );

            } catch (
                    DateTimeParseException ignored
            ) {

                // Continue.

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private BigDecimal firstDecimal(
            Object value
    ) {

        for (
                String text :
                textValues(
                        value
                )
        ) {

            try {

                return new BigDecimal(

                        text
                                .replace(
                                        " ",
                                        ""
                                )
                                .replace(
                                        ",",
                                        "."
                                )

                );

            } catch (
                    NumberFormatException ignored
            ) {

                // Continue.

            }

        }


        return null;

    }


    private String extractCpv(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String digits =
                value.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9]",
                        ""
                );


        if (
                digits.length()
                        <
                        8
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String candidate =
                digits.substring(
                        0,
                        8
                );


        return candidate.matches(
                "\\d{8}"
        )
                ? candidate
                : null;

    }


    private boolean signalEnabled(
            Object value
    ) {

        List<String> values =
                textValues(
                        value
                );


        for (
                String candidate :
                values
        ) {

            String normalized =

                    candidate
                            .trim()
                            .toLowerCase(
                                    Locale.ROOT
                            );


            if (
                    normalized.equals(
                            "false"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.equals(
                            "no"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.equals(
                            "none"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.equals(
                            "not-applicable"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.equals(
                            "not applicable"
                    )
            ) {

                continue;

            }


            if (
                    normalized.equals(
                            "true"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.equals(
                            "yes"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.contains(
                            "framework"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.startsWith(
                            "fa-"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.contains(
                            "allowed"
                    )
                    ||
                    normalized.contains(
                            "required"
                    )
            ) {

                return true;

            }

        }


        return false;

    }


    private String chooseSourceUrl(
            Object item
    ) {

        List<String> urls =
                new ArrayList<>();


        collectUrls(
                item,
                urls
        );


        for (
                String url :
                urls
        ) {

            String lower =
                    url.toLowerCase(
                            Locale.ROOT
                    );


            if (
                    lower.contains(
                            "ted.europa.eu"
                    )
                    &&
                    !lower.endsWith(
                            ".xml"
                    )
                    &&
                    !lower.endsWith(
                            ".pdf"
                    )
                    &&
                    !lower.contains(
                            "/api/"
                    )
            ) {

                return url;

            }

        }


        return urls.isEmpty()
                ? null
                : urls.getFirst();

    }


    private void collectUrls(

            Object node,

            List<String> urls

    ) {

        if (
                node instanceof String string
        ) {

            if (
                    string.startsWith(
                            "https://"
                    )
                    ||
                    string.startsWith(
                            "http://"
                    )
            ) {

                urls.add(
                        string
                );

            }


            return;

        }


        if (
                node instanceof List<?> list
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    list
            ) {

                collectUrls(
                        value,
                        urls
                );

            }


            return;

        }


        if (
                node instanceof Map<?, ?> map
        ) {

            for (
                    Object value :
                    map.values()
            ) {

                collectUrls(
                        value,
                        urls
                );

            }

        }

    }


    private long firstLong(

            Object value,

            long fallback

    ) {

        String text =
                firstText(
                        value
                );


        if (
                text == null
        ) {

            return fallback;

        }


        try {

            return Long.parseLong(
                    text
            );

        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {

            return fallback;

        }

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }


    private String nullSafe(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.datasource.ted;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TedSettings {

    private final String baseUrl;

    private final String searchPath;

    private final int defaultLookbackDays;

    private final int defaultLimit;

    private final int maxLimit;

    private final boolean manualSyncEnabled;


    public TedSettings(

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.base-url:https://api.ted.europa.eu}"
            )
            String baseUrl,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.search-path:/v3/notices/search}"
            )
            String searchPath,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.default-lookback-days:7}"
            )
            int defaultLookbackDays,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.default-limit:25}"
            )
            int defaultLimit,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.max-limit:100}"
            )
            int maxLimit,


            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.ted.manual-sync-enabled:true}"
            )
            boolean manualSyncEnabled

    ) {

        this.baseUrl =
                stripTrailingSlash(
                        baseUrl
                );

        this.searchPath =
                normalizePath(
                        searchPath
                );

        this.defaultLookbackDays =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        defaultLookbackDays
                );

        this.defaultLimit =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        defaultLimit
                );

        this.maxLimit =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        maxLimit
                );

        this.manualSyncEnabled =
                manualSyncEnabled;

    }


    private String stripTrailingSlash(
            String value
    ) {

        String trimmed =
                value.trim();


        while (
                trimmed.endsWith(
                        "/"
                )
        ) {

            trimmed =
                    trimmed.substring(
                            0,
                            trimmed.length()
                                    -
                                    1
                    );

        }


        return trimmed;

    }


    private String normalizePath(
            String value
    ) {

        String trimmed =
                value.trim();


        return trimmed.startsWith(
                "/"
        )
                ? trimmed
                : "/" + trimmed;

    }


    public String baseUrl() {

        return baseUrl;

    }


    public String searchPath() {

        return searchPath;

    }


    public int defaultLookbackDays() {

        return defaultLookbackDays;

    }


    public int defaultLimit() {

        return defaultLimit;

    }


    public int maxLimit() {

        return maxLimit;

    }


    public boolean manualSyncEnabled() {

        return manualSyncEnabled;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.identity.api;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.application.AuthenticationService;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.application.CurrentSessionService;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.application.IssuedSession;

import com.tenderpilot.security.SecurityProperties;

import jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import java.util.Arrays;

import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/auth"
)
public class AuthController {

    private final AuthenticationService
            authenticationService;


    private final CurrentSessionService
            currentSessionService;


    private final RefreshCookieService
            refreshCookieService;


    private final SecurityProperties
            securityProperties;


    public AuthController(

            AuthenticationService authenticationService,

            CurrentSessionService currentSessionService,

            RefreshCookieService refreshCookieService,

            SecurityProperties securityProperties

    ) {

        this.authenticationService =
                authenticationService;

        this.currentSessionService =
                currentSessionService;

        this.refreshCookieService =
                refreshCookieService;

        this.securityProperties =
                securityProperties;

    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/register"
    )
    public ResponseEntity<AuthSessionResponse> register(

            @Valid
            @RequestBody
            RegisterRequest request

    ) {

        return sessionResponse(

                authenticationService
                        .register(
                                request
                        )

        );

    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/login"
    )
    public ResponseEntity<AuthSessionResponse> login(

            @Valid
            @RequestBody
            LoginRequest request

    ) {

        return sessionResponse(

                authenticationService
                        .login(
                                request
                        )

        );

    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/refresh"
    )
    public ResponseEntity<AuthSessionResponse> refresh(
            HttpServletRequest request
    ) {

        String refreshToken =

                readRefreshCookie(
                        request
                );


        if (
                refreshToken == null
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    "Refresh session is unavailable"
            );

        }


        return sessionResponse(

                authenticationService
                        .refresh(
                                refreshToken
                        )

        );

    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/logout"
    )
    public ResponseEntity<Void> logout(
            HttpServletRequest request
    ) {

        authenticationService
                .logout(
                        readRefreshCookie(
                                request
                        )
                );


        return ResponseEntity
                .noContent()
                .header(

                        HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE,

                        refreshCookieService
                                .clear()
                                .toString()

                )
                .build();

    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/me"
    )
    public AuthUserResponse me() {

        return currentSessionService
                .currentUser();

    }


    private ResponseEntity<AuthSessionResponse>
    sessionResponse(
            IssuedSession issuedSession
    ) {

        return ResponseEntity

                .ok()

                .header(

                        HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE,

                        refreshCookieService
                                .create(
                                        issuedSession
                                                .refreshToken()
                                )
                                .toString()

                )

                .body(
                        issuedSession.response()
                );

    }


    private String readRefreshCookie(
            HttpServletRequest request
    ) {

        Cookie[] cookies =
                request.getCookies();


        if (
                cookies == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        return Arrays
                .stream(
                        cookies
                )
                .filter(
                        cookie ->
                                securityProperties
                                        .refreshCookieName()
                                        .equals(
                                                cookie.getName()
                                        )
                )
                .map(
                        Cookie::getValue
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(
                        null
                );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/identity/api/RefreshCookieService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.identity.api;

import com.tenderpilot.security.SecurityProperties;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.springframework.http.ResponseCookie;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class RefreshCookieService {

    private final SecurityProperties
            securityProperties;


    public RefreshCookieService(
            SecurityProperties securityProperties
    ) {

        this.securityProperties =
                securityProperties;

    }


    public ResponseCookie create(
            String rawRefreshToken
    ) {

        return ResponseCookie

                .from(
                        securityProperties
                                .refreshCookieName(),
                        rawRefreshToken
                )

                .httpOnly(
                        true
                )

                .secure(
                        securityProperties
                                .refreshCookieSecure()
                )

                .sameSite(
                        "Strict"
                )

                .path(
                        "/api/v1/auth"
                )

                .maxAge(
                        securityProperties
                                .refreshTokenTtl()
                )

                .build();

    }


    public ResponseCookie clear() {

        return ResponseCookie

                .from(
                        securityProperties
                                .refreshCookieName(),
                        ""
                )

                .httpOnly(
                        true
                )

                .secure(
                        securityProperties
                                .refreshCookieSecure()
                )

                .sameSite(
                        "Strict"
                )

                .path(
                        "/api/v1/auth"
                )

                .maxAge(
                        Duration.ZERO
                )

                .build();

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.identity.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ConflictException;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.api.AuthSessionResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.api.LoginRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.api.RegisterRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.RefreshTokenEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.UserEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.UserStatus;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.infrastructure.RefreshTokenRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.application.OrganizationSlugService;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.MembershipRole;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationMembershipEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationMembershipRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuthenticationService {

    private static final String GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR =
            "Invalid email or password";


    private final UserRepository
            userRepository;


    private final OrganizationRepository
            organizationRepository;


    private final OrganizationMembershipRepository
            membershipRepository;


    private final RefreshTokenRepository
            refreshTokenRepository;


    private final PasswordEncoder
            passwordEncoder;


    private final IdentityNormalizer
            identityNormalizer;


    private final OrganizationSlugService
            organizationSlugService;


    private final JwtTokenService
            jwtTokenService;


    private final RefreshTokenService
            refreshTokenService;


    private final AuthResponseFactory
            authResponseFactory;


    public AuthenticationService(

            UserRepository userRepository,

            OrganizationRepository organizationRepository,

            OrganizationMembershipRepository membershipRepository,

            RefreshTokenRepository refreshTokenRepository,

            PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,

            IdentityNormalizer identityNormalizer,

            OrganizationSlugService organizationSlugService,

            JwtTokenService jwtTokenService,

            RefreshTokenService refreshTokenService,

            AuthResponseFactory authResponseFactory

    ) {

        this.userRepository =
                userRepository;

        this.organizationRepository =
                organizationRepository;

        this.membershipRepository =
                membershipRepository;

        this.refreshTokenRepository =
                refreshTokenRepository;

        this.passwordEncoder =
                passwordEncoder;

        this.identityNormalizer =
                identityNormalizer;

        this.organizationSlugService =
                organizationSlugService;

        this.jwtTokenService =
                jwtTokenService;

        this.refreshTokenService =
                refreshTokenService;

        this.authResponseFactory =
                authResponseFactory;

    }


    @Transactional
    public IssuedSession register(
            RegisterRequest request
    ) {

        String normalizedEmail =

                identityNormalizer
                        .normalizeEmail(
                                request.email()
                        );


        if (
                userRepository
                        .existsByNormalizedEmail(
                                normalizedEmail
                        )
        ) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "An account already exists for this email address"
            );

        }


        String fullName =

                identityNormalizer
                        .cleanDisplayText(
                                request.fullName()
                        );


        String organizationName =

                identityNormalizer
                        .cleanDisplayText(
                                request.organizationName()
                        );


        UserEntity user =

                UserEntity
                        .create(

                                normalizedEmail,

                                normalizedEmail,

                                passwordEncoder
                                        .encode(
                                                request.password()
                                        ),

                                fullName

                        );


        userRepository
                .save(
                        user
                );


        OrganizationEntity organization =

                OrganizationEntity
                        .create(

                                organizationName,

                                organizationSlugService
                                        .generate(
                                                organizationName
                                        )

                        );


        organizationRepository
                .save(
                        organization
                );


        OrganizationMembershipEntity membership =

                OrganizationMembershipEntity
                        .create(

                                organization,

                                user,

                                MembershipRole.OWNER

                        );


        membershipRepository
                .save(
                        membership
                );


        return issueSession(

                user,

                organization,

                MembershipRole.OWNER

        );

    }


    @Transactional
    public IssuedSession login(
            LoginRequest request
    ) {

        String normalizedEmail =

                identityNormalizer
                        .normalizeEmail(
                                request.email()
                        );


        UserEntity user =

                userRepository
                        .findByNormalizedEmail(
                                normalizedEmail
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR
                                        )
                        );


        if (
                user.getStatus()
                        !=
                        UserStatus.ACTIVE
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR
            );

        }


        if (
                !passwordEncoder
                        .matches(

                                request.password(),

                                user.getPasswordHash()

                        )
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR
            );

        }


        OrganizationMembershipEntity membership =

                membershipRepository
                        .findFirstByUser_IdOrderByCreatedAtAsc(
                                user.getId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Account is not attached to an organization"
                                        )
                        );


        return issueSession(

                user,

                membership.getOrganization(),

                membership.getRole()

        );

    }


    @Transactional
    public IssuedSession refresh(
            String rawRefreshToken
    ) {

        RefreshTokenEntity existing =

                refreshTokenService
                        .find(
                                rawRefreshToken
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Refresh session is invalid"
                                        )
                        );


        if (
                !existing
                        .isUsableAt(
                                Instant.now()
                        )
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    "Refresh session has expired"
            );

        }


        UserEntity user =
                existing.getUser();


        OrganizationEntity organization =
                existing.getOrganization();


        if (
                user.getStatus()
                        !=
                        UserStatus.ACTIVE
        ) {

            existing.revoke();

            refreshTokenRepository
                    .save(
                            existing
                    );


            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    "Account is not active"
            );

        }


        OrganizationMembershipEntity membership =

                membershipRepository
                        .findByUser_IdAndOrganization_Id(

                                user.getId(),

                                organization.getId()

                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Organization membership is no longer active"
                                        )
                        );


        existing.consume();

        refreshTokenRepository
                .save(
                        existing
                );


        return issueSession(

                user,

                organization,

                membership.getRole()

        );

    }


    @Transactional
    public void logout(
            String rawRefreshToken
    ) {

        refreshTokenService
                .revokeIfPresent(
                        rawRefreshToken
                );

    }


    private IssuedSession issueSession(

            UserEntity user,

            OrganizationEntity organization,

            MembershipRole role

    ) {

        IssuedAccessToken accessToken =

                jwtTokenService
                        .issue(

                                user,

                                organization,

                                role

                        );


        CreatedRefreshToken refreshToken =

                refreshTokenService
                        .create(

                                user,

                                organization

                        );


        AuthSessionResponse response =

                authResponseFactory
                        .session(

                                accessToken,

                                user,

                                organization,

                                role

                        );


        return new IssuedSession(

                response,

                refreshToken.rawToken()

        );

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.identity.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.api.AuthUserResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.UserEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.tenant.CurrentPrincipalService;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CurrentSessionService {

    private final CurrentPrincipalService
            currentPrincipalService;


    private final UserRepository
            userRepository;


    private final OrganizationRepository
            organizationRepository;


    private final OrganizationMembershipRepository
            membershipRepository;


    private final AuthResponseFactory
            authResponseFactory;


    public CurrentSessionService(

            CurrentPrincipalService currentPrincipalService,

            UserRepository userRepository,

            OrganizationRepository organizationRepository,

            OrganizationMembershipRepository membershipRepository,

            AuthResponseFactory authResponseFactory

    ) {

        this.currentPrincipalService =
                currentPrincipalService;

        this.userRepository =
                userRepository;

        this.organizationRepository =
                organizationRepository;

        this.membershipRepository =
                membershipRepository;

        this.authResponseFactory =
                authResponseFactory;

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public AuthUserResponse currentUser() {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        UserEntity user =

                userRepository
                        .findById(
                                principal.userId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Authenticated user no longer exists"
                                        )
                        );


        OrganizationEntity organization =

                organizationRepository
                        .findById(
                                principal.organizationId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Authenticated organization no longer exists"
                                        )
                        );


        OrganizationMembershipEntity membership =

                membershipRepository
                        .findByUser_IdAndOrganization_Id(

                                user.getId(),

                                organization.getId()

                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                                "Authenticated organization membership no longer exists"
                                        )
                        );


        return authResponseFactory
                .user(

                        user,

                        organization,

                        membership.getRole()

                );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/identity/application/JwtTokenService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.identity.application;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.UserEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.MembershipRole;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.security.SecurityProperties;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jose.jws.MacAlgorithm;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtClaimsSet;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtEncoderParameters;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwsHeader;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class JwtTokenService {

    private final JwtEncoder jwtEncoder;

    private final SecurityProperties
            securityProperties;


    public JwtTokenService(

            JwtEncoder jwtEncoder,

            SecurityProperties securityProperties

    ) {

        this.jwtEncoder =
                jwtEncoder;

        this.securityProperties =
                securityProperties;

    }


    public IssuedAccessToken issue(

            UserEntity user,

            OrganizationEntity organization,

            MembershipRole role

    ) {

        Instant issuedAt =
                Instant.now();


        Instant expiresAt =
                issuedAt.plus(
                        securityProperties
                                .accessTokenTtl()
                );


        JwtClaimsSet claims =

                JwtClaimsSet
                        .builder()

                        .issuer(
                                securityProperties
                                        .issuer()
                        )

                        .subject(
                                user
                                        .getId()
                                        .toString()
                        )

                        .issuedAt(
                                issuedAt
                        )

                        .expiresAt(
                                expiresAt
                        )

                        .id(
                                UUID
                                        .randomUUID()
                                        .toString()
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "token_type",
                                "access"
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "email",
                                user.getEmail()
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "name",
                                user.getFullName()
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "org_id",
                                organization
                                        .getId()
                                        .toString()
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "org_name",
                                organization.getName()
                        )

                        .claim(
                                "role",
                                role.name()
                        )

                        .build();


        JwsHeader header =

                JwsHeader
                        .with(
                                MacAlgorithm.HS256
                        )
                        .type(
                                "JWT"
                        )
                        .build();


        String value =

                jwtEncoder
                        .encode(
                                JwtEncoderParameters
                                        .from(
                                                header,
                                                claims
                                        )
                        )
                        .getTokenValue();


        return new IssuedAccessToken(

                value,

                expiresAt,

                securityProperties
                        .accessTokenTtl()
                        .toSeconds()

        );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/identity/application/RefreshTokenService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.identity.application;

import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.RefreshTokenEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.domain.UserEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.identity.infrastructure.RefreshTokenRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.security.SecurityProperties;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.SecureRandom;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class RefreshTokenService {

    private static final int TOKEN_BYTES =
            32;


    private final SecureRandom secureRandom =
            new SecureRandom();


    private final RefreshTokenRepository
            refreshTokenRepository;


    private final SecurityProperties
            securityProperties;


    public RefreshTokenService(

            RefreshTokenRepository refreshTokenRepository,

            SecurityProperties securityProperties

    ) {

        this.refreshTokenRepository =
                refreshTokenRepository;

        this.securityProperties =
                securityProperties;

    }


    public CreatedRefreshToken create(

            UserEntity user,

            OrganizationEntity organization

    ) {

        byte[] randomBytes =
                new byte[
                        TOKEN_BYTES
                        ];


        secureRandom.nextBytes(
                randomBytes
        );


        String rawToken =

                Base64
                        .getUrlEncoder()
                        .withoutPadding()
                        .encodeToString(
                                randomBytes
                        );


        RefreshTokenEntity entity =

                RefreshTokenEntity
                        .create(

                                user,

                                organization,

                                hash(
                                        rawToken
                                ),

                                Instant
                                        .now()
                                        .plus(
                                                securityProperties
                                                        .refreshTokenTtl()
                                        )

                        );


        refreshTokenRepository
                .save(
                        entity
                );


        return new CreatedRefreshToken(

                rawToken,

                entity

        );

    }


    public Optional<RefreshTokenEntity> find(
            String rawToken
    ) {

        if (
                rawToken == null
                ||
                rawToken.isBlank()
        ) {

            return Optional.empty();

        }


        return refreshTokenRepository
                .findByTokenHash(
                        hash(
                                rawToken
                        )
                );

    }


    public void revokeIfPresent(
            String rawToken
    ) {

        find(
                rawToken
        )
                .ifPresent(
                        token -> {

                            token.revoke();

                            refreshTokenRepository
                                    .save(
                                            token
                                    );

                        }
                );

    }


    private String hash(
            String rawToken
    ) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest
                            .getInstance(
                                    "SHA-256"
                            );


            byte[] hashed =

                    digest.digest(

                            rawToken
                                    .getBytes(
                                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )

                    );


            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(
                            hashed
                    );


        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 is unavailable",
                    exception
            );

        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.identity.domain;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.ManyToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.PrePersist;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "auth_refresh_tokens"
)
public class RefreshTokenEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;


    @ManyToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "user_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private UserEntity user;


    @ManyToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "organization_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private OrganizationEntity organization;


    @Column(
            name = "token_hash",
            nullable = false,
            unique = true,
            length = 64
    )
    private String tokenHash;


    @Column(
            name = "expires_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant expiresAt;


    @Column(
            name = "created_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant createdAt;


    @Column(
            name = "last_used_at"
    )
    private Instant lastUsedAt;


    @Column(
            name = "revoked_at"
    )
    private Instant revokedAt;


    protected RefreshTokenEntity() {
    }


    private RefreshTokenEntity(

            UUID id,

            UserEntity user,

            OrganizationEntity organization,

            String tokenHash,

            Instant expiresAt

    ) {

        this.id =
                id;

        this.user =
                user;

        this.organization =
                organization;

        this.tokenHash =
                tokenHash;

        this.expiresAt =
                expiresAt;

    }


    public static RefreshTokenEntity create(

            UserEntity user,

            OrganizationEntity organization,

            String tokenHash,

            Instant expiresAt

    ) {

        return new RefreshTokenEntity(

                UUID.randomUUID(),

                user,

                organization,

                tokenHash,

                expiresAt

        );

    }


    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {

        if (
                id == null
        ) {

            id =
                    UUID.randomUUID();

        }


        if (
                createdAt == null
        ) {

            createdAt =
                    Instant.now();

        }

    }


    public void consume() {

        Instant now =
                Instant.now();

        lastUsedAt =
                now;

        revokedAt =
                now;

    }


    public void revoke() {

        if (
                revokedAt == null
        ) {

            revokedAt =
                    Instant.now();

        }

    }


    public boolean isUsableAt(
            Instant instant
    ) {

        return revokedAt == null
                &&
                expiresAt.isAfter(
                        instant
                );

    }


    public UUID getId() {

        return id;

    }


    public UserEntity getUser() {

        return user;

    }


    public OrganizationEntity getOrganization() {

        return organization;

    }


    public String getTokenHash() {

        return tokenHash;

    }


    public Instant getExpiresAt() {

        return expiresAt;

    }


    public Instant getCreatedAt() {

        return createdAt;

    }


    public Instant getLastUsedAt() {

        return lastUsedAt;

    }


    public Instant getRevokedAt() {

        return revokedAt;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.localai.api;

import com.tenderpilot.localai.application.BidDocumentAiAnalysisService;
import com.tenderpilot.localai.application.LocalAiStatusService;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.security.CurrentOrganizationResolver;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/local-ai"
)
@PreAuthorize(
        "isAuthenticated()"
)
public class LocalAiController {

    private final LocalAiStatusService
            statusService;


    private final BidDocumentAiAnalysisService
            analysisService;


    private final CurrentOrganizationResolver
            organizationResolver;


    public LocalAiController(
            LocalAiStatusService statusService,
            BidDocumentAiAnalysisService analysisService,
            CurrentOrganizationResolver organizationResolver
    ) {

        this.statusService =
                statusService;

        this.analysisService =
                analysisService;

        this.organizationResolver =
                organizationResolver;
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/status"
    )
    public LocalAiStatusResponse status() {

        return statusService
                .status();
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/bid-workspaces/{tenderId}/analyses"
    )
    public List<BidDocumentAiAnalysisResponse> analyses(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return analysisService
                .analyses(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId
                );
    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/bid-workspaces/{tenderId}/documents/{documentId}/analyze"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER','ANALYST')"
    )
    public BidDocumentAiAnalysisResponse analyze(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId,
            @PathVariable
            UUID documentId
    ) {

        return analysisService
                .analyze(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId,
                        documentId
                );
    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/bid-workspaces/{tenderId}/analyze-all"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER','ANALYST')"
    )
    public List<BidDocumentAiAnalysisResponse> analyzeAll(
            Authentication authentication,
            @PathVariable
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        return analysisService
                .analyzeAll(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                ),
                        tenderId
                );
    }

}
