    private void validateQueryCapabilities(
            MarketQuery query,
            MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema schema
    ) {

        var base =
                schema.base();


        if (
                query.country() != null
                &&
                !schema.countryAvailable()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Country filtering is unavailable for the current procurement corpus"
            );
        }


        if (
                query.region() != null
                &&
                !schema.regionAvailable()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Region filtering is unavailable for the current procurement corpus"
            );
        }


        if (
                query.cpvPrefix() != null
                &&
                !base.cpvAvailable()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "CPV filtering is unavailable for the current procurement corpus"
            );
        }


        if (
                query.status() != null
                &&
                base.tenderStatus() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Status filtering is unavailable for the current procurement corpus"
            );
        }


        if (
                (
                        query.dateFrom() != null
                        ||
                        query.dateTo() != null
                )
                &&
                base.tenderPublicationDate() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Publication-date filtering is unavailable for the current procurement corpus"
            );
        }
    }


    private void appendCountryFilter(
            StringBuilder sql,
            List<Object> args,
            String country,
            MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema schema
    ) {

        if (
                country == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        var base =
                schema.base();


        if (
                schema.locationRowsAvailable()
                &&
                schema.locationCountry() != null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and exists (select 1 from "
            )
                    .append(
                            q(
                                    schema.locationTable()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " ml where "
                    )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "ml",
                                    schema.locationTenderId()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " = "
                    )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "t",
                                    base.tenderId()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " and upper("
                    )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "ml",
                                    schema.locationCountry()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") = upper(?))"
                    );


            args.add(
                    country
            );

            return;
        }


        sql.append(
                " and upper("
        )
                .append(
                        column(
                                "t",
                                schema.tenderCountry()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        ") = upper(?)"
                );


        args.add(
                country
        );
    }


    private void appendRegionFilter(
            StringBuilder sql,
            List<Object> args,
            String region,
            MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema schema
    ) {

        if (
                region == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        var base =
                schema.base();


        if (
                schema.locationRowsAvailable()
                &&
                (
                        schema.locationRegionCode() != null
                        ||
                        schema.locationRegionName() != null
                )
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and exists (select 1 from "
            )
                    .append(
                            q(
                                    schema.locationTable()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " mr where "
                    )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "mr",
                                    schema.locationTenderId()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " = "
                    )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "t",
                                    base.tenderId()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            " and ("
                    );


            boolean first =
                    true;


            if (
                    schema.locationRegionCode() != null
            ) {

                sql.append(
                        "upper("
                )
                        .append(
                                column(
                                        "mr",
                                        schema.locationRegionCode()
                                )
                        )
                        .append(
                                ") = upper(?)"
                        );


                args.add(
                        region
                );

                first =
                        false;
            }


            if (
                    schema.locationRegionName() != null
            ) {

                if (
                        !first
                ) {

                    sql.append(
                            " or "
                    );
                }


                sql.append(
                        "lower("
                )
                        .append(
                                column(
                                        "mr",
                                        schema.locationRegionName()
                                )
                        )
                        .append(
                                ") = lower(?)"
                        );


                args.add(
                        region
                );
            }


            sql.append(
                    "))"
            );


            return;
        }


        sql.append(
                " and ("
        );


        boolean first =
                true;


        if (
                schema.tenderRegionCode() != null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    "upper("
            )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "t",
                                    schema.tenderRegionCode()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") = upper(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    region
            );


            first =
                    false;
        }


        if (
                schema.tenderRegionName() != null
        ) {

            if (
                    !first
            ) {

                sql.append(
                        " or "
                );
            }


            sql.append(
                    "lower("
            )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "t",
                                    schema.tenderRegionName()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") = lower(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    region
            );
        }


        sql.append(
                ")"
        );
    }


    private void appendCpvFilter(
            StringBuilder sql,
            List<Object> args,
            String cpvPrefix,
            MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema schema
    ) {

        if (
                cpvPrefix == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        var base =
                schema.base();


        sql.append(
                " and exists (select 1 from "
        )
                .append(
                        q(
                                base.cpvTable()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " mc where "
                )
                .append(
                        column(
                                "mc",
                                base.cpvTenderId()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " = "
                )
                .append(
                        column(
                                "t",
                                base.tenderId()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " and "
                )
                .append(
                        column(
                                "mc",
                                base.cpvCode()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " like ?)"
                );


        args.add(
                cpvPrefix
                        +
                        "%"
        );
    }


    private MarketTenderObservation tender(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {

        return new MarketTenderObservation(
                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_id"
                        )
                ),

                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_id"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_name"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_category"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_country"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_title"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_status"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_procedure"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "contract_nature"
                        )
                ),

                date(
                        row.get(
                                "publication_date"
                        )
                ),

                instant(
                        row.get(
                                "submission_deadline"
                        )
                ),

                decimal(
                        row.get(
                                "estimated_min_value"
                        )
                ),

                decimal(
                        row.get(
                                "estimated_max_value"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_currency"
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private String projection(
            String tableAlias,
            String identifier,
            String alias
    ) {

        return identifier == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : column(
                        tableAlias,
                        identifier
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String plainProjection(
            String identifier,
            String alias
    ) {

        return identifier == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : q(
                        identifier
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String column(
            String tableAlias,
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                tableAlias == null
                ||
                !tableAlias.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid table alias"
            );
        }


        return tableAlias
                +
                "."
                +
                q(
                        identifier
                );
    }


    private String q(
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                ||
                !identifier.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid database identifier"
            );
        }


        return "\""
                +
                identifier
                +
                "\"";
    }


    private String placeholders(
            int count
    ) {

        return String.join(
                ",",
                Collections.nCopies(
                        count,
                        "?"
                )
        );
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        return UUID.fromString(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private BigDecimal decimal(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof BigDecimal decimal
        ) {

            return decimal;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }


        return new BigDecimal(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private LocalDate date(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Date date
        ) {

            return date.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp
                    .toLocalDateTime()
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant
                    .atOffset(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    )
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        String raw =
                value.toString();


        if (
                raw.length() >= 10
        ) {

            return LocalDate.parse(
                    raw.substring(
                            0,
                            10
                    )
            );
        }


        return null;
    }


    private Instant instant(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toInstant();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate
                    .atStartOfDay()
                    .toInstant(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }


        return Instant.parse(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/marketanalytics/infrastructure/MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.marketanalytics.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private final ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector
            procurementSchemaInspector;


    private volatile Schema
            cached;


    public MarketAnalyticsSchemaInspector(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate,
            ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector procurementSchemaInspector
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;

        this.procurementSchemaInspector =
                procurementSchemaInspector;
    }


    public Schema schema() {

        Schema current =
                cached;


        if (
                current != null
        ) {

            return current;
        }


        synchronized (
                this
        ) {

            if (
                    cached == null
            ) {

                cached =
                        inspect();
            }


            return cached;
        }
    }


    private Schema inspect() {

        ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema base =
                procurementSchemaInspector
                        .schema();


        String locationTable =
                optionalTable(
                        List.of(
                                "procurement_tender_locations",
                                "tender_locations"
                        )
                );


        return new Schema(
                base,

                semanticColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),

                        List.of(
                                "procedure",
                                "procurement_procedure",
                                "procedure_type",
                                "procedure_code"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "procedure"
                        )
                ),

                semanticColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),

                        List.of(
                                "contract_nature",
                                "nature",
                                "contract_type",
                                "contract_nature_type"
                        ),

                        List.of(
                                "contract",
                                "nature"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),
                        List.of(
                                "country_code",
                                "country"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),
                        List.of(
                                "region_code"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),
                        List.of(
                                "region_name",
                                "region"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        base.tenderTable(),
                        List.of(
                                "city",
                                "locality"
                        )
                ),

                locationTable,

                optionalColumn(
                        locationTable,
                        List.of(
                                "tender_id"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        locationTable,
                        List.of(
                                "country_code",
                                "country"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        locationTable,
                        List.of(
                                "region_code"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        locationTable,
                        List.of(
                                "region_name",
                                "region"
                        )
                ),

                optionalColumn(
                        locationTable,
                        List.of(
                                "city",
                                "locality"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String semanticColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> exactCandidates,
            List<String> semanticTokens
    ) {

        String exact =
                optionalColumn(
                        table,
                        exactCandidates
                );


        if (
                exact != null
        ) {

            return exact;
        }


        if (
                table == null
                ||
                semanticTokens == null
                ||
                semanticTokens.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        List<String> available =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .query(
                                """
                                select column_name
                                from information_schema.columns
                                where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                order by ordinal_position
                                """,

                                (
                                        rs,
                                        rowNumber
                                ) ->
                                        rs.getString(
                                                1
                                        ),

                                table
                        );


        List<String> matches =
                available
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                actual -> {

                                    String normalized =
                                            actual
                                                    .toLowerCase(
                                                            Locale.ROOT
                                                    );


                                    return semanticTokens
                                            .stream()
                                            .map(
                                                    token ->
                                                            token
                                                                    .toLowerCase(
                                                                            Locale.ROOT
                                                                    )
                                            )
                                            .allMatch(
                                                    normalized::contains
                                            );
                                }
                        )
                        .toList();


        if (
                matches.size() == 1
        ) {

            return matches.getFirst();
        }


        return null;
    }



    private String optionalTable(
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            List<String> result =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .query(
                                    """
                                    select table_name
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                    order by table_name
                                    """,

                                    (
                                            rs,
                                            rowNumber
                                    ) ->
                                            rs.getString(
                                                    1
                                            ),

                                    candidate
                            );


            if (
                    !result.isEmpty()
            ) {

                return result.getFirst();
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private String optionalColumn(
            String table,
            List<String> candidates
    ) {

        if (
                table == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        Set<String> columns =
                new LinkedHashSet<>(
                        jdbcTemplate
                                .query(
                                        """
                                        select column_name
                                        from information_schema.columns
                                        where lower(table_name) = lower(?)
                                        """,

                                        (
                                                rs,
                                                rowNumber
                                        ) ->
                                                rs.getString(
                                                        1
                                                ),

                                        table
                                )
                );


        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            for (
                    String actual :
                    columns
            ) {

                if (
                        actual
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                )
                                .equals(
                                        candidate
                                                .toLowerCase(
                                                        Locale.ROOT
                                                )
                                )
                ) {

                    return actual;
                }
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    public record Schema(

            ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema base,

            String tenderProcedure,

            String tenderContractNature,

            String tenderCountry,

            String tenderRegionCode,

            String tenderRegionName,

            String tenderCity,

            String locationTable,

            String locationTenderId,

            String locationCountry,

            String locationRegionCode,

            String locationRegionName,

            String locationCity

    ) {

        public boolean countryAvailable() {

            return (
                    locationTable != null
                    &&
                    locationTenderId != null
                    &&
                    locationCountry != null
            )
                    ||
                    tenderCountry != null;
        }


        public boolean regionAvailable() {

            return (
                    locationTable != null
                    &&
                    locationTenderId != null
                    &&
                    (
                            locationRegionCode != null
                            ||
                            locationRegionName != null
                    )
            )
                    ||
                    tenderRegionCode != null
                    ||
                    tenderRegionName != null;
        }


        public boolean locationRowsAvailable() {

            return locationTable != null
                    &&
                    locationTenderId != null;
        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.matching.api;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.application.TenderMatchingService;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchGrade;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.security.CurrentOrganizationResolver;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/matches"
)
@PreAuthorize(
        "isAuthenticated()"
)
public class TenderMatchingController {

    private final TenderMatchingService
            matchingService;


    private final CurrentOrganizationResolver
            organizationResolver;


    public TenderMatchingController(
            TenderMatchingService matchingService,
            CurrentOrganizationResolver organizationResolver
    ) {

        this.matchingService =
                matchingService;

        this.organizationResolver =
                organizationResolver;
    }


    @GetMapping
    public List<TenderMatchSummaryResponse> list(
            Authentication authentication,

            @RequestParam(
                    required = false
            )
            Integer minScore,

            @RequestParam(
                    required = false
            )
            TenderMatchGrade grade,

            @RequestParam(
                    defaultValue = "false"
            )
            boolean includeBlocked
    ) {

        UUID organizationId =
                organizationResolver
                        .resolve(
                                authentication
                        );


        return matchingService
                .list(
                        organizationId,
                        minScore,
                        grade,
                        includeBlocked
                );
    }


    @GetMapping(
            "/overview"
    )
    public TenderMatchOverviewResponse overview(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return matchingService
                .overview(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                )
                );
    }


    @PostMapping(
            "/recalculate"
    )
    @PreAuthorize(
            "hasAnyRole('OWNER','BID_MANAGER','ANALYST')"
    )
    public TenderMatchRecalculationResponse recalculate(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return matchingService
                .recalculate(
                        organizationResolver
                                .resolve(
                                        authentication
                                )
                );
    }

}
