package com.tenderpilot.matching.application;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchCandidate;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.infrastructure.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TenderMatchCandidateBuilder {

    private final ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
            qualityRepository;


    public TenderMatchCandidateBuilder(
            ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository qualityRepository
    ) {

        this.qualityRepository =
                qualityRepository;
    }


    public TenderMatchCandidate build(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {

        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity quality =
                qualityRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tender.getId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new TenderMatchCandidate(
                tender.getId(),

                tender.getTitle(),

                tender.getDescription(),

                tender
                        .getBuyer()
                        .getCategory()
                        .name(),

                tender.getCountryCode(),

                tender.getPrimaryRegionCode(),

                tender.getPrimaryRegionName(),

                tender.getEstimatedMinValue(),

                tender.getEstimatedMaxValue(),

                tender.getCurrency(),

                tender.getSubmissionDeadline(),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                cpv ->
                                        cpv.getCode()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                cpv ->
                                        cpv.getLabel()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                quality == null
                        ? null
                        : quality.getScore()
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/matching/application/TenderMatchScorer.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.matching.application;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.CompanyMatchProfile;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.MatchSignalCode;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.MatchSignalImpact;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.MatchSignalValue;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchCandidate;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchGrade;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.text.Normalizer;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TenderMatchScorer {

    private static final int CPV_MAX = 25;

    private static final int GEOGRAPHY_MAX = 15;

    private static final int VALUE_MAX = 15;

    private static final int BUYER_MAX = 10;

    private static final int CAPABILITY_MAX = 15;

    private static final int TIMING_MAX = 10;

    private static final int QUALITY_MAX = 10;


    public TenderMatchEvaluation evaluate(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            Instant now
    ) {

        List<MatchSignalValue> signals =
                new ArrayList<>();


        String tenderText =
                normalized(
                        String.join(
                                " ",
                                safe(tender.title()),
                                safe(tender.description()),
                                String.join(
                                        " ",
                                        tender.cpvLabels()
                                )
                        )
                );


        String blockedKeyword =
                firstExcludedKeyword(
                        profile,
                        tenderText
                );


        if (
                blockedKeyword != null
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.EXCLUDED_KEYWORD,
                            MatchSignalImpact.BLOCKER,
                            "exclusions",
                            0,
                            100,
                            "Opportunity contains excluded keyword: "
                                    +
                                    blockedKeyword
                    )
            );


            return new TenderMatchEvaluation(
                    0,
                    TenderMatchGrade.BLOCKED,
                    true,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    List.copyOf(
                            signals
                    )
            );
        }


        int cpv =
                cpvScore(
                        profile,
                        tender,
                        signals
                );


        int geography =
                geographyScore(
                        profile,
                        tender,
                        signals
                );


        int value =
                valueScore(
                        profile,
                        tender,
                        signals
                );


        int buyer =
                buyerScore(
                        profile,
                        tender,
                        signals
                );


        int capability =
                capabilityScore(
                        profile,
                        tenderText,
                        signals
                );


        int timing =
                timingScore(
                        profile,
                        tender,
                        now,
                        signals
                );


        int quality =
                qualityScore(
                        tender,
                        signals
                );


        int total =
                cpv
                        +
                        geography
                        +
                        value
                        +
                        buyer
                        +
                        capability
                        +
                        timing
                        +
                        quality;


        total =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                total
                        )
                );


        return new TenderMatchEvaluation(
                total,
                TenderMatchGrade.fromScore(
                        total
                ),
                false,
                cpv,
                geography,
                value,
                buyer,
                capability,
                timing,
                quality,
                List.copyOf(
                        signals
                )
        );
    }


    private int cpvScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        if (
                profile.targetCpvs()
                        .isEmpty()
                ||
                tender.cpvCodes()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CPV_NO_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "cpv",
                            0,
                            CPV_MAX,
                            "No usable CPV overlap could be established."
                    )
            );

            return 0;
        }


        int bestPrefix =
                0;


        for (
                String target :
                profile.targetCpvs()
        ) {

            for (
                    String actual :
                    tender.cpvCodes()
            ) {

                int prefix =
                        commonPrefix(
                                digits(target),
                                digits(actual)
                        );


                bestPrefix =
                        Math.max(
                                bestPrefix,
                                prefix
                        );
            }
        }


        int score;


        if (
                bestPrefix >= 8
        ) {

            score = 25;

        } else if (
                bestPrefix >= 5
        ) {

            score = 20;

        } else if (
                bestPrefix >= 4
        ) {

            score = 17;

        } else if (
                bestPrefix >= 3
        ) {

            score = 14;

        } else if (
                bestPrefix >= 2
        ) {

            score = 10;

        } else {

            score = 0;
        }


        if (
                score == 25
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CPV_EXACT_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "cpv",
                            score,
                            CPV_MAX,
                            "Opportunity contains an exact target CPV classification."
                    )
            );

        } else if (
                score > 0
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CPV_HIERARCHY_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "cpv",
                            score,
                            CPV_MAX,
                            "Opportunity matches the company's target CPV hierarchy."
                    )
            );

        } else {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CPV_NO_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "cpv",
                            0,
                            CPV_MAX,
                            "Opportunity CPVs do not match company target CPVs."
                    )
            );
        }


        return score;
    }


    private int geographyScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        if (
                profile.operatingRegions()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.GEOGRAPHY_COUNTRY_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                            "geography",
                            8,
                            GEOGRAPHY_MAX,
                            "No explicit company operating-region preference is configured."
                    )
            );

            return 8;
        }


        for (
                CompanyMatchProfile.OperatingRegion region :
                profile.operatingRegions()
        ) {

            if (
                    equalsNormalized(
                            region.regionCode(),
                            tender.regionCode()
                    )
                    ||
                    equalsNormalized(
                            region.regionName(),
                            tender.regionName()
                    )
            ) {

                signals.add(
                        signal(
                                MatchSignalCode.GEOGRAPHY_EXACT_MATCH,
                                MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                                "geography",
                                15,
                                GEOGRAPHY_MAX,
                                "Opportunity is in a configured operating region."
                        )
                );

                return 15;
            }
        }


        for (
                CompanyMatchProfile.OperatingRegion region :
                profile.operatingRegions()
        ) {

            if (
                    equalsNormalized(
                            region.countryCode(),
                            tender.countryCode()
                    )
            ) {

                signals.add(
                        signal(
                                MatchSignalCode.GEOGRAPHY_COUNTRY_MATCH,
                                MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                                "geography",
                                8,
                                GEOGRAPHY_MAX,
                                "Opportunity is in a supported country but outside the preferred region."
                        )
                );

                return 8;
            }
        }


        signals.add(
                signal(
                        MatchSignalCode.GEOGRAPHY_NO_MATCH,
                        MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                        "geography",
                        0,
                        GEOGRAPHY_MAX,
                        "Opportunity geography does not match configured operating regions."
                )
        );


        return 0;
    }


    private int valueScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        BigDecimal preferredMin =
                profile.preferredMinimumValue();


        BigDecimal preferredMax =
                profile.preferredMaximumValue();


        if (
                preferredMin == null
                &&
                preferredMax == null
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.VALUE_UNKNOWN,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                            "value",
                            10,
                            VALUE_MAX,
                            "No preferred contract-value range is configured."
                    )
            );

            return 10;
        }


        BigDecimal tenderMin =
                tender.estimatedMinimumValue();


        BigDecimal tenderMax =
                tender.estimatedMaximumValue();


        if (
                tenderMin == null
                &&
                tenderMax == null
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.VALUE_UNKNOWN,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                            "value",
                            5,
                            VALUE_MAX,
                            "Opportunity does not disclose a structured estimated value."
                    )
            );

            return 5;
        }


        if (
                profile.preferredCurrency()
                        !=
                        null
                &&
                tender.currency()
                        !=
                        null
                &&
                !profile
                        .preferredCurrency()
                        .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                tender.currency()
                        )
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "value",
                            0,
                            VALUE_MAX,
                            "Opportunity currency differs from the preferred company currency."
                    )
            );

            return 0;
        }


        BigDecimal actualMin =
                tenderMin != null
                        ? tenderMin
                        : tenderMax;


        BigDecimal actualMax =
                tenderMax != null
                        ? tenderMax
                        : tenderMin;


        BigDecimal acceptedMin =
                preferredMin != null
                        ? preferredMin
                        : BigDecimal.ZERO;


        BigDecimal acceptedMax =
                preferredMax;


        boolean aboveMinimum =
                actualMax.compareTo(
                        acceptedMin
                )
                        >=
                        0;


        boolean belowMaximum =
                acceptedMax == null
                ||
                actualMin.compareTo(
                        acceptedMax
                )
                        <=
                        0;


        if (
                aboveMinimum
                &&
                belowMaximum
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.VALUE_IN_RANGE,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "value",
                            15,
                            VALUE_MAX,
                            "Opportunity value overlaps the preferred contract range."
                    )
            );

            return 15;
        }


        signals.add(
                signal(
                        MatchSignalCode.VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE,
                        MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                        "value",
                        0,
                        VALUE_MAX,
                        "Opportunity value is outside the preferred contract range."
                )
        );


        return 0;
    }


    private int buyerScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        if (
                profile.preferredBuyerTypes()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.BUYER_NEUTRAL,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                            "buyer",
                            5,
                            BUYER_MAX,
                            "No preferred buyer categories are configured."
                    )
            );

            return 5;
        }


        String actual =
                normalized(
                        tender.buyerCategory()
                );


        boolean matched =
                profile
                        .preferredBuyerTypes()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::normalized
                        )
                        .anyMatch(
                                preferred ->
                                        preferred != null
                                        &&
                                        actual != null
                                        &&
                                        (
                                                preferred.equals(
                                                        actual
                                                )
                                                ||
                                                preferred.contains(
                                                        actual
                                                )
                                                ||
                                                actual.contains(
                                                        preferred
                                                )
                                        )
                        );


        if (
                matched
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.BUYER_PREFERRED,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "buyer",
                            10,
                            BUYER_MAX,
                            "Buyer category matches a preferred buyer type."
                    )
            );

            return 10;
        }


        signals.add(
                signal(
                        MatchSignalCode.BUYER_NOT_PREFERRED,
                        MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                        "buyer",
                        0,
                        BUYER_MAX,
                        "Buyer category is outside configured preferences."
                )
        );


        return 0;
    }


    private int capabilityScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            String tenderText,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        if (
                profile.capabilities()
                        .isEmpty()
                ||
                tenderText == null
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CAPABILITY_NO_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "capabilities",
                            0,
                            CAPABILITY_MAX,
                            "No capability evidence could be matched."
                    )
            );

            return 0;
        }


        int matched =
                0;


        List<String> matchedNames =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                String rawCapability :
                profile.capabilities()
        ) {

            String capability =
                    normalized(
                            rawCapability
                    );


            if (
                    capability == null
            ) {
                continue;
            }


            boolean fullPhrase =
                    tenderText.contains(
                            capability
                    );


            if (
                    fullPhrase
                    ||
                    tokenCoverage(
                            capability,
                            tenderText
                    )
                            >=
                            0.5
            ) {

                matched++;

                matchedNames.add(
                        rawCapability
                );
            }
        }


        int score =
                (int)
                        Math.round(
                                CAPABILITY_MAX
                                        *
                                        (
                                                matched
                                                        /
                                                        (double)
                                                                profile
                                                                        .capabilities()
                                                                        .size()
                                        )
                        );


        score =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(
                                CAPABILITY_MAX,
                                score
                        )
                );


        if (
                score > 0
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CAPABILITY_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "capabilities",
                            score,
                            CAPABILITY_MAX,
                            "Matched company capabilities: "
                                    +
                                    String.join(
                                            ", ",
                                            matchedNames
                                    )
                    )
            );

        } else {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.CAPABILITY_NO_MATCH,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "capabilities",
                            0,
                            CAPABILITY_MAX,
                            "Opportunity text does not match configured company capabilities."
                    )
            );
        }


        return score;
    }


    private int timingScore(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            Instant now,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        if (
                tender.submissionDeadline()
                        ==
                        null
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.NOTICE_SHORT,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "timing",
                            0,
                            TIMING_MAX,
                            "No structured submission deadline is available."
                    )
            );

            return 0;
        }


        long days =
                Duration
                        .between(
                                now,
                                tender.submissionDeadline()
                        )
                        .toDays();


        if (
                days < 0
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.NOTICE_PASSED,
                            MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                            "timing",
                            0,
                            TIMING_MAX,
                            "Submission deadline has already passed."
                    )
            );

            return 0;
        }


        Integer required =
                profile.minimumNoticeDays();


        if (
                required == null
                ||
                days >= required
        ) {

            signals.add(
                    signal(
                            MatchSignalCode.NOTICE_SUFFICIENT,
                            MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE,
                            "timing",
                            10,
                            TIMING_MAX,
                            "Available response time satisfies the configured notice requirement."
                    )
            );

            return 10;
        }


        signals.add(
                signal(
                        MatchSignalCode.NOTICE_SHORT,
                        MatchSignalImpact.NEGATIVE,
                        "timing",
                        5,
                        TIMING_MAX,
                        "Opportunity is still open, but the remaining response time is shorter than preferred."
                )
        );


        return 5;
    }


    private int qualityScore(
            TenderMatchCandidate tender,
            List<MatchSignalValue> signals
    ) {

        int raw =
                tender.dataQualityScore()
                        ==
                        null
                        ? 50
                        : Math.max(
                                0,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        tender.dataQualityScore()
                                )
                        );


        int score =
                (int)
                        Math.round(
                                raw / 10.0
                        );


        signals.add(
                signal(
                        MatchSignalCode.QUALITY_SCORE,
                        raw >= 75
                                ? MatchSignalImpact.POSITIVE
                                : MatchSignalImpact.NEUTRAL,
                        "quality",
                        score,
                        QUALITY_MAX,
                        "Procurement data quality score is "
                                +
                                raw
                                +
                                "/100."
                )
        );


        return score;
    }


    private String firstExcludedKeyword(
            CompanyMatchProfile profile,
            String tenderText
    ) {

        if (
                tenderText == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        for (
                String raw :
                profile.excludedKeywords()
        ) {

            String keyword =
                    normalized(
                            raw
                    );


            if (
                    keyword != null
                    &&
                    tenderText.contains(
                            keyword
                    )
            ) {

                return raw;
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private double tokenCoverage(
            String capability,
            String tenderText
    ) {

        String[] tokens =
                capability.split(
                        "\\s+"
                );


        int meaningful =
                0;


        int matched =
                0;


        for (
                String token :
                tokens
        ) {

            if (
                    token.length()
                            <
                            3
            ) {
                continue;
            }


            meaningful++;


            if (
                    tenderText.contains(
                            token
                    )
            ) {

                matched++;
            }
        }


        return meaningful == 0
                ? 0
                : matched
                        /
                        (double) meaningful;
    }


    private int commonPrefix(
            String left,
            String right
    ) {

        if (
                left == null
                ||
                right == null
        ) {
            return 0;
        }


        int length =
                Math.min(
                        left.length(),
                        right.length()
                );


        int index =
                0;


        while (
                index < length
                &&
                left.charAt(index)
                        ==
                        right.charAt(index)
        ) {

            index++;
        }


        return index;
    }


    private String digits(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value.replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9]",
                        ""
                );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private boolean equalsNormalized(
            String left,
            String right
    ) {

        String normalizedLeft =
                normalized(
                        left
                );


        String normalizedRight =
                normalized(
                        right
                );


        return normalizedLeft != null
                &&
                normalizedLeft.equals(
                        normalizedRight
                );
    }


    private String normalized(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        if (
                cleaned.isBlank()
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        return Normalizer
                .normalize(
                        cleaned,
                        Normalizer.Form.NFD
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\p{M}+",
                        ""
                )
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "[^a-z0-9 ]",
                        " "
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\s+",
                        " "
                )
                .trim();
    }


    private String safe(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;
    }


    private MatchSignalValue signal(
            MatchSignalCode code,
            MatchSignalImpact impact,
            String dimension,
            int earned,
            int maximum,
            String message
    ) {

        return new MatchSignalValue(
                code,
                impact,
                dimension,
                earned,
                maximum,
                message
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/matching/application/TenderMatchingService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.matching.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.api.TenderMatchOverviewResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.api.TenderMatchRecalculationResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.api.TenderMatchSummaryResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.CompanyMatchProfile;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchGrade;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.OpportunityQueryService;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class TenderMatchingService {

    private final CompanyMatchProfileProvider
            profileProvider;


    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    private final TenderMatchCandidateBuilder
            candidateBuilder;


    private final TenderMatchScorer
            scorer;


    private final OpportunityQueryService
            opportunityQueryService;


    public TenderMatchingService(
            CompanyMatchProfileProvider profileProvider,
            TenderRepository tenderRepository,
            TenderMatchRepository matchRepository,
            TenderMatchCandidateBuilder candidateBuilder,
            TenderMatchScorer scorer,
            OpportunityQueryService opportunityQueryService
    ) {

        this.profileProvider =
                profileProvider;

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.matchRepository =
                matchRepository;

        this.candidateBuilder =
                candidateBuilder;

        this.scorer =
                scorer;

        this.opportunityQueryService =
                opportunityQueryService;
    }


    @Transactional
    public TenderMatchRecalculationResponse recalculate(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        CompanyMatchProfile profile =
                profileProvider
                        .load(
                                organizationId
                        );


        if (
                !profile.hasCoreSignals()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Company profile needs capabilities, target CPVs or operating regions before matching"
            );
        }


        matchRepository
                .deleteByOrganizationId(
                        organizationId
                );


        matchRepository.flush();


        List<TenderEntity> candidates =
                tenderRepository
                        .findTop100ByOrderByPublicationDateDesc()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                tender ->
                                        tender.getStatus()
                                                ==
                                                ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED
                                        ||
                                        tender.getStatus()
                                                ==
                                                ProcurementStatus.UPDATED
                        )
                        .toList();


        int actionable =
                0;


        int blocked =
                0;


        int excellent =
                0;


        int strong =
                0;


        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        for (
                TenderEntity tender :
                candidates
        ) {

            TenderMatchEvaluation evaluation =
                    scorer.evaluate(
                            profile,
                            candidateBuilder
                                    .build(
                                            tender
                                    ),
                            now
                    );


            TenderMatchEntity entity =
                    TenderMatchEntity
                            .create(
                                    organizationId,
                                    tender
                            );


            entity.apply(
                    evaluation
            );


            matchRepository
                    .save(
                            entity
                    );


            if (
                    evaluation.blocked()
            ) {

                blocked++;

            } else {

                actionable++;
            }


            if (
                    evaluation.grade()
                            ==
                            TenderMatchGrade.EXCELLENT
            ) {

                excellent++;

            } else if (
                    evaluation.grade()
                            ==
                            TenderMatchGrade.STRONG
            ) {

                strong++;
            }
        }


        matchRepository.flush();


        return new TenderMatchRecalculationResponse(
                candidates.size(),
                actionable,
                blocked,
                excellent,
                strong
        );
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<TenderMatchSummaryResponse> list(
            UUID organizationId,
            Integer minimumScore,
            TenderMatchGrade grade,
            boolean includeBlocked
    ) {

        int minimum =
                minimumScore == null
                        ? 0
                        : Math.max(
                                0,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        minimumScore
                                )
                        );


        return matchRepository
                .findByOrganizationIdOrderByBlockedAscTotalScoreDescEvaluatedAtDesc(
                        organizationId
                )
                .stream()

                .filter(
                        match ->
                                includeBlocked
                                ||
                                !match.isBlocked()
                )

                .filter(
                        match ->
                                match.getTotalScore()
                                        >=
                                        minimum
                )

                .filter(
                        match ->
                                grade == null
                                ||
                                match.getGrade()
                                        ==
                                        grade
                )

                .limit(
                        100
                )

                .map(
                        this::response
                )

                .toList();
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TenderMatchOverviewResponse overview(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        List<TenderMatchEntity> matches =
                matchRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdOrderByBlockedAscTotalScoreDescEvaluatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        long blocked =
                matches
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                TenderMatchEntity::isBlocked
                        )
                        .count();


        long excellent =
                countGrade(
                        matches,
                        TenderMatchGrade.EXCELLENT
                );


        long strong =
                countGrade(
                        matches,
                        TenderMatchGrade.STRONG
                );


        long good =
                countGrade(
                        matches,
                        TenderMatchGrade.GOOD
                );


        double average =
                matches
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                match ->
                                        !match.isBlocked()
                        )
                        .mapToInt(
                                TenderMatchEntity::getTotalScore
                        )
                        .average()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        Instant last =
                matches
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                TenderMatchEntity::getEvaluatedAt
                        )
                        .max(
                                Instant::compareTo
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new TenderMatchOverviewResponse(
                matches.size(),
                matches.size() - blocked,
                blocked,
                excellent,
                strong,
                good,
                average,
                last
        );
    }


    private long countGrade(
            List<TenderMatchEntity> matches,
            TenderMatchGrade grade
    ) {

        return matches
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        match ->
                                match.getGrade()
                                        ==
                                        grade
                )
                .count();
    }


    private TenderMatchSummaryResponse response(
            TenderMatchEntity match
    ) {

        return new TenderMatchSummaryResponse(
                match.getId(),

                match.getTotalScore(),

                match.getGrade(),

                match.isBlocked(),

                match.getCpvScore(),

                match.getGeographyScore(),

                match.getValueScore(),

                match.getBuyerScore(),

                match.getCapabilityScore(),

                match.getTimingScore(),

                match.getQualityScore(),

                match.getEvaluatedAt(),

                opportunityQueryService
                        .summaryById(
                                match
                                        .getTender()
                                        .getId()
                        ),

                match
                        .getSignals()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                signal ->
                                        new TenderMatchSummaryResponse
                                                .SignalResponse(
                                                        signal.getCode(),
                                                        signal.getImpact(),
                                                        signal.getDimension(),
                                                        signal.getEarnedScore(),
                                                        signal.getMaximumScore(),
                                                        signal.getMessage()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/matching/domain/CompanyMatchProfile.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.matching.domain;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public record CompanyMatchProfile(

        UUID organizationId,

        List<String> capabilities,

        List<OperatingRegion> operatingRegions,

        List<String> targetCpvs,

        List<String> preferredBuyerTypes,

        List<String> excludedKeywords,

        BigDecimal preferredMinimumValue,

        BigDecimal preferredMaximumValue,

        String preferredCurrency,

        Integer minimumNoticeDays

) {

    public boolean hasCoreSignals() {

        return !capabilities.isEmpty()
                ||
                !operatingRegions.isEmpty()
                ||
                !targetCpvs.isEmpty();
    }


    public record OperatingRegion(

            String countryCode,

            String regionCode,

            String regionName

    ) {
    }

}

        updatedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }

package com.tenderpilot.matching.domain;

public enum TenderMatchGrade {

    BLOCKED,

    EXCELLENT,

    STRONG,

    GOOD,

    WEAK,

    POOR;


    public static TenderMatchGrade fromScore(
            int score
    ) {

        if (score >= 85) {
            return EXCELLENT;
        }

        if (score >= 70) {
            return STRONG;
        }

        if (score >= 55) {
            return GOOD;
        }

        if (score >= 40) {
            return WEAK;
        }

        return POOR;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/matching/infrastructure/JdbcCompanyMatchProfileProvider.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.application.CompanyMatchProfileProvider;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.CompanyMatchProfile;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class JdbcCompanyMatchProfileProvider
        implements CompanyMatchProfileProvider {

    private static final Pattern CPV =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?<!\\d)(\\d{8})(?!\\d)"
            );


    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    public JdbcCompanyMatchProfileProvider(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;
    }


    @Override
    public CompanyMatchProfile load(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                """
                                select *
                                from company_profiles
                                where organization_id = ?
                                """,
                                organizationId
                        );


        if (
                rows.isEmpty()
        ) {

            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Company profile is required before opportunity matching"
            );
        }


        Map<String, Object> profile =
                rows.getFirst();


        UUID profileId =
                uuid(
                        value(
                                profile,
                                "id"
                        )
                );


        if (
                profileId == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Company profile identifier is missing"
            );
        }


        List<String> capabilities =
                values(
                        "company_capabilities",
                        profileId,
                        List.of(
                                "capability",
                                "value",
                                "name",
                                "label"
                        )
                );


        List<String> targetCpvs =
                cpvValues(
                        profileId
                );


        List<String> buyerTypes =
                values(
                        "company_preferred_buyer_types",
                        profileId,
                        List.of(
                                "buyer_type",
                                "value",
                                "type"
                        )
                );


        List<String> exclusions =
                values(
                        "company_excluded_keywords",
                        profileId,
                        List.of(
                                "keyword",
                                "value",
                                "term"
                        )
                );


        List<CompanyMatchProfile.OperatingRegion>
                regions =
                regionValues(
                        profileId
                );


        return new CompanyMatchProfile(
                organizationId,

                capabilities,

                regions,

                targetCpvs,

                buyerTypes,

                exclusions,

                decimal(
                        value(
                                profile,
                                "preferred_contract_min_value",
                                "preferred_contract_min",
                                "preferred_min_contract_value",
                                "minimum_contract_value",
                                "contract_min_value"
                        )
                ),

                decimal(
                        value(
                                profile,
                                "preferred_contract_max_value",
                                "preferred_contract_max",
                                "preferred_max_contract_value",
                                "maximum_contract_value",
                                "contract_max_value"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        value(
                                profile,
                                "preferred_contract_currency",
                                "preferred_currency",
                                "contract_currency",
                                "currency"
                        )
                ),

                integer(
                        value(
                                profile,
                                "minimum_notice_days",
                                "minimum_notice_period_days",
                                "min_notice_days",
                                "notice_days"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private List<String> values(
            String table,
            UUID profileId,
            List<String> preferredColumns
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                "select * from "
                                        +
                                        table
                                        +
                                        " where profile_id = ? order by position",
                                profileId
                        );


        Set<String> result =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                Map<String, Object> row :
                rows
        ) {

            String resolved =
                    null;


            for (
                    String column :
                    preferredColumns
            ) {

                resolved =
                        string(
                                value(
                                        row,
                                        column
                                )
                        );


                if (
                        resolved != null
                ) {
                    break;
                }
            }


            if (
                    resolved == null
            ) {

                resolved =
                        firstMeaningfulString(
                                row
                        );
            }


            if (
                    resolved != null
            ) {

                result.add(
                        resolved
                );
            }
        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );
    }


    private List<String> cpvValues(
            UUID profileId
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                """
                                select *
                                from company_target_cpvs
                                where profile_id = ?
                                order by position
                                """,
                                profileId
                        );


        Set<String> cpvs =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                Map<String, Object> row :
                rows
        ) {

            for (
                    Object raw :
                    row.values()
            ) {

                if (
                        raw == null
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                Matcher matcher =
                        CPV.matcher(
                                raw.toString()
                        );


                while (
                        matcher.find()
                ) {

                    cpvs.add(
                            matcher.group(
                                    1
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }


        return List.copyOf(
                cpvs
        );
    }


    private List<CompanyMatchProfile.OperatingRegion>
    regionValues(
            UUID profileId
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                """
                                select *
                                from company_operating_regions
                                where profile_id = ?
                                order by position
                                """,
                                profileId
                        );


        List<CompanyMatchProfile.OperatingRegion>
                result =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                Map<String, Object> row :
                rows
        ) {

            String country =
                    string(
                            value(
                                    row,
                                    "country_code",
                                    "country",
                                    "countrycode"
                            )
                    );


            String regionCode =
                    string(
                            value(
                                    row,
                                    "region_code",
                                    "regioncode",
                                    "code"
                            )
                    );


            String regionName =
                    string(
                            value(
                                    row,
                                    "region_name",
                                    "regionname",
                                    "name",
                                    "value"
                            )
                    );


            if (
                    country == null
                    &&
                    regionCode == null
                    &&
                    regionName == null
            ) {

                regionName =
                        firstMeaningfulString(
                                row
                        );
            }


            if (
                    country != null
                    ||
                    regionCode != null
                    ||
                    regionName != null
            ) {

                result.add(
                        new CompanyMatchProfile
                                .OperatingRegion(
                                        country,
                                        regionCode,
                                        regionName
                                )
                );
            }
        }


        return List.copyOf(
                result
        );
    }


    private String firstMeaningfulString(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {

        Set<String> ignored =
                Set.of(
                        "id",
                        "profileid",
                        "position",
                        "organizationid",
                        "createdat",
                        "updatedat"
                );


        for (
                Map.Entry<String, Object> entry :
                row.entrySet()
        ) {

            if (
                    ignored.contains(
                            normalizeKey(
                                    entry.getKey()
                            )
                    )
            ) {
                continue;
            }


            String candidate =
                    string(
                            entry.getValue()
                    );


            if (
                    candidate != null
            ) {

                return candidate;
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private Object value(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String... candidates
    ) {

        for (
                String candidate :
                candidates
        ) {

            String normalized =
                    normalizeKey(
                            candidate
                    );


            for (
                    Map.Entry<String, Object> entry :
                    row.entrySet()
            ) {

                if (
                        normalizeKey(
                                entry.getKey()
                        )
                                .equals(
                                        normalized
                                )
                ) {

                    return entry.getValue();
                }
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private String normalizeKey(
            String value
    ) {

        return value
                .toLowerCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "[^a-z0-9]",
                        ""
                );
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        try {

            return UUID.fromString(
                    value.toString()
            );

        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            return null;
        }
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private BigDecimal decimal(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof BigDecimal decimal
        ) {

            return decimal;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return new BigDecimal(
                    number.toString()
            );
        }


        try {

            return new BigDecimal(
                    value
                            .toString()
                            .trim()
                            .replace(
                                    ",",
                                    "."
                            )
            );

        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {

            return null;
        }
    }


    private Integer integer(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return number.intValue();
        }


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        try {

            return Integer.valueOf(
                    value.toString()
            );

        } catch (
                NumberFormatException exception
        ) {

            return null;
        }
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/matching/security/CurrentOrganizationResolver.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.matching.security;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class CurrentOrganizationResolver {

    private static final List<String> ORGANIZATION_CLAIMS =
            List.of(
                    "organizationId",
                    "organization_id",
                    "orgId",
                    "org_id",
                    "organization",
                    "org"
            );


    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    public CurrentOrganizationResolver(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;
    }


    public UUID resolve(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (
                authentication == null
                ||
                !authentication.isAuthenticated()
        ) {

            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Authenticated organization context is required"
            );
        }


        Jwt jwt =
                extractJwt(
                        authentication
                );


        if (
                jwt != null
        ) {

            UUID fromClaim =
                    organizationClaim(
                            jwt.getClaims()
                    );


            if (
                    fromClaim != null
            ) {

                return fromClaim;
            }


            UUID subjectUserId =
                    uuid(
                            jwt.getSubject()
                    );


            if (
                    subjectUserId != null
            ) {

                UUID membership =
                        singleMembershipForUser(
                                subjectUserId
                        );


                if (
                        membership != null
                ) {

                    return membership;
                }
            }


            String email =
                    jwt.getClaimAsString(
                            "email"
                    );


            if (
                    email != null
            ) {

                UUID membership =
                        singleMembershipForEmail(
                                email
                        );


                if (
                        membership != null
                ) {

                    return membership;
                }
            }
        }


        throw new AccessDeniedException(
                "Unable to resolve the active organization"
        );
    }


    private Jwt extractJwt(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (
                authentication
                        instanceof
                        JwtAuthenticationToken token
        ) {

            return token.getToken();
        }


        if (
                authentication.getPrincipal()
                        instanceof
                        Jwt jwt
        ) {

            return jwt;
        }


        return null;
    }


    private UUID organizationClaim(
            Map<String, Object> claims
    ) {

        for (
                String name :
                ORGANIZATION_CLAIMS
        ) {

            UUID candidate =
                    uuid(
                            claims.get(
                                    name
                            )
                    );


            if (
                    candidate != null
            ) {

                return candidate;
            }
        }


        return null;
    }


    private UUID singleMembershipForUser(
            UUID userId
    ) {

        List<UUID> memberships =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                """
                                select organization_id
                                from organization_memberships
                                where user_id = ?
                                """,
                                UUID.class,
                                userId
                        );


        return singleMembership(
                memberships
        );
    }


    private UUID singleMembershipForEmail(
            String email
    ) {

        List<UUID> memberships =
                jdbcTemplate
                        .queryForList(
                                """
                                select m.organization_id
                                from organization_memberships m
                                join app_users u
                                  on u.id = m.user_id
                                where u.normalized_email = ?
                                """,
                                UUID.class,
                                email
                                        .trim()
                                        .toLowerCase()
                        );


        return singleMembership(
                memberships
        );
    }


    private UUID singleMembership(
            List<UUID> memberships
    ) {

        if (
                memberships.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                memberships.size()
                        >
                        1
        ) {

            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Multiple organization memberships require an active organization JWT claim"
            );
        }


        return memberships.getFirst();
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        try {

            return UUID.fromString(
                    value.toString()
            );

        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            return null;
        }
    }

}
