===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/notification/application/NotificationCenterService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.notification.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.api.DashboardCommandCenterResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.application.DashboardCommandCenterService;

import com.tenderpilot.notification.api.CreateWatchlistItemRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.api.NotificationCenterResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.AlertSignal;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationSeverity;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.WatchlistTargetType;

import com.tenderpilot.notification.infrastructure.NotificationEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.infrastructure.NotificationRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.infrastructure.WatchlistItemEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.infrastructure.WatchlistItemRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class NotificationCenterService {

    private final WatchlistItemRepository
            watchlistRepository;


    private final NotificationRepository
            notificationRepository;


    private final DashboardCommandCenterService
            dashboardService;


    private final NotificationSignalFactory
            signalFactory;


    public NotificationCenterService(
            WatchlistItemRepository watchlistRepository,
            NotificationRepository notificationRepository,
            DashboardCommandCenterService dashboardService,
            NotificationSignalFactory signalFactory
    ) {

        this.watchlistRepository =
                watchlistRepository;

        this.notificationRepository =
                notificationRepository;

        this.dashboardService =
                dashboardService;

        this.signalFactory =
                signalFactory;
    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public NotificationCenterResponse center(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse createWatchlistItem(
            UUID organizationId,
            CreateWatchlistItemRequest request
    ) {

        WatchlistTargetType type =
                request.type();


        String targetKey =
                normalizeTarget(
                        type,
                        request.targetKey()
                );


        String label =
                clean(
                        request.label()
                );


        WatchlistItemEntity entity =
                watchlistRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTypeAndTargetKey(
                                organizationId,
                                type,
                                targetKey
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        WatchlistItemEntity.create(
                                                organizationId,
                                                type,
                                                targetKey,
                                                label,
                                                Instant.now()
                                        )
                        );


        entity.updateLabel(
                label
        );


        watchlistRepository.save(
                entity
        );


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse removeWatchlistItem(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID watchlistId
    ) {

        long deleted =
                watchlistRepository
                        .deleteByIdAndOrganizationId(
                                watchlistId,
                                organizationId
                        );


        if (
                deleted == 0
        ) {

            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Watchlist item was not found"
            );
        }


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse refresh(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard =
                dashboardService
                        .commandCenter(
                                organizationId
                        );


        List<WatchlistItemEntity> watchlist =
                watchlistRepository
                        .findAllByOrganizationIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        List<AlertSignal> signals =
                signalFactory
                        .create(
                                dashboard,

                                watchlist
                                        .stream()
                                        .map(
                                                WatchlistItemEntity::snapshot
                                        )
                                        .toList()
                        );


        List<NotificationEntity> existing =
                notificationRepository
                        .findAllByOrganizationIdOrderByActiveDescLastObservedAtDescCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        Map<String, NotificationEntity> byFingerprint =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                NotificationEntity entity :
                existing
        ) {

            byFingerprint.put(
                    entity.fingerprint(),
                    entity
            );
        }


        Set<String> activeFingerprints =
                signals
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                AlertSignal::fingerprint
                        )
                        .collect(
                                java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(
                                        LinkedHashSet::new
                                )
                        );


        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        for (
                NotificationEntity entity :
                existing
        ) {

            if (
                    !activeFingerprints.contains(
                            entity.fingerprint()
                    )
            ) {

                entity.markInactive(
                        now
                );
            }
        }


        for (
                AlertSignal signal :
                signals
        ) {

            NotificationEntity entity =
                    byFingerprint.get(
                            signal.fingerprint()
                    );


            if (
                    entity == null
            ) {

                entity =
                        NotificationEntity.create(
                                organizationId,
                                signal,
                                now
                        );


                existing =
                        append(
                                existing,
                                entity
                        );


            } else {

                entity.observe(
                        signal,
                        now
                );
            }
        }


        notificationRepository.saveAll(
                existing
        );


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse acknowledge(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID notificationId
    ) {

        NotificationEntity entity =
                notification(
                        organizationId,
                        notificationId
                );


        entity.acknowledge(
                Instant.now()
        );


        notificationRepository.save(
                entity
        );


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse dismiss(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID notificationId
    ) {

        NotificationEntity entity =
                notification(
                        organizationId,
                        notificationId
                );


        entity.dismiss(
                Instant.now()
        );


        notificationRepository.save(
                entity
        );


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public NotificationCenterResponse markAllRead(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        List<NotificationEntity> notifications =
                notificationRepository
                        .findAllByOrganizationIdOrderByActiveDescLastObservedAtDescCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        for (
                NotificationEntity entity :
                notifications
        ) {

            if (
                    entity.status()
                            ==
                            NotificationStatus.UNREAD
            ) {

                entity.acknowledge(
                        now
                );
            }
        }


        notificationRepository.saveAll(
                notifications
        );


        return response(
                organizationId
        );
    }


    private NotificationEntity notification(
            UUID organizationId,
            UUID notificationId
    ) {

        return notificationRepository
                .findByIdAndOrganizationId(
                        notificationId,
                        organizationId
                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "Notification was not found"
                                )
                );
    }


    private NotificationCenterResponse response(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        List<NotificationEntity> notifications =
                notificationRepository
                        .findAllByOrganizationIdOrderByActiveDescLastObservedAtDescCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        List<WatchlistItemEntity> watchlist =
                watchlistRepository
                        .findAllByOrganizationIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                organizationId
                        );


        int active =
                (int)
                        notifications
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        NotificationEntity::active
                                )
                                .count();


        int unread =
                (int)
                        notifications
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        NotificationEntity::active
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        item ->
                                                item.status()
                                                        ==
                                                        NotificationStatus.UNREAD
                                )
                                .count();


        int critical =
                activeSeverityCount(
                        notifications,
                        NotificationSeverity.CRITICAL
                );


        int high =
                activeSeverityCount(
                        notifications,
                        NotificationSeverity.HIGH
                );


        return new NotificationCenterResponse(
                new NotificationCenterResponse
                        .Summary(
                                active,
                                unread,
                                critical,
                                high,
                                watchlist.size()
                        ),

                notifications
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::notificationResponse
                        )
                        .toList(),

                watchlist
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::watchlistResponse
                        )
                        .toList()
        );
    }


    private int activeSeverityCount(
            List<NotificationEntity> notifications,
            NotificationSeverity severity
    ) {

        return (int)
                notifications
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                NotificationEntity::active
                        )
                        .filter(
                                notification ->
                                        notification.severity()
                                                ==
                                                severity
                        )
                        .count();
    }


    private NotificationCenterResponse.NotificationItem
    notificationResponse(
            NotificationEntity entity
    ) {

        return new NotificationCenterResponse
                .NotificationItem(
                        entity.id(),
                        entity.type(),
                        entity.severity(),
                        entity.title(),
                        entity.detail(),
                        entity.tenderId(),
                        entity.href(),
                        entity.status(),
                        entity.active(),
                        entity.createdAt(),
                        entity.updatedAt(),
                        entity.lastObservedAt()
                );
    }


    private NotificationCenterResponse.WatchlistItem
    watchlistResponse(
            WatchlistItemEntity entity
    ) {

        return new NotificationCenterResponse
                .WatchlistItem(
                        entity.id(),
                        entity.type(),
                        entity.targetKey(),
                        entity.label(),
                        entity.createdAt()
                );
    }


    private String normalizeTarget(
            WatchlistTargetType type,
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                clean(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Watchlist target is required"
            );
        }


        return switch (
                type
        ) {

            case TENDER, BUYER ->
                    normalizeUuid(
                            value
                    );

            case CPV ->
                    normalizeCpv(
                            value
                    );
        };
    }


    private String normalizeUuid(
            String value
    ) {

        try {

            return UUID
                    .fromString(
                            value
                    )
                    .toString();


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Watchlist target must be a valid UUID"
            );
        }
    }


    private String normalizeCpv(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                value.replaceAll(
                        "\\s+",
                        ""
                );


        if (
                !result.matches(
                        "[0-9]{1,8}"
                )
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "CPV watchlist targets must contain between 1 and 8 digits"
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private List<NotificationEntity> append(
            List<NotificationEntity> source,
            NotificationEntity item
    ) {

        java.util.ArrayList<NotificationEntity> result =
                new java.util.ArrayList<>(
                        source
                );


        result.add(
                item
        );


        return result;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/notification/application/NotificationSignalFactory.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.notification.application;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.api.DashboardCommandCenterResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.domain.DashboardActionPriority;

import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.AlertSignal;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationSeverity;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationType;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.WatchlistItemSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.WatchlistTargetType;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class NotificationSignalFactory {

    public List<AlertSignal> create(
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard,
            List<WatchlistItemSnapshot> watchlist
    ) {

        Map<String, AlertSignal> signals =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        addDashboardActions(
                dashboard,
                signals
        );


        addWatchlistSignals(
                dashboard,
                watchlist == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : watchlist,
                signals
        );


        return signals
                .values()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .<AlertSignal>comparingInt(
                                        signal ->
                                                severityRank(
                                                        signal.severity()
                                                )
                                )
                                .thenComparing(
                                        AlertSignal::fingerprint
                                )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private void addDashboardActions(
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard,
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals
    ) {

        if (
                dashboard == null
                ||
                dashboard.priorities() == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        for (
                DashboardCommandCenterResponse.Action action :
                dashboard.priorities()
        ) {

            String fingerprint =
                    "dashboard:"
                            +
                            action.type()
                            +
                            ":"
                            +
                            (
                                    action.tenderId() == null
                                            ? "global"
                                            : action.tenderId()
                            );


            signals.put(
                    fingerprint,

                    new AlertSignal(
                            fingerprint,
                            NotificationType.PORTFOLIO_ACTION,
                            severity(
                                    action.priority()
                            ),
                            action.title(),
                            action.detail(),
                            action.tenderId(),
                            action.href()
                    )
            );
        }
    }


    private void addWatchlistSignals(
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard,
            List<WatchlistItemSnapshot> watchlist,
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals
    ) {

        if (
                dashboard == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        Map<UUID, DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard>
                portfolioByTender =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        if (
                dashboard.portfolio() != null
        ) {

            for (
                    DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card :
                    dashboard.portfolio()
            ) {

                portfolioByTender.put(
                        card.tenderId(),
                        card
                );
            }
        }


        for (
                WatchlistItemSnapshot item :
                watchlist
        ) {

            if (
                    item.type() == WatchlistTargetType.TENDER
            ) {

                tenderSignals(
                        item,
                        portfolioByTender,
                        signals
                );


            } else if (
                    item.type() == WatchlistTargetType.BUYER
            ) {

                buyerSignals(
                        item,
                        dashboard,
                        signals
                );


            } else if (
                    item.type() == WatchlistTargetType.CPV
            ) {

                cpvSignals(
                        item,
                        dashboard,
                        signals
                );
            }
        }
    }


    private void tenderSignals(
            WatchlistItemSnapshot item,
            Map<UUID, DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard>
                    portfolioByTender,
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals
    ) {

        UUID tenderId;


        try {

            tenderId =
                    UUID.fromString(
                            item.targetKey()
                    );


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            return;
        }


        DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard card =
                portfolioByTender.get(
                        tenderId
                );


        if (
                card == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        String name =
                label(
                        item,
                        card.title()
                );


        if (
                card.overdueTasks()
                        >
                        0
        ) {

            add(
                    signals,

                    signal(
                            "watch:tender:overdue:"
                                    +
                                    tenderId,

                            NotificationType.WATCHLIST_OVERDUE,

                            NotificationSeverity.CRITICAL,

                            "Watched bid has overdue work",

                            name
                                    +
                                    " has "
                                    +
                                    card.overdueTasks()
                                    +
                                    " overdue task"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.overdueTasks()
                                    )
                                    +
                                    ".",

                            tenderId,

                            "/bid-workspaces/"
                                    +
                                    tenderId
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    )
            );
        }


        if (
                !card.submitted()
                &&
                !"NO_GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline() != null
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline() >= 0
                &&
                card.daysToDeadline() <= 7
        ) {

            add(
                    signals,

                    signal(
                            "watch:tender:deadline:"
                                    +
                                    tenderId,

                            NotificationType.WATCHLIST_DEADLINE,

                            NotificationSeverity.HIGH,

                            "Watched tender deadline approaching",

                            name
                                    +
                                    " is due in "
                                    +
                                    card.daysToDeadline()
                                    +
                                    " day"
                                    +
                                    plural(
                                            card.daysToDeadline()
                                    )
                                    +
                                    ".",

                            tenderId,

                            "/bid-workspaces/"
                                    +
                                    tenderId
                    )
            );
        }


        if (
                !card.submitted()
                &&
                card.readyForSubmission()
        ) {

            add(
                    signals,

                    signal(
                            "watch:tender:submission-ready:"
                                    +
                                    tenderId,

                            NotificationType.WATCHLIST_SUBMISSION_READY,

                            NotificationSeverity.HIGH,

                            "Watched bid is submission ready",

                            name
                                    +
                                    " has cleared the TenderPilot submission-readiness gate.",

                            tenderId,

                            "/bid-workspaces/"
                                    +
                                    tenderId
                                    +
                                    "/planning"
                    )
            );
        }


        if (
                "GO".equals(
                        card.decisionOutcome()
                )
                &&
                !card.complianceReady()
        ) {

            add(
                    signals,

                    signal(
                            "watch:tender:compliance:"
                                    +
                                    tenderId,

                            NotificationType.WATCHLIST_COMPLIANCE,

                            NotificationSeverity.HIGH,

                            "Watched GO bid has compliance gaps",

                            name
                                    +
                                    " is GO with compliance readiness at "
                                    +
                                    card.complianceReadinessScore()
                                    +
                                    "%.",

                            tenderId,

                            "/bid-workspaces/"
                                    +
                                    tenderId
                                    +
                                    "/compliance"
                    )
            );
        }


        if (
                !card.matchBlocked()
                &&
                card.matchScore()
                        >=
                        85
        ) {

            add(
                    signals,

                    signal(
                            "watch:tender:high-match:"
                                    +
                                    tenderId,

                            NotificationType.WATCHLIST_HIGH_MATCH,

                            NotificationSeverity.MEDIUM,

                            "Watched tender is a high match",

                            name
                                    +
                                    " currently has a "
                                    +
                                    card.matchScore()
                                    +
                                    "% match score.",

                            tenderId,

                            "/opportunities/"
                                    +
                                    tenderId
                    )
            );
        }
    }


    private void buyerSignals(
            WatchlistItemSnapshot item,
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard,
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals
    ) {

        UUID buyerId;


        try {

            buyerId =
                    UUID.fromString(
                            item.targetKey()
                    );


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            return;
        }


        List<DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard> cards =
                dashboard
                        .portfolio()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                card ->
                                        buyerId.equals(
                                                card.buyerId()
                                        )
                                &&
                                !card.submitted()
                                &&
                                !"NO_GO".equals(
                                        card.decisionOutcome()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();


        if (
                cards.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return;
        }


        DashboardCommandCenterResponse.BidCard strongest =
                cards
                        .stream()
                        .max(
                                Comparator.comparingInt(
                                        DashboardCommandCenterResponse
                                                .BidCard::matchScore
                                )
                        )
                        .orElseThrow();


        String name =
                label(
                        item,
                        strongest.buyerName()
                );


        add(
                signals,

                signal(
                        "watch:buyer:portfolio:"
                                +
                                buyerId,

                        NotificationType.WATCHLIST_BUYER_OPPORTUNITY,

                        strongest.matchScore() >= 85
                                ? NotificationSeverity.HIGH
                                : NotificationSeverity.MEDIUM,

                        "Watched buyer has active opportunities",

                        name
                                +
                                " currently appears on "
                                +
                                cards.size()
                                +
                                " active matched opportunit"
                                +
                                (
                                        cards.size() == 1
                                                ? "y"
                                                : "ies"
                                )
                                +
                                "; strongest match is "
                                +
                                strongest.matchScore()
                                +
                                "%.",

                        strongest.tenderId(),

                        "/buyers/"
                                +
                                buyerId
                )
        );
    }


    private void cpvSignals(
            WatchlistItemSnapshot item,
            DashboardCommandCenterResponse dashboard,
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals
    ) {

        if (
                dashboard.market() == null
                ||
                !dashboard.market().available()
                ||
                dashboard.market().leadingCpv() == null
        ) {

            return;
        }


        if (
                !dashboard
                        .market()
                        .leadingCpv()
                        .startsWith(
                                item.targetKey()
                        )
        ) {

            return;
        }


        String name =
                item.label() == null
                        ||
                        item.label().isBlank()
                        ? "CPV "
                                +
                                item.targetKey()
                        : item.label();


        add(
                signals,

                signal(
                        "watch:cpv:leading:"
                                +
                                item.targetKey(),

                        NotificationType.WATCHLIST_CPV_ACTIVITY,

                        NotificationSeverity.MEDIUM,

                        "Watched CPV leads recent market activity",

                        name
                                +
                                " matches the leading CPV in the current 30-day public market pulse"
                                +
                                (
                                        dashboard
                                                .market()
                                                .leadingCpvSharePercentage()
                                                ==
                                                null
                                                ? "."
                                                : " at "
                                                        +
                                                        dashboard
                                                                .market()
                                                                .leadingCpvSharePercentage()
                                                        +
                                                        "% of observed CPV activity."
                                ),

                        null,

                        "/market"
                )
        );
    }


    private AlertSignal signal(
            String fingerprint,
            NotificationType type,
            NotificationSeverity severity,
            String title,
            String detail,
            UUID tenderId,
            String href
    ) {

        return new AlertSignal(
                fingerprint,
                type,
                severity,
                title,
                detail,
                tenderId,
                href
        );
    }


    private void add(
            Map<String, AlertSignal> signals,
            AlertSignal signal
    ) {

        signals.put(
                signal.fingerprint(),
                signal
        );
    }


    private NotificationSeverity severity(
            DashboardActionPriority priority
    ) {

        return switch (
                priority
        ) {

            case CRITICAL ->
                    NotificationSeverity.CRITICAL;

            case HIGH ->
                    NotificationSeverity.HIGH;

            case MEDIUM ->
                    NotificationSeverity.MEDIUM;

            case LOW ->
                    NotificationSeverity.LOW;
        };
    }


    private int severityRank(
            NotificationSeverity severity
    ) {

        return switch (
                severity
        ) {

            case CRITICAL ->
                    0;

            case HIGH ->
                    1;

            case MEDIUM ->
                    2;

            case LOW ->
                    3;
        };
    }


    private String label(
            WatchlistItemSnapshot item,
            String fallback
    ) {

        if (
                item.label() != null
                &&
                !item.label().isBlank()
        ) {

            return item.label();
        }


        return fallback == null
                ||
                fallback.isBlank()
                ? item.targetKey()
                : fallback;
    }


    private String plural(
            long count
    ) {

        return count == 1
                ? ""
                : "s";
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.notification.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.AlertSignal;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationSeverity;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.notification.domain.NotificationType;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import jakarta.persistence.UniqueConstraint;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "organization_notifications",
        uniqueConstraints = {
                @UniqueConstraint(
                        name = "uq_org_notification_fingerprint",
                        columnNames = {
                                "organization_id",
                                "fingerprint"
                        }
                )
        }
)
public class NotificationEntity {

    @Id
    @Column(
            nullable = false
    )
    private UUID id;


    @Column(
            name = "organization_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private UUID organizationId;


    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 700
    )
    private String fingerprint;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 64
    )
    private NotificationType type;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 16
    )
    private NotificationSeverity severity;


    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 255
    )
    private String title;


    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            columnDefinition = "text"
    )
    private String detail;


    @Column(
            name = "tender_id"
    )
    private UUID tenderId;


    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 512
    )
    private String href;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            nullable = false,
            length = 24
    )
    private NotificationStatus status;


    @Column(
            nullable = false
    )
    private boolean active;


    @Column(
            name = "created_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant createdAt;


    @Column(
            name = "updated_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant updatedAt;


    @Column(
            name = "last_observed_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant lastObservedAt;


    protected NotificationEntity() {
    }


    public static NotificationEntity create(
            UUID organizationId,
            AlertSignal signal,
            Instant now
    ) {

        NotificationEntity entity =
                new NotificationEntity();


        entity.id =
                UUID.randomUUID();

        entity.organizationId =
                organizationId;

        entity.fingerprint =
                signal.fingerprint();

        entity.type =
                signal.type();

        entity.severity =
                signal.severity();

        entity.title =
                signal.title();

        entity.detail =
                signal.detail();

        entity.tenderId =
                signal.tenderId();

        entity.href =
                signal.href();

        entity.status =
                NotificationStatus.UNREAD;

        entity.active =
                true;

        entity.createdAt =
                now;

        entity.updatedAt =
                now;

        entity.lastObservedAt =
                now;


        return entity;
    }


    public void observe(
            AlertSignal signal,
            Instant now
    ) {

        boolean previouslyActive =
                active;


        type =
                signal.type();

        severity =
                signal.severity();

        title =
                signal.title();

        detail =
                signal.detail();

        tenderId =
                signal.tenderId();

        href =
                signal.href();

        active =
                true;

        lastObservedAt =
                now;

        updatedAt =
                now;


        if (
                !previouslyActive
                &&
                status == NotificationStatus.READ
        ) {

            status =
                    NotificationStatus.UNREAD;
        }
    }


    public void markInactive(
            Instant now
    ) {

        if (
                active
        ) {

            active =
                    false;

            updatedAt =
                    now;
        }
    }


    public void acknowledge(
            Instant now
    ) {

        if (
                status != NotificationStatus.DISMISSED
        ) {

            status =
                    NotificationStatus.READ;

            updatedAt =
                    now;
        }
    }


    public void dismiss(
            Instant now
    ) {

        status =
                NotificationStatus.DISMISSED;

        active =
                false;

        updatedAt =
                now;
    }


    public UUID id() {

        return id;
    }


    public UUID organizationId() {

        return organizationId;
    }


    public String fingerprint() {

        return fingerprint;
    }


    public NotificationType type() {

        return type;
    }


    public NotificationSeverity severity() {

        return severity;
    }


    public String title() {

        return title;
    }


    public String detail() {

        return detail;
    }


    public UUID tenderId() {

        return tenderId;
    }


    public String href() {

        return href;
    }


    public NotificationStatus status() {

        return status;
    }


    public boolean active() {

        return active;
    }


    public Instant createdAt() {

        return createdAt;
    }


    public Instant updatedAt() {

        return updatedAt;
    }


    public Instant lastObservedAt() {

        return lastObservedAt;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/organization/application/OrganizationService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.organization.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.api.OrganizationMemberResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.api.OrganizationResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.OrganizationMembershipEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationMembershipRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.tenant.CurrentPrincipal;
import com.tenderpilot.tenant.CurrentPrincipalService;
import com.tenderpilot.tenant.TenantAccessGuard;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class OrganizationService {

    private final OrganizationRepository
            organizationRepository;


    private final OrganizationMembershipRepository
            membershipRepository;


    private final CurrentPrincipalService
            currentPrincipalService;


    private final TenantAccessGuard
            tenantAccessGuard;


    public OrganizationService(

            OrganizationRepository organizationRepository,

            OrganizationMembershipRepository membershipRepository,

            CurrentPrincipalService currentPrincipalService,

            TenantAccessGuard tenantAccessGuard

    ) {

        this.organizationRepository =
                organizationRepository;

        this.membershipRepository =
                membershipRepository;

        this.currentPrincipalService =
                currentPrincipalService;

        this.tenantAccessGuard =
                tenantAccessGuard;

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public OrganizationResponse current() {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        assertMembership(
                principal
        );


        return map(

                organizationRepository
                        .findById(
                                principal.organizationId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Organization was not found"
                                        )
                        )

        );

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public OrganizationResponse getForCurrentTenant(
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        tenantAccessGuard
                .requireCurrentOrganization(
                        organizationId
                );


        return current();

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public List<OrganizationMemberResponse> currentMembers() {

        CurrentPrincipal principal =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require();


        assertMembership(
                principal
        );


        return membershipRepository

                .findAllByOrganization_IdOrderByCreatedAtAsc(
                        principal.organizationId()
                )

                .stream()

                .map(
                        this::mapMember
                )

                .toList();

    }


    private void assertMembership(
            CurrentPrincipal principal
    ) {

        membershipRepository
                .findByUser_IdAndOrganization_Id(

                        principal.userId(),

                        principal.organizationId()

                )
                .orElseThrow(
                        () ->
                                new ApiAuthenticationException(
                                        "Organization membership is no longer active"
                                )
                );

    }


    private OrganizationResponse map(
            OrganizationEntity organization
    ) {

        return new OrganizationResponse(

                organization.getId(),

                organization.getName(),

                organization.getSlug(),

                organization.getCreatedAt()

        );

    }


    private OrganizationMemberResponse mapMember(
            OrganizationMembershipEntity membership
    ) {

        return new OrganizationMemberResponse(

                membership
                        .getUser()
                        .getId(),

                membership
                        .getUser()
                        .getFullName(),

                membership
                        .getUser()
                        .getEmail(),

                membership.getRole(),

                membership.getCreatedAt()

        );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/organization/application/OrganizationSlugService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.organization.application;

import com.tenderpilot.organization.infrastructure.OrganizationRepository;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class OrganizationSlugService {

    private final OrganizationRepository
            organizationRepository;


    public OrganizationSlugService(
            OrganizationRepository organizationRepository
    ) {

        this.organizationRepository =
                organizationRepository;

    }


    public String generate(
            String organizationName
    ) {

        String normalized =
                Normalizer
                        .normalize(
                                organizationName,
                                Normalizer.Form.NFD
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\p{M}",
                                ""
                        )
                        .toLowerCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "[^a-z0-9]+",
                                "-"
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "^-+|-+$",
                                ""
                        );


        if (
                normalized.isBlank()
        ) {

            normalized =
                    "organization";

        }


        String candidate =
                normalized;


        if (
                !organizationRepository
                        .existsBySlug(
                                candidate
                        )
        ) {

            return candidate;

        }


        do {

            candidate =
                    normalized
                            +
                            "-"
                            +
                            UUID
                                    .randomUUID()
                                    .toString()
                                    .substring(
                                            0,
                                            8
                                    );

        } while (
                organizationRepository
                        .existsBySlug(
                                candidate
                        )
        );


        return candidate;

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/procurement/application/CanonicalTenderImportService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.procurement.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.application.ProcurementDataQualityService;
import com.tenderpilot.search.application.SearchProjectionService;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.CpvClassificationValue;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementBuyerEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementLocationValue;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderLotEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderSourceRecordEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.ProcurementBuyerRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderSourceRecordRepository;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.net.URI;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CanonicalTenderImportService {

    private final ProcurementBuyerRepository
            buyerRepository;


    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final TenderSourceRecordRepository
            sourceRecordRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityService
            dataQualityService;


    private final SearchProjectionService
            searchProjectionService;


    public CanonicalTenderImportService(

            ProcurementBuyerRepository buyerRepository,

            TenderRepository tenderRepository,

            TenderSourceRecordRepository sourceRecordRepository,

            ProcurementDataQualityService dataQualityService,

            SearchProjectionService searchProjectionService

    ) {

        this.buyerRepository =
                buyerRepository;

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.sourceRecordRepository =
                sourceRecordRepository;

        this.dataQualityService =
                dataQualityService;


        this.searchProjectionService =
                searchProjectionService;

    }


    @Transactional
    public UUID upsert(
            CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest request
    ) {

        validate(
                request
        );


        String externalId =
                cleanRequired(
                        request.externalId()
                );


        ProcurementBuyerEntity buyer =
                resolveBuyer(
                        request.buyer()
                );


        TenderSourceRecordEntity existingSource =

                sourceRecordRepository
                        .findBySourceAndExternalId(

                                request.source(),

                                externalId

                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        TenderEntity tender;


        if (
                existingSource == null
        ) {

            tender =
                    TenderEntity
                            .create(
                                    canonicalKey(

                                            request.source()
                                                    .name(),

                                            externalId

                                    )
                            );

        } else {

            tender =
                    existingSource
                            .getTender();

        }


        tender.update(

                buyer,

                cleanRequired(
                        request.title()
                ),

                cleanOptional(
                        request.description()
                )
                        == null
                        ? ""
                        : cleanOptional(
                                request.description()
                        ),

                request.status(),

                request.procedureType(),

                request.contractNature(),

                request.publicationDate(),

                request.submissionDeadline(),

                request.estimatedMinValue(),

                request.estimatedMaxValue(),

                upperOptional(
                        request.currency()
                ),

                upper(
                        request.countryCode()
                ),

                upperOptional(
                        request.primaryRegionCode()
                ),

                cleanOptional(
                        request.primaryRegionName()
                ),

                request.frameworkAgreement(),

                request.jointProcurement(),

                request.electronicSubmission()

        );


        tender.replaceCpvs(
                normalizeCpvs(
                        request.cpvs()
                )
        );


        tender.replaceLocations(
                normalizeLocations(
                        request.locations()
                )
        );


        tender.replaceLots(
                normalizeLots(

                        tender,

                        request.lots()

                )
        );


        if (
                existingSource == null
        ) {

            TenderSourceRecordEntity sourceRecord =

                    TenderSourceRecordEntity
                            .create(

                                    tender,

                                    request.source(),

                                    externalId

                            );


            sourceRecord.touch(

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.externalVersion()
                    ),

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.noticeType()
                    ),

                    normalizeUrl(
                            request.sourceUrl()
                    ),

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.payloadChecksum()
                    ),

                    request.sourcePublishedAt()

            );


            tender.addSourceRecord(
                    sourceRecord
            );


        } else {

            existingSource.touch(

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.externalVersion()
                    ),

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.noticeType()
                    ),

                    normalizeUrl(
                            request.sourceUrl()
                    ),

                    cleanOptional(
                            request.payloadChecksum()
                    ),

                    request.sourcePublishedAt()

            );

        }


        TenderEntity saved =

                tenderRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                tender
                        );


        dataQualityService
                .assessAndPersist(
                        saved.getId()
                );


        searchProjectionService
                .indexAfterWrite(
                        saved.getId()
                );


        return saved.getId();

    }


    private ProcurementBuyerEntity resolveBuyer(
            CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.BuyerInput input
    ) {

        String canonicalKey =
                cleanRequired(
                        input.canonicalKey()
                );


        ProcurementBuyerEntity buyer =

                buyerRepository
                        .findByCanonicalKey(
                                canonicalKey
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        ProcurementBuyerEntity
                                                .create(
                                                        canonicalKey
                                                )
                        );


        buyer.update(

                cleanRequired(
                        input.legalName()
                ),

                input.category(),

                upper(
                        input.countryCode()
                ),

                cleanOptional(
                        input.city()
                ),

                cleanOptional(
                        input.registrationNumber()
                ),

                normalizeUrl(
                        input.websiteUrl()
                )

        );


        return buyerRepository
                .save(
                        buyer
                );

    }


    private List<CpvClassificationValue> normalizeCpvs(
            List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.CpvInput> inputs
    ) {

        Map<String, CpvClassificationValue> distinct =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.CpvInput input :
                safeList(
                        inputs
                )
        ) {

            String code =
                    cleanRequired(
                            input.code()
                    );


            if (
                    !code.matches(
                            "\\d{8}"
                    )
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "CPV code must contain exactly 8 digits"
                );

            }


            distinct.putIfAbsent(

                    code,

                    new CpvClassificationValue(

                            code,

                            cleanRequired(
                                    input.label()
                            )

                    )

            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct.values()
        );

    }


    private List<ProcurementLocationValue> normalizeLocations(
            List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput> inputs
    ) {

        Map<String, ProcurementLocationValue> distinct =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LocationInput input :
                safeList(
                        inputs
                )
        ) {

            ProcurementLocationValue location =

                    new ProcurementLocationValue(

                            upper(
                                    input.countryCode()
                            ),

                            upperOptional(
                                    input.regionCode()
                            ),

                            cleanOptional(
                                    input.regionName()
                            ),

                            cleanOptional(
                                    input.city()
                            )

                    );


            String key =

                    location.getCountryCode()
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(
                                    location.getRegionCode()
                            )
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(
                                    location.getCity()
                            );


            distinct.putIfAbsent(
                    key,
                    location
            );

        }


        return List.copyOf(
                distinct.values()
        );

    }


    private List<TenderLotEntity> normalizeLots(

            TenderEntity tender,

            List<CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest.LotInput> inputs

    ) {

        return safeList(
                inputs
        )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        input -> {

                            validateRange(

                                    input.estimatedMinValue(),

                                    input.estimatedMaxValue(),

                                    "Lot minimum estimated value cannot exceed its maximum estimated value"

                            );


                            requireCurrencyWhenValued(

                                    input.estimatedMinValue(),

                                    input.estimatedMaxValue(),

                                    input.currency(),

                                    "Lot currency is required when an estimated value is supplied"

                            );


                            return TenderLotEntity
                                    .create(

                                            tender,

                                            cleanRequired(
                                                    input.lotNumber()
                                            ),

                                            cleanRequired(
                                                    input.title()
                                            ),

                                            cleanOptional(
                                                    input.description()
                                            )
                                                    == null
                                                    ? ""
                                                    : cleanOptional(
                                                            input.description()
                                                    ),

                                            input.estimatedMinValue(),

                                            input.estimatedMaxValue(),

                                            upperOptional(
                                                    input.currency()
                                            ),

                                            normalizeCpvs(
                                                    input.cpvs()
                                            )

                                    );

                        }
                )
                .toList();

    }


    private void validate(
            CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest request
    ) {

        if (
                request == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Canonical tender request is required"
            );

        }


        if (
                request.source() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Procurement source is required"
            );

        }


        requirePresent(

                request.externalId(),

                "External tender identifier is required"

        );


        if (
                request.buyer() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Buyer information is required"
            );

        }


        requirePresent(

                request.buyer()
                        .canonicalKey(),

                "Buyer canonical key is required"

        );


        requirePresent(

                request.buyer()
                        .legalName(),

                "Buyer legal name is required"

        );


        if (
                request.buyer()
                        .category()
                        ==
                        null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Buyer category is required"
            );

        }


        requireCountry(
                request.buyer()
                        .countryCode()
        );


        requirePresent(

                request.title(),

                "Tender title is required"

        );


        if (
                request.status() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Tender status is required"
            );

        }


        if (
                request.procedureType() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Tender procedure type is required"
            );

        }


        if (
                request.contractNature() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Tender contract nature is required"
            );

        }


        if (
                request.publicationDate() == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Tender publication date is required"
            );

        }


        requireCountry(
                request.countryCode()
        );


        validateRange(

                request.estimatedMinValue(),

                request.estimatedMaxValue(),

                "Tender minimum estimated value cannot exceed its maximum estimated value"

        );


        requireCurrencyWhenValued(

                request.estimatedMinValue(),

                request.estimatedMaxValue(),

                request.currency(),

                "Tender currency is required when an estimated value is supplied"

        );

    }


    private void validateRange(

            BigDecimal minimum,

            BigDecimal maximum,

            String message

    ) {

        if (
                minimum != null
                &&
                maximum != null
                &&
                minimum.compareTo(
                        maximum
                )
                >
                0
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );

        }

    }


    private void requireCurrencyWhenValued(

            BigDecimal minimum,

            BigDecimal maximum,

            String currency,

            String message

    ) {

        if (
                (
                        minimum != null
                        ||
                        maximum != null
                )
                &&
                cleanOptional(
                        currency
                )
                ==
                null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );

        }

    }


    private void requireCountry(
            String countryCode
    ) {

        String normalized =
                upper(
                        countryCode
                );


        if (
                !normalized.matches(
                        "[A-Z]{2}"
                )
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Country code must contain exactly two letters"
            );

        }

    }


    private void requirePresent(

            String value,

            String message

    ) {

        if (
                cleanOptional(
                        value
                )
                ==
                null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    message
            );

        }

    }


    private String normalizeUrl(
            String raw
    ) {

        String value =
                cleanOptional(
                        raw
                );


        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        try {

            URI uri =
                    URI.create(
                            value
                    );


            if (
                    !(
                            "http".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                    uri.getScheme()
                            )
                            ||
                            "https".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                    uri.getScheme()
                            )
                    )
                    ||
                    uri.getHost()
                            ==
                            null
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "URL must be a valid http or https URL"
                );

            }


            return uri.toString();


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "URL is invalid"
            );

        }

    }


    private String canonicalKey(

            String source,

            String externalId

    ) {

        return source
                +
                ":"
                +
                externalId;

    }


    private String cleanRequired(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Required text value is missing"
            );

        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        if (
                cleaned.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Required text value is blank"
            );

        }


        return cleaned;

    }


    private String cleanOptional(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;

        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }


    private String upper(
            String value
    ) {

        return cleanRequired(
                value
        )
                .toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }


    private String upperOptional(
            String value
    ) {

        String cleaned =
                cleanOptional(
                        value
                );


        return cleaned == null
                ? null
                : cleaned.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

    }


    private String nullSafe(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;

    }


    private <T> List<T> safeList(
            List<T> values
    ) {

        return values == null
                ? List.of()
                : values;

    }

}
