package com.tenderpilot.procurement.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.api.OpportunityDetailResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.api.OpportunitySummaryResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.TenderAwardEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.infrastructure.TenderAwardRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.CpvClassificationValue;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityGrade;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.infrastructure.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class OpportunityQueryService {

    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final TenderAwardRepository
            awardRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
            qualityRepository;


    public OpportunityQueryService(
            TenderRepository tenderRepository,
            TenderAwardRepository awardRepository,
            ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
                    qualityRepository
    ) {

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.awardRepository =
                awardRepository;

        this.qualityRepository =
                qualityRepository;
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<OpportunitySummaryResponse> list(
            String query,
            ProcurementStatus status,
            ProcurementSource source
    ) {

        return list(
                query,
                status,
                source,
                null,
                null
        );
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<OpportunitySummaryResponse> list(
            String query,
            ProcurementStatus status,
            ProcurementSource source,
            Integer minQualityScore,
            DataQualityGrade qualityGrade
    ) {

        String normalizedQuery =
                query == null
                        ? null
                        : query
                                .trim()
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                );


        return tenderRepository
                .findTop100ByOrderByPublicationDateDesc()
                .stream()

                .filter(
                        tender ->
                                status == null
                                ||
                                tender.getStatus()
                                        ==
                                        status
                )

                .filter(
                        tender ->
                                source == null
                                ||
                                tender
                                        .getSourceRecords()
                                        .stream()
                                        .anyMatch(
                                                record ->
                                                        record.getSource()
                                                                ==
                                                                source
                                        )
                )

                .filter(
                        tender ->
                                matchesText(
                                        tender,
                                        normalizedQuery
                                )
                )

                .filter(
                        tender ->
                                matchesQuality(
                                        tender,
                                        minQualityScore,
                                        qualityGrade
                                )
                )

                .map(
                        this::toSummary
                )

                .toList();
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public OpportunitySummaryResponse summaryById(
            UUID id
    ) {

        TenderEntity tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(
                                id
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Opportunity was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        return toSummary(
                tender
        );

    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public OpportunityDetailResponse detail(
            UUID id
    ) {

        TenderEntity tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(
                                id
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Opportunity was not found"
                                        )
                        );


        return detailResponse(
                tender
        );
    }


    private boolean matchesText(
            TenderEntity tender,
            String query
    ) {

        if (
                query == null
                ||
                query.isBlank()
        ) {
            return true;
        }


        if (
                tender.getTitle()
                        .toLowerCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        )
                        .contains(
                                query
                        )
        ) {
            return true;
        }


        if (
                tender.getBuyer()
                        .getLegalName()
                        .toLowerCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        )
                        .contains(
                                query
                        )
        ) {
            return true;
        }


        return tender
                .getCpvs()
                .stream()
                .anyMatch(
                        cpv ->
                                cpv.getCode()
                                        .contains(
                                                query
                                        )
                                ||
                                cpv.getLabel()
                                        .toLowerCase(
                                                Locale.ROOT
                                        )
                                        .contains(
                                                query
                                        )
                );
    }


    private boolean matchesQuality(
            TenderEntity tender,
            Integer minQualityScore,
            DataQualityGrade grade
    ) {

        if (
                minQualityScore == null
                &&
                grade == null
        ) {
            return true;
        }


        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity quality =
                qualityRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tender.getId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        if (quality == null) {
            return false;
        }


        if (
                minQualityScore != null
                &&
                quality.getScore()
                        <
                        minQualityScore
        ) {
            return false;
        }


        return grade == null
                ||
                quality.getGrade()
                        ==
                        grade;
    }


    private OpportunitySummaryResponse toSummary(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {

        TenderAwardEntity award =
                awardRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tender.getId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity quality =
                qualityRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tender.getId()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new OpportunitySummaryResponse(
                tender.getId(),
                tender.getTitle(),
                tender
                        .getBuyer()
                        .getLegalName(),
                tender.getStatus(),
                tender.getProcedureType(),
                tender.getContractNature(),
                tender.getPublicationDate(),
                tender.getSubmissionDeadline(),
                tender.getEstimatedMinValue(),
                tender.getEstimatedMaxValue(),
                tender.getCurrency(),
                tender.getCountryCode(),
                tender.getPrimaryRegionName(),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .limit(
                                3
                        )
                        .map(
                                cpv ->
                                        new OpportunitySummaryResponse
                                                .CpvSummary(
                                                        cpv.getCode(),
                                                        cpv.getLabel()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getSourceRecords()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                record ->
                                        record.getSource()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getLots()
                        .size(),

                award == null
                        ? null
                        : award.getAwardedAmount(),

                award == null
                        ? null
                        : award.getCurrency(),

                quality == null
                        ? null
                        : quality.getScore(),

                quality == null
                        ? null
                        : quality.getGrade(),

                quality == null
                        ? 0
                        : quality.getIssueCount()
        );
    }


    private OpportunityDetailResponse detailResponse(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {

        return new OpportunityDetailResponse(
                tender.getId(),
                tender.getCanonicalKey(),
                tender.getTitle(),
                tender.getDescription(),
                tender.getStatus(),
                tender.getProcedureType(),
                tender.getContractNature(),
                tender.getPublicationDate(),
                tender.getSubmissionDeadline(),
                tender.getEstimatedMinValue(),
                tender.getEstimatedMaxValue(),
                tender.getCurrency(),
                tender.getCountryCode(),
                tender.getPrimaryRegionCode(),
                tender.getPrimaryRegionName(),
                tender.isFrameworkAgreement(),
                tender.isJointProcurement(),
                tender.isElectronicSubmission(),

                new OpportunityDetailResponse
                        .BuyerResponse(
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getId(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getLegalName(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getCategory(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getCountryCode(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getCity(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getRegistrationNumber(),
                                tender
                                        .getBuyer()
                                        .getWebsiteUrl()
                        ),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                this::cpv
                        )
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getLocations()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                location ->
                                        new OpportunityDetailResponse
                                                .LocationResponse(
                                                        location.getCountryCode(),
                                                        location.getRegionCode(),
                                                        location.getRegionName(),
                                                        location.getCity()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getLots()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                lot ->
                                        new OpportunityDetailResponse
                                                .LotResponse(
                                                        lot.getId(),
                                                        lot.getLotNumber(),
                                                        lot.getTitle(),
                                                        lot.getDescription(),
                                                        lot.getEstimatedMinValue(),
                                                        lot.getEstimatedMaxValue(),
                                                        lot.getCurrency(),
                                                        lot
                                                                .getCpvs()
                                                                .stream()
                                                                .map(
                                                                        this::cpv
                                                                )
                                                                .toList()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getSourceRecords()
                        .stream()

                                source ->
                                        new OpportunityDetailResponse
                                                .SourceResponse(
                                                        source.getSource(),
                                                        source.getExternalId(),
                                                        source.getExternalVersion(),
                                                        source.getNoticeType(),
                                                        source.getSourceUrl(),
                                                        source.getPayloadChecksum(),
                                                        source.getSourcePublishedAt(),
                                                        source.getFirstSeenAt(),
                                                        source.getLastSeenAt()
                                                )
                        )
                        .toList(),

                awardResponse(
                        tender.getId()
                ),

                qualityResponse(
                        tender.getId()
                )
        );
    }

                .AwardResponse(

                        award.getAwardedAmount(),
                        award.getCurrency(),

                        award.getFrameworkAgreementId(),
                        award.getSocialConsiderations(),

                        award.getExecutionModalities(),

                                                                supplier.getIdentifierType(),
                                                                supplier.getLegalName()
                                                        )
                                )
                                .toList()
                );
    }

    qualityResponse(

    ) {

                        .findByTender_Id(

                        )
                        .orElse(

        return new OpportunityDetailResponse

package com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.AwardSupplierValue;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.TenderAwardEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.infrastructure.TenderAwardRepository;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.application.ProcurementDataQualityService;
import com.tenderpilot.search.application.SearchProjectionService;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CanonicalAwardImportService {

    private final TenderRepository tenderRepository;
    private final TenderAwardRepository awardRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityService
            dataQualityService;


    private final SearchProjectionService
            searchProjectionService;

    public CanonicalAwardImportService(
            TenderRepository tenderRepository,
            TenderAwardRepository awardRepository,
            ProcurementDataQualityService dataQualityService,
            SearchProjectionService searchProjectionService
    ) {
        this.tenderRepository = tenderRepository;
        this.awardRepository = awardRepository;
        this.dataQualityService = dataQualityService;

        this.searchProjectionService = searchProjectionService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public UUID upsert(
            UUID tenderId,
            CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest request
    ) {

        if (tenderId == null) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Tender identifier is required for an award"
            );
        }

        if (request == null) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Award request is required"
            );
        }

        validateAmount(request.awardedAmount());
        validateNonNegative(
                request.durationMonths(),
                "Award duration cannot be negative"
        );
        validateNonNegative(
                request.offersReceived(),
                "Offers received cannot be negative"
        );

        String currency =
                normalizeCurrency(request.currency());

        if (
                request.awardedAmount() != null
                &&
                currency == null
        ) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Award currency is required when an awarded amount is supplied"
            );
        }

        TenderEntity tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(tenderId)
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Tender was not found for award import"
                                        )
                        );

        TenderAwardEntity award =
                awardRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(tenderId)
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        TenderAwardEntity.create(tender)
                        );

        award.update(
                request.notificationDate(),
                request.awardedAmount(),
                currency,
                request.durationMonths(),
                clean(request.priceForm()),
                request.offersReceived(),
                clean(request.frameworkAgreementId()),
                clean(request.socialConsiderations()),
                clean(request.environmentalConsiderations()),
                clean(request.executionModalities()),
                clean(request.operatorGroupType()),
                clean(request.subcontractingDeclared())
        );

        award.replaceSuppliers(
                normalizeSuppliers(request.suppliers())
        );

        TenderAwardEntity saved =
                awardRepository
                        .saveAndFlush(
                                award
                        );


        dataQualityService
                .assessAndPersist(
                        tenderId
                );


        searchProjectionService
                .indexAfterWrite(
                        tenderId
                );


        return saved.getId();
    }

    private List<AwardSupplierValue> normalizeSuppliers(
            List<CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest.SupplierInput> inputs
    ) {

        Map<String, AwardSupplierValue> unique =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (
                CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest.SupplierInput input :
                safeList(inputs)
        ) {

            String identifier =
                    clean(input.identifier());

            String identifierType =
                    clean(input.identifierType());

            String legalName =
                    clean(input.legalName());

            if (
                    identifier == null
                    &&
                    legalName == null
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            String key =
                    nullSafe(identifier)
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(identifierType)
                            +
                            "|"
                            +
                            nullSafe(legalName);

            unique.putIfAbsent(
                    key,
                    new AwardSupplierValue(
                            identifier,
                            identifierType,
                            legalName
                    )
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
    }

    private void validateAmount(BigDecimal value) {

        if (
                value != null
                &&
                value.signum() < 0
        ) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Awarded amount cannot be negative"
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateNonNegative(
            Integer value,
            String message
    ) {

        if (
                value != null
                &&
                value < 0
        ) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(message);
        }
    }

    private String normalizeCurrency(String value) {

        String cleaned = clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String upper =
                cleaned.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!upper.matches("[A-Z]{3}")) {
            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Award currency must contain exactly three letters"
            );
        }

        return upper;
    }

    private String clean(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private String nullSafe(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value;
    }

    private <T> List<T> safeList(List<T> values) {
        return values == null
                ? List.of()
                : values;
    }
}

package com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.application;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;

public record CanonicalAwardUpsertRequest(

        LocalDate notificationDate,

        BigDecimal awardedAmount,

        String currency,

        Integer durationMonths,

        String priceForm,

        Integer offersReceived,

        String frameworkAgreementId,

        String socialConsiderations,

package com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import jakarta.persistence.CollectionTable;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.ElementCollection;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.OneToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.OrderColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.PrePersist;
import jakarta.persistence.PreUpdate;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(name = "procurement_tender_awards")
public class TenderAwardEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;

    @OneToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY, optional = false)
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "tender_id",
            nullable = false,
            unique = true
    )
    private TenderEntity tender;

    @Column(name = "notification_date")
    private LocalDate notificationDate;

    @Column(
            name = "awarded_amount",
            precision = 19,
            scale = 2
    )
    private BigDecimal awardedAmount;

    @Column(name = "currency", length = 3)
    private String currency;

    @Column(name = "duration_months")
    private Integer durationMonths;

    @Column(name = "price_form", length = 160)
    private String priceForm;

    @Column(name = "offers_received")
    private Integer offersReceived;

    @Column(name = "framework_agreement_id", length = 220)
    private String frameworkAgreementId;

    @Column(name = "social_considerations", length = 600)
    private String socialConsiderations;

    @Column(name = "environmental_considerations", length = 600)
    private String environmentalConsiderations;

    @Column(name = "execution_modalities", length = 600)
    private String executionModalities;

    @Column(name = "operator_group_type", length = 160)
    private String operatorGroupType;

    @Column(name = "subcontracting_declared", length = 160)
    private String subcontractingDeclared;

    @ElementCollection(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @CollectionTable(
            name = "procurement_tender_award_suppliers",
            joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "award_id")
    )
    @OrderColumn(name = "position")
    private List<AwardSupplierValue> suppliers =
            new ArrayList<>();

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant updatedAt;

    protected TenderAwardEntity() {
    }

    private TenderAwardEntity(TenderEntity tender) {
        this.id = UUID.randomUUID();
        this.tender = tender;
    }

    public static TenderAwardEntity create(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {
        return new TenderAwardEntity(tender);
    }

    public void update(
            LocalDate notificationDate,
            BigDecimal awardedAmount,
            String currency,
            Integer durationMonths,
            String priceForm,
            Integer offersReceived,
            String frameworkAgreementId,
            String socialConsiderations,
            String environmentalConsiderations,
            String executionModalities,
            String operatorGroupType,
            String subcontractingDeclared
    ) {
        this.notificationDate = notificationDate;
        this.awardedAmount = awardedAmount;
        this.currency = currency;
        this.durationMonths = durationMonths;
        this.priceForm = priceForm;
        this.offersReceived = offersReceived;
        this.frameworkAgreementId = frameworkAgreementId;
        this.socialConsiderations = socialConsiderations;
        this.environmentalConsiderations =
                environmentalConsiderations;
        this.executionModalities = executionModalities;
        this.operatorGroupType = operatorGroupType;
        this.subcontractingDeclared = subcontractingDeclared;
    }

    public void replaceSuppliers(
            List<AwardSupplierValue> values
    ) {
        suppliers.clear();
        suppliers.addAll(values);
    }

    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {
        Instant now = Instant.now();

        if (id == null) {
            id = UUID.randomUUID();
        }

        if (createdAt == null) {
            createdAt = now;
        }

        updatedAt = now;
    }

    @PreUpdate
    void beforeUpdate() {
        updatedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    public UUID getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public TenderEntity getTender() {
        return tender;
    }

    public LocalDate getNotificationDate() {
        return notificationDate;
    }

    public BigDecimal getAwardedAmount() {
        return awardedAmount;
    }

    public String getCurrency() {
        return currency;
    }

    public Integer getDurationMonths() {
        return durationMonths;
    }

    public String getPriceForm() {
        return priceForm;
    }

    public Integer getOffersReceived() {
        return offersReceived;
    }

    public String getFrameworkAgreementId() {
        return frameworkAgreementId;
    }

    public String getSocialConsiderations() {
        return socialConsiderations;
    }

    public String getEnvironmentalConsiderations() {
        return environmentalConsiderations;
    }

    public String getExecutionModalities() {
        return executionModalities;
    }

    public String getOperatorGroupType() {
        return operatorGroupType;
    }

    public String getSubcontractingDeclared() {
        return subcontractingDeclared;
    }

    public List<AwardSupplierValue> getSuppliers() {
        return List.copyOf(suppliers);
    }

    public Instant getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }

    public Instant getUpdatedAt() {
        return updatedAt;
    }
}

import jakarta.persistence.ManyToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.OneToMany;
import jakarta.persistence.OrderColumn;

import jakarta.persistence.PreUpdate;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "procurement_tenders"
)
public class TenderEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;


    @Column(
            name = "canonical_key",
            nullable = false,
            unique = true,
            length = 320
    )
    private String canonicalKey;


    @ManyToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "buyer_id",
            nullable = false
    )
    private ProcurementBuyerEntity buyer;


    @Column(
            name = "title",
            nullable = false,
            length = 1000
    )
    private String title;


    @Column(
            name = "description",
            nullable = false,
            length = 12000
    )
    private String description;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            name = "status",
            nullable = false,
            length = 60
    )
    private ProcurementStatus status;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            name = "procedure_type",
            nullable = false,
            length = 80
    )
    private ProcurementProcedure procedureType;


    @Enumerated(
            EnumType.STRING
    )
    @Column(
            name = "contract_nature",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private ContractNature contractNature;


    @Column(
            name = "publication_date",
            nullable = false
    )
    private LocalDate publicationDate;


    @Column(
            name = "submission_deadline"
    )
    private Instant submissionDeadline;


    @Column(
            name = "estimated_min_value",
            precision = 19,
            scale = 2
    )
    private BigDecimal estimatedMinValue;


    @Column(
            name = "estimated_max_value",
            precision = 19,
            scale = 2
    )
    private BigDecimal estimatedMaxValue;


    @Column(
            name = "currency",
            length = 3
    )
    private String currency;


    @Column(
            name = "country_code",
            nullable = false,
            length = 2
    )
    private String countryCode;


    @Column(
            name = "primary_region_code",
            length = 40
    )
    private String primaryRegionCode;


    @Column(
            name = "primary_region_name",
            length = 180
    )
    private String primaryRegionName;


    @Column(
            name = "framework_agreement",
            nullable = false
    )
    private boolean frameworkAgreement;


    @Column(
            name = "joint_procurement",
            nullable = false
    )
    private boolean jointProcurement;


    @Column(
            name = "electronic_submission",
            nullable = false
    )
    private boolean electronicSubmission;


    @ElementCollection(

    )

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/procurement/quality/application/ProcurementDataQualityEvaluator.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.application;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.TenderAwardEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityGrade;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityIssueCode;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityIssueValue;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualitySeverity;

import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class ProcurementDataQualityEvaluator {

    public DataQualityEvaluation evaluate(
            TenderEntity tender,
            TenderAwardEntity award
    ) {

        List<DataQualityIssueValue> issues =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int score = 100;


        /*
         * Buyer identity — 15 points.
         */
        if (
                tender.getBuyer() == null
                ||
                isGenericBuyer(
                        tender.getBuyer()
                                .getLegalName()
                )
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .GENERIC_BUYER_IDENTITY,

                            DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                            "buyer.legalName",

                            "Buyer identity is generic or insufficiently specific."
                    )
            );

            score -= 15;
        }


        /*
         * CPV classification — 20 points.
         */
        if (
                tender.getCpvs() == null
                ||
                tender.getCpvs()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .MISSING_CPV,

                            DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                            "cpvs",

                            "No normalized CPV classification is available."
                    )
            );

            score -= 20;
        }


        /*
         * Geography — 15 points.
         */
        if (
                tender.getLocations() == null
                ||
                tender.getLocations()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .MISSING_LOCATION,

                            DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                            "locations",

                            "No structured place of performance is available."
                    )
            );

            score -= 15;
        }


        /*
         * Open-notice timing — 10 points.
         */
        if (
                requiresSubmissionDeadline(
                        tender.getStatus()
                )
                &&
                tender.getSubmissionDeadline()
                        ==
                        null
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .MISSING_SUBMISSION_DEADLINE,

                            DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                            "submissionDeadline",

                            "Published opportunity has no structured submission deadline."
                    )
            );

            score -= 10;
        }


        /*
         * Invalid chronology — critical 25-point deduction.
         */
        if (
                tender.getSubmissionDeadline()
                        !=
                        null
                &&
                tender.getPublicationDate()
                        !=
                        null
                &&
                tender.getSubmissionDeadline()
                        .isBefore(
                                tender
                                        .getPublicationDate()
                                        .atStartOfDay()
                                        .toInstant(
                                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                                        )
                        )
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .DEADLINE_BEFORE_PUBLICATION,

                            DataQualitySeverity.CRITICAL,

                            "submissionDeadline",

                            "Submission deadline occurs before the publication date."
                    )
            );

            score -= 25;
        }


        /*
         * Open-notice commercial value — 5 points.
         *
         * Missing values are common in procurement notices, so this is INFO
         * rather than WARNING.
         */
        if (
                requiresEstimatedValue(
                        tender.getStatus()
                )
                &&
                tender.getEstimatedMinValue()
                        ==
                        null
                &&
                tender.getEstimatedMaxValue()
                        ==
                        null
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .MISSING_ESTIMATED_VALUE,

                            DataQualitySeverity.INFO,

                            "estimatedValue",

                            "Published opportunity has no structured estimated value."
                    )
            );

            score -= 5;
        }


        /*
         * Provenance — 25 critical points if entirely absent.
         * Otherwise 5 informational points if source URLs are absent.
         */
        if (
                tender.getSourceRecords() == null
                ||
                tender.getSourceRecords()
                        .isEmpty()
        ) {

            issues.add(
                    issue(
                            DataQualityIssueCode
                                    .MISSING_SOURCE_LINEAGE,

                            DataQualitySeverity.CRITICAL,

                            "sources",

                            "Canonical procurement record has no source lineage."
                    )
            );

            score -= 25;

        } else {

            boolean sourceUrlAvailable =
                    tender
                            .getSourceRecords()
                            .stream()
                            .anyMatch(
                                    source ->
                                            source.getSourceUrl()
                                                    !=
                                                    null
                                            &&
                                            !source
                                                    .getSourceUrl()
                                                    .isBlank()
                            );


            if (!sourceUrlAvailable) {

                issues.add(
                        issue(
                                DataQualityIssueCode
                                        .MISSING_SOURCE_URL,

                                DataQualitySeverity.INFO,

                                "sources.sourceUrl",

                                "Source lineage exists but no source URL is available."
                        )
                );

                score -= 5;
            }
        }


        /*
         * Award-stage consistency.
         */
        if (
                tender.getStatus()
                        ==
                        ProcurementStatus.AWARDED
        ) {

            if (award == null) {

                issues.add(
                        issue(
                                DataQualityIssueCode
                                        .AWARD_RECORD_MISSING,

                                DataQualitySeverity.CRITICAL,

                                "award",

                                "Tender is marked AWARDED but has no canonical award record."
                        )
                );

                score -= 25;

            } else {

                if (
                        award.getAwardedAmount()
                                ==
                                null
                ) {

                    issues.add(
                            issue(
                                    DataQualityIssueCode
                                            .AWARDED_AMOUNT_MISSING,

                                    DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                                    "award.awardedAmount",

                                    "Award record does not contain an awarded amount."
                            )
                    );

                    score -= 10;
                }


                if (
                        award.getSuppliers()
                                .isEmpty()
                ) {

                    issues.add(
                            issue(
                                    DataQualityIssueCode
                                            .AWARDED_SUPPLIER_MISSING,

                                    DataQualitySeverity.WARNING,

                                    "award.suppliers",

                                    "Award record does not contain a structured awarded supplier."
                            )
                    );

                    score -= 10;
                }
            }
        }


        int normalizedScore =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                score
                        )
                );


        return new DataQualityEvaluation(
                normalizedScore,
                DataQualityGrade.fromScore(
                        normalizedScore
                ),
                List.copyOf(
                        issues
                )
        );
    }


    private boolean requiresSubmissionDeadline(
            ProcurementStatus status
    ) {

        return status
                ==
                ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED
                ||
                status
                        ==
                        ProcurementStatus.UPDATED;
    }


    private boolean requiresEstimatedValue(
            ProcurementStatus status
    ) {

        return status
                ==
                ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED
                ||
                status
                        ==
                        ProcurementStatus.UPDATED;
    }


    private boolean isGenericBuyer(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
                ||
                value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return true;
        }


        String normalized =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return normalized.equals(
                "ted contracting authority"
        )
                ||
                normalized.equals(
                        "acheteur public boamp"
                )
                ||
                normalized.equals(
                        "french public buyer"
                )
                ||
                normalized.equals(
                        "acheteur public français"
                )
                ||
                normalized.startsWith(
                        "public buyer "
                )
                ||
                normalized.startsWith(
                        "acheteur "
                );
    }


    private DataQualityIssueValue issue(
            DataQualityIssueCode code,
            DataQualitySeverity severity,
            String field,
            String message
    ) {

        return new DataQualityIssueValue(
                code,
                severity,
                field,
                message
        );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/procurement/quality/application/ProcurementDataQualityService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.TenderAwardEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.infrastructure.TenderAwardRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.api.DataQualityOverviewResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.DataQualityGrade;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.infrastructure.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class ProcurementDataQualityService {

    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final TenderAwardRepository
            awardRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
            assessmentRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityEvaluator
            evaluator;


    public ProcurementDataQualityService(
            TenderRepository tenderRepository,
            TenderAwardRepository awardRepository,
            ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
                    assessmentRepository,
            ProcurementDataQualityEvaluator evaluator
    ) {

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.awardRepository =
                awardRepository;

        this.assessmentRepository =
                assessmentRepository;

        this.evaluator =
                evaluator;
    }


    @Transactional
    public ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
    assessAndPersist(
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderEntity tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Tender was not found for data quality assessment"
                                        )
                        );


        TenderAwardEntity award =
                awardRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        DataQualityEvaluation evaluation =
                evaluator.evaluate(
                        tender,
                        award
                );


        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                assessment =
                assessmentRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseGet(
                                () ->
                                        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                                .create(
                                                        tender
                                                )
                        );


        assessment.apply(
                evaluation
        );


        return assessmentRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        assessment
                );
    }


    @Transactional
    public int recalculateAll() {

        List<TenderEntity> tenders =
                tenderRepository.findAll();


        for (
                TenderEntity tender :
                tenders
        ) {

            assessAndPersist(
                    tender.getId()
            );
        }


        return tenders.size();
    }


    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public DataQualityOverviewResponse overview() {

        long totalTenders =
                tenderRepository.count();


        List<ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity>
                assessments =
                assessmentRepository.findAll();


        long assessed =
                assessments.size();


        double average =
                assessments.isEmpty()
                        ? 0.0
                        : assessments
                                .stream()
                                .mapToInt(
                                        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                                ::getScore
                                )
                                .average()
                                .orElse(
                                        0.0
                                );


        long excellent =
                countGrade(
                        assessments,
                        DataQualityGrade.EXCELLENT
                );


        long good =
                countGrade(
                        assessments,
                        DataQualityGrade.GOOD
                );


        long fair =
                countGrade(
                        assessments,
                        DataQualityGrade.FAIR
                );


        long poor =
                countGrade(
                        assessments,
                        DataQualityGrade.POOR
                );


        long critical =
                countGrade(
                        assessments,
                        DataQualityGrade.CRITICAL
                );


        long criticalIssues =
                assessments
                        .stream()
                        .mapToLong(
                                ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                        ::getCriticalIssueCount
                        )
                        .sum();


        long warningIssues =
                assessments
                        .stream()
                        .mapToLong(
                                ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                        ::getWarningIssueCount
                        )
                        .sum();


        long infoIssues =
                assessments
                        .stream()
                        .mapToLong(
                                ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                        ::getInfoIssueCount
                        )
                        .sum();


        Instant lastAssessedAt =
                assessments
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity
                                        ::getAssessedAt
                        )
                        .max(
                                Instant::compareTo
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new DataQualityOverviewResponse(
                totalTenders,
                assessed,
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        totalTenders - assessed
                ),
                average,
                excellent,
                good,
                fair,
                poor,
                critical,
                criticalIssues,
                warningIssues,
                infoIssues,
                lastAssessedAt
        );
    }


    private long countGrade(
            List<ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity>
                    assessments,
            DataQualityGrade grade
    ) {

        return assessments
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        assessment ->
                                assessment.getGrade()
                                        ==
                                        grade
                )
                .count();
    }

}

public enum DataQualityGrade {

    EXCELLENT,

    GOOD,

    FAIR,

    POOR,

    CRITICAL;


    public static DataQualityGrade fromScore(
            int score
    ) {

        if (score >= 90) {
            return EXCELLENT;
        }

        if (score >= 75) {
            return GOOD;
        }

        if (score >= 60) {
            return FAIR;
        }

        if (score >= 40) {
            return POOR;
        }

        return CRITICAL;
    }

package com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;

import jakarta.persistence.CollectionTable;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.ElementCollection;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.OneToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.OrderColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.PrePersist;
import jakarta.persistence.PreUpdate;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Entity
@Table(
        name = "procurement_data_quality_assessments"
)
public class ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity {

    @Id
    private UUID id;


    @OneToOne(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY,
            optional = false
    )
    @JoinColumn(
            name = "tender_id",
            nullable = false,
            unique = true
    )
    private TenderEntity tender;


    @Column(
            name = "score",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int score;


    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(
            name = "grade",
            nullable = false,
            length = 40
    )
    private DataQualityGrade grade;


    @Column(
            name = "critical_issue_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int criticalIssueCount;


    @Column(
            name = "warning_issue_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int warningIssueCount;


    @Column(
            name = "info_issue_count",
            nullable = false
    )
    private int infoIssueCount;


    @Column(
            name = "assessed_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant assessedAt;


    @ElementCollection(
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY
    )
    @CollectionTable(
            name = "procurement_data_quality_issues",
            joinColumns = @JoinColumn(
                    name = "assessment_id"
            )
    )
    @OrderColumn(
            name = "position"
    )
    private List<DataQualityIssueValue> issues =
            new ArrayList<>();


    @Column(
            name = "created_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant createdAt;


    @Column(
            name = "updated_at",
            nullable = false
    )
    private Instant updatedAt;


    protected ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity() {
    }


    private ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {

        this.id = UUID.randomUUID();
        this.tender = tender;
    }


    public static ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity create(
            TenderEntity tender
    ) {

        return new ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity(
                tender
        );
    }


    public void apply(
            DataQualityEvaluation evaluation
    ) {

        this.score =
                evaluation.score();

        this.grade =
                evaluation.grade();

        this.issues.clear();

        this.issues.addAll(
                evaluation.issues()
        );

        this.criticalIssueCount =
                (int)
                        evaluation
                                .issues()
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        issue ->
                                                issue.getSeverity()
                                                        ==
                                                        DataQualitySeverity.CRITICAL
                                )
                                .count();

        this.warningIssueCount =
                (int)
                        evaluation
                                .issues()
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        issue ->
                                                issue.getSeverity()
                                                        ==
                                                        DataQualitySeverity.WARNING
                                )
                                .count();

        this.infoIssueCount =
                (int)
                        evaluation
                                .issues()
                                .stream()
                                .filter(
                                        issue ->
                                                issue.getSeverity()
                                                        ==
                                                        DataQualitySeverity.INFO
                                )
                                .count();

        this.assessedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }


    @PrePersist
    void beforeInsert() {

        Instant now =
                Instant.now();

        if (id == null) {
            id = UUID.randomUUID();
        }

        if (createdAt == null) {
            createdAt = now;
        }

        if (assessedAt == null) {
            assessedAt = now;
        }

        updatedAt = now;
    }


    @PreUpdate
    void beforeUpdate() {

        updatedAt =
                Instant.now();
    }


    public UUID getId() {
        return id;
    }


    public TenderEntity getTender() {
        return tender;
    }


    public int getScore() {
        return score;
    }


    public DataQualityGrade getGrade() {
        return grade;
    }


    public int getCriticalIssueCount() {
        return criticalIssueCount;
    }


    public int getWarningIssueCount() {
        return warningIssueCount;
    }


    public int getInfoIssueCount() {
        return infoIssueCount;
    }


    public int getIssueCount() {
        return criticalIssueCount
                +
                warningIssueCount
                +
                infoIssueCount;
    }


    public Instant getAssessedAt() {
        return assessedAt;
    }


    public List<DataQualityIssueValue> getIssues() {

        return List.copyOf(
                issues
        );
    }


    public Instant getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }


    public Instant getUpdatedAt() {
        return updatedAt;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/rag/application/BidRagChunker.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.rag.application;

import com.tenderpilot.rag.domain.BidRagChunk;

import com.tenderpilot.rag.infrastructure.RagSettings;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class BidRagChunker {

    private final RagSettings settings;


    public BidRagChunker(
            RagSettings settings
    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;
    }


    public List<BidRagChunk> chunk(
            String rawText
    ) {

        String text =
                normalize(
                        rawText
                );


        if (
                text.isBlank()
        ) {

            return List.of();
        }


        List<BidRagChunk> chunks =
                new ArrayList<>();


        int start =
                0;

        int index =
                0;


        while (
                start < text.length()
        ) {

            int desiredEnd =
                    Math.min(
                            text.length(),
                            start
                                    +
                                    settings.chunkSizeChars()
                    );


            int end =
                    chooseBoundary(
                            text,
                            start,
                            desiredEnd
                    );


            if (
                    end <= start
            ) {

                end =
                        desiredEnd;
            }


            String value =
                    text.substring(
                            start,
                            end
                    )
                            .trim();


            if (
                    !value.isBlank()
            ) {

                chunks.add(
                        new BidRagChunk(
                                index,
                                start,
                                end,
                                value
                        )
                );


                index++;
            }


            if (
                    end >= text.length()
            ) {

                break;
            }


            int nextStart =
                    end
                            -
                            settings.chunkOverlapChars();


            if (
                    nextStart <= start
            ) {

                nextStart =
                        start + 1;
            }


            start =
                    nextStart;
        }


        return List.copyOf(
                chunks
        );
    }


    private int chooseBoundary(
            String text,
            int start,
            int desiredEnd
    ) {

        if (
                desiredEnd >= text.length()
        ) {

            return text.length();
        }


        int minimum =
                start
                        +
                        settings.chunkSizeChars()
                        /
                        2;


        int paragraph =
                text.lastIndexOf(
                        "\n\n",
                        desiredEnd
                );


        if (
                paragraph >= minimum
        ) {

            return paragraph;
        }


        int sentence =
                Math.max(
                        text.lastIndexOf(
                                ". ",
                                desiredEnd
                        ),
                        text.lastIndexOf(
                                "\n",
                                desiredEnd
                        )
                );


        if (
                sentence >= minimum
        ) {

            return sentence + 1;
        }


        int whitespace =
                text.lastIndexOf(
                        ' ',
                        desiredEnd
                );


        if (
                whitespace >= minimum
        ) {

            return whitespace;
        }


        return desiredEnd;
    }


    private String normalize(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return "";
        }


        return value
                .replace(
                        "\r\n",
                        "\n"
                )
                .replace(
                        '\r',
                        '\n'
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "[\\t\\x0B\\f]+",
                        " "
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        " +",
                        " "
                )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\n{3,}",
                        "\n\n"
                )
                .trim();
    }

}

            BidDocumentTextExtractor textExtractor,

            OllamaRagGateway ollamaGateway,

    ) {
