package com.tenderpilot.search.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.domain.TenderAwardEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.award.infrastructure.TenderAwardRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.domain.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.quality.infrastructure.ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchDocument;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Component
public class ProcurementSearchDocumentBuilder {

    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final TenderAwardRepository
            awardRepository;


    private final ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository
            qualityRepository;


    public ProcurementSearchDocumentBuilder(

            TenderRepository tenderRepository,

            TenderAwardRepository awardRepository,

            ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentRepository qualityRepository

    ) {

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.awardRepository =
                awardRepository;

        this.qualityRepository =
                qualityRepository;

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public ProcurementSearchDocument build(
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        TenderEntity tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () ->
                                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                                "Tender was not found for search projection"
                                        )
                        );


        TenderAwardEntity award =
                awardRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        ProcurementDataQualityAssessmentEntity quality =
                qualityRepository
                        .findByTender_Id(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new ProcurementSearchDocument(

                tender.getId(),

                tender.getCanonicalKey(),

                tender.getTitle(),

                tender.getDescription(),

                tender
                        .getBuyer()
                        .getLegalName(),

                tender
                        .getBuyer()
                        .getCategory()
                        .name(),

                tender
                        .getStatus()
                        .name(),

                tender
                        .getProcedureType()
                        .name(),

                tender
                        .getContractNature()
                        .name(),

                tender.getPublicationDate()
                        ==
                        null
                        ? null
                        : tender
                                .getPublicationDate()
                                .toString(),

                tender.getSubmissionDeadline()
                        ==
                        null
                        ? null
                        : tender
                                .getSubmissionDeadline()
                                .toString(),

                tender.getEstimatedMinValue(),

                tender.getEstimatedMaxValue(),

                tender.getCurrency(),

                tender.getCountryCode(),

                tender.getPrimaryRegionCode(),

                tender.getPrimaryRegionName(),

                tender.isFrameworkAgreement(),

                tender.isJointProcurement(),

                tender.isElectronicSubmission(),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                cpv ->
                                        cpv.getCode()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getCpvs()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                cpv ->
                                        cpv.getLabel()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getSourceRecords()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                source ->
                                        source
                                                .getSource()
                                                .name()
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                tender
                        .getLots()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                lot ->
                                        lot.getTitle()
                        )
                        .filter(
                                value ->
                                        value != null
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList(),

                award == null
                        ? null
                        : award.getAwardedAmount(),

                award == null
                        ? null
                        : award.getCurrency(),

                award == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : award
                                .getSuppliers()
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        supplier ->
                                                supplier.getLegalName()
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        value ->
                                                value != null
                                )
                                .distinct()
                                .toList(),

                award == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : award
                                .getSuppliers()
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        supplier ->
                                                supplier.getIdentifier()
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        value ->
                                                value != null
                                )
                                .distinct()
                                .toList(),

                quality == null
                        ? null
                        : quality.getScore(),

                quality == null
                        ? null
                        : quality
                                .getGrade()
                                .name(),

                quality == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : quality
                                .getIssues()
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        issue ->
                                                issue
                                                        .getCode()
                                                        .name()
                                )
                                .distinct()
                                .toList()

        );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/search/application/ProcurementSearchService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.search.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.api.OpportunitySummaryResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.OpportunityQueryService;

import com.tenderpilot.search.api.ProcurementSearchResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchQuery;

import com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure.OpenSearchQueryBuilder;
import com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure.OpenSearchSettings;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class ProcurementSearchService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(
                    ProcurementSearchService.class
            );


    private final OpenSearchGateway
            gateway;


    private final OpenSearchSettings
            settings;


    private final OpenSearchQueryBuilder
            queryBuilder;


    private final OpportunityQueryService
            opportunityQueryService;


    public ProcurementSearchService(

            OpenSearchGateway gateway,

            OpenSearchSettings settings,

            OpenSearchQueryBuilder queryBuilder,

            OpportunityQueryService opportunityQueryService

    ) {

        this.gateway =
                gateway;

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.queryBuilder =
                queryBuilder;

        this.opportunityQueryService =
                opportunityQueryService;

    }


    public ProcurementSearchResponse search(
            ProcurementSearchQuery query
    ) {

        if (
                settings.enabled()
        ) {

            try {

                OpenSearchGateway.SearchPage page =
                        gateway.search(
                                query
                        );


                List<ProcurementSearchResponse.Hit> hits =
                        new ArrayList<>();


                for (
                        OpenSearchGateway.SearchMatch match :
                        page.matches()
                ) {

                    try {

                        hits.add(
                                new ProcurementSearchResponse
                                        .Hit(
                                                match.score(),
                                                opportunityQueryService
                                                        .summaryById(
                                                                match.tenderId()
                                                        )
                                        )
                        );

                    } catch (
                            ResourceNotFoundException staleProjection
                    ) {

                        log.warn(
                                "Ignoring stale OpenSearch document {}",
                                match.tenderId()
                        );

                    }

                }


                return new ProcurementSearchResponse(
                        "OPENSEARCH",
                        false,
                        page.total(),
                        List.copyOf(
                                hits
                        )
                );


            } catch (
                    RuntimeException exception
            ) {

                log.warn(
                        "OpenSearch query unavailable; using PostgreSQL fallback",
                        exception
                );

            }

        }


        return fallback(
                query
        );

    }


    private ProcurementSearchResponse fallback(
            ProcurementSearchQuery query
    ) {

        List<OpportunitySummaryResponse> candidates =
                opportunityQueryService
                        .list(
                                query.text(),
                                query.status(),
                                query.source(),
                                query.minimumQualityScore(),
                                query.qualityGrade()
                        );


        String country =
                clean(
                        query.countryCode()
                );


        String region =
                clean(
                        query.region()
                );


        int size =
                queryBuilder
                        .normalizedSize(
                                query.size()
                        );


        List<ProcurementSearchResponse.Hit> results =
                candidates
                        .stream()

                        .filter(
                                opportunity ->
                                        query.contractNature()
                                                ==
                                                null
                                        ||
                                        opportunity.contractNature()
                                                ==
                                                query.contractNature()
                        )

                        .filter(
                                opportunity ->
                                        country == null
                                        ||
                                        opportunity.countryCode()
                                                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                                        country
                                                )
                        )

                        .filter(
                                opportunity ->
                                        region == null
                                        ||
                                        (
                                                opportunity.primaryRegionName()
                                                        !=
                                                        null
                                                &&
                                                opportunity
                                                        .primaryRegionName()
                                                        .toLowerCase(
                                                                Locale.ROOT
                                                        )
                                                        .contains(
                                                                region
                                                                        .toLowerCase(
                                                                                Locale.ROOT
                                                                        )
                                                        )
                                        )
                        )

                        .limit(
                                size
                        )

                        .map(
                                opportunity ->
                                        new ProcurementSearchResponse
                                                .Hit(
                                                        null,
                                                        opportunity
                                                )
                        )

                        .toList();


        return new ProcurementSearchResponse(
                "POSTGRESQL_FALLBACK",
                true,
                results.size(),
                results
        );

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value.trim();


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/search/application/SearchProjectionService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.search.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchDocument;

import com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure.OpenSearchSettings;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class SearchProjectionService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(
                    SearchProjectionService.class
            );


    private final OpenSearchGateway
            gateway;


    private final OpenSearchSettings
            settings;


    private final TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private final ProcurementSearchDocumentBuilder
            documentBuilder;


    public SearchProjectionService(

            OpenSearchGateway gateway,

            OpenSearchSettings settings,

            TenderRepository tenderRepository,

            ProcurementSearchDocumentBuilder documentBuilder

    ) {

        this.gateway =
                gateway;

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.tenderRepository =
                tenderRepository;

        this.documentBuilder =
                documentBuilder;

    }


    public boolean indexAfterWrite(
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
                ||
                !settings.autoIndex()
        ) {
            return false;
        }


        return indexBestEffort(
                tenderId
        );

    }


    public boolean indexBestEffort(
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {
            return false;
        }


        try {

            gateway.ensureIndex();


            ProcurementSearchDocument document =
                    documentBuilder
                            .build(
                                    tenderId
                            );


            gateway.index(
                    document
            );


            return true;

        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            /*
             * PostgreSQL is authoritative.
             *
             * A search projection failure must never roll back
             * procurement ingestion.
             */
            log.warn(
                    "Unable to update OpenSearch projection for tender {}",
                    tenderId,
                    exception
            );


            return false;

        }

    }


    @Transactional(
            readOnly = true
    )
    public SearchReindexResult rebuild() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "OpenSearch projection is disabled"
            );

        }


        gateway.recreateIndex();


        List<TenderEntity> tenders =
                tenderRepository.findAll();


        int indexed =
                0;


        int failed =
                0;


        String lastError =
                null;


        for (
                TenderEntity tender :
                tenders
        ) {

            try {

                gateway.index(
                        documentBuilder
                                .build(
                                        tender.getId()
                                )
                );


                indexed++;

            } catch (
                    RuntimeException exception
            ) {

                failed++;

                lastError =
                        safeMessage(
                                exception
                        );

            }

        }


        return new SearchReindexResult(
                tenders.size(),
                indexed,
                failed,
                lastError
        );

    }


    private String safeMessage(
            Throwable throwable
    ) {

        String message =
                throwable.getMessage();


        return message == null
                ||
                message.isBlank()
                ? throwable
                        .getClass()
                        .getSimpleName()
                : message;

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/search/application/SearchStatusService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.search.application;

import com.tenderpilot.search.api.SearchProjectionStatusResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure.OpenSearchSettings;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class SearchStatusService {

    private final OpenSearchGateway
            gateway;


    private final OpenSearchSettings
            settings;


    public SearchStatusService(

            OpenSearchGateway gateway,

            OpenSearchSettings settings

    ) {

        this.gateway =
                gateway;

        this.settings =
                settings;

    }


    public SearchProjectionStatusResponse status() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {

            return new SearchProjectionStatusResponse(
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                    settings.indexName(),
                    0,
                    "POSTGRESQL",
                    "POSTGRESQL"
            );

        }


        try {

            boolean reachable =
                    gateway.isAvailable();


            if (
                    !reachable
            ) {

                return new SearchProjectionStatusResponse(
                        true,
                        false,
                        false,
                        settings.indexName(),
                        0,
                        "POSTGRESQL",
                        "POSTGRESQL"
                );

            }


            boolean exists =
                    gateway.indexExists();


            long count =
                    exists
                            ? gateway.count()
                            : 0;


            return new SearchProjectionStatusResponse(
                    true,
                    true,
                    exists,
                    settings.indexName(),
                    count,
                    "POSTGRESQL",
                    "POSTGRESQL"
            );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            return new SearchProjectionStatusResponse(
                    true,
                    false,
                    false,
                    settings.indexName(),
                    0,
                    "POSTGRESQL",
                    "POSTGRESQL"
            );

        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class OpenSearchIndexDefinition {

    public Map<String, Object> createIndexBody() {

        Map<String, Object> properties =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        properties.put(
                "id",
                field(
                        "keyword"
                )
        );

        properties.put(
                "canonicalKey",
                field(
                        "keyword"
                )
        );

        properties.put(
                "title",
                field(
                        "text"
                )
        );

        properties.put(
                "description",
                field(
                        "text"

package com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.search.application.OpenSearchGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchDocument;
import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchQuery;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientResponseException;

@Component
public class OpenSearchProcurementGateway
        implements OpenSearchGateway {

    private final OpenSearchSettings
            settings;


    private final OpenSearchIndexDefinition
            indexDefinition;


    private final OpenSearchQueryBuilder
            queryBuilder;


    private final RestClient
            restClient;


    public OpenSearchProcurementGateway(

            OpenSearchSettings settings,

            OpenSearchIndexDefinition indexDefinition,

            OpenSearchQueryBuilder queryBuilder

    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;

        this.indexDefinition =
                indexDefinition;

        this.queryBuilder =
                queryBuilder;

        this.restClient =
                RestClient
                        .builder()
                        .baseUrl(
                                settings.baseUrl()
                        )
                        .build();

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    public boolean isAvailable() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {
            return false;
        }


        try {

            Map response =
                    restClient
                            .get()
                            .uri("/")
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(
                                    Map.class
                            );


            return response != null;

        } catch (
                RestClientException exception
        ) {

            return false;

        }

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    public boolean indexExists() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {
            return false;
        }


        try {

            Map response =
                    restClient
                            .get()
                            .uri(
                                    "/{index}",
                                    settings.indexName()
                            )
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(
                                    Map.class
                            );


            return response != null;

        } catch (
                RestClientResponseException exception
        ) {

            if (
                    exception
                            .getStatusCode()
                            .value()
                            ==
                            404
            ) {
                return false;
            }


            throw exception;

        }

    }


    @Override
    public void ensureIndex() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {
            return;
        }


        if (
                indexExists()
        ) {
            return;
        }


        restClient
                .put()
                .uri(
                        "/{index}",
                        settings.indexName()
                )
                .body(
                        indexDefinition
                                .createIndexBody()
                )
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();

    }


    @Override
    public void recreateIndex() {

        if (
                !settings.enabled()
        ) {
            return;
        }


        try {

            restClient
                    .delete()
                    .uri(
                            "/{index}",
                            settings.indexName()
                    )
                    .retrieve()
                    .toBodilessEntity();

        } catch (
                RestClientResponseException exception
        ) {

            if (
                    exception
                            .getStatusCode()
                            .value()
                            !=
                            404
            ) {
                throw exception;
            }

        }


        restClient
                .put()
                .uri(
                        "/{index}",
                        settings.indexName()
                )
                .body(
                        indexDefinition
                                .createIndexBody()
                )
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();

    }


    @Override
    public void index(
            ProcurementSearchDocument document
    ) {

        restClient
                .put()
                .uri(
                        "/{index}/_doc/{id}",
                        settings.indexName(),
                        document
                                .id()
                                .toString()
                )
                .body(
                        document.toSource()
                )
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    public long count() {

        if (
                !indexExists()
        ) {
            return 0;
        }


        Map response =
                restClient
                        .get()
                        .uri(
                                "/{index}/_count",
                                settings.indexName()
                        )
                        .retrieve()
                        .body(
                                Map.class
                        );


        if (
                response == null
        ) {
            return 0;
        }


        Object count =
                response.get(
                        "count"
                );


        return count instanceof Number number
                ? number.longValue()
                : 0;

    }


    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    public SearchPage search(
            ProcurementSearchQuery query
    ) {

        ensureIndex();


        Map response =
                restClient
                        .post()
                        .uri(
                                "/{index}/_search",
                                settings.indexName()
                        )
                        .body(
                                queryBuilder
                                        .build(
                                                query
                                        )
                        )
                        .retrieve()
                        .body(
                                Map.class
                        );


        if (
                response == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "OpenSearch returned an empty search response"
            );

        }


        Object hitsValue =
                response.get(
                        "hits"
                );


        if (
                !(hitsValue instanceof Map hits)
        ) {

            return new SearchPage(
                    0,
                    List.of()
            );

        }


        long total =
                parseTotal(
                        hits.get(
                                "total"
                        )
                );


        Object rawMatches =
                hits.get(
                        "hits"
                );


        if (
                !(rawMatches instanceof List<?> list)
        ) {

            return new SearchPage(
                    total,
                    List.of()
            );

        }


        List<SearchMatch> matches =
                new ArrayList<>();


        for (
                Object raw :
                list
        ) {

            if (
                    !(raw instanceof Map hit)
            ) {
                continue;
            }


            Object idValue =
                    hit.get(
                            "_id"
                    );


            if (
                    idValue == null
            ) {
                continue;
            }


            UUID id;


            try {

                id =
                        UUID.fromString(
                                idValue.toString()
                        );

            } catch (
                    IllegalArgumentException exception
            ) {

                continue;

            }


            Object scoreValue =
                    hit.get(
                            "_score"
                    );


            double score =
                    scoreValue instanceof Number number
                            ? number.doubleValue()
                            : 0.0;


            matches.add(
                    new SearchMatch(
                            id,
                            score
                    )
            );

        }


        return new SearchPage(
                total,
                List.copyOf(
                        matches
                )
        );

    }


    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    private long parseTotal(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return number.longValue();

        }


        if (
                value instanceof Map map
        ) {

            Object nested =
                    map.get(
                            "value"
                    );


            if (
                    nested instanceof Number number
            ) {

                return number.longValue();

            }

        }


        return 0;

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.search.domain.ProcurementSearchQuery;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class OpenSearchQueryBuilder {

    private final OpenSearchSettings
            settings;


    public OpenSearchQueryBuilder(
            OpenSearchSettings settings
    ) {

        this.settings =
                settings;

    }


    public Map<String, Object> build(
            ProcurementSearchQuery query
    ) {

        int size =
                normalizedSize(
                        query.size()
                );


        List<Object> must =
                new ArrayList<>();


        List<Object> filters =
                new ArrayList<>();


        String text =
                clean(
                        query.text()
                );


        if (
                text == null
        ) {

            must.add(
                    Map.of(
                            "match_all",
                            Map.of()
                    )
            );

        } else {

            Map<String, Object> multiMatch =
                    new LinkedHashMap<>();

            multiMatch.put(
                    "query",
                    text
            );

            multiMatch.put(
                    "fields",
                    List.of(
                            "title^5",
                            "buyerName^4",
                            "cpvCodes^4",
                            "cpvLabels^3",
                            "description^2",
                            "supplierNames^2",
                            "lotTitles"
                    )
            );

            multiMatch.put(
                    "fuzziness",
                    "AUTO"
            );


            must.add(
                    Map.of(
                            "multi_match",
                            multiMatch
                    )
            );

        }


        if (
                query.status() != null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "status",
                            query.status()
                                    .name()
                    )
            );

        }


        if (
                query.source() != null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "sources",
                            query.source()
                                    .name()
                    )
            );

        }


        if (
                query.contractNature()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "contractNature",
                            query
                                    .contractNature()
                                    .name()
                    )
            );

        }


        String countryCode =
                clean(
                        query.countryCode()
                );


        if (
                countryCode != null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "countryCode",
                            countryCode
                                    .toUpperCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    )
                    )
            );

        }


        String region =
                clean(
                        query.region()
                );


        if (
                region != null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "regionName",
                            region
                    )
            );

        }


        if (
                query.minimumQualityScore()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            int quality =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            Math.min(
                                    100,
                                    query.minimumQualityScore()
                            )
                    );


            filters.add(
                    Map.of(
                            "range",
                            Map.of(
                                    "qualityScore",
                                    Map.of(
                                            "gte",
                                            quality
                                    )
                            )
                    )
            );

        }


        if (
                query.qualityGrade()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            filters.add(
                    term(
                            "qualityGrade",
                            query
                                    .qualityGrade()
                                    .name()
                    )
            );

        }


        Map<String, Object> bool =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        bool.put(
                "must",
                must
        );

        if (
                !filters.isEmpty()
        ) {

            bool.put(
                    "filter",
                    filters
            );

        }


        Map<String, Object> body =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        body.put(
                "size",
                size
        );

        body.put(
                "track_total_hits",
                true
        );

        body.put(
                "_source",
                false
        );

        body.put(
                "query",
                Map.of(
                        "bool",
                        bool
                )
        );


        List<Object> sort =
                new ArrayList<>();


        if (
                text != null
        ) {

            sort.add(
                    Map.of(
                            "_score",
                            Map.of(
                                    "order",
                                    "desc"
                            )
                    )
            );

        }


        sort.add(
                Map.of(
                        "publicationDate",
                        Map.of(
                                "order",
                                "desc",
                                "unmapped_type",
                                "date"
                        )
                )
        );


        body.put(
                "sort",
                sort
        );


        return body;

    }


    public int normalizedSize(
            Integer requested
    ) {

        if (
                requested == null
        ) {

            return Math.min(
                    settings.defaultSize(),
                    settings.maxSize()
            );

        }


        return Math.max(
                1,
                Math.min(
                        settings.maxSize(),
                        requested
                )
        );

    }


    private Map<String, Object> term(
            String field,
            Object value
    ) {

        return Map.of(
                "term",
                Map.of(
                        field,
                        value
                )
        );

    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {
            return null;
        }


        String cleaned =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/search/infrastructure/OpenSearchSettings.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.search.infrastructure;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class OpenSearchSettings {

    private final boolean enabled;

    private final boolean autoIndex;

    private final String baseUrl;

    private final String indexName;

    private final int defaultSize;

    private final int maxSize;


    public OpenSearchSettings(

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.enabled:true}"
            )
            boolean enabled,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.auto-index:true}"
            )
            boolean autoIndex,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.base-url:http://localhost:9200}"
            )
            String baseUrl,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.index-name:tenderpilot-opportunities-v1}"
            )
            String indexName,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.default-size:25}"
            )
            int defaultSize,

            @Value(
                    "${tenderpilot.search.max-size:100}"
            )
            int maxSize

    ) {

        this.enabled =
                enabled;

        this.autoIndex =
                autoIndex;

        this.baseUrl =
                removeTrailingSlash(
                        baseUrl
                );

        this.indexName =
                normalizeIndexName(
                        indexName
                );

        this.defaultSize =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        defaultSize
                );

        this.maxSize =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                maxSize
                        )
                );

    }


    private String removeTrailingSlash(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                value.trim();


        while (
                result.endsWith("/")
        ) {

            result =
                    result.substring(
                            0,
                            result.length() - 1
                    );

        }


        return result;

    }


    private String normalizeIndexName(
            String value
    ) {

        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();


        if (
                !result.matches(
                        "[a-z0-9._-]+"
                )
                ||
                result.startsWith("_")
                ||
                result.startsWith("-")
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid OpenSearch procurement index name"
            );

        }


        return result;

    }


    public boolean enabled() {
        return enabled;
    }


    public boolean autoIndex() {
        return autoIndex;
    }


    public String baseUrl() {
        return baseUrl;
    }


    public String indexName() {
        return indexName;
    }


    public int defaultSize() {
        return defaultSize;
    }


    public int maxSize() {
        return maxSize;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/security/SecurityConfiguration.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.security;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.config.Customizer;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.factory.PasswordEncoderFactories;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jose.jws.MacAlgorithm;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtValidators;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.NimbusJwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.NimbusJwtEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

@Configuration
@EnableMethodSecurity
public class SecurityConfiguration {

    @Bean
    PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {

        return PasswordEncoderFactories
                .createDelegatingPasswordEncoder();

    }


    @Bean
    SecretKey accessTokenSecretKey(
            SecurityProperties properties
    ) {

        byte[] secretBytes =
                properties
                        .accessTokenSecret()
                        .getBytes(
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        );


        if (
                secretBytes.length < 32
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET must contain at least 32 UTF-8 bytes"
            );

        }


        return new SecretKeySpec(
                secretBytes,
                "HmacSHA256"
        );

    }


    @Bean
    JwtEncoder jwtEncoder(
            SecretKey accessTokenSecretKey
    ) {

        return NimbusJwtEncoder
                .withSecretKey(
                        accessTokenSecretKey
                )
                .algorithm(
                        MacAlgorithm.HS256
                )
                .build();

    }


    @Bean
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(

            SecretKey accessTokenSecretKey,

            SecurityProperties properties

    ) {

        NimbusJwtDecoder decoder =

                NimbusJwtDecoder
                        .withSecretKey(
                                accessTokenSecretKey
                        )
                        .macAlgorithm(
                                MacAlgorithm.HS256
                        )
                        .build();


        decoder.setJwtValidator(

                JwtValidators
                        .createDefaultWithIssuer(
                                properties.issuer()
                        )

        );


        return decoder;

    }


    @Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(

            HttpSecurity http,

            JwtDecoder jwtDecoder

    ) throws Exception {

        http

                .csrf(
                        csrf ->
                                csrf.disable()
                )

                .cors(
                        Customizer.withDefaults()
                )

                .sessionManagement(
                        session ->
                                session.sessionCreationPolicy(
                                        SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS
                                )
                )

                .authorizeHttpRequests(
                        authorization ->
                                authorization

                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.OPTIONS,
                                                "/**"
                                        )
                                        .permitAll()

                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                "/actuator/health"
                                        )
                                        .permitAll()

                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                "/api/v1/system/**"
                                        )
                                        .permitAll()

                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.POST,
                                                "/api/v1/auth/register",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/login",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/refresh",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/logout"
                                        )
                                        .permitAll()

                                        .anyRequest()
                                        .authenticated()
                )

                .oauth2ResourceServer(
                        resourceServer ->
                                resourceServer.jwt(
                                        jwt ->
                                                jwt
                                                        .decoder(
                                                                jwtDecoder
                                                        )
                                                        .jwtAuthenticationConverter(
                                                                jwtAuthenticationConverter()
                                                        )
                                )
                );


        return http.build();

    }


    private Converter<
            Jwt,
            ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken
            > jwtAuthenticationConverter() {

        return jwt -> {

            String role =
                    jwt.getClaimAsString(
                            "role"
                    );


            List<GrantedAuthority> authorities =

                    role == null
                            || role.isBlank()

                            ? List.of()

                            : List.of(
                                    new SimpleGrantedAuthority(
                                            "ROLE_" + role
                                    )
                            );


            String principalName =
                    jwt.getClaimAsString(
                            "email"
                    );


            if (
                    principalName == null
                    || principalName.isBlank()
            ) {

                principalName =
                        jwt.getSubject();

            }


            return new JwtAuthenticationToken(

                    jwt,

                    authorities,

                    principalName

            );

        };

    }

}

import java.time.Duration;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;

@ConfigurationProperties(
        prefix = "tenderpilot.security"
)
public record SecurityProperties(

        String issuer,

        String accessTokenSecret,

        Duration accessTokenTtl,

        Duration refreshTokenTtl,

        String refreshCookieName,

        boolean refreshCookieSecure

) {
}
