===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/supplierintelligence/application/SupplierIntelligenceService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.api.SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.api.SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierAwardObservation;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierAwardParty;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierLandscapeMetrics;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierTenderCpv;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class SupplierIntelligenceService {

    private static final String VALUE_INTERPRETATION =
            "Award values are public contract values associated with this supplier. "
                    +
                    "When an award contains multiple suppliers, TenderPilot does not assume "
                    +
                    "that the full contract value represents revenue attributable to one supplier.";


    private static final String LANDSCAPE_INTERPRETATION =
            "Competitive-landscape signals describe observed public award relationships only. "
                    +
                    "They do not identify unsuccessful bidders or prove who competed for an award "
                    +
                    "unless the underlying public source explicitly provides that information.";


    private final SupplierObservationGateway
            observationGateway;


    private final SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer
            landscapeAnalyzer;


    private final SupplierKeyCodec
            keyCodec;


    public SupplierIntelligenceService(
            SupplierObservationGateway observationGateway,
            SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer landscapeAnalyzer,
            SupplierKeyCodec keyCodec
    ) {

        this.observationGateway =
                observationGateway;

        this.landscapeAnalyzer =
                landscapeAnalyzer;

        this.keyCodec =
                keyCodec;
    }


    public List<SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse> search(
            String query,
            String buyerCountry,
            Integer limit
    ) {

        int resolvedLimit =
                limit == null
                        ? 50
                        : Math.max(
                                1,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        limit
                                )
                        );


        List<String> names =
                observationGateway
                        .searchSupplierNames(
                                query,
                                buyerCountry,
                                resolvedLimit
                        );


        Map<String, SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse> unique =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                String name :
                names
        ) {

            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations =
                    observationGateway
                            .observationsBySupplier(
                                    name
                            );


            if (
                    observations.isEmpty()
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse summary =
                    summary(
                            name,
                            observations
                    );


            unique.putIfAbsent(
                    summary.supplierKey(),
                    summary
            );
        }


        return unique
                .values()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse::awardCount
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse::name,
                                        String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                                )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    public SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse detail(
            String supplierKey
    ) {

        String supplierName =
                keyCodec
                        .decode(
                                supplierKey
                        );


        List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations =
                observationGateway
                        .observationsBySupplier(
                                supplierName
                        );


        if (
                observations.isEmpty()
        ) {

            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Supplier was not found in the public award corpus"
            );
        }


        List<UUID> tenderIds =
                observations
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                SupplierAwardObservation::tenderId
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList();


        List<UUID> awardIds =
                observations
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                SupplierAwardObservation::awardId
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList();


        List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvs =
                observationGateway
                        .cpvsForTenders(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        List<SupplierAwardParty> parties =
                observationGateway
                        .suppliersForAwards(
                                awardIds
                        );


        Map<UUID, Integer> supplierCountsByAward =
                supplierCountsByAward(
                        parties
                );


        return new SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse(
                summary(
                        supplierName,
                        observations,
                        cpvs
                ),

                VALUE_INTERPRETATION,

                LANDSCAPE_INTERPRETATION,

                topBuyers(
                        observations
                ),

                topCpvs(
                        cpvs
                ),

                coAwardSuppliers(
                        supplierName,
                        awardIds.size(),
                        parties
                ),

                recentAwards(
                        observations,
                        supplierCountsByAward
                )
        );
    }


    private SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse summary(
            String supplierName,
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations
    ) {

        List<UUID> tenderIds =
                observations
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                SupplierAwardObservation::tenderId
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .distinct()
                        .toList();


        List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvs =
                observationGateway
                        .cpvsForTenders(
                                tenderIds
                        );


        return summary(
                supplierName,
                observations,
                cpvs
        );
    }


    private SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse summary(
            String supplierName,
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations,
            List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvs
    ) {

        List<SupplierAwardObservation> uniqueAwards =
                uniqueAwards(
                        observations
                );


        Map<String, Integer> buyerCounts =
                buyerAwardCounts(
                        uniqueAwards
                );


        Map<String, Integer> cpvCounts =
                counts(
                        cpvs
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        SupplierTenderCpv::code
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        SupplierLandscapeMetrics landscape =
                landscapeAnalyzer
                        .analyze(
                                uniqueAwards.size(),
                                buyerCounts,
                                cpvCounts
                        );


        Set<UUID> buyers =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        Set<String> countries =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardObservation observation :
                uniqueAwards
        ) {

            if (
                    observation.buyerId()
                            !=
                            null
            ) {

                buyers.add(
                        observation.buyerId()
                );
            }


            if (
                    observation.buyerCountryCode()
                            !=
                            null
            ) {

                countries.add(
                        observation
                                .buyerCountryCode()
                                .toUpperCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                )
                );
            }
        }


        CurrencyAggregate values =
                awardValues(
                        uniqueAwards
                );


        LocalDate lastPublication =
                uniqueAwards
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                SupplierAwardObservation::publicationDate
                        )
                        .filter(
                                java.util.Objects::nonNull
                        )
                        .max(
                                Comparator.naturalOrder()
                        )
                        .orElse(
                                null
                        );


        return new SupplierIntelligenceSummaryResponse(
                keyCodec
                        .encode(
                                supplierName
                        ),

                supplierName,

                uniqueAwards.size(),

                buyers.size(),

                countries.size(),

                values.total(),

                values.average(),

                values.currency(),

                lastPublication,

                landscape.topBuyerSharePercentage(),

                landscape.buyerHhi(),

                landscape.buyerConcentration(),

                landscape.repeatBuyerSignal(),

                landscape.topCpvSharePercentage(),

                landscape.cpvSpecialization()
        );
    }


    private List<SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse.BuyerInsight>
    topBuyers(
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations
    ) {

        List<SupplierAwardObservation> uniqueAwards =
                uniqueAwards(
                        observations
                );


        Map<String, BuyerAccumulator> buyers =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardObservation observation :
                uniqueAwards
        ) {

            String key =
                    observation.buyerId() != null
                            ? observation
                                    .buyerId()
                                    .toString()
                            : normalized(
                                    observation.buyerName()
                            );


            if (
                    key == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            BuyerAccumulator current =
                    buyers.computeIfAbsent(
                            key,
                            ignored ->
                                    new BuyerAccumulator(
                                            observation.buyerId(),
                                            observation.buyerName(),
                                            observation.buyerCountryCode(),
                                            observation.buyerCity()
                                    )
                    );


            current.awardCount++;
        }


        int total =
                uniqueAwards.size();


        return buyers
                .values()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        BuyerAccumulator::awardCount
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        BuyerAccumulator::name,
                                        Comparator.nullsLast(
                                                String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .limit(
                        10
                )
                .map(
                        buyer ->
                                new SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .BuyerInsight(
                                                buyer.id,
                                                buyer.name,
                                                buyer.countryCode,
                                                buyer.city,
                                                buyer.awardCount,
                                                percentage(
                                                        buyer.awardCount,
                                                        total
                                                )
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private List<SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse.CpvInsight>
    topCpvs(
            List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvs
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> counts =
                counts(
                        cpvs
                                .stream()
                                .map(
                                        SupplierTenderCpv::code
                                )
                                .filter(
                                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                                )
                                .toList()
                );


        Map<String, String> descriptions =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierTenderCpv cpv :
                cpvs
        ) {

            if (
                    cpv.code() != null
                    &&
                    cpv.description() != null
            ) {

                descriptions.putIfAbsent(
                        cpv.code(),
                        cpv.description()
                );
            }
        }


        int total =
                counts
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        return counts
                .entrySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Map.Entry
                                .<String, Integer>comparingByValue()
                                .reversed()
                )
                .limit(
                        10
                )
                .map(
                        entry ->
                                new SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .CpvInsight(
                                                entry.getKey(),

                                                descriptions.get(
                                                        entry.getKey()
                                                ),

                                                entry.getValue(),

                                                percentage(
                                                        entry.getValue(),
                                                        total
                                                )
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private List<SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse.CoAwardSupplierInsight>
    coAwardSuppliers(
            String supplierName,
            int supplierAwardCount,
            List<SupplierAwardParty> parties
    ) {

        Map<String, CoAwardAccumulator> counts =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardParty party :
                parties
        ) {

            if (
                    party.supplierName() == null
                    ||
                    party.supplierName()
                            .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                    supplierName
                            )
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            String normalizedName =
                    normalized(
                            party.supplierName()
                    );


            if (
                    normalizedName == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            CoAwardAccumulator current =
                    counts.computeIfAbsent(
                            normalizedName,

                            ignored ->
                                    new CoAwardAccumulator(
                                            party.supplierName()
                                    )
                    );


            current.awardIds.add(
                    party.awardId()
            );
        }


        return counts
                .values()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        CoAwardAccumulator::sharedAwardCount
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        CoAwardAccumulator::name,
                                        String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                                )
                )
                .limit(
                        12
                )
                .map(
                        item ->
                                new SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .CoAwardSupplierInsight(
                                                keyCodec
                                                        .encode(
                                                                item.name
                                                        ),

                                                item.name,

                                                item.sharedAwardCount(),

                                                percentage(
                                                        item.sharedAwardCount(),
                                                        supplierAwardCount
                                                )
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private List<SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse.RecentAward>
    recentAwards(
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations,
            Map<UUID, Integer> supplierCountsByAward
    ) {

        return uniqueAwards(
                observations
        )
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparing(
                                        SupplierAwardObservation::publicationDate,
                                        Comparator.nullsLast(
                                                Comparator.reverseOrder()
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .limit(
                        15
                )
                .map(
                        observation ->
                                new SupplierIntelligenceDetailResponse
                                        .RecentAward(
                                                observation.awardId(),

                                                observation.tenderId(),

                                                observation.tenderTitle(),

                                                observation.tenderStatus(),

                                                observation.buyerId(),

                                                observation.buyerName(),

                                                observation.buyerCountryCode(),

                                                observation.buyerCity(),

                                                observation.publicationDate(),

                                                observation.awardedAmount(),

                                                observation.awardCurrency(),

                                                supplierCountsByAward
                                                        .getOrDefault(
                                                                observation.awardId(),
                                                                1
                                                        )
                                                        >
                                                        1
                                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private Map<UUID, Integer> supplierCountsByAward(
            List<SupplierAwardParty> parties
    ) {

        Map<UUID, Set<String>> names =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardParty party :
                parties
        ) {

            if (
                    party.awardId() == null
                    ||
                    party.supplierName() == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            names
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            party.awardId(),
                            ignored ->
                                    new LinkedHashSet<>()
                    )
                    .add(
                            normalized(
                                    party.supplierName()
                            )
                    );
        }


        Map<UUID, Integer> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                Map.Entry<UUID, Set<String>> entry :
                names.entrySet()
        ) {

            result.put(
                    entry.getKey(),
                    entry.getValue().size()
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private List<SupplierAwardObservation> uniqueAwards(
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations
    ) {

        Map<String, SupplierAwardObservation> unique =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardObservation observation :
                observations
        ) {

            String key =
                    observation.awardId() != null
                            ? "A:"
                                    +
                                    observation.awardId()
                            : "T:"
                                    +
                                    observation.tenderId();


            unique.putIfAbsent(
                    key,
                    observation
            );
        }


        return List.copyOf(
                unique.values()
        );
    }


    private Map<String, Integer> buyerAwardCounts(
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardObservation observation :
                observations
        ) {

            String key =
                    observation.buyerId() != null
                            ? observation
                                    .buyerId()
                                    .toString()
                            : normalized(
                                    observation.buyerName()
                            );


            if (
                    key == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            result.merge(
                    key,
                    1,
                    Integer::sum
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private Map<String, Integer> counts(
            List<String> values
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                String value :
                values
        ) {

            String normalized =
                    normalized(
                            value
                    );


            if (
                    normalized == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            result.merge(
                    normalized,
                    1,
                    Integer::sum
            );
        }


        return result;
    }


    private CurrencyAggregate awardValues(
            List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations
    ) {

        Map<String, List<BigDecimal>> byCurrency =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        for (
                SupplierAwardObservation observation :
                observations
        ) {

            if (
                    observation.awardedAmount() == null
                    ||
                    observation.awardCurrency() == null
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            String currency =
                    observation
                            .awardCurrency()
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase(
                                    Locale.ROOT
                            );


            if (
                    currency.isBlank()
            ) {

                continue;
            }


            byCurrency
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            currency,
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(
                            observation.awardedAmount()
                    );
        }


        if (
                byCurrency.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return new CurrencyAggregate(
                    null,
                    null,
                    null
            );
        }


        if (
                byCurrency.size() > 1
        ) {

            return new CurrencyAggregate(
                    null,
                    null,
                    "MIXED"
            );
        }


        Map.Entry<String, List<BigDecimal>> entry =
                byCurrency
                        .entrySet()
                        .iterator()
                        .next();


        BigDecimal total =
                entry
                        .getValue()
                        .stream()
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );


        BigDecimal average =
                total.divide(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                entry.getValue().size()
                        ),
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );


        return new CurrencyAggregate(
                total,
                average,
                entry.getKey()
        );
    }


    private String normalized(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        )
                        .toLowerCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private int percentage(
            int numerator,
            int denominator
    ) {

        if (
                denominator <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        numerator
                                *
                                100.0
                                /
                                denominator
                );
    }


    private record CurrencyAggregate(

            BigDecimal total,

            BigDecimal average,

            String currency

    ) {
    }


    private static final class BuyerAccumulator {

        private final UUID id;

        private final String name;

        private final String countryCode;

        private final String city;

        private int awardCount;


        private BuyerAccumulator(
                UUID id,
                String name,
                String countryCode,
                String city
        ) {

            this.id =
                    id;

            this.name =
                    name;

            this.countryCode =
                    countryCode;

            this.city =
                    city;
        }


        private int awardCount() {

            return awardCount;
        }


        private String name() {

            return name;
        }

    }


    private static final class CoAwardAccumulator {

        private final String name;

        private final Set<UUID> awardIds =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();


        private CoAwardAccumulator(
                String name
        ) {

            this.name =
                    name;
        }


        private int sharedAwardCount() {

            return awardIds.size();
        }


        private String name() {

            return name;
        }

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/supplierintelligence/application/SupplierKeyCodec.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.util.Base64;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class SupplierKeyCodec {

    public String encode(
            String supplierName
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalize(
                        supplierName
                );


        if (
                normalized == null
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Supplier name is required"
            );
        }


        return Base64
                .getUrlEncoder()
                .withoutPadding()
                .encodeToString(
                        normalized
                                .getBytes(
                                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                )
                );
    }


    public String decode(
            String supplierKey
    ) {

        if (
                supplierKey == null
                ||
                supplierKey.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Supplier key is required"
            );
        }


        try {

            String decoded =
                    new String(
                            Base64
                                    .getUrlDecoder()
                                    .decode(
                                            supplierKey
                                    ),

                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    );


            String normalized =
                    normalize(
                            decoded
                    );


            if (
                    normalized == null
            ) {

                throw new InvalidRequestException(
                        "Supplier key is invalid"
                );
            }


            return normalized;


        } catch (
                IllegalArgumentException exception
        ) {

            throw new InvalidRequestException(
                    "Supplier key is invalid"
            );
        }
    }


    private String normalize(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .trim()
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        );


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/supplierintelligence/application/SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.BuyerConcentration;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.CpvSpecialization;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierLandscapeMetrics;

import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer {

    public SupplierLandscapeMetrics analyze(
            int awardCount,
            Map<String, Integer> buyerAwardCounts,
            Map<String, Integer> cpvCounts
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> safeBuyers =
                buyerAwardCounts == null
                        ? Map.of()
                        : buyerAwardCounts;


        Map<String, Integer> safeCpvs =
                cpvCounts == null
                        ? Map.of()
                        : cpvCounts;


        int buyerTotal =
                safeBuyers
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        int topBuyerCount =
                safeBuyers
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .max()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        int topBuyerShare =
                percentage(
                        topBuyerCount,
                        buyerTotal
                );


        int buyerHhi =
                hhi(
                        safeBuyers
                );


        BuyerConcentration buyerConcentration =
                buyerConcentration(
                        safeBuyers.size(),
                        buyerHhi
                );


        int cpvTotal =
                safeCpvs
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        int topCpvCount =
                safeCpvs
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .max()
                        .orElse(
                                0
                        );


        int topCpvShare =
                percentage(
                        topCpvCount,
                        cpvTotal
                );


        CpvSpecialization specialization =
                cpvSpecialization(
                        cpvTotal,
                        topCpvShare
                );


        boolean repeatBuyer =
                awardCount >= 3
                &&
                topBuyerShare >= 50;


        return new SupplierLandscapeMetrics(
                topBuyerShare,
                buyerHhi,
                buyerConcentration,
                topCpvShare,
                specialization,
                repeatBuyer
        );
    }


    private BuyerConcentration buyerConcentration(
            int buyerCount,
            int hhi
    ) {

        if (
                buyerCount <= 0
        ) {

            return BuyerConcentration.UNKNOWN;
        }


        if (
                buyerCount >= 4
                &&
                hhi < 2500
        ) {

            return BuyerConcentration.DIVERSIFIED;
        }


        if (
                hhi < 5000
        ) {

            return BuyerConcentration.MODERATE;
        }


        return BuyerConcentration.CONCENTRATED;
    }


    private CpvSpecialization cpvSpecialization(
            int total,
            int topShare
    ) {

        if (
                total <= 0
        ) {

            return CpvSpecialization.UNKNOWN;
        }


        if (
                topShare >= 70
        ) {

            return CpvSpecialization.SPECIALIZED;
        }


        if (
                topShare >= 50
        ) {

            return CpvSpecialization.FOCUSED;
        }


        return CpvSpecialization.BROAD;
    }


    private int percentage(
            int numerator,
            int denominator
    ) {

        if (
                denominator <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        numerator
                                *
                                100.0
                                /
                                denominator
                );
    }


    private int hhi(
            Map<String, Integer> counts
    ) {

        int total =
                counts
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                Integer::intValue
                        )
                        .sum();


        if (
                total <= 0
        ) {

            return 0;
        }


        double result =
                0;


        for (
                Integer count :
                counts.values()
        ) {

            double share =
                    count
                            /
                            (double)
                                    total;


            result +=
                    share
                            *
                            share;
        }


        return (int)
                Math.round(
                        result
                                *
                                10000
                );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.infrastructure;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.infrastructure.ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application.SupplierObservationGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierAwardObservation;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierAwardParty;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.SupplierTenderCpv;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.sql.Date;
import java.sql.Timestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class CanonicalSupplierObservationGateway
        implements SupplierObservationGateway {

    private final JdbcTemplate
            jdbcTemplate;


    private final ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector
            schemaInspector;


    public CanonicalSupplierObservationGateway(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate,
            ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector schemaInspector
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;

        this.schemaInspector =
                schemaInspector;
    }


    @Override
    public List<String> searchSupplierNames(
            String query,
            String buyerCountry,
            int limit
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        if (
                !schema.suppliersAvailable()
        ) {

            return List.of();
        }


        StringBuilder sql =
                new StringBuilder();


        sql.append(
                "select distinct "
        )
                .append(
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierName()
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " as supplier_name "
                )
                .append(
                        joins(
                                schema
                        )
                )
                .append(
                        " where 1 = 1"
                );


        List<Object> args =
                new ArrayList<>();


        String cleanQuery =
                clean(
                        query
                );


        if (
                cleanQuery != null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and lower("
            )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "s",
                                    schema.supplierName()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") like lower(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    "%"
                            +
                            cleanQuery
                            +
                            "%"
            );
        }


        String country =
                clean(
                        buyerCountry
                );


        if (
                country != null
                &&
                schema.buyerCountry()
                        !=
                        null
        ) {

            sql.append(
                    " and upper("
            )
                    .append(
                            column(
                                    "b",
                                    schema.buyerCountry()
                            )
                    )
                    .append(
                            ") = upper(?)"
                    );


            args.add(
                    country
            );
        }


        sql.append(
                " order by supplier_name asc limit ?"
        );


        args.add(
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.min(
                                100,
                                limit
                        )
                )
        );


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql.toString(),
                        args.toArray()
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        row ->
                                string(
                                        row.get(
                                                "supplier_name"
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .filter(
                        java.util.Objects::nonNull
                )
                .toList();
    }


    @Override
    public List<SupplierAwardObservation> observationsBySupplier(
            String supplierName
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        if (
                !schema.suppliersAvailable()
        ) {

            return List.of();
        }


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierName()
                        )
                        +
                        " as supplier_name, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "a",
                                schema.awardId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as award_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                schema.tenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "b",
                                schema.buyerId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as buyer_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "b",
                                schema.buyerName()
                        )
                        +
                        " as buyer_name, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "b",
                                schema.buyerCountry(),
                                "buyer_country"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "b",
                                schema.buyerCity(),
                                "buyer_city"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        column(
                                "t",
                                schema.tenderTitle()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_title, "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "t",
                                schema.tenderStatus(),
                                "tender_status"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "t",
                                schema.tenderPublicationDate(),
                                "publication_date"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "a",
                                schema.awardAmount(),
                                "awarded_amount"
                        )
                        +
                        ", "
                        +
                        projection(
                                "a",
                                schema.awardCurrency(),
                                "award_currency"
                        )
                        +
                        " "
                        +
                        joins(
                                schema
                        )
                        +
                        " where lower("
                        +
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierName()
                        )
                        +
                        ") = lower(?)";


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql,
                        supplierName
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        this::observation
                )
                .toList();
    }


    @Override
    public List<SupplierAwardParty> suppliersForAwards(
            Collection<UUID> awardIds
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        if (
                !schema.suppliersAvailable()
                ||
                awardIds == null
                ||
                awardIds.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return List.of();
        }


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierAwardId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as award_id, "
                        +
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierName()
                        )
                        +
                        " as supplier_name "
                        +
                        "from "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.supplierTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " s "
                        +
                        "where "
                        +
                        column(
                                "s",
                                schema.supplierAwardId()
                        )
                        +
                        " in ("
                        +
                        placeholders(
                                awardIds.size()
                        )
                        +
                        ")";


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql,
                        awardIds.toArray()
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        row ->
                                new SupplierAwardParty(
                                        uuid(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "award_id"
                                                )
                                        ),

                                        string(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "supplier_name"
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .filter(
                        party ->
                                party.awardId() != null
                                &&
                                party.supplierName() != null
                )
                .toList();
    }


    @Override
    public List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvsForTenders(
            Collection<UUID> tenderIds
    ) {

        var schema =
                schemaInspector.schema();


        if (
                !schema.cpvAvailable()
                ||
                tenderIds == null
                ||
                tenderIds.isEmpty()
        ) {

            return List.of();
        }


        String sql =
                "select "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.cpvTenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " as tender_id, "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.cpvCode()
                        )
                        +
                        " as cpv_code, "
                        +
                        plainProjection(
                                schema.cpvDescription(),
                                "cpv_description"
                        )
                        +
                        " from "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.cpvTable()
                        )
                        +
                        " where "
                        +
                        q(
                                schema.cpvTenderId()
                        )
                        +
                        " in ("
                        +
                        placeholders(
                                tenderIds.size()
                        )
                        +
                        ")";


        return jdbcTemplate
                .queryForList(
                        sql,
                        tenderIds.toArray()
                )
                .stream()
                .map(
                        row ->
                                new SupplierTenderCpv(
                                        uuid(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "tender_id"
                                                )
                                        ),

                                        string(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "cpv_code"
                                                )
                                        ),

                                        string(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "cpv_description"
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .toList();
    }


    private String joins(
            ProcurementAnalyticsSchemaInspector.Schema schema
    ) {

        return "from "
                +
                q(
                        schema.supplierTable()
                )
                +
                " s "
                +
                "join "
                +
                q(
                        schema.awardTable()
                )
                +
                " a on "
                +
                column(
                        "s",
                        schema.supplierAwardId()
                )
                +
                " = "
                +
                column(
                        "a",
                        schema.awardId()
                )
                +
                " join "
                +
                q(
                        schema.tenderTable()
                )
                +
                " t on "
                +
                column(
                        "a",
                        schema.awardTenderId()
                )
                +
                " = "
                +
                column(
                        "t",
                        schema.tenderId()
                )
                +
                " join "
                +
                q(
                        schema.buyerTable()
                )
                +
                " b on "
                +
                column(
                        "t",
                        schema.tenderBuyerId()
                )
                +
                " = "
                +
                column(
                        "b",
                        schema.buyerId()
                );
    }


    private SupplierAwardObservation observation(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {

        return new SupplierAwardObservation(
                string(
                        row.get(
                                "supplier_name"
                        )
                ),

                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "award_id"
                        )
                ),

                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_id"
                        )
                ),

                uuid(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_id"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_name"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_country"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "buyer_city"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_title"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "tender_status"
                        )
                ),

                date(
                        row.get(
                                "publication_date"
                        )
                ),

                decimal(
                        row.get(
                                "awarded_amount"
                        )
                ),

                string(
                        row.get(
                                "award_currency"
                        )
                )
        );
    }


    private String projection(
            String tableAlias,
            String column,
            String alias
    ) {

        return column == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : column(
                        tableAlias,
                        column
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String plainProjection(
            String column,
            String alias
    ) {

        return column == null
                ? "null as "
                        +
                        alias
                : q(
                        column
                )
                        +
                        " as "
                        +
                        alias;
    }


    private String column(
            String tableAlias,
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                tableAlias == null
                ||
                !tableAlias.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid table alias"
            );
        }


        return tableAlias
                +
                "."
                +
                q(
                        identifier
                );
    }


    private String q(
            String identifier
    ) {

        if (
                identifier == null
                ||
                !identifier.matches(
                        "[A-Za-z0-9_]+"
                )
        ) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid database identifier"
            );
        }


        return "\""
                +
                identifier
                +
                "\"";
    }


    private String placeholders(
            int count
    ) {

        return String.join(
                ",",
                Collections.nCopies(
                        count,
                        "?"
                )
        );
    }


    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value.trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private String string(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        String result =
                value
                        .toString()
                        .trim();


        return result.isBlank()
                ? null
                : result;
    }


    private UUID uuid(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof UUID uuid
        ) {

            return uuid;
        }


        return UUID.fromString(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private BigDecimal decimal(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof BigDecimal decimal
        ) {

            return decimal;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Number number
        ) {

            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }


        return new BigDecimal(
                value.toString()
        );
    }


    private LocalDate date(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
        ) {

            return null;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDate localDate
        ) {

            return localDate;
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Date date
        ) {

            return date.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Timestamp timestamp
        ) {

            return timestamp
                    .toLocalDateTime()
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime
        ) {

            return dateTime.toLocalDate();
        }


        if (
                value instanceof Instant instant
        ) {

            return instant
                    .atOffset(
                            ZoneOffset.UTC
                    )
                    .toLocalDate();
        }


        String raw =
                value.toString();


        if (
                raw.length() >= 10
        ) {

            return LocalDate.parse(
                    raw.substring(
                            0,
                            10
                    )
            );
        }


        return null;
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.system.api;

import com.tenderpilot.system.application.SystemStatusService;
import com.tenderpilot.system.domain.SystemStatus;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(
        "/api/v1/system"
)
public class SystemStatusController {

    private final SystemStatusService

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/system/application/SystemStatusService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.system.application;

import com.tenderpilot.config.AppProperties;
import com.tenderpilot.config.IntegrationProperties;
import com.tenderpilot.system.domain.DependencyStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.system.domain.SystemStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.system.infrastructure.FoundationRepository;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class SystemStatusService {

    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    private final IntegrationProperties
            integrationProperties;

    private final FoundationRepository
            foundationRepository;

    private final HttpClient httpClient;

    private final Environment environment;


    public SystemStatusService(

            AppProperties appProperties,

            IntegrationProperties
                    integrationProperties,

            FoundationRepository
                    foundationRepository,

            HttpClient httpClient,

            Environment environment

    ) {

        this.appProperties =
                appProperties;

        this.integrationProperties =
                integrationProperties;

        this.foundationRepository =
                foundationRepository;

        this.httpClient =
                httpClient;

        this.environment =
                environment;

    }


    public SystemStatus currentStatus() {

        List<DependencyStatus> dependencies =
                List.of(

                        databaseStatus(),

                        httpStatus(

                                "OpenSearch",

                                integrationProperties
                                        .opensearch()
                                        .baseUrl(),

                                ""

                        ),

                        httpStatus(

                                "Ollama",

                                integrationProperties
                                        .ollama()
                                        .baseUrl(),

                                "/api/tags"

                        )

                );


        return new SystemStatus(

                appProperties.displayName(),

                appProperties.version(),

                activeEnvironment(),

                Instant.now(),

                dependencies

        );

    }


    private DependencyStatus databaseStatus() {

        try {

            String marker =

                    foundationRepository
                            .schemaMarker()
                            .orElse(
                                    "missing"
                            );


            if (
                    "missing".equals(
                            marker
                    )
            ) {

                return new DependencyStatus(

                        "PostgreSQL",

                        "DOWN",

                        "Database reachable but schema marker is missing"

                );

            }


            return new DependencyStatus(

                    "PostgreSQL",

                    "UP",

                    "Schema version " + marker

            );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            return new DependencyStatus(

                    "PostgreSQL",

                    "DOWN",

                    "Database check failed: "
                            +
                            exception
                                    .getClass()
                                    .getSimpleName()

            );

        }

    }


    private DependencyStatus httpStatus(

            String name,

            URI baseUrl,

            String path

    ) {

        URI target =

                path.isBlank()

                        ? baseUrl

                        : baseUrl.resolve(
                                path
                        );


        HttpRequest request =

                HttpRequest
                        .newBuilder(
                                target
                        )

                        .GET()

                        .timeout(
                                Duration.ofSeconds(2)
                        )

                        .build();


        try {

            HttpResponse<Void> response =

                    httpClient.send(

                            request,

                            HttpResponse
                                    .BodyHandlers
                                    .discarding()

                    );


            if (
                    response.statusCode() >= 200
                    &&
                    response.statusCode() < 300
            ) {

                return new DependencyStatus(

                        name,

                        "UP",

                        "Reachable at "
                                +
                                baseUrl

                );

            }


            return new DependencyStatus(

                    name,

                    "DOWN",

                    "HTTP "
                            +
                            response.statusCode()
                            +
                            " from "
                            +
                            baseUrl

            );


        } catch (
                InterruptedException exception
        ) {

            Thread
                    .currentThread()
                    .interrupt();


            return new DependencyStatus(

                    name,

                    "DOWN",

                    "Health check interrupted"

            );


        } catch (
                Exception exception
        ) {

            return new DependencyStatus(

                    name,

                    "DOWN",

                    "Not reachable at "
                            +
                            baseUrl

            );

        }

    }


    private String activeEnvironment() {

        String[] profiles =
                environment
                        .getActiveProfiles();


        return profiles.length == 0

                ? "default"

                : String.join(
                        ",",
                        Arrays.asList(
                                profiles
                        )
                );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/system/infrastructure/FoundationRepository.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.system.infrastructure;

import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

@Repository
public class FoundationRepository {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    public FoundationRepository(
            JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {

        this.jdbcTemplate =
                jdbcTemplate;

    }


    public Optional<String> schemaMarker() {

        return jdbcTemplate.query(

                """
                select metadata_value
                from platform_metadata
                where metadata_key = 'schema.version'
                """,

                resultSet ->

                        resultSet.next()

                                ? Optional.ofNullable(
                                        resultSet.getString(1)
                                )

                                : Optional.empty()

        );

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/tenant/CurrentPrincipalService.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.tenant;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ApiAuthenticationException;
import com.tenderpilot.organization.domain.MembershipRole;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class CurrentPrincipalService {

    public CurrentPrincipal require() {

        Authentication authentication =

                SecurityContextHolder
                        .getContext()
                        .getAuthentication();


        if (
                !(
                        authentication
                                instanceof
                                JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication
                )
                ||
                !authentication.isAuthenticated()
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    "Authentication is required"
            );

        }


        String organizationId =
                jwtAuthentication
                        .getToken()
                        .getClaimAsString(
                                "org_id"
                        );


        String role =
                jwtAuthentication
                        .getToken()
                        .getClaimAsString(
                                "role"
                        );


        String email =
                jwtAuthentication
                        .getToken()
                        .getClaimAsString(
                                "email"
                        );


        try {

            return new CurrentPrincipal(

                    UUID.fromString(
                            jwtAuthentication
                                    .getToken()
                                    .getSubject()
                    ),

                    UUID.fromString(
                            organizationId
                    ),

                    MembershipRole
                            .valueOf(
                                    role
                            ),

                    email

            );


        } catch (
                RuntimeException exception
        ) {

            throw new ApiAuthenticationException(
                    "Access token does not contain a valid TenderPilot tenant context"
            );

        }

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/tenant/TenantAccessGuard.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.tenant;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ForbiddenOperationException;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class TenantAccessGuard {

    private final CurrentPrincipalService
            currentPrincipalService;


    public TenantAccessGuard(
            CurrentPrincipalService currentPrincipalService
    ) {

        this.currentPrincipalService =
                currentPrincipalService;

    }


    public void requireCurrentOrganization(
            UUID requestedOrganizationId
    ) {

        UUID activeOrganizationId =

                currentPrincipalService
                        .require()
                        .organizationId();


        if (
                !activeOrganizationId
                        .equals(
                                requestedOrganizationId
                        )
        ) {

            throw new ForbiddenOperationException(
                    "Cross-organization access is forbidden"
            );

        }

    }

}
