package com.tenderpilot.biddecision;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.SetBidDecisionRequest;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.api.UpdateBidAssessmentRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.application.BidDecisionService;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionEventType;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.infrastructure.BidDecisionRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEntity;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.matching.domain.TenderMatchGrade;

import com.tenderpilot.matching.infrastructure.TenderMatchRepository;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderImportService;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.application.CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest;

import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.BuyerCategory;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ContractNature;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementProcedure;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementSource;
import com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.ProcurementStatus;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_bid_decision;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH",
                "tenderpilot.search.enabled=false",
                "tenderpilot.search.auto-index=false"
        }
)
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
@Transactional
class BidDecisionIntegrationTest {

    private static final UUID ORG_ONE =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000111"
            );


    private static final UUID ORG_TWO =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000222"
            );


    @Autowired
    private CanonicalTenderImportService
            tenderImportService;


    @Autowired
    private TenderMatchRepository
            matchRepository;


    @Autowired
    private BidDecisionRepository
            decisionRepository;


    @Autowired
    private BidDecisionService
            decisionService;


    @BeforeEach
    void clean() {

        decisionRepository.deleteAll();

        matchRepository.deleteAll();

        decisionRepository.flush();

        matchRepository.flush();
    }


    @Test
    void assessmentCreatesDecisionAndAuditHistory() {

        UUID tenderId =
                seedTenderAndMatch(
                        "BID-ASSESSMENT",
                        ORG_ONE,
                        90
                );


        BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse workspace =
                decisionService
                        .assess(
                                ORG_ONE,

                                tenderId,

                                assessment(
                                        5
                                ),

                                "analyst@example.test"
                        );


        assertThat(
                workspace.decision()
        )
                .isNotNull();


        assertThat(
                workspace
                        .decision()
                        .decisionScore()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                workspace
                        .decision()
                        .recommendedOutcome()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
                );


        assertThat(
                workspace
                        .decision()
                        .outcome()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.PENDING
                );


        assertThat(
                workspace.history()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                workspace
                        .history()
                        .getFirst()
                        .eventType()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionEventType.ASSESSMENT_UPDATED
                );
    }


    @Test
    void bidManagerCanProgressAssessmentToGoAndReopen() {

        UUID tenderId =
                seedTenderAndMatch(
                        "BID-DECISION",
                        ORG_ONE,
                        90
                );


        decisionService
                .assess(
                        ORG_ONE,
                        tenderId,
                        assessment(
                                5
                        ),
                        "analyst@example.test"
                );


        BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse decided =
                decisionService
                        .decide(
                                ORG_ONE,

                                tenderId,

                                new SetBidDecisionRequest(
                                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO,
                                        "Approved for pursuit."
                                ),

                                "manager@example.test"
                        );


        assertThat(
                decided
                        .decision()
                        .outcome()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
                );


        assertThat(
                decided
                        .decision()
                        .decidedBy()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "manager@example.test"
                );


        assertThat(
                decided.history()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        2
                );


        BidDecisionWorkspaceResponse reopened =
                decisionService
                        .reopen(
                                ORG_ONE,
                                tenderId,
                                "manager@example.test"
                        );


        assertThat(
                reopened
                        .decision()
                        .outcome()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.PENDING
                );


        assertThat(
                reopened.history()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        3
                );
    }


    @Test
    void decisionsAndQueueRemainTenantIsolated() {

        UUID tenderId =
                seedTenderAndMatch(
                        "BID-TENANT",
                        ORG_ONE,
                        90
                );


        seedMatch(
                tenderId,
                ORG_TWO,
                65
        );


        decisionService
                .assess(
                        ORG_ONE,
                        tenderId,
                        assessment(
                                5
                        ),
                        "org-one@example.test"
                );


        assertThat(
                decisionService
                        .queue(
                                ORG_ONE,
                                null,
                                false
                        )
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                decisionService
                        .queue(
                                ORG_TWO,
                                null,
                                false
                        )
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                decisionService
                        .queue(
                                ORG_TWO,
                                null,
                                false
                        )
                        .getFirst()
                        .decision()
        )
                .isNull();


        assertThat(
                decisionService
                        .overview(
                                ORG_ONE
                        )
                        .totalDecisions()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                decisionService
                        .overview(
                                ORG_TWO
                        )
                        .totalDecisions()
        )
                .isZero();
    }


    private UUID seedTenderAndMatch(
            String externalId,
            UUID organizationId,
            int score
    ) {

        UUID tenderId =
                tenderImportService
                        .upsert(
                                tender(
                                        externalId
                                )
                        );


        seedMatch(
                tenderId,
                organizationId,
                score
        );


        return tenderId;
    }


    private void seedMatch(
            UUID tenderId,
            UUID organizationId,
            int score
    ) {

        var tender =
                opportunityTender(
                        tenderId
                );


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                TenderMatchEntity
                        .create(
                                organizationId,
                                tender
                        );


        match.apply(
                new TenderMatchEvaluation(
                        score,

                        score >= 85
                                ? TenderMatchGrade.EXCELLENT
                                : score >= 70
                                        ? TenderMatchGrade.STRONG
                                        : TenderMatchGrade.GOOD,

                        false,

                        Math.min(
                                25,
                                score
                        ),

                        15,

                        15,

                        10,

                        15,

                        5,

                        5,

                        List.of()
                )
        );


        matchRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        match
                );
    }


    private com.tenderpilot.procurement.domain.TenderEntity
    opportunityTender(
            UUID tenderId
    ) {

        /*
         * TenderMatchRepository is JPA-based; the canonical import
         * has already persisted this tender. We retrieve it through
         * the match repository entity manager indirectly by using
         * the canonical repository bean resolved through Spring.
         *
         * The helper below is replaced by Spring injection via
         * TenderRepository field.
         */
        return tenderRepository
                .findById(
                        tenderId
                )
                .orElseThrow();
    }


    @Autowired
    private com.tenderpilot.procurement.infrastructure.TenderRepository
            tenderRepository;


    private UpdateBidAssessmentRequest assessment(
            int score
    ) {

        return new UpdateBidAssessmentRequest(
                score,
                score,
                score,
                score,
                score,
                score,
                "Strong strategic fit and relevant reference base.",
                "Resource scheduling requires confirmation.",
                "Tender timetable remains unchanged."
        );
    }


    private CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest tender(
            String externalId
    ) {

        return new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest(
                ProcurementSource.MANUAL_DEMO,

                externalId,

                "1",

                "BID_DECISION_TEST",

                "https://example.test/"
                        +
                        externalId,

                "bid-decision-checksum-"
                        +
                        externalId,

                Instant.parse(
                        "2026-09-10T08:00:00Z"
                ),

                new CanonicalTenderUpsertRequest
                        .BuyerInput(
                                "BID-BUYER:"
                                        +
                                        externalId,

                                "Ville de Paris",

                                BuyerCategory.LOCAL_AUTHORITY,

                                "FR",

                                "Paris",

                                null,

                                null
                        ),

                "Public-building energy renovation "
                        +
                        externalId,

                "Energy renovation and refurbishment of public property.",

                ProcurementStatus.PUBLISHED,

                ProcurementProcedure.OPEN,

                ContractNature.WORKS,

                LocalDate.of(
                        2026,
                        9,
                        10
                ),

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_bid_decision_migration;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH"
        }
)
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
class BidDecisionMigrationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    @Test
    void liquibaseCreatesBidDecisionTables() {

        for (
                String table :
                List.of(
                        "organization_bid_decisions",
                        "organization_bid_decision_history"
                )
        ) {

            Integer count =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .queryForObject(
                                    """
                                    select count(*)
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = ?
                                    """,
                                    Integer.class,
                                    table
                            );


            assertThat(
                    count
            )
                    .as(
                            "Expected bid-decision table %s",
                            table
                    )
                    .isEqualTo(
                            1
                    );
        }
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.biddecision;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.application.BidDecisionScoringService;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidAssessmentEvaluation;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;
import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionScorecard;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class BidDecisionScoringServiceTest {

    private final BidDecisionScoringService service =
            new BidDecisionScoringService();


    @Test
    void perfectAssessmentAndStrongMatchRecommendGo() {

        BidAssessmentEvaluation result =
                service.evaluate(
                        scorecard(
                                5
                        ),
                        90,
                        false
                );


        assertThat(
                result.score()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recommendation()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO
                );
    }


    @Test
    void mediumAssessmentRecommendsHold() {

        BidAssessmentEvaluation result =
                service.evaluate(
                        scorecard(
                                3
                        ),
                        75,
                        false
                );


        assertThat(
                result.score()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        60
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recommendation()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.HOLD
                );
    }


    @Test
    void lowAssessmentRecommendsNoGo() {

        BidAssessmentEvaluation result =
                service.evaluate(
                        scorecard(
                                2
                        ),
                        80,
                        false
                );


        assertThat(
                result.score()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        40
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recommendation()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
                );
    }


    @Test
    void blockedMatchAlwaysRecommendsNoGo() {

        BidAssessmentEvaluation result =
                service.evaluate(
                        scorecard(
                                5
                        ),
                        95,
                        true
                );


        assertThat(
                result.score()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recommendation()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
                );
    }


    @Test
    void weakMatchCannotReceiveGoRecommendation() {

        BidAssessmentEvaluation result =
                service.evaluate(
                        scorecard(
                                5
                        ),
                        50,
                        false
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recommendation()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.NO_GO
                );
    }


    @Test
    void scorecardRejectsValuesAboveFive() {

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        service.evaluate(
                                new BidDecisionScorecard(
                                        6,
                                        5,
                                        5,
                                        5,
                                        5,
                                        5
                                ),
                                90,
                                false
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        InvalidRequestException.class
                );
    }


    private BidDecisionScorecard scorecard(
            int value
    ) {

        return new BidDecisionScorecard(
                value,
                value,
                value,
                value,
                value,
                value
        );
    }

}

    private UUID createRequirement(
            UUID tenderId,
            String title
    ) {

        var workspace =
                workspaceService
                        .createRequirement(
                                ORG_ONE,

                                tenderId,

                                new CreateBidRequirementRequest(
                                        title,

                                        "Planning integration requirement.",

                                        BidRequirementCategory.TECHNICAL,

                                        true,

                                        null,

                                        "CCTP §5",

                                        LocalDate.of(
                                                2099,
                                                10,
                                                10
                                        ),

                                        "Bid team",

                                        null
                                ),

                                "analyst@example.test"
                        );


        return workspace
                .requirements()
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        requirement ->
                                requirement.title()
                                        .equals(
                                                title
                                        )
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow()
                .id();
    }


    private void createDecision(
            UUID tenderId,
            BidDecisionOutcome outcome
    ) {

        TenderMatchEntity match =
                matchRepository
                        .findByOrganizationIdAndTender_Id(
                                ORG_ONE,
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow();


        BidDecisionEntity decision =
                BidDecisionEntity
                        .create(
                                ORG_ONE,
                                match.getTender()
                        );


        decision.applyAssessment(
                new BidDecisionScorecard(
                        5,
                        5,
                        5,
                        5,
                        5,
                        5
                ),

                new BidAssessmentEvaluation(
                        100,
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO,
                        "Synthetic planning recommendation"
                ),

                90,

                TenderMatchGrade.EXCELLENT,

                "Strong strategic fit",

                "No material risks",

                "Stable assumptions"
        );


        decision.decide(
                outcome,
                "manager@example.test"
        );


        decisionRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        decision
                );
    }


    private UUID seedTenderAndMatch(
            String externalId,
            UUID organizationId
    ) {

        UUID tenderId =
                tenderImportService
                        .upsert(
                                tender(
                                        externalId
                                )
                        );


        var tender =
                tenderRepository
                        .findById(
                                tenderId
                        )
                        .orElseThrow();


        TenderMatchEntity match =
                TenderMatchEntity
                        .create(
                                organizationId,
                                tender
                        );


        match.apply(
                new TenderMatchEvaluation(
                        90,
                        TenderMatchGrade.EXCELLENT,
                        false,
                        25,
                        15,
                        15,
                        10,
                        15,
                        5,
                        5,
                        List.of()
                )
        );


        matchRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        match
                );


        return tenderId;
    }

package com.tenderpilot.bidplanning;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_bid_planning_migration;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH"
        }
)
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
class BidPlanningMigrationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    @Test
    void liquibaseCreatesBidPlanningTables() {

        for (
                String table :
                List.of(
                        "organization_bid_tasks",
                        "organization_bid_submission_controls",
                        "organization_bid_planning_events"
                )
        ) {

            Integer count =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .queryForObject(
                                    """
                                    select count(*)
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = ?
                                    """,
                                    Integer.class,
                                    table
                            );


            assertThat(
                    count
            )
                    .as(
                            "Expected planning table %s",
                            table
                    )
                    .isEqualTo(
                            1
                    );
        }

class BidSubmissionReadinessEngineTest {

    private final BidSubmissionReadinessEngine engine =
            new BidSubmissionReadinessEngine();


    @Test
    void fullGoComplianceTasksAndChecklistIsReady() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        BidDecisionOutcome.GO,

                                2026,
                                9,
                                10

                .isEqualTo(

                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()

                .isTrue();
    }

        )
                .isEqualTo(

                );
    }

    @TestConfiguration

        @Primary
        FakeBidDocumentStorageGateway

            return new FakeBidDocumentStorageGateway();
        }

    static class FakeBidDocumentStorageGateway
            implements BidDocumentStorageGateway {

        private final Map<String, byte[]> content =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        void reset() {

            content.clear();
        }


        @Override
        public StoredBidDocument store(
                UUID organizationId,
                UUID tenderId,
                String originalFilename,
                byte[] bytes
        ) {

            String key =
                    organizationId
                            +
                            "/"
                            +
                            tenderId
                            +
                            "/"
                            +
                            UUID.randomUUID()
                            +
                            ".pdf";


            content.put(
                    key,
                    bytes.clone()
            );


            return new StoredBidDocument(
                    key,
                    key.substring(
                            key.lastIndexOf(
                                    '/'
                            )
                                    +
                                    1
                    )
            );
        }


        @Override
        public byte[] load(
                String storageKey
        ) {

            byte[] bytes =
                    content.get(
                            storageKey
                    );


            if (
                    bytes == null
            ) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Synthetic document missing"
                );
            }


            return bytes.clone();
        }


        @Override
        public void delete(
                String storageKey
        ) {

            content.remove(
                    storageKey
            );
        }
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_bid_workspace_migration;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH"
        }
)
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
class BidWorkspaceMigrationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    @Test
    void liquibaseCreatesBidWorkspaceTables() {

        for (
                String table :
                List.of(
                        "organization_bid_documents",
                        "organization_bid_requirements"
                )
        ) {

            Integer count =
                    jdbcTemplate
                            .queryForObject(
                                    """
                                    select count(*)
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = ?
                                    """,
                                    Integer.class,
                                    table
                            );


            assertThat(
                    count
            )
                    .as(
                            "Expected bid-workspace table %s",
                            table
                    )
                    .isEqualTo(
                            1
                    );
        }
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.application.BidDocumentStorageGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure.BidDocumentStorageSettings;
import com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace.infrastructure.LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;
import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.ResourceNotFoundException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.nio.file.Path;

import java.util.UUID;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class LocalBidDocumentStorageGatewayTest {

    @TempDir
    Path tempDirectory;


    @Test
    void storesAndLoadsDocumentRoundTrip() {

        LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway =
                gateway(
                        1024
                );


        byte[] content =
                "Tender specifications"
                        .getBytes(
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        );


        BidDocumentStorageGateway.StoredBidDocument stored =
                gateway.store(
                        organization(),
                        tender(),
                        "specifications.pdf",
                        content
                );


        assertThat(
                stored.storageKey()
        )
                .contains(
                        organization()
                                .toString()
                )
                .contains(
                        tender()
                                .toString()
                )
                .endsWith(
                        ".pdf"
                );


        assertThat(
                gateway.load(
                        stored.storageKey()
                )
        )
                .containsExactly(
                        content
                );
    }


    @Test
    void sanitizesTraversalFromOriginalFilename() {

        LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway =
                gateway(
                        1024
                );


        BidDocumentStorageGateway.StoredBidDocument stored =
                gateway.store(
                        organization(),
                        tender(),
                        "../../dangerous-name.pdf",
                        new byte[] {
                                1,
                                2,
                                3
                        }
                );


        assertThat(
                stored.storageKey()
        )
                .doesNotContain(
                        ".."
                );


        assertThat(
                stored.storedFilename()
        )
                .endsWith(
                        ".pdf"
                );
    }


    @Test
    void rejectsUnsupportedFileExtension() {

        LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway =
                gateway(
                        1024
                );


        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        gateway.store(
                                organization(),
                                tender(),
                                "script.exe",
                                new byte[] {
                                        1
                                }
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        InvalidRequestException.class
                );
    }


    @Test
    void rejectsFilesAboveConfiguredLimit() {

        LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway =
                gateway(
                        4
                );


        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        gateway.store(
                                organization(),
                                tender(),
                                "large.pdf",
                                new byte[] {
                                        1,
                                        2,
                                        3,
                                        4,
                                        5
                                }
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        InvalidRequestException.class
                );
    }


    @Test
    void deleteRemovesStoredContent() {

        LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway =
                gateway(
                        1024
                );


        BidDocumentStorageGateway.StoredBidDocument stored =
                gateway.store(
                        organization(),
                        tender(),
                        "delete-me.pdf",
                        new byte[] {
                                5,
                                4,
                                3
                        }
                );


        gateway.delete(
                stored.storageKey()
        );


        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        gateway.load(
                                stored.storageKey()
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                );
    }


    private LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway gateway(
            long maxBytes
    ) {

        return new LocalBidDocumentStorageGateway(
                new BidDocumentStorageSettings(
                        tempDirectory.toString(),
                        maxBytes
                )
        );
    }


    private UUID organization() {

        return UUID.fromString(
                "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000001200"
        );
    }


    private UUID tender() {

        return UUID.fromString(
                "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000001200"
        );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.application.BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer;

import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.DeadlineTempo;
import com.tenderpilot.buyerintelligence.domain.SupplierConcentration;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class BuyerBehaviorAnalyzerTest {

    private final BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer analyzer =
            new BuyerBehaviorAnalyzer();


    @Test
    void missingSupplierHistoryProducesUnknownConcentration() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        1,
                        Map.of(),
                        Map.of(),
                        List.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.supplierConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SupplierConcentration.UNKNOWN
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topSupplierSharePercentage()
        )
                .isZero();


        assertThat(
                result.supplierHhi()
        )
                .isZero();
    }


    @Test
    void dominantSupplierProducesConcentratedMarket() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        10,

                        Map.of(
                                "Supplier A",
                                8,

                                "Supplier B",
                                2
                        ),

                        Map.of(),

                        List.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topSupplierSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        80
                );


        assertThat(
                result.supplierHhi()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        6800
                );


        assertThat(
                result.supplierConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SupplierConcentration.CONCENTRATED
                );
    }


    @Test
    void fourBalancedSuppliersAreDiversified() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        12,

                        Map.of(
                                "A",
                                3,
                                "B",
                                3,
                                "C",
                                3,
                                "D",
                                3
                        ),

                        Map.of(),

                        List.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topSupplierSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        25
                );


        assertThat(
                result.supplierHhi()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        2500
                );


        /*
         * Exact 2500 sits on the moderate boundary.
         */
        assertThat(
                result.supplierConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SupplierConcentration.MODERATE
                );
    }


    @Test
    void repeatedCpvCreatesRecurringProcurementSignal() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        5,

                        Map.of(),

                        Map.of(
                                "45453000",
                                4,

                                "45210000",
                                1
                        ),

                        List.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topCpvSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        80
                );


        assertThat(
                result.recurringProcurement()
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    @Test
    void medianDeadlineTempoIsCalculated() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        4,

                        Map.of(),

                        Map.of(),

                        List.of(
                                20,
                                30,
                                40,
                                50
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.medianResponseDays()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        35
                );


        assertThat(
                result.deadlineTempo()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        DeadlineTempo.STANDARD
                );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.company;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
class CompanyProfileMigrationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    @Test
    void liquibaseCreatesCompanyIntelligenceTables() {

        List<String> tables =

                List.of(

                        "company_profiles",

                        "company_capabilities",

                        "company_operating_regions",

                        "company_target_cpvs",

                        "company_certifications",

                        "company_reference_projects",

                        "company_preferred_buyer_types",

                        "company_excluded_keywords"

                );


        for (
                String table :
                tables
        ) {

            Integer count =

                    jdbcTemplate
                            .queryForObject(

                                    """
                                    select count(*)

    private UUID createRequirement(
            UUID tenderId,
            boolean mandatory,
            String title
    ) {

        var workspace =
                workspaceService
                        .createRequirement(
                                ORG_ONE,

                                tenderId,

                                new CreateBidRequirementRequest(
                                        title,

                                        "Requirement fixture for compliance intelligence.",

                                        BidRequirementCategory.TECHNICAL,

                                        mandatory,

                                        null,

                                        "CCTP §4",

                                        LocalDate.of(
                                                2026,
                                                10,
                                                20
                                        ),

                                        "Bid team",

                                        null
                                ),

                                "analyst@example.test"
                        );


        return workspace
                .requirements()
                .stream()
                .filter(
                        requirement ->
                                requirement.title()
                                        .equals(
                                                title
                                        )
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow()
                .id();
    }

                        15,
                        5,
                        5,

                )
        );


        matchRepository
                .saveAndFlush(
                        match
                );


        return tenderId;
    }

===== FILE: ./backend/src/test/java/com/tenderpilot/compliance/ComplianceReadinessEngineTest.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.compliance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.application.ComplianceReadinessEngine;

import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.CompliancePriority;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRequirementSnapshot;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceRiskLevel;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.ComplianceVerdict;
import com.tenderpilot.compliance.domain.EvidenceStrength;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ComplianceReadinessEngineTest {

    private final ComplianceReadinessEngine engine =
            new ComplianceReadinessEngine();


    @Test
    void fullyCompliantStrongEvidenceIsSubmissionReady() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        List.of(
                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.LOW,
                                        EvidenceStrength.STRONG
                                ),

                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.LOW,
                                        EvidenceStrength.STRONG
                                )
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readinessScore()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    @Test
    void mandatoryNonComplianceCreatesBlocker() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        List.of(
                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.HIGH,
                                        EvidenceStrength.NONE
                                )
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.mandatoryBlockerCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isFalse();


        assertThat(
                engine.priority(
                        snapshot(
                                true,
                                ComplianceVerdict.NON_COMPLIANT,
                                ComplianceRiskLevel.HIGH,
                                EvidenceStrength.NONE
                        )
                )
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        CompliancePriority.BLOCKER
                );
    }


    @Test
    void mandatoryUnassessedRequirementPreventsReadiness() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        List.of(
                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.UNASSESSED,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED,
                                        EvidenceStrength.NONE
                                )
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.mandatoryIncompleteCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isFalse();
    }


    @Test
    void criticalRiskPreventsSubmissionReadiness() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        List.of(
                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.CRITICAL,
                                        EvidenceStrength.STRONG
                                )
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readinessScore()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        80
                );


        assertThat(
                result.criticalRiskCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isFalse();
    }


    @Test
    void evidenceStrengthChangesRowScore() {

        int strong =
                engine.rowScore(
                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT,
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.LOW,
                        EvidenceStrength.STRONG
                );


        int weak =
                engine.rowScore(
                        ComplianceVerdict.COMPLIANT,
                        ComplianceRiskLevel.LOW,
                        EvidenceStrength.WEAK
                );


        assertThat(
                strong
        )
                .isGreaterThan(
                        weak
                );


        assertThat(
                strong
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                weak
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        85
                );
    }


    @Test
    void notApplicableRequirementDoesNotReduceReadiness() {

        var result =
                engine.calculate(
                        List.of(
                                snapshot(
                                        true,
                                        ComplianceVerdict.NOT_APPLICABLE,
                                        ComplianceRiskLevel.UNASSESSED,
                                        EvidenceStrength.NONE
                                )
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readinessScore()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );


        assertThat(
                result.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    private ComplianceRequirementSnapshot snapshot(
            boolean mandatory,
            ComplianceVerdict verdict,
            ComplianceRiskLevel risk,
            EvidenceStrength evidence
    ) {

        return new ComplianceRequirementSnapshot(
                mandatory,
                verdict,
                risk,
                evidence
        );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.dashboard;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import com.tenderpilot.biddecision.domain.BidDecisionOutcome;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.api.BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse;

import com.tenderpilot.bidplanning.application.BidPlanningService;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class BidPlanningDashboardAdapterTest {

    private static final UUID ORG =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "20200000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
            );


    private static final UUID TENDER =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "20300000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
            );


    @Test
    void mapsPlanningWorkspaceIntoDashboardOperationalSnapshot() {

        BidPlanningService planningService =
                mock(
                        BidPlanningService.class
                );


        when(
                planningService.workspace(
                        ORG,
                        TENDER
                )
        )
                .thenReturn(
                        workspace(
                                BidDecisionOutcome.GO,
                                true,
                                88,
                                3,
                                4,
                                1,
                                1,
                                2,
                                false,
                                false
                        )
                );


        var adapter =
                new BidPlanningDashboardAdapter(
                        planningService
                );


        var snapshot =
                adapter.snapshot(
                        ORG,
                        TENDER
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.decisionOutcome()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "GO"
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.complianceReadinessScore()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        88
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.openTasks()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        3
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.overdueTasks()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.criticalOpenTasks()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        2
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.submitted()
        )
                .isFalse();
    }


    @Test
    void submittedTimestampMapsToFrozenSubmittedState() {

        BidPlanningService planningService =
                mock(
                        BidPlanningService.class
                );


        when(
                planningService.workspace(
                        ORG,
                        TENDER
                )
        )
                .thenReturn(
                        workspace(
                                BidDecisionOutcome.GO,
                                true,
                                100,
                                0,
                                6,
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                true,
                                true
                        )
                );


        var adapter =
                new BidPlanningDashboardAdapter(
                        planningService
                );


        var snapshot =
                adapter.snapshot(
                        ORG,
                        TENDER
                );


        assertThat(
                snapshot.readyForSubmission()
        )
                .isTrue();


        assertThat(
                snapshot.submitted()
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    private BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse workspace(
            BidDecisionOutcome decision,
            boolean complianceReady,
            int complianceScore,
            int openTasks,
            int completedTasks,
            int overdueTasks,
            int blockedTasks,
            int criticalTasks,
            boolean ready,
            boolean submitted
    ) {

        return new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse(
                TENDER,

                decision,

                complianceReady,

                complianceScore,

                !submitted,

                submitted
                        ? "Submitted"
                        : null,

                new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                        .Statistics(
                                ready
                                        ? 100
                                        : 65,

                                openTasks
                                        +
                                        completedTasks,

                                openTasks,

                                completedTasks,

                                blockedTasks,

                                overdueTasks,

                                criticalTasks,

                                openTasks
                                        +
                                        completedTasks
                                        ==
                                        0
                                        ? 100
                                        : (int)
                                                Math.round(
                                                        completedTasks
                                                                *
                                                                100.0
                                                                /
                                                                (
                                                                        openTasks
                                                                        +
                                                                        completedTasks
                                                                )
                                                ),

                                ready
                                        ? 100
                                        : 75,

                                ready
                        ),

                new BidPlanningWorkspaceResponse
                        .SubmissionControl(
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                ready,
                                null,
                                submitted
                                        ? Instant.parse(
                                                "2026-09-10T10:00:00Z"
                                        )
                                        : null,
                                submitted
                                        ? "TEST-RECEIPT"
                                        : null,
                                submitted
                                        ? "manager@example.test"
                                        : null,
                                null,
                                null
                        ),

                List.of(),

        );
    }

                .isZero();
    }


    private DashboardCommandCenterService service(
            List<DashboardMatchObservation> matches,
            Map<UUID, DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot> operations
    ) {

        DashboardMatchGateway matchGateway =
                organizationId ->
                        matches;


        DashboardBidOperationalGateway operationalGateway =
                (
                        organizationId,
                        tenderId
                ) -> {

                    DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot snapshot =
                            operations.get(
                                    tenderId
                            );


                    if (
                            snapshot == null
                    ) {

                        return operational(
                                null,
                                false,
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                false,
                                false
                        );
                    }


                    return snapshot;
                };


        DashboardPublicMarketGateway marketGateway =
                (
                        dateFrom,
                        dateTo
                ) ->
                        new DashboardMarketSignal(
                                true,
                                125,
                                40,
                                18,
                                12,
                                "DIVERSIFIED",
                                "MODERATE",
                                "45453000",
                                34,
                                52
                        );


        return new DashboardCommandCenterService(
                matchGateway,
                operationalGateway,
                marketGateway
        );
    }


    private DashboardMatchObservation match(
            UUID tenderId,
            String title,
            int score,
            long daysToDeadline
    ) {

        LocalDate date =
                LocalDate.now(
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                )
                        .plusDays(
                                daysToDeadline
                        );


        return new DashboardMatchObservation(
                tenderId,
                UUID.randomUUID(),
                title,
                "Public Buyer",
                date
                        .atStartOfDay()
                        .toInstant(
                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                        ),
                score,
                score >= 85
                        ? "EXCELLENT"
                        : score >= 70
                                ? "STRONG"
                                : "WEAK",
                false
        );
    }


    private DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot operational(
            String outcome,
            boolean complianceReady,
            int complianceScore,
            int openTasks,
            int completedTasks,
            int overdueTasks,
            int blockedTasks,
            int criticalOpenTasks,
            boolean submissionReady,
            boolean submitted
    ) {

        return new DashboardBidOperationalSnapshot(
                outcome,
                complianceReady,
                complianceScore,
                openTasks,
                completedTasks,
                overdueTasks,
                blockedTasks,
                criticalOpenTasks,
                submissionReady,
                submitted
        );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.dashboard;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.infrastructure.DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector;
import com.tenderpilot.dashboard.infrastructure.JdbcDashboardMatchGateway;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_dashboard_schema;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH",
                "tenderpilot.search.enabled=false",
                "tenderpilot.search.auto-index=false",
                "tenderpilot.local-ai.enabled=false",

)
class DashboardSchemaIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private DashboardAnalyticsSchemaInspector
            schemaInspector;


    @Autowired
    private JdbcDashboardMatchGateway
            matchGateway;


    @Test

                schemaInspector.schema();


        assertThat(
                schema.matchTable()
        )
                .isEqualToIgnoringCase(
                        "organization_tender_matches"
                );

        )

        )

package com.tenderpilot.database;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
class DatabaseMigrationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;


    @Test
    void liquibaseCreatesStepTwoSchemaBeforeApplicationTests() {

        List<String> requiredTables =

                List.of(

                        "app_users",

                        "organizations",

                        "organization_memberships",

                        "auth_refresh_tokens"

                );


        for (
                String table :
                requiredTables
        ) {

            Integer count =

                    jdbcTemplate
                            .queryForObject(

                                    """
                                    select count(*)
                                    from information_schema.tables
                                    where lower(table_name) = ?
                                    """,

                                    Integer.class,

                                    table

                            );


            assertThat(
                    count
            )
                    .as(
                            "Expected Liquibase table %s",
                            table
                    )
                    .isEqualTo(
                            1
                    );

        }

    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.application.DataOperationsService;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class DataOperationsServiceTest {

    @Test
    void coreSourcesRemainVisibleEvenWithoutRunHistory() {

        DataOperationsService service =
                new DataOperationsService(
                        limit ->
                                List.of(),

                        new SourceHealthAnalyzer()
                );


        var result =
                service.overview(
                        50
                );


        assertThat(
                result.sources()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                source ->
                                        source.source()
                        )
        )
                .containsExactly(
                        "BOAMP",
                        "DECP",
                        "TED"
                );


        assertThat(
                result.summary()
                        .unknownSourceCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        3
                );
    }


    @Test
    void overviewAggregatesSourceHealthAndReliability() {

        Instant now =
                Instant.now();


        IngestionRunGateway gateway =
                limit ->
                        List.of(
                                new IngestionRunObservation(
                                        "TED",
                                        "SUCCESS",
                                        now.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        2
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        now.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        1
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        500L,
                                        5L
                                ),

                                new IngestionRunObservation(
                                        "BOAMP",
                                        "FAILED",
                                        now.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        3
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        now.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        2
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        0L,
                                        100L
                                ),

                                new IngestionRunObservation(
                                        "DECP",
                                        "RUNNING",
                                        now.minus(
                                                Duration.ofMinutes(
                                                        30
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        null,
                                        null,
                                        null
                                )
                        );


        DataOperationsService service =
                new DataOperationsService(
                        gateway,
                        new SourceHealthAnalyzer()
                );


        var result =
                service.overview(
                        50
                );


        assertThat(
                result.summary()
                        .runs24Hours()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        3
                );


        assertThat(
                result.summary()
                        .failures24Hours()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                result.summary()
                        .successRate7Days()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        50
                );


        assertThat(
                result.sources()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                source ->
                                        source.source()
                                                .equals(
                                                        "TED"
                                                )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow()
                        .health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.HEALTHY
                );
    }


    @Test

package com.tenderpilot.dataoperations;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.application.SourceHealthAnalyzer;

import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.IngestionRunObservation;
import com.tenderpilot.dataoperations.domain.SourceHealthStatus;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SourceHealthAnalyzerTest {

    private static final Instant NOW =
            Instant.parse(
                    "2026-09-10T12:00:00Z"
            );


    private final SourceHealthAnalyzer analyzer =
            new SourceHealthAnalyzer();


    @Test
    void recentSuccessfulRunIsHealthy() {

        var analysis =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        "TED",

                        List.of(
                                run(
                                        "SUCCESS",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        4
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        3
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                        ),

                        NOW
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.HEALTHY
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.successRate7Days()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        100
                );
    }


    @Test
    void oldSuccessfulRunIsStale() {

        var analysis =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        "BOAMP",

                        List.of(
                                run(
                                        "COMPLETED",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofDays(
                                                        4
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofDays(
                                                        4
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                        ),

                        NOW
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.STALE
                );
    }


    @Test
    void recentFailureAfterRecentSuccessIsDegraded() {

        var analysis =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        "DECP",

                        List.of(
                                run(
                                        "FAILED",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        2
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        1
                                                )
                                        )
                                ),

                                run(
                                        "SUCCESS",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        10
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        9
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                        ),

                        NOW
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.DEGRADED
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.failureStreak()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        1
                );
    }


    @Test
    void repeatedFailureWithoutRecentSuccessIsUnhealthy() {

        var analysis =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        "TED",

                        List.of(
                                run(
                                        "ERROR",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        2
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        1
                                                )
                                        )
                                ),

                                run(
                                        "FAILED",
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        7
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        NOW.minus(
                                                Duration.ofHours(
                                                        6
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                        ),

                        NOW
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.UNHEALTHY
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.failureStreak()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        2
                );
    }


    @Test
    void unfinishedRunningRunHasRunningHealth() {

        var analysis =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        "TED",

                        List.of(
                                new IngestionRunObservation(
                                        "TED",
                                        "RUNNING",
                                        NOW.minusSeconds(
                                                60
                                        ),
                                        null,
                                        null,
                                        null
                                )
                        ),

                        NOW
                );


        assertThat(
                analysis.health()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        SourceHealthStatus.RUNNING
                );
    }


    private static IngestionRunObservation run(
            String status,
            Instant started,
            Instant finished
    ) {

        return new IngestionRunObservation(
                "SOURCE",
                status,
                started,
                finished,
                100L,
                2L
        );
    }

}
