    @TestConfiguration
    static class FakeSearchConfiguration {

        @Bean
        @Primary
        FakeOpenSearchGateway fakeOpenSearchGateway() {

            return new FakeOpenSearchGateway();

        }

    }


    static class FakeOpenSearchGateway
            implements OpenSearchGateway {

        private final Map<UUID, ProcurementSearchDocument>
                documents =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();


        private boolean failSearch;


        private int recreateCount;


        private boolean indexExists;


        void reset() {

            documents.clear();

            failSearch =
                    false;

            recreateCount =
                    0;

            indexExists =
                    false;

        }


        @Override
        public boolean isAvailable() {

            return true;

        }


        @Override
        public boolean indexExists() {

            return indexExists;

        }


        @Override
        public void ensureIndex() {

            indexExists =
                    true;

        }


        @Override
        public void recreateIndex() {

            documents.clear();

            indexExists =
                    true;

            recreateCount++;

        }


        @Override
        public void index(
                ProcurementSearchDocument document
        ) {

            indexExists =
                    true;

            documents.put(
                    document.id(),
                    document
            );

        }


        @Override
        public long count() {

            return documents.size();

        }


        @Override
        public SearchPage search(
                ProcurementSearchQuery query
        ) {

            if (
                    failSearch
            ) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Synthetic OpenSearch failure"
                );

            }


            String text =
                    query.text()
                            ==
                            null

                            ? null

                            : query
                                    .text()
                                    .trim()
                                    .toLowerCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    );


            List<SearchMatch> matches =
                    new ArrayList<>();


            for (
                    ProcurementSearchDocument document :
                    documents.values()
            ) {

                if (
                        query.status()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        !document
                                .status()
                                .equals(
                                        query
                                                .status()
                                                .name()
                                )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                if (
                        query.source()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        !document
                                .sources()
                                .contains(
                                        query
                                                .source()
                                                .name()
                                )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                if (
                        query.contractNature()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        !document
                                .contractNature()
                                .equals(
                                        query
                                                .contractNature()
                                                .name()
                                )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                if (
                        query.countryCode()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        !document
                                .countryCode()
                                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                        query.countryCode()
                                )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                if (
                        query.region()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        (
                                document.regionName()
                                        ==
                                        null
                                ||
                                !document
                                        .regionName()
                                        .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                                query.region()
                                        )
                        )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                if (
                        query.minimumQualityScore()
                                !=
                                null
                        &&
                        (
                                document.qualityScore()
                                        ==
                                        null
                                ||
                                document.qualityScore()
                                        <
                                        query.minimumQualityScore()
                        )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                double score =
                        1.0;


                if (
                        text != null
                        &&
                        !text.isBlank()
                ) {

                    String haystack =
                            String.join(
                                    " ",
                                    document.title(),
                                    document.description(),
                                    document.buyerName(),
                                    String.join(
                                            " ",
                                            document.cpvCodes()
                                    ),
                                    String.join(
                                            " ",
                                            document.cpvLabels()
                                    )
                            )
                                    .toLowerCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    );


                    boolean allTokensMatch =
                            List.of(
                                    text.split(
                                            "\\s+"
                                    )
                            )
                                    .stream()
                                    .allMatch(
                                            haystack::contains
                                    );


                    if (
                            !allTokensMatch
                    ) {
                        continue;
                    }


                    if (
                            document
                                    .title()
                                    .toLowerCase(
                                            Locale.ROOT
                                    )
                                    .contains(
                                            text
                                    )
                    ) {
                        score =
                                5.0;

                    } else {
                        score =
                                2.0;
                    }

                }


                matches.add(
                        new SearchMatch(
                                document.id(),
                                score
                        )
                );

            }


            matches.sort(
                    Comparator.comparingDouble(
                            SearchMatch::score
                    )
                            .reversed()
            );


            int size =
                    query.size()
                            ==
                            null

                            ? 25

                            : Math.max(
                                    1,
                                    Math.min(
                                            100,
                                            query.size()
                                    )
                            );


            List<SearchMatch> bounded =
                    matches
                            .stream()
                            .limit(
                                    size
                            )
                            .toList();


            return new SearchPage(
                    matches.size(),
                    bounded
            );

        }

    }

}

import java.util.UUID;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary;

import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:tenderpilot_supplier_intelligence;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE;DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING=HIGH",
                "tenderpilot.search.enabled=false",
                "tenderpilot.search.auto-index=false",
                "tenderpilot.local-ai.enabled=false",
                "tenderpilot.rag.enabled=false"
        }
)
@ActiveProfiles(
        "test"
)
@Import(
        SupplierIntelligenceIntegrationTest
                .FakeConfiguration.class
)
class SupplierIntelligenceIntegrationTest {

    private static final UUID AWARD_1 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
            );


    private static final UUID AWARD_2 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
            );


    private static final UUID AWARD_3 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
            );


    private static final UUID TENDER_1 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
            );


    private static final UUID TENDER_2 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
            );


    private static final UUID TENDER_3 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
            );


    private static final UUID BUYER_1 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18200000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
            );


    private static final UUID BUYER_2 =
            UUID.fromString(
                    "18200000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
            );


    @Autowired
    private SupplierIntelligenceService
            service;


    @Test
    void supplierSearchBuildsPublicAwardProfile() {

        var suppliers =
                service.search(
                        "Alpha",
                        "FR",
                        20
                );


        assertThat(
                suppliers
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        var supplier =
                suppliers.getFirst();


        assertThat(
                supplier.name()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "Supplier Alpha"
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.awardCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        3
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.uniqueBuyerCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        2
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.repeatBuyerSignal()
        )
                .isTrue();


        assertThat(
                supplier.topBuyerSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        67
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.buyerHhi()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        5556
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.buyerConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BuyerConcentration.CONCENTRATED
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.topCpvSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        67
                );


        assertThat(
                supplier.cpvSpecialization()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        CpvSpecialization.FOCUSED
                );
    }


    @Test
    void detailContainsBuyerCpvCoAwardAndRecentAwardLandscape() {

        String supplierKey =
                service
                        .search(
                                "Alpha",
                                "FR",
                                20
                        )
                        .getFirst()
                        .supplierKey();


        var detail =
                service.detail(
                        supplierKey
                );


        assertThat(
                detail.topBuyers()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        2
                );


        assertThat(
                detail
                        .topBuyers()
                        .getFirst()
                        .awardCount()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        2
                );


        assertThat(
                detail.topCpvs()
        )
                .isNotEmpty();


        assertThat(
                detail.coAwardSuppliers()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                detail
                        .coAwardSuppliers()
                        .getFirst()
                        .name()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "Supplier Beta"
                );


        assertThat(
                detail.recentAwards()
        )
                .hasSize(
                        3
                );


        assertThat(
                detail
                        .recentAwards()
                        .stream()
                        .anyMatch(
                                recent ->
                                        recent.jointAward()
                        )
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    @Test
    void countryFilterUsesObservedBuyerCountry() {

        assertThat(
                service.search(
                        "Alpha",
                        "FR",
                        20
                )
        )
                .hasSize(
                        1
                );


        assertThat(
                service.search(
                        "Alpha",
                        "BE",
                        20
                )
        )
                .isEmpty();
    }


    @Test
    void unknownSupplierKeyReturnsResourceNotFound() {

        String unknown =
                java.util.Base64
                        .getUrlEncoder()
                        .withoutPadding()
                        .encodeToString(
                                "Unknown Supplier"
                                        .getBytes(
                                                java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                        )
                        );


        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        service.detail(
                                unknown
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                );
    }


    @TestConfiguration
    static class FakeConfiguration {

        @Bean
        @Primary
        SupplierObservationGateway supplierObservationGateway() {

            return new FakeSupplierObservationGateway();
        }

    }


    static class FakeSupplierObservationGateway
            implements SupplierObservationGateway {

        private final List<SupplierAwardObservation> observations =
                List.of(
                        observation(
                                "Supplier Alpha",
                                AWARD_1,
                                TENDER_1,
                                BUYER_1,
                                "Ville A",
                                "Paris",
                                LocalDate.of(
                                        2026,
                                        8,
                                        1
                                ),
                                "100000"
                        ),

                        observation(
                                "Supplier Alpha",
                                AWARD_2,
                                TENDER_2,
                                BUYER_1,
                                "Ville A",
                                "Paris",
                                LocalDate.of(
                                        2026,
                                        7,
                                        1
                                ),
                                "200000"
                        ),

                        observation(
                                "Supplier Alpha",
                                AWARD_3,
                                TENDER_3,
                                BUYER_2,
                                "Métropole B",
                                "Lyon",
                                LocalDate.of(
                                        2026,
                                        6,
                                        1
                                ),
                                "300000"
                        )
                );


        @Override
        public List<String> searchSupplierNames(
                String query,
                String buyerCountry,
                int limit
        ) {

            if (
                    buyerCountry != null
                    &&
                    !buyerCountry.equalsIgnoreCase(
                            "FR"
                    )
            ) {

                return List.of();
            }


            if (
                    query != null
                    &&
                    !(
                            "Supplier Alpha"
                                    .toLowerCase()
                                    .contains(
                                            query
                                                    .toLowerCase()
                                    )
                    )
            ) {

                return List.of();
            }


            return List.of(
                    "Supplier Alpha"
            );
        }


        @Override
        public List<SupplierAwardObservation> observationsBySupplier(
                String supplierName
        ) {

            if (
                    supplierName.equalsIgnoreCase(
                            "Supplier Alpha"
                    )
            ) {

                return observations;
            }


            return List.of();
        }


        @Override
        public List<SupplierAwardParty> suppliersForAwards(
                Collection<UUID> awardIds
        ) {

            List<SupplierAwardParty> result =
                    new ArrayList<>();


            for (
                    UUID awardId :
                    awardIds
            ) {

                result.add(
                        new SupplierAwardParty(
                                awardId,
                                "Supplier Alpha"
                        )
                );


                if (
                        awardId.equals(
                                AWARD_1
                        )
                ) {

                    result.add(
                            new SupplierAwardParty(
                                    awardId,
                                    "Supplier Beta"
                            )
                    );
                }
            }


            return List.copyOf(
                    result
            );
        }


        @Override
        public List<SupplierTenderCpv> cpvsForTenders(
                Collection<UUID> tenderIds
        ) {

            List<SupplierTenderCpv> result =
                    new ArrayList<>();


            for (
                    UUID tenderId :
                    tenderIds
            ) {

                if (
                        tenderId.equals(
                                TENDER_1
                        )
                        ||
                        tenderId.equals(
                                TENDER_2
                        )
                ) {

                    result.add(
                            new SupplierTenderCpv(
                                    tenderId,
                                    "45453000",
                                    "Overhaul and refurbishment work"
                            )
                    );


                } else if (
                        tenderId.equals(
                                TENDER_3
                        )
                ) {

                    result.add(
                            new SupplierTenderCpv(
                                    tenderId,
                                    "45210000",
                                    "Building construction work"
                            )
                    );
                }
            }


            return List.copyOf(
                    result
            );
        }


        private static SupplierAwardObservation observation(
                String supplierName,
                UUID awardId,
                UUID tenderId,
                UUID buyerId,
                String buyerName,
                String buyerCity,
                LocalDate publicationDate,
                String amount
        ) {

            return new SupplierAwardObservation(
                    supplierName,
                    awardId,
                    tenderId,
                    buyerId,
                    buyerName,
                    "FR",
                    buyerCity,
                    "Public contract "
                            +
                            tenderId,
                    "AWARDED",
                    publicationDate,
                    new BigDecimal(
                            amount
                    ),
                    "EUR"
            );
        }

    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/test/java/com/tenderpilot/supplierintelligence/SupplierKeyCodecTest.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import com.tenderpilot.common.domain.InvalidRequestException;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application.SupplierKeyCodec;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SupplierKeyCodecTest {

    private final SupplierKeyCodec codec =
            new SupplierKeyCodec();


    @Test
    void supplierNameRoundTripsThroughUrlSafeKey() {

        String key =
                codec.encode(
                        "Entreprise Générale Bâtiment"
                );


        assertThat(
                key
        )
                .doesNotContain(
                        "/"
                )
                .doesNotContain(
                        "+"
                );


        assertThat(
                codec.decode(
                        key
                )
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "Entreprise Générale Bâtiment"
                );
    }


    @Test
    void whitespaceIsNormalizedBeforeEncoding() {

        String key =
                codec.encode(
                        "  Supplier    Alpha   France "
                );


        assertThat(
                codec.decode(
                        key
                )
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "Supplier Alpha France"
                );
    }


    @Test
    void invalidKeyIsRejected() {

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () ->
                        codec.decode(
                                "###invalid###"
                        )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        InvalidRequestException.class
                );
    }

}

===== FILE: ./backend/src/test/java/com/tenderpilot/supplierintelligence/SupplierLandscapeAnalyzerTest.java =====
package com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.application.SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer;

import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.BuyerConcentration;
import com.tenderpilot.supplierintelligence.domain.CpvSpecialization;

import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SupplierLandscapeAnalyzerTest {

    private final SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer analyzer =
            new SupplierLandscapeAnalyzer();


    @Test
    void noBuyerOrCpvHistoryProducesUnknownSignals() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        0,
                        Map.of(),
                        Map.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.buyerConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BuyerConcentration.UNKNOWN
                );


        assertThat(
                result.cpvSpecialization()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        CpvSpecialization.UNKNOWN
                );


        assertThat(
                result.repeatBuyerSignal()
        )
                .isFalse();
    }


    @Test
    void dominantBuyerCreatesConcentrationSignal() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        10,

                        Map.of(
                                "buyer-a",
                                8,

                                "buyer-b",
                                2
                        ),

                        Map.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topBuyerSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        80
                );


        assertThat(
                result.buyerHhi()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        6800
                );


        assertThat(
                result.buyerConcentration()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        BuyerConcentration.CONCENTRATED
                );
    }


    @Test
    void repeatedBuyerWithThreeAwardsCreatesRepeatBuyerSignal() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        3,

                        Map.of(
                                "buyer-a",
                                2,

                                "buyer-b",
                                1
                        ),

                        Map.of()
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topBuyerSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        67
                );


        assertThat(
                result.repeatBuyerSignal()
        )
                .isTrue();
    }


    @Test
    void dominantCpvCreatesSpecializedSupplierSignal() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        5,

                        Map.of(),

                        Map.of(
                                "45453000",
                                4,

                                "45210000",
                                1
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topCpvSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        80
                );


        assertThat(
                result.cpvSpecialization()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        CpvSpecialization.SPECIALIZED
                );
    }


    @Test
    void balancedCpvHistoryIsBroad() {

        var result =
                analyzer.analyze(
                        4,

                        Map.of(),

                        Map.of(
                                "A",
                                1,

                                "B",
                                1,

                                "C",
                                1,

                                "D",
                                1
                        )
                );


        assertThat(
                result.topCpvSharePercentage()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        25
                );


        assertThat(
                result.cpvSpecialization()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        CpvSpecialization.BROAD
                );
    }

}

package com.tenderpilot.system.api;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import com.tenderpilot.system.application.SystemStatusService;
import com.tenderpilot.system.domain.DependencyStatus;
import com.tenderpilot.system.domain.SystemStatus;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SystemStatusControllerTest {

    @Test
    void delegatesStatusRequestToApplicationService() {

        SystemStatusService service =
                mock(
                        SystemStatusService.class
                );


        SystemStatus expected =

                new SystemStatus(

                        "TenderPilot",

                        "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT",

                        "test",

                        Instant.parse(
                                "2026-09-09T12:00:00Z"
                        ),

                        List.of(

                                new DependencyStatus(

                                        "PostgreSQL",

                                        "UP",

                                        "Schema version 1"

                                )

                        )

                );


        when(
                service.currentStatus()
        )
                .thenReturn(
                        expected
                );


        SystemStatusController controller =

                new SystemStatusController(
                        service
                );


        assertThat(
                controller.status()
        )
                .isSameAs(
                        expected
                );

    }

}

"use client";


import {

  ArrowRight,

  LoaderCircle,

  LockKeyhole,

  Mail,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link
  from "next/link";


import {

  useRouter,

} from "next/navigation";


import {

  type FormEvent,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  AuthShell,

} from "@/components/auth/auth-shell";


import {

  ApiHttpError,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-api";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


export default function LoginPage() {

  const router =
    useRouter();


  const {

    login,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    email,

    setEmail,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    password,

    setPassword,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    pending,

    setPending,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  async function submit(
    event:
      FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event.preventDefault();


    setPending(
      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      await login({

        email,

        password,

      });


      router.replace(
        "/dashboard",
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(

        cause instanceof ApiHttpError

          ? cause.message

          : "Unable to sign in. Please try again.",

      );


    } finally {

      setPending(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  return (

    <AuthShell

      eyebrow="
        Welcome back
      "

      title="
        Sign in to TenderPilot
      "

      description="
        Access your organization's procurement intelligence workspace.
      "

    >

      <form
        onSubmit={
          submit
        }
        className="
          space-y-5
        "
      >

        {
          error

            ? (

              <div
                className="
                  rounded-xl
                  border
                  border-red-200
                  bg-red-50
                  px-4
                  py-3
                  text-sm
                  text-red-700
                "
              >

                {
                  error
                }

              </div>

            )

            : null
        }


        <label
          className="
            block
          "
        >

          <span
            className="
              text-sm
              font-medium
              text-slate-700
            "
          >

            Email address

          </span>


          <div
            className="
              relative
              mt-2
            "
          >

            <Mail
              className="
                absolute
                left-3.5
                top-1/2
                size-4
                -translate-y-1/2
                text-slate-400
              "
            />


            <input

              type="email"

              autoComplete="email"

              required

              value={
                email
              }

              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  setEmail(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }

              placeholder="
                you@company.com
              "

"use client";


import {

  ArrowRight,

  Building2,

  LoaderCircle,

  LockKeyhole,

  Mail,

  UserRound,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link
  from "next/link";


import {

  useRouter,

} from "next/navigation";


import {

  type FormEvent,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  AuthShell,

} from "@/components/auth/auth-shell";


import {

  ApiHttpError,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-api";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


function inputClassName() {

  return `
    h-12
    w-full
    rounded-xl
    border
    border-slate-200
    bg-white
    pl-10
    pr-4
    text-sm
    text-slate-900
    outline-none
    transition
    placeholder:text-slate-400
    focus:border-[#2f6fed]
    focus:ring-4
    focus:ring-blue-500/10
  `;

}


export default function RegisterPage() {

  const router =
    useRouter();


  const {

    register,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    fullName,

    setFullName,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    organizationName,

    setOrganizationName,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    email,

    setEmail,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    password,

    setPassword,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    pending,

    setPending,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  async function submit(
    event:
      FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event.preventDefault();


    setPending(
      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      await register({

        fullName,

        organizationName,

        email,

        password,

      });


      router.replace(
        "/dashboard",
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(

        cause instanceof ApiHttpError

          ? cause.message

          : "Unable to create your TenderPilot workspace.",

      );


    } finally {

      setPending(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  return (

    <AuthShell

      eyebrow="
        Create workspace
      "

      title="
        Start your TenderPilot organization
      "

      description="
        Your first account becomes the organization owner. You can build the procurement profile in the next development phase.
      "

    >

      <form
        onSubmit={
          submit
        }
        className="
          space-y-4
        "
      >

        {
          error

            ? (

              <div
                className="
                  rounded-xl
                  border
                  border-red-200
                  bg-red-50
                  px-4
                  py-3
                  text-sm
                  text-red-700
                "
              >

                {
                  error
                }

              </div>

            )

            : null
        }


        <label
          className="
            block
          "
        >

          <span
            className="
              text-sm
              font-medium
              text-slate-700
            "
          >

            Your name

          </span>


          <div
            className="
              relative
              mt-2
            "
          >

            <UserRound
              className="
                absolute
                left-3.5
                top-1/2
                size-4
                -translate-y-1/2
                text-slate-400
              "
            />


            <input

              required

              maxLength={
                160
              }

              value={
                fullName
              }

              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  setFullName(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }

              placeholder="
                Julie Martin
              "

              className={
                inputClassName()
              }

            />

          </div>

        </label>


        <label
          className="
            block
          "
        >

          <span
            className="
              text-sm
              font-medium
              text-slate-700
            "
          >

            Organization

          </span>


          <div
            className="
              relative
              mt-2
            "
          >

            <Building2
              className="
                absolute
                left-3.5
                top-1/2
                size-4
                -translate-y-1/2
                text-slate-400
              "
            />


            <input

              required

              maxLength={
                180
              }

              value={
                organizationName
              }

              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  setOrganizationName(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }

              placeholder="

function DecisionBadge({

  value,

}: {

  value:
    string;

}) {

  const classes =
    value ===
    "GO"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
      : value ===
        "HOLD"
        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
        : value ===
          "NO_GO"
          ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
          : "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${classes}
        `
      }
    >
      {
        value.replace(
          "_",
          "-",
        )
      }
    </span>

  );

}


function ReadinessBadge({

  value,

  label,

}: {

  value:
    string;

  label:
    string;

}) {

  const classes =
    value ===
    "READY"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
      : value ===
        "AT_RISK"
        ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
        : value ===
          "REVIEW"
          ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
          : value ===
            "DECISION"
            ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"
            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          whitespace-nowrap
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${classes}
        `
      }
    >
      {
        label
      }
    </span>

  );

}


function AlertMarker({

  severity,

}: {

  severity:
    string;

}) {

  if (
    severity ===
    "CRITICAL"
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          size-10
          shrink-0
          place-items-center
          rounded-xl
          bg-red-50
          text-red-600
        "
      >
        <AlertOctagon
          className="size-4"
        />
      </div>

    );

  }


  if (
    severity ===
    "HIGH"
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          size-10
          shrink-0
          place-items-center
          rounded-xl
          bg-amber-50
          text-amber-600
        "
      >
        <TriangleAlert
          className="size-4"
        />
      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        grid
        size-10
        shrink-0
        place-items-center
        rounded-xl
        bg-blue-50
        text-blue-600
      "
    >
      <BellRing
        className="size-4"
      />
    </div>

  );

}


function MarketSignal({

  label,

  value,

}: {

  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <div>

      <p
        className="
          text-[9px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.08em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-sm
          font-semibold
        "
      >
        {
          value
        }
      </p>

    </div>

  );

}

    Icon,

    LucideIcon;

      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          items-center
          gap-3
        "
      >

        <Icon
          className="
            size-5
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />


        <h3
          className="
            text-base
            font-semibold
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          {
            title
          }
        </h3>

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-5

          py-1
          text-[10px]

      }

      {
        value
      }

  );

}

    3,

    3,

    3,

  resourceCapacity:
    3,

  riskConfidence:

    "",

  keyRisks:
    "",

  assumptions:
    "",

};


export default function BidDecisionWorkspacePage() {

    useParams<{
      tenderId:
        string;
    }>();

    params.tenderId;


  const {

    api,

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    workspace,

    setWorkspace,

  ] = useState<
    BidDecisionWorkspace
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    form,

    setForm,

  ] = useState<AssessmentForm>(
    INITIAL_FORM,
  );

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );

    saving,

    setSaving,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    |
    "REOPEN"

    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    error,

    string

  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<BidDecisionWorkspace>(
        `/api/v1/bid-decisions/${tenderId}`,
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setWorkspace(
              result,
            );


            if (
              result.decision
            ) {

              setForm({
                strategicFit:
                  result.decision.strategicFit,

                capabilityConfidence:
                  result.decision.capabilityConfidence,

                commercialAttractiveness:
                  result.decision.commercialAttractiveness,

                deliveryFeasibility:
                  result.decision.deliveryFeasibility,

                resourceCapacity:
                  result.decision.resourceCapacity,

                riskConfidence:
                  result.decision.riskConfidence,

                rationale:
                  result.decision.rationale
                  ??
                  "",

                keyRisks:
                  result.decision.keyRisks
                  ??
                  "",

                assumptions:
                  result.decision.assumptions
                  ??
                  "",
              });

            }

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,

            if (

                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load bid-decision workspace.",
              );

          },
        )
        .finally(

            if (

            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

    setSaving(
      true,

      null,
    );

        await api<BidDecisionWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-decisions/${tenderId}/assessment`,
          {
            method:
              "PUT",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                form,
              ),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to save bid assessment.",
      );

      setSaving(
        false,
      );

    }

  const {

  const [

    queue,

    setQueue,

  ] = useState<BidDecisionQueueItem[]>(
    [],
  );


  const [

    overview,

    setOverview,

  ] = useState<BidDecisionOverview | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [

    minimumMatchScore,

    setMinimumMatchScore,

  ] = useState(
    "55",
  );


  const [

    includeBlocked,

    setIncludeBlocked,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<string | null>(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      const params =
        new URLSearchParams();


      if (
        minimumMatchScore
      ) {

        params.set(
          "minMatchScore",
          minimumMatchScore,
        );

      }


      if (
        includeBlocked
      ) {

        params.set(
          "includeBlocked",
          "true",
        );

        api<BidDecisionQueueItem[]>(
