import type {

  BidWorkspace,

} from "@/features/bid-workspace/bid-workspace-types";


import type {

  BidDocumentAiAnalysis,

  LocalAiStatus,

} from "@/features/local-ai/local-ai-types";


import {

  formatEnum,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-format";


export default function LocalAiDocumentAnalysisPage() {

  const params =
    useParams<{
      tenderId:
        string;
    }>();


  const tenderId =
    params.tenderId;


  const {

    api,

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    workspace,

    setWorkspace,

  ] = useState<
    BidWorkspace
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    localAi,

    setLocalAi,

  ] = useState<
    LocalAiStatus
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    analyses,

    setAnalyses,

  ] = useState<
    BidDocumentAiAnalysis[]
  >(
    [],
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    activeDocument,

    setActiveDocument,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    "ALL"
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    promoting,

    setPromoting,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      Promise.all([

        api<BidWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`,
        ),

        api<LocalAiStatus>(
          "/api/v1/local-ai/status",
        ),

        api<BidDocumentAiAnalysis[]>(
          `/api/v1/local-ai/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/analyses`,
        ),

      ])
        .then(
          (
            [
              workspaceResult,
              aiResult,
              analysisResult,
            ],
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setWorkspace(
              workspaceResult,
            );


            setLocalAi(
              aiResult,
            );


            setAnalyses(
              analysisResult,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load local AI analysis.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
      tenderId,
    ],
  );


  async function analyzeDocument(
    documentId:
      string,
  ) {

    setActiveDocument(
      documentId,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<BidDocumentAiAnalysis>(
          `/api/v1/local-ai/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/documents/${documentId}/analyze`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setAnalyses(
        (
          current,
        ) =>
          current.map(
            (
              analysis,
            ) =>
              analysis.documentId ===
              documentId
                ? result
                : analysis,
          ),
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Local AI analysis failed.",
      );


    } finally {

      setActiveDocument(
        null,
      );

    }

  }


  async function analyzeAll() {

    setActiveDocument(
      "ALL",
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<BidDocumentAiAnalysis[]>(
          `/api/v1/local-ai/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/analyze-all`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setAnalyses(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to analyze all supported documents.",
      );


    } finally {

      setActiveDocument(
        null,
      );

    }

  }


  async function promoteFinding(
    analysis:
      BidDocumentAiAnalysis,
    findingIndex:
      number,
  ) {

    const finding =
      analysis.findings[
        findingIndex
      ];


    if (
      finding ===
      undefined
    ) {
      return;
    }


    const key =
      `${analysis.documentId}-${findingIndex}`;


    setPromoting(
      key,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/requirements`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                title:
                  finding.title,

                description:
                  finding.detail,

                category:
                  finding.requirementCategory
                  ??
                  "OTHER",

                mandatory:
                  finding.mandatory
                  ??
                  false,

                sourceDocumentId:
                  analysis.documentId,

                sourceReference:
                  finding.evidenceSnippet,

                dueDate:
                  null,

                assignedTo:
                  null,

                evidenceNotes:
                  "Created from local AI document analysis. Human review required.",
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to create requirement from AI finding.",
      );


    } finally {

      setPromoting(
        null,
      );

    }

  }


  const canAnalyze =
    workspace?.writable ===
      true
    &&
    (
      user?.role ===
        "OWNER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "BID_MANAGER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "ANALYST"
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]
          place-items-center
        "
      >

        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <Link
        href={
          `/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`
        }
        className="
          inline-flex
          items-center
          gap-2
          text-sm
          font-semibold
          text-slate-600
        "
      >

        <ArrowLeft
          className="size-4"
        />

        Preparation workspace

      </Link>


      <div
        className="
          mt-6
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Local AI
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Document analysis
          </h1>


          <p
            className="
              mt-3
              max-w-3xl
              text-sm
              leading-6
              text-slate-500
            "
          >
            Extract procurement requirements, risks,
            deadlines, qualifications and deliverables
            locally with Ollama. Uploaded document content
            remains inside the TenderPilot environment.
          </p>

        </div>


        {
          canAnalyze

            ? (

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={
                  () => {
                    void analyzeAll();
                  }
                }
                disabled={
                  activeDocument !==
                  null
                  ||
                  !localAi?.reachable
                  ||
                  !localAi.modelAvailable
                }
                className="
                  inline-flex
                  h-11
                  items-center
                  justify-center
                  gap-2
                  rounded-xl
                  bg-[#14213d]
                  px-5
                  text-sm
                  font-semibold
                  text-white
                  disabled:opacity-40
                "
              >

                {
                  activeDocument ===
                  "ALL"

                    ? (

                      <LoaderCircle
                        className="
                          size-4
                          animate-spin
                        "
                      />

                    )

                    : (

                      <Sparkles
                        className="size-4"
                      />

                    )
                }

                Analyze all documents

              </button>

            )

            : null
        }

      </div>


      {
        localAi

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-7
                grid
                gap-4
                md:grid-cols-3
              "
            >

              <StatusCard
                icon={Server}
                label="Ollama"
                value={
                  localAi.reachable
                    ? "Reachable"
                    : "Offline"
                }
                detail={
                  localAi.baseUrl
                }
              />


              <StatusCard
                icon={Bot}
                label="Model"
                value={
                  localAi.model
                }
                detail={
                  localAi.modelAvailable
                    ? "Available locally"
                    : "Model not installed"
                }
              />


              <StatusCard
                icon={ShieldCheck}
                label="Data boundary"
                value="Local only"
                detail="Organization-private"
              />

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        localAi
        &&
        localAi.reachable
        &&
        !localAi.modelAvailable

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-amber-200
                bg-amber-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-amber-900
              "
            >

              <p
                className="font-semibold"
              >
                Local model is not installed.
              </p>


              <p
                className="mt-2"
              >
                Prepare it locally with:
              </p>


              <code
                className="
                  mt-2
                  block
                  rounded-lg
                  bg-white
                  px-3
                  py-2
                  font-mono
                  text-xs
                "
              >
                ./scripts/prepare-local-ai.sh
              </code>

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                items-start
                gap-3
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >

              <TriangleAlert
                className="
                  mt-0.5
                  size-5
                  shrink-0
                "
              />

              {
                error
              }

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        workspace
        &&
        !workspace.writable

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                gap-3
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-amber-200
                bg-amber-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-amber-800
              "
            >

              <AlertTriangle
                className="
                  size-5
                  shrink-0
                "
              />

              Local AI writes are locked because the
              bid decision is NO-GO. Existing analysis
              remains readable.

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      <div
        className="
          mt-7
          space-y-5
        "
      >

        {
          analyses.map(
            (
              analysis,
            ) => (

              <article
                key={
                  analysis.documentId
                }
                className="
                  overflow-hidden
                  rounded-3xl
                  border
                  border-slate-200
                  bg-white
                "
              >

                <div
                  className="
                    flex
                    flex-col
                    gap-5
                    p-6
                    xl:flex-row
                    xl:items-start
                    xl:justify-between
                  "
                >

                  <div
                    className="
                      min-w-0
                      flex-1
                    "
                  >

                    <div
                      className="
                        flex
                        flex-wrap
                        items-center
                        gap-2
                      "
                    >

                      <AnalysisStatus
                        status={
                          analysis.status
                        }
                      />


                      <span
                        className="
                          rounded-full
                          bg-slate-100
                          px-2.5
                          py-1
                          text-[10px]
                          font-semibold
                          text-slate-600
                        "
                      >
                        {
                          formatEnum(
                            analysis.documentCategory,
                          )
                        }
                      </span>


                      {
                        analysis.confidence !==
                        null

                          ? (

                            <span
                              className="
                                rounded-full
                                bg-violet-50
                                px-2.5
                                py-1
                                text-[10px]
                                font-semibold
                                text-violet-700
                              "
                            >
                              Confidence
                              {" "}
                              {
                                analysis.confidence
                              }
                              %
                            </span>

                          )

                          : null
                      }

                    </div>


                    <div
                      className="
                        mt-4
                        flex
                        items-center
                        gap-3
                      "
                    >

                      <FileSearch
                        className="
                          size-5
                          shrink-0
                          text-[#2f6fed]
                        "
                      />


                      <h2
                        className="
                          truncate
                          text-lg
                          font-semibold
                          text-slate-950
                        "
                      >
                        {
                          analysis.filename
                        }
                      </h2>

                    </div>


                    {
                      analysis.summary

                        ? (

                          <p
                            className="
                              mt-4
                              max-w-4xl
                              text-sm
                              leading-6
                              text-slate-600
                            "
                          >
                            {
                              analysis.summary
                            }
                          </p>

                        )

                        : null
                    }


                    {
                      analysis.errorMessage

                        ? (

                          <div
                            className="
                              mt-4
                              rounded-xl
                              bg-red-50
                              p-3
                              text-xs
                              leading-5
                              text-red-700
                            "
                          >
                            {
                              analysis.errorMessage
                            }
                          </div>

                        )

                        : null
                    }


                    {
                      analysis.extractedCharacterCount !==
                      null

                        ? (

                          <p
                            className="
                              mt-4
                              text-xs
                              text-slate-400
                            "
                          >
                            Extracted
                            {" "}
                            {
                              analysis.extractedCharacterCount
                                .toLocaleString()
                            }
                            {" "}
                            characters
                            {
                              analysis.extractionTruncated
                                ? " · extraction capped"
                                : ""
                            }
                            {
                              analysis.detectedMediaType
                                ? ` · ${analysis.detectedMediaType}`
                                : ""
                            }
                          </p>

                        )

                        : null
                    }

                  </div>


                  {
                    canAnalyze

                      ? (

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={
                            () => {
                              void analyzeDocument(
                                analysis.documentId,
                              );
                            }
                          }
                          disabled={
                            activeDocument !==
                            null
                            ||
                            !localAi?.reachable
                            ||
                            !localAi.modelAvailable
                          }
                          className="
                            inline-flex
                            h-10
                            shrink-0
                            items-center
                            justify-center
                            gap-2
                            rounded-xl
                            border
                            border-slate-200
                            bg-white
                            px-4
                            text-sm
                            font-semibold
                            text-slate-700
                            disabled:opacity-40
                          "
                        >

                          {
                            activeDocument ===
                            analysis.documentId

                              ? (

                                <LoaderCircle
                                  className="
                                    size-4
                                    animate-spin
                                  "
                                />

                              )

                              : (

                                <RefreshCw
                                  className="size-4"
                                />

                              )
                          }

                          {
                            analysis.status ===
                            "NOT_ANALYZED"
                              ? "Analyze"
                              : "Re-analyze"
                          }

                        </button>

                      )

                      : null
                  }

                </div>


                {
                  analysis.findings.length >
                  0

                    ? (

                      <div
                        className="
                          border-t
                          border-slate-100
                          bg-slate-50/50
                          p-6
                        "
                      >

                        <p
                          className="
                            text-[10px]
                            font-semibold
                            uppercase
                            tracking-[0.14em]
                            text-slate-400
                          "
                        >
                          Structured findings
                        </p>


                        <div
                          className="
                            mt-4
                            grid
                            gap-3
                            lg:grid-cols-2
                          "
                        >

                          {
                            analysis.findings.map(
                              (
                                finding,
                                index,
                              ) => {

                                const promotionKey =
                                  `${analysis.documentId}-${index}`;


                                return (

                                  <div
                                    key={
                                      promotionKey
                                    }
                                    className="
                                      rounded-2xl
                                      border
                                      border-slate-200
                                      bg-white
                                      p-4
                                    "
                                  >

                                    <div
                                      className="
                                        flex
                                        flex-wrap
                                        items-center
                                        gap-2
                                      "
                                    >

                                      <span
                                        className="
                                          rounded-full
                                          bg-blue-50
                                          px-2.5
                                          py-1
                                          text-[10px]
                                          font-semibold
                                          text-blue-700
                                        "
                                      >
                                        {
                                          formatEnum(
                                            finding.type,
                                          )
                                        }
                                      </span>


                                      {
                                        finding.mandatory

                                          ? (

                                            <span
                                              className="
                                                rounded-full
                                                bg-red-50
                                                px-2.5
                                                py-1
                                                text-[10px]
                                                font-semibold
                                                text-red-700
                                              "
                                            >
                                              Mandatory
                                            </span>

                                          )

                                          : null
                                      }

                                    </div>


                                    <p
                                      className="
                                        mt-3
                                        text-sm
                                        font-semibold
                                        text-slate-900
                                      "
                                    >
                                      {
                                        finding.title
                                      }
                                    </p>


                                    <p
                                      className="
                                        mt-2
                                        text-sm
                                        leading-6
                                        text-slate-600
                                      "
                                    >
                                      {
                                        finding.detail
                                      }
                                    </p>


                                    {
                                      finding.evidenceSnippet

                                        ? (

                                          <div
                                            className="
                                              mt-3
                                              rounded-xl
                                              bg-slate-50
                                              p-3
                                              text-xs
                                              leading-5
                                              text-slate-500
                                            "
                                          >
                                            Evidence:
                                            {" "}
                                            {
                                              finding.evidenceSnippet
                                            }
                                          </div>

                                        )

                                        : null
                                    }


                                    {
                                      workspace?.writable
                                      &&
                                      (
                                        finding.type ===
                                        "REQUIREMENT"
                                        ||
                                        finding.type ===
                                        "DEADLINE"
                                        ||
                                        finding.type ===
                                        "DELIVERABLE"
                                        ||
                                        finding.type ===
                                        "QUALIFICATION"
                                      )

                                        ? (

                                          <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={
                                              () => {
                                                void promoteFinding(
                                                  analysis,
                                                  index,
                                                );
                                              }
                                            }
                                            disabled={
                                              promoting ===
                                              promotionKey
                                            }
                                            className="
                                              mt-4
                                              inline-flex
                                              h-9
                                              items-center
                                              gap-2
                                              rounded-xl
                                              border
                                              border-slate-200
                                              px-3
                                              text-xs
                                              font-semibold
                                              text-slate-700
                                              disabled:opacity-50
                                            "
                                          >

                                            {
                                              promoting ===
                                              promotionKey

                                                ? (

                                                  <LoaderCircle
                                                    className="
                                                      size-3.5
                                                      animate-spin
                                                    "
                                                  />

                                                )

                                                : (

                                                  <Plus
                                                    className="size-3.5"
                                                  />

                                                )
                                            }

                                            Add to requirements

                                          </button>

                                        )

                                        : null
                                    }

                                  </div>

                                );

                              },
                            )
                          }

                        </div>

                      </div>

                    )

                    : null
                }

              </article>

            ),
          )
        }


        {
          analyses.length ===
          0

            ? (

              <div
                className="
                  rounded-3xl
                  border
                  border-dashed
                  border-slate-300
                  bg-white
                  px-6
                  py-16
                  text-center
                "
              >

                <FileSearch
                  className="
                    mx-auto
                    size-8
                    text-slate-300
                  "
                />


                <p
                  className="
                    mt-4
                    text-sm
                    font-semibold
                    text-slate-900
                  "
                >
                  No bid documents available
                </p>


                <p
                  className="
                    mt-2
                    text-sm
                    text-slate-500
                  "
                >
                  Upload bid documents in the preparation
                  workspace before running local AI analysis.
                </p>

              </div>

            )

            : null
        }

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-6
          rounded-2xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-slate-50
          p-4
          text-xs
          leading-5
          text-slate-500
        "
      >

        <ShieldCheck
          className="
            mb-2
            size-4
            text-slate-500
          "
        />

        AI findings are decision-support suggestions.
        TenderPilot does not automatically mark requirements
        satisfied or make GO/NO-GO decisions from model output.
        Human review remains authoritative.

      </div>

    </div>

  );

}


function StatusCard({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

  detail,

}: {

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

  detail:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <div
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="
          size-4
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      />


      <p
        className="
          mt-4
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.12em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          truncate
          text-sm
          font-semibold
          text-slate-950
        "
      >
        {
          value
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          truncate
          text-xs
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          detail
        }
      </p>

    </div>

  );

}


function AnalysisStatus({

  status,

}: {

  status:
    BidDocumentAiAnalysis["status"];

}) {

  const icon =
    status ===
      "COMPLETED"
      ? CheckCircle2
      : status ===
        "FAILED"
        ? AlertTriangle
        : FileSearch;


  const Icon =
    icon;


  return (

    <span
      className="
        inline-flex
        items-center
        gap-1.5
        rounded-full
        bg-slate-100
        px-2.5
        py-1
        text-[10px]
        font-semibold
        text-slate-700
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="size-3"
      />

      {
        formatEnum(
          status,
        )
      }

    </span>

  );

  onChange:

      value:
        string,
    ) => void;

}) {

  return (

    <label>

      <span
        className="
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.1em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </span>


      <select
        value={
          value
        }
        disabled={
          disabled
        }
        onChange={
          (
            event,
          ) =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value,
            )
        }
        className="
          mt-2
          h-10
          w-full
          rounded-xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          px-2
          text-xs
          disabled:bg-slate-50
        "
      >

        {
          values.map(
            (
              item,
            ) => (

              <option
                key={
                  item
                }
                value={
                  item
                }
              >
                {
                  formatEnum(
                    item,
                  )
                }
              </option>

            ),
          )
        }

      </select>

    </label>

  );

}


function Metric({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

  detail,

}: {

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

  detail:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <article
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "

        className="
          size-4

      }

  );

  async function uploadDocument() {

    if (
      selectedFile ===
      null
    ) {

      setError(
        "Choose a document first.",
      );

      return;
    }


    if (
      selectedFile.size >

      );

  async function downloadDocument(
    documentId:
      string,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<BidDocumentContent>(
          `/api/v1/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/documents/${documentId}/content`,
        );


      const binary =
        window.atob(
          result.contentBase64,
        );


      const bytes =
        new Uint8Array(
          binary.length,
        );


      for (
        let index = 0;
        index < binary.length;
        index += 1
      ) {

        bytes[index] =
          binary.charCodeAt(
            index,
          );

      }


      const blob =
        new Blob(
          [
            bytes,
          ],
          {
            type:
              result.contentType
              ??
              "application/octet-stream",
          },
        );


      const url =
        URL.createObjectURL(
          blob,
        );


      const link =
        document.createElement(
          "a",
        );


      link.href =
        url;

      link.download =
        result.originalFilename;


      document.body.appendChild(
        link,
      );


      link.click();

      link.remove();


      URL.revokeObjectURL(
        url,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to download document.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function deleteDocument(
    documentId:
      string,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(

function fileToBase64(
  file:
    File,
) {

  return new Promise<string>(
    (
      resolve,
      reject,
    ) => {

      const reader =
        new FileReader();


      reader.onload =
        () => {

          if (
            typeof reader.result !==
            "string"
          ) {

            reject(
              new Error(
                "Unable to encode document.",
              ),
            );

            return;
          }


          const comma =
            reader.result.indexOf(
              ",",
            );


          resolve(
            comma >= 0
              ? reader.result.slice(
                  comma + 1,
                )
              : reader.result,
          );

        };


      reader.onerror =
        () => {

          reject(
            new Error(
              "Unable to read document.",
            ),
          );

        };


      reader.readAsDataURL(
        file,
      );

    },
  );

}


function formatBytes(
  bytes:
    number,
) {

  if (
    bytes <
    1024
  ) {

    return `${bytes} B`;

  }


  if (
    bytes <
    1024 * 1024
  ) {

    return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB`;

  }


  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MiB`;

}

          size-4

        "
      />

  );


  const [

    dueDate,

    setDueDate,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    submissionReference,

    setSubmissionReference,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
        `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}`,
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setWorkspace(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load bid plan.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
      tenderId,
    ],
  );


  const canEditTasks =
    workspace?.writable ===
      true
    &&
    (
      user?.role ===
        "OWNER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "BID_MANAGER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "ANALYST"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "CONTRIBUTOR"
    );


  const canEditControl =
    workspace?.writable ===
      true
    &&
    (
      user?.role ===
        "OWNER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "BID_MANAGER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "ANALYST"
    );


  const canAuthorize =
    workspace?.writable ===
      true
    &&
    (
      user?.role ===
        "OWNER"
      ||
      user?.role ===
        "BID_MANAGER"
    );


  const canDelete =
    canAuthorize;


  async function createTask() {

    if (
      title.trim() ===
      ""
    ) {

      setError(
        "Task title is required.",
      );

      return;
    }


    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/tasks`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                title,

                description,

                priority,

                milestone,

                assignedTo:
                  assignedTo
                  ||
                  null,

                dueDate:
                  dueDate
                  ||
                  null,

                requirementId:
                  null,
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


      setTitle(
        "",
      );


      setDescription(
        "",
      );


      setAssignedTo(
        "",
      );


      setDueDate(
        "",
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to create task.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function updateTaskStatus(
    taskId:
      string,
    status:
      BidTaskStatus,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/tasks/${taskId}`,
          {
            method:
              "PUT",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                status,
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to update task.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function deleteTask(
    taskId:
      string,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/tasks/${taskId}`,
          {
            method:
              "DELETE",
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to delete task.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function updateChecklist(
    key:
      | "portalReady"
      | "signaturesReady"
      | "technicalResponseReady"
      | "commercialResponseReady"
      | "administrativePackReady"
      | "finalReviewReady",
    value:
      boolean,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/submission-control`,
          {
            method:
              "PUT",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                [key]:
                  value,
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to update submission checklist.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function authorizeSubmission(
    authorized:
      boolean,
  ) {

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/submission-control/authorization`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                authorized,
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to change submission authorization.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function markSubmitted() {

    if (
      submissionReference.trim() ===
      ""
    ) {

      setError(
        "Enter the portal receipt or submission reference.",
      );

      return;
    }


    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const updated =
        await api<BidPlanningWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-planning/${tenderId}/submission-control/mark-submitted`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                submissionReference,
                notes:
                  "Submission confirmed from TenderPilot.",
              }),
          },
        );


      setWorkspace(
        updated,
      );


      setSubmissionReference(
        "",
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to mark bid submitted.",
      );


    } finally {

      setBusy(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]
          place-items-center
        "
      >

        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

      </div>

    );

  }


  if (
    workspace ===
    null
  ) {

    return (

      <div>

        <Link
          href={
            `/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`
          }
          className="
            inline-flex
            items-center
            gap-2
            text-sm
            font-semibold
            text-slate-600
          "
        >

          <ArrowLeft
            className="size-4"
          />

          Preparation workspace

        </Link>


        <div
          className="
            mt-6
            rounded-2xl
            border
            border-red-200
            bg-red-50
            p-5
            text-sm
            text-red-700
          "
        >
          {
            error
            ??
            "Bid planning workspace is unavailable."
          }
        </div>

      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1500px]
      "
    >

      <Link
        href={
          `/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`
        }
        className="
          inline-flex
          items-center
          gap-2
          text-sm
          font-semibold
          text-slate-600
        "
      >

        <ArrowLeft
          className="size-4"
        />

        Preparation workspace

      </Link>


      <div
        className="mt-6"
      >

        <p
          className="
            text-xs
            font-semibold
            uppercase
            tracking-[0.18em]
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        >
          Bid execution
        </p>


        <h1
          className="
            mt-3
            text-4xl
            font-semibold
            tracking-[-0.03em]
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          Planning & submission control
        </h1>


        <p
          className="
            mt-3
            max-w-3xl
            text-sm
            leading-6
            text-slate-500
          "
        >
          Coordinate bid tasks, monitor deadlines and blockers,
          complete submission controls, authorize release, and
          preserve the final portal submission reference.
        </p>

      </div>


      {
        !workspace.writable

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-amber-200
                bg-amber-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-amber-800
              "
            >
              {
                workspace.writeLockReason
              }
            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                gap-3
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >

              <TriangleAlert
                className="
                  size-5
                  shrink-0
                "
              />

              {
                error
              }

            </div>

          : null
      }


      <div
        className="
          mt-7
          grid
          gap-4
          md:grid-cols-2
          xl:grid-cols-4
        "
      >

        <Metric
          icon={Gauge}
          label="Submission readiness"
          value={
            `${workspace.statistics.readinessScore}%`

            workspace.statistics.readyForSubmission
              ? "Ready to submit"

          }
        />


        <Metric
          icon={ClipboardList}
          label="Tasks"

            `${workspace.statistics.completedTasks}/${workspace.statistics.totalTasks}`
          }
          detail={
            `${workspace.statistics.openTasks} open`

        />


        <Metric
          icon={Clock3}
          label="Overdue"
          value={
            workspace.statistics.overdueTasks
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${workspace.statistics.blockedTasks} blocked`
          }
        />


        <Metric
          icon={AlertOctagon}
          label="Critical open"
          value={
            workspace.statistics.criticalOpenTasks
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${workspace.complianceReadinessScore}% compliance readiness`

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-6
          grid
          gap-6
          xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]
        "
      >

        <section
          className="
            rounded-3xl
            border
            border-slate-200
            bg-white
            p-6
          "
        >

          <div
            className="
              flex
              items-center
              gap-3
            "
          >

            <ClipboardList

                size-5

              "

                "

              </h2>


              <p
                className="
                  mt-1
                  text-xs
                  text-slate-500
                "
              >
                Track ownership, milestones, deadlines and blockers.
              </p>

          {
            canEditTasks

                  className="

                    rounded-2xl
                    bg-slate-50
                    p-4
                  "

                    value={
                      title
                    }

                        setTitle(

                        )
                    }
                    placeholder="Task title"
                    className="
                      h-11
                      w-full
                      rounded-xl
                      border
                      border-slate-200
                      bg-white
                      px-3
                      text-sm
                    "
                  />


                  <textarea
                    value={
                      description
                    }
                    onChange={
                      (
                        event,
                      ) =>
                        setDescription(
                          event.target.value,
                        )
                    }
                    placeholder="Task description"
                    rows={2}
                    className="
                      mt-3
                      w-full
                      rounded-xl
                      border
                      border-slate-200
                      bg-white
                      p-3
                      text-sm
                    "
                  />


                  <div
                    className="
                      mt-3
                      grid
                      gap-3
                      md:grid-cols-2
                    "
                  >

                    <select
                      value={
                        priority
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setPriority(
                            event.target.value as BidTaskPriority,
                          )
                      }
                      className="
                        h-11
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    >

                      {
                        TASK_PRIORITIES.map(
                          (
                            value,
                          ) => (

                            <option
                              key={
                                value
                              }
                              value={
                                value
                              }
                            >
                              {
                                formatEnum(
                                  value,
                                )
                              }
                            </option>

                          ),
                        )
                      }

                    </select>


                    <select
                      value={
                        milestone
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setMilestone(
                            event.target.value as BidTaskMilestone,
                          )
                      }
                      className="
                        h-11
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    >

                      {
                        TASK_MILESTONES.map(
                          (
                            value,
                          ) => (

                            <option
                              key={
                                value
                              }
                              value={
                                value
                              }
                            >
                              {
                                formatEnum(
                                  value,
                                )
                              }
                            </option>

                          ),
                        )
                      }

                    </select>


                    <input
                      value={
                        assignedTo
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setAssignedTo(
                            event.target.value,
                          )
                      }
                      placeholder="Owner / assignee"
                      className="
                        h-11
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    />


                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={
                        dueDate
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setDueDate(
                            event.target.value,
                          )
                      }
                      className="
                        h-11
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    />

                  <button

                      disabled:opacity-50

                    <Plus
                      className="size-4"

          }


          <div
            className="
              mt-6
              space-y-3
            "
          >

            {
              workspace.tasks.map(

                    }

                      border-slate-200

                    "

                    <div
                      className="
                        flex
                        flex-col
                        gap-4
                        lg:flex-row
                        lg:items-start
                        lg:justify-between
                      "
                    >

                      <div

                          min-w-0
                          flex-1
                        "
                      >

                          className="
                            flex
                            flex-wrap
                            gap-2
                          "
                        >

                          <Badge
                            value={
                              formatEnum(
                                task.priority,
                              )
                            }
                          />


                          <Badge
                            value={
                              formatEnum(
                                task.milestone,
                              )
                            }
                          />


                          {
                            task.overdue

                              ? (

                                  className="
                                    rounded-full

                                }

                        }

                          className="
                            mt-3
                            flex
                            flex-wrap
                            gap-x-4
                            gap-y-1
                            text-xs
                            text-slate-400
                          "
                        >

                          {
                            task.assignedTo

                                  Owner:

                                  }

                          }

                                  Due:

                                  }

                  text-slate-950
                "

                Submission control

                  text-slate-500
                "

            "

              }

                ||
                busy
              }

                ) => {
                  void updateChecklist(
                    "portalReady",
                    checked,
                  );
                }
              }
            />


            <ChecklistItem
              label="Signatures / certificates ready"
              checked={
                workspace.submissionControl.signaturesReady
              }
              disabled={
                !canEditControl
                ||
                busy
              }
              onChange={
                (
                  checked,
                ) => {
                  void updateChecklist(
                    "signaturesReady",
                    checked,
                  );
                }
              }
            />


            <ChecklistItem
              label="Technical response finalized"
              checked={
                workspace.submissionControl.technicalResponseReady
              }
              disabled={
                !canEditControl
                ||
                busy
              }
              onChange={
                (
                  checked,
                ) => {
                  void updateChecklist(
                    "technicalResponseReady",

function Metric({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

  detail,

}: {

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

  detail:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <article
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="
          size-4
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      />


      <p
        className="
          mt-4
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.12em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-2xl
          font-semibold
          text-slate-950
        "
      >
        {
          value
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-xs
          text-slate-500
        "
      >
        {
          detail
        }
      </p>

    </article>

  );

}


function ChecklistItem({

  label,

  checked,

  disabled,

  onChange,

}: {

  label:
    string;

  checked:
    boolean;

  disabled:
    boolean;

  onChange:
    (
      checked:
        boolean,
    ) => void;

}) {

  return (

    <label
      className="
        flex
        items-center
        gap-3
        rounded-xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        p-3
      "
    >

      <input
        type="checkbox"
        checked={
          checked
        }
        disabled={
          disabled
        }
        onChange={
          (
            event,
          ) =>
            onChange(
              event.target.checked,
            )
        }
      />


      <span
        className="
          text-sm
          text-slate-700
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </span>

    </label>

  );

}


function GateRow({

  label,

  ready,

  value,

}: {

  label:
    string;

  ready:
    boolean;

  value:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <div
      className="
        flex
        items-center
        justify-between
        gap-4
      "
    >

      <dt
        className="
          text-slate-500
        "

        }
      </dt>


      <dd
        className="
          flex
          items-center
          gap-2
          font-semibold

        "
      >

        {

            ? (

              <CheckCircle2

            : (

        }

      </dd>

}

}

"use client";


import {

  ArrowLeft,

  Bot,

  BookOpen,

  CheckCircle2,

  Database,

  FileSearch,

  LoaderCircle,

  MessageSquareText,

  RefreshCw,

  Search,

  Server,

  ShieldCheck,

  TriangleAlert,

} from "lucide-react";


import type {

  LucideIcon,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link from "next/link";


import {

  useEffect,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  useParams,

} from "next/navigation";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


import type {

  BidWorkspace,

} from "@/features/bid-workspace/bid-workspace-types";


import type {

  BidRagAnswer,

  BidRagIndexStatus,

  BidRagRebuildResult,

  RagStatus,

} from "@/features/rag/rag-types";


export default function BidDocumentQaPage() {

  const params =
    useParams<{
      tenderId:
        string;
    }>();


  const tenderId =
    params.tenderId;


  const {

    api,

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    workspace,

    setWorkspace,

  ] = useState<
    BidWorkspace
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    ragStatus,

    setRagStatus,

  ] = useState<
    RagStatus
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    indexStatus,

    setIndexStatus,

  ] = useState<
    BidRagIndexStatus
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    history,

    setHistory,

  ] = useState<
    BidRagAnswer[]
  >(
    [],
  );


  const [

    latestAnswer,

    setLatestAnswer,

  ] = useState<
    BidRagAnswer
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    question,

    setQuestion,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    rebuilding,

    setRebuilding,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    asking,

    setAsking,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      Promise.all([

        api<BidWorkspace>(
          `/api/v1/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`,
        ),

        api<RagStatus>(
          "/api/v1/rag/status",
        ),

        api<BidRagIndexStatus>(
          `/api/v1/rag/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/index`,
        ),

        api<BidRagAnswer[]>(
          `/api/v1/rag/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/history`,
        ),

      ])
        .then(
          (
            [
              workspaceResult,
              statusResult,
              indexResult,
              historyResult,
            ],
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setWorkspace(
              workspaceResult,
            );


            setRagStatus(
              statusResult,
            );


            setIndexStatus(
              indexResult,
            );


            setHistory(
              historyResult,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load private document Q&A.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
      tenderId,
    ],
  );


  async function rebuildIndex() {

    setRebuilding(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<BidRagRebuildResult>(
          `/api/v1/rag/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}/rebuild`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setIndexStatus({
        documentCount:
          result.totalDocuments,

        indexedDocumentCount:
          result.indexedDocuments,

        chunkCount:
          result.chunks,

        ready:
          result.chunks >
          0,

        embeddingModel:
          result.embeddingModel,
      });


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to rebuild the private RAG index.",
      );


    } finally {

      setRebuilding(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function askQuestion() {

    const cleanQuestion =

      cleanQuestion.length <

    ) {

      setError(

            body:

                topK:

              }),
          },
        );

      );

    );

    &&

    &&

          grid

        "

            size-6

          "
        />

  return (

      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1400px]
      "
    >

      <Link
        href={
          `/bid-workspaces/${tenderId}`

        className="
          inline-flex
          items-center
          gap-2
          text-sm
          font-semibold
          text-slate-600
        "
      >

        <ArrowLeft
          className="size-4"
        />

        Preparation workspace

      </Link>


      <div
        className="
          mt-6
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Private RAG
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3

const MONTHS = [

  "Jan",

  "Feb",

  "Mar",

  "Apr",

  "May",

  "Jun",

  "Jul",

  "Aug",

  "Sep",

  "Oct",

  "Nov",

  "Dec",

];


export default function BuyerDetailPage() {

  const params =
    useParams<{
      buyerId:
        string;
    }>();


  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    detail,

    setDetail,

  ] = useState<
    BuyerIntelligenceDetail
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<BuyerIntelligenceDetail>(
        `/api/v1/buyers/${params.buyerId}`,
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setDetail(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load buyer intelligence.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
      params.buyerId,
    ],
  );


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]
          place-items-center
        "

          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]

        />

  }


  if (
    detail ===
    null
  ) {

          className="
            inline-flex
            items-center
            gap-2
            text-sm

            text-slate-600
          "

            mt-6
            rounded-2xl
            border
            border-red-200
            bg-red-50

            text-sm
            text-red-700
          "
        >
          {
            error
            ??
            "Buyer intelligence is unavailable."
          }
        </div>

      </div>

    );

  }


  const summary =
    detail.summary;


  const maximumMonth =
    Math.max(
      1,
      ...detail.monthlyActivity.map(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.noticeCount,
      ),
    );


  return (

      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <Link

        className="
          inline-flex
          items-center
          gap-2
          text-sm
          font-semibold
          text-slate-600
        "

        All buyers

          "
        />

          "

  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    buyers,

    setBuyers,

  ] = useState<
    BuyerIntelligenceSummary[]
  >(
    [],
  );


  const [

    query,

    setQuery,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    country,

    setCountry,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const load =
    useCallback(
      async () => {

        setLoading(
          true,
        );


        setError(
          null,
        );


        const params =
          new URLSearchParams();


        if (
          query.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "q",
            query.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          country.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "country",
            country.trim(),
          );

        }


        params.set(
          "limit",
          "60",
        );

          const result =
            await api<BuyerIntelligenceSummary[]>(
              `/api/v1/buyers?${params.toString()}`,
            );

            result,
          );

          cause
        ) {

          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ? cause.message
              : "Unable to load buyer intelligence.",
          );

          setLoading(
            false,

        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
