    setPending,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<CompanyProfile>(
        "/api/v1/company/profile",
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {

              return;

            }


            setProfile(
              result,
            );


            setForm(
              profileToForm(
                result,
              ),
            );


            if (
              !result.exists
            ) {

              setEditing(
                true,
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(

                cause instanceof Error

                  ? cause.message

                  : "Unable to load company profile.",

              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },

    [
      api,
    ],

  );


  async function submit(
    event:
      FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event.preventDefault();


    setPending(
      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const input =
        formToInput(
          form,
        );


      const result =

        await api<CompanyProfile>(

          "/api/v1/company/profile",

          {

            method:
              "PUT",

            headers: {

              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",

            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                input,
              ),

          },

        );


      setProfile(
        result,
      );


      setForm(
        profileToForm(
          result,
        ),
      );


      setEditing(
        false,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(

        cause instanceof ApiHttpError

          ? cause.message

          : cause instanceof Error

            ? cause.message

            : "Unable to save the company profile.",

      );


    } finally {

      setPending(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  function cancel() {

    if (
      profile
    ) {

      setForm(
        profileToForm(
          profile,
        ),
      );

    }


    if (
      profile?.exists
    ) {

      setEditing(
        false,
      );

    }


    setError(
      null,
    );

  }

    loading
  ) {

        "
      >

            text-center
          "
        >

            className="
              mx-auto
              size-6
              animate-spin
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          />


          <p
            className="
              mt-4
              text-sm
              text-slate-500
            "

  ) {

function Row({

}) {

function formatEnum(
  value:
    string,
) {

  return value
    .replaceAll(
      "_",
      " ",
    )
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /\b\w/g,
      (
        character,
      ) =>
        character.toUpperCase(),
    );

}


function formatRange(

  minimum:
    number
    |
    null,

  maximum:
    number
    |
    null,

  currency:
    string
    |
    null,

) {

  if (
    minimum ===
    null

    &&
    maximum ===
    null
  ) {

    return "Not configured";

  }


  return `${formatMoney(minimum, currency)} – ${formatMoney(maximum, currency)}`;

}


function formatMoney(

  value:
    number
    |
    null,

  currency:
    string
    |
    null,

) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {

    return "—";

  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(

    "en",

    {

      style:
        "currency",

      currency:
        currency
        ??
        "EUR",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        0,

    },

  ).format(
    value,
  );

}

  ] = useState<
    DashboardCommandCenter
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<DashboardCommandCenter>(
        "/api/v1/dashboard/command-center",
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setDashboard(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load the TenderPilot command center.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  const visiblePortfolio =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        dashboard?.portfolio.slice(
          0,
          10,
        )
        ??
        [],
      [
        dashboard,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[65vh]
          place-items-center
        "
      >

        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

      </div>

    );

  }


  if (
    dashboard ===
    null
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          mx-auto
          max-w-[1500px]
        "
      >

        <h1
          className="
            text-3xl
            font-semibold
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          Command center
        </h1>


        <div
          className="
            mt-6
            rounded-2xl
            border
            border-red-200
            bg-red-50
            p-5
            text-sm
            text-red-700
          "
        >
          {
            error
            ??
            "Dashboard is unavailable."
          }
        </div>

      </div>

    );

  }


  const summary =
    dashboard.summary;


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1550px]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Executive command center
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Bid portfolio dashboard
          </h1>


          <p
            className="
              mt-3
              max-w-3xl
              text-sm
              leading-6
              text-slate-500
            "
          >
            See where your organization should focus now:
            high-potential opportunities, bid decisions,
            compliance health, execution risk, submission
            readiness and approaching deadlines.
          </p>

        </div>


        <div
          className="
            flex
            flex-wrap
            gap-2
          "
        >

          <QuickLink
            href="/opportunities"
            label="Opportunities"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/matches"
            label="Matches"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/bid-decisions"
            label="Bid decisions"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/market"
            label="Market explorer"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/notifications"
            label="Notifications"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/data-operations"
            label="Data operations"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/workspace"
            label="Product map"
          />


          <QuickLink
            href="/showcase"
            label="Portfolio showcase"
          />

        </div>

      </div>


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                gap-3
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-amber-200
                bg-amber-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-amber-800
              "
            >

              <TriangleAlert
                className="
                  size-5
                  shrink-0
                "
              />

              {
                error
              }

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      <div
        className="
          mt-7
          grid
          gap-4
          md:grid-cols-2
          xl:grid-cols-4
        "
      >

        <Metric
          icon={Target}
          label="High-potential matches"
          value={
            summary.highPotentialMatches
              .toLocaleString()

          detail={
            `${summary.matchedOpportunities} total matched opportunities`
          }
        />


        <Metric
          icon={CheckCircle2}
          label="GO portfolio"
          value={
            summary.goBids
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${summary.holdBids} HOLD · ${summary.noGoBids} NO-GO`
          }
        />


        <Metric
          icon={FileCheck2}
          label="Submission ready"
          value={
            summary.submissionReadyBids
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${summary.submittedBids} already submitted`
          }
        />


        <Metric
          icon={AlertOctagon}
          label="Overdue work"
          value={
            summary.overdueTasks
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${summary.criticalOpenTasks} critical · ${summary.blockedTasks} blocked`
          }
        />

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-4
          grid
          gap-4
          md:grid-cols-2
          xl:grid-cols-4
        "
      >

        <Metric
          icon={Scale}
          label="Pending decisions"
          value={
            summary.pendingDecisionBids
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail="Matched opportunities awaiting a decision"
        />


        <Metric
          icon={ShieldCheck}
          label="Compliance ready"
          value={
            summary.complianceReadyBids
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail="Bid workspaces clearing compliance readiness"
        />


        <Metric
          icon={ClipboardCheck}
          label="Open bid tasks"
          value={
            summary.openTasks
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail="Execution work remaining across the portfolio"
        />


        <Metric
          icon={CalendarClock}
          label="Deadlines ≤ 7 days"
          value={
            summary.deadlinesNext7Days
              .toLocaleString()
          }
          detail={
            `${summary.deadlinesNext30Days} deadlines within 30 days`
          }
        />

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-6
          grid
          gap-6
          xl:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]
        "
      >

        <section
          className="
            rounded-3xl
            border
            border-slate-200
            bg-white
            p-6
          "
        >

          <div
            className="
              flex
              items-center
              justify-between
              gap-4
            "
          >

            <div>

              <p
                className="
                  text-xs
                  font-semibold
                  uppercase
                  tracking-[0.12em]
                  text-[#2f6fed]
                "
              >
                What needs attention
              </p>


              <h2
                className="
                  mt-2
                  text-xl
                  font-semibold
                  text-slate-950
                "
              >
                Operational priorities
              </h2>

            </div>


            <AlertOctagon
              className="
                size-5
                text-slate-400
              "
            />

          </div>


          <div
            className="
              mt-6
              space-y-3
            "
          >

            {
              dashboard.priorities.map(
                (
                  action,
                ) => (

                  <Link
                    key={
                      `${action.tenderId ?? "global"}-${action.type}`
                    }
                    href={
                      action.href
                    }
                    className="
                      group
                      block
                      rounded-2xl
                      border
                      border-slate-200
                      p-4
                      transition
                      hover:border-slate-300
                      hover:bg-slate-50
                    "
                  >

                    <div
                      className="
                        flex
                        items-start
                        gap-4
                      "
                    >

                      <PriorityIcon
                        priority={
                          action.priority
                        }
                      />


                      <div
                        className="
                          min-w-0
                          flex-1
                        "
                      >

                        <div
                          className="
                            flex
                            flex-wrap
                            items-center
                            gap-2
                          "
                        >

                          <PriorityBadge
                            priority={
                              action.priority
                            }
                          />


                          <span
                            className="
                              text-[10px]
                              font-semibold
                              uppercase
                              tracking-[0.08em]
                              text-slate-400
                            "
                          >
                            {
                              formatEnum(
                                action.type,
                              )
                            }
                          </span>

                        </div>


                        <p
                          className="
                            mt-2
                            text-sm
                            font-semibold
                            text-slate-900
                          "
                        >
                          {
                            action.title
                          }
                        </p>


                        <p
                          className="
                            mt-1
                            text-xs
                            leading-5
                            text-slate-500
                          "
                        >
                          {
                            action.detail
                          }
                        </p>

                      </div>


                      <ArrowRight
                        className="
                          mt-1
                          size-4
                          shrink-0
                          text-slate-300
                          transition
                          group-hover:translate-x-0.5
                        "
                      />

                    </div>

                  </Link>

                ),
              )
            }


            {
              dashboard.priorities.length ===
              0

                ? (

                  <div
                    className="
                      rounded-2xl
                      border
                      border-dashed
                      border-slate-300
                      p-10
                      text-center
                    "
                  >

                    <CheckCircle2
                      className="
                        mx-auto
                        size-7
                        text-emerald-500
                      "
                    />


                    <p
                      className="
                        mt-3
                        text-sm
                        font-semibold
                        text-slate-900
                      "
                    >
                      No immediate portfolio actions
                    </p>


                    <p
                      className="
                        mt-1
                        text-xs
                        text-slate-400
                      "
                    >
                      TenderPilot did not detect an urgent
                      action in the current matched portfolio.
                    </p>

                  </div>

                )

                : null
            }

          </div>

        </section>


        <section
          className="
            rounded-3xl
            border
            border-slate-200

            text-white
          "
        >

          <Compass
            className="
              size-5
              text-blue-300
            "
          />


          <p
            className="
              mt-5
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.12em]
              text-blue-200
            "
          >
            Public market pulse
          </p>


          <h2
            className="
              mt-2
              text-xl
              font-semibold
            "
          >
            Last 30 days
          </h2>


          {
            dashboard.market.available

              ? (

                <>

                  <div
                    className="
                      mt-6
                      grid
                      grid-cols-2
                      gap-3
                    "

                      label="Buyers"

                        dashboard.market.uniqueBuyerCount30Days
                          .toLocaleString()

                    <DarkMetric
                      label="Observed suppliers"

                        dashboard.market.uniqueObservedSupplierCount30Days
                          .toLocaleString()
                      }
                    />

                  <dl
                    className="
                      mt-6
                      space-y-3
                      text-xs
                    "
                  >

                    <DarkRow
                      label="Buyer concentration"
                      value={
                        formatEnum(
                          dashboard.market.buyerConcentration,
                        )
                      }
                    />


                    <DarkRow
                      label="Supplier concentration"
                      value={
                        formatEnum(
                          dashboard.market.supplierConcentration,
                        )
                      }
                    />


                    <DarkRow
                      label="Award coverage"
                      value={
                        `${dashboard.market.awardCoveragePercentage30Days}%`
                      }
                    />


                    <DarkRow
                      label="Leading CPV"
                      value={
                        dashboard.market.leadingCpv
                          ? `${dashboard.market.leadingCpv}${
                              dashboard.market.leadingCpvSharePercentage ===
                              null
                                ? ""
                                : ` · ${dashboard.market.leadingCpvSharePercentage}%`
                            }`
                          : "Unavailable"
                      }
                    />

                  </dl>


                  <Link
                    href="/market"
                    className="
                      mt-6
                      inline-flex
                      h-10
                      items-center
                      gap-2
                      rounded-xl
                      bg-white
                      px-4
                      text-sm
                      font-semibold
                      text-slate-900
                    "
                  >
                    Open Market Explorer

                    <ArrowRight
                      className="size-4"
                    />
                  </Link>

                </>

              )

              : (

                <div
                  className="
                    mt-6
                    rounded-2xl
                    bg-white/10
                    p-4
                    text-sm
                    leading-6
                    text-slate-200
                  "
                >
                  Public market pulse is temporarily unavailable.
                  Your private bid portfolio remains fully usable.
                </div>

              )
          }

        </section>

      </div>


      <section
        className="
          mt-6
          rounded-3xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          p-6
        "
      >

        <div
          className="
            flex
            flex-col
            gap-4
            md:flex-row
            md:items-center
            md:justify-between
          "
        >

          <div>

            <p
              className="
                text-xs
                font-semibold
                uppercase
                tracking-[0.12em]
                text-[#2f6fed]
              "
            >
              Active intelligence
            </p>


            <h2
              className="
                mt-2
                text-xl
                font-semibold
                text-slate-950
              "
            >
              Bid portfolio
            </h2>


            <p
              className="
                mt-1
                text-xs

              "
            >

          </div>


          <Link

              inline-flex
              h-10
              items-center
              gap-2

              border
              border-slate-200

              text-sm
              font-semibold
              text-slate-700
            "
          >
            View all matches

            <ArrowRight
              className="size-4"
            />
          </Link>

        </div>


        <div
          className="
            mt-6
            space-y-3
          "
        >

          {
            visiblePortfolio.map(
              (
                bid,
              ) => (

                <article
                  key={
                    bid.tenderId
                  }
                  className="
                    rounded-2xl
                    border

                    p-4
                  "
                >

                  <div
                    className="
                      flex
                      flex-col
                      gap-4
                      xl:flex-row
                      xl:items-start
                      xl:justify-between
                    "
                  >

                    <div
                      className="
                        min-w-0
                        flex-1
                      "
                    >

                      <div
                        className="
                          flex
                          flex-wrap
                          gap-2
                        "
                      >

                        <Badge
                          value={
                            `${bid.matchScore}% match`
                          }
                        />


                        <Badge
                          value={
                            formatEnum(
                              bid.matchGrade,
                            )
                          }
                        />


                        <DecisionBadge
                          outcome={

                          }
                        />


                        {
                          bid.readyForSubmission

                                  text-emerald-700
                                "
                              >
                                Submission ready
                              </span>

                            )

                        }


                        {
                          bid.submitted

                            ? (

                              <span
                                className="
                                  rounded-full
                                  bg-blue-50

                                  py-1
                                  text-[10px]
                                  font-semibold
                                  text-blue-700
                                "
                              >
                                Submitted
                              </span>

                            )

                            : null
                        }

                      </div>


                      <h3
                        className="
                          mt-3
                          text-sm
                          font-semibold

                        }

                          text-xs

                                "

                                {

                          font-semibold
                          text-slate-700

                        Workspace

                          px-3
                          text-xs

          }


          {

      >

        <CommandCard

          mt-6

function Metric({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

  detail,

}: {

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

  detail:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <article
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="
          size-4
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      />


      <p
        className="
          mt-4
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.12em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-2xl
          font-semibold
          text-slate-950
        "
      >
        {
          value
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-xs
          leading-5
          text-slate-500
        "
      >
        {
          detail
        }
      </p>

    </article>

  );

}


function QuickLink({

  href,

  label,

}: {

  href:
    string;

  label:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <Link
      href={
        href
      }
      className="
        inline-flex
        h-10
        items-center
        gap-2
        rounded-xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        px-4
        text-sm
        font-semibold
        text-slate-700
        hover:bg-slate-50
      "
    >
      {
        label
      }

      <ArrowRight
        className="size-3.5"
      />
    </Link>

  );

}


function PriorityIcon({

  priority,

}: {

  priority:

function deadlineText(
  days:
    number,
) {

  if (
    days <
    0
  ) {

    return `${Math.abs(
      days,
    )}d overdue`;

  }


  if (
    days ===
    0
  ) {

    return "due today";

  }


  return `${days}d remaining`;

}

  LucideIcon,

} from "lucide-react";

  useState,

  DataOperations,

  IngestionRunOutcome,

  SourceHealthStatus,

} from "@/features/data-operations/data-operations-types";


export default function DataOperationsPage() {

  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    operations,

    setOperations,

  ] = useState<
    DataOperations
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    refreshing,

    setRefreshing,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<DataOperations>(
        "/api/v1/data-operations?historyLimit=60",
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setOperations(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load data operations.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  async function refresh() {

    setRefreshing(
      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<DataOperations>(
          "/api/v1/data-operations?historyLimit=60",
        );


      setOperations(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to refresh source health.",
      );


    } finally {

      setRefreshing(
        false,
      );

    }

  }

    loading
  ) {

          grid
          min-h-[65vh]

            size-6

          "
        />

      </div>

function HealthBadge({

  health,

}: {

    SourceHealthStatus;

  const className =
    health ===
    "HEALTHY"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
      : health ===
        "RUNNING"
        ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"
        : health ===

          ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
          : health ===
            "STALE"
            ? "bg-orange-50 text-orange-700"
            : health ===
              "UNHEALTHY"
              ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
              : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${className}
        `
      }

      {
        formatEnum(
          health,

      }
    </span>

  );

}

function durationText(
  seconds:
    number
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    seconds ===
    null
  ) {

    return "—";

  }


  if (
    seconds <
    60
  ) {

    return `${seconds}s`;

  }


  const minutes =
    Math.floor(
      seconds /
      60,
    );


  const remainingSeconds =
    seconds %
    60;


  if (
    minutes <
    60
  ) {

    return `${minutes}m ${remainingSeconds}s`;

  }


  const hours =
    Math.floor(
      minutes /
      60,
    );


  const remainingMinutes =
    minutes %
    60;


  return `${hours}h ${remainingMinutes}m`;

}

import type {

  DecpDataSourceStatus,

  TedDataSourceStatus,

} from "@/features/data-source/ted-types";


type SourceName =
  | "TED"
  | "BOAMP"
  | "DECP";


export default function DataSourcesPage() {

  const {

    api,

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  const [
    ted,
    setTed,
  ] = useState<TedDataSourceStatus | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [
    boamp,
    setBoamp,
  ] = useState<BoampDataSourceStatus | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [
    decp,
    setDecp,
  ] = useState<DecpDataSourceStatus | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [
    syncing,
    setSyncing,
  ] = useState<SourceName | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState<string | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [
    result,
    setResult,
  ] = useState<{
    source: SourceName;
    run: DataSourceSyncResult;
  } | null>(
    null,
  );


  const [tedDays, setTedDays] =
    useState(7);

  const [tedLimit, setTedLimit] =
    useState(25);

  const [boampDays, setBoampDays] =
    useState(7);

  const [boampLimit, setBoampLimit] =
    useState(25);

  const [decpDays, setDecpDays] =
    useState(7);

  const [decpLimit, setDecpLimit] =
    useState(25);


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      Promise.all([

        api<TedDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/ted",
        ),

        api<BoampDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/boamp",
        ),

        api<DecpDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/decp",
        ),

      ])
        .then(
          (
            [
              tedResult,
              boampResult,
              decpResult,
            ],
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }

            setTed(tedResult);
            setBoamp(boampResult);
            setDecp(decpResult);
          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load data sources.",
              );
            }
          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {
              setLoading(false);
            }
          },
        );


      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
      };

    },
    [api],
  );


  async function refresh() {

    const [
      tedResult,
      boampResult,
      decpResult,
    ] =
      await Promise.all([

        api<TedDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/ted",
        ),

        api<BoampDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/boamp",
        ),

        api<DecpDataSourceStatus>(
          "/api/v1/data-sources/decp",
        ),

      ]);

    setTed(tedResult);
    setBoamp(boampResult);
    setDecp(decpResult);
  }


  async function synchronize(

    source:
      SourceName,

    days:
      number,

    limit:
      number,

  ) {

    setSyncing(source);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);

    try {

      const syncResult =
        await api<DataSourceSyncResult>(
          `/api/v1/data-sources/${source.toLowerCase()}/sync?days=${days}&limit=${limit}`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );

      setResult({
        source,
        run:
          syncResult,
      });

      await refresh();

    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : `${source} synchronization failed.`,
      );

    } finally {
      setSyncing(null);
    }
  }


  function submit(

    source:
      SourceName,

    days:
      number,

    limit:
      number,

  ) {

    return (
      event:
        FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
    ) => {

      event.preventDefault();

      void synchronize(
        source,
        days,
        limit,
      );
    };
  }


  const owner =
    user?.role ===
    "OWNER";

    loading
  ) {

        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]

        "
      >
        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />
      </div>

    );
  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Procurement ingestion
          </p>

          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Data sources
          </h1>

          <p
            className="

function formatDateTime(
  value:
    string
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return "Never";
  }


  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      value,
    ),
  );
}

        "
      >

            gap-3
          "

              place-items-center

            "
          >

          />

            label="Fair"

            value={overview.fairCount}
          />

          <GradeCard
            label="Poor"
            range="40–59"
            value={overview.poorCount}
          />

          <GradeCard
            label="Critical"
            range="0–39"
            value={overview.criticalCount}
          />

        </div>

      </section>


      <section
        className="
          mt-6
          rounded-3xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          p-6
        "
      >

        <h2
          className="
            text-base
            font-semibold
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          Structured quality findings
        </h2>


        <p
          className="
            mt-2
            max-w-3xl
            text-sm
            leading-6
            text-slate-500
          "
        >
          Every deduction is represented as a structured,
          explainable issue rather than an opaque score.
        </p>


        <div
          className="
            mt-6
            grid
            gap-4
            md:grid-cols-3
          "
        >

            "

            }

            "
          />


          <IssueMetric
            icon={Info}
            label="Information gaps"
            value={
              overview.infoIssueCount
            }
            description="
              Useful but non-blocking fields such as estimated value or source URL.
            "
          />

        </div>

      </section>

    </div>

  );
}

"use client";


import {

  BarChart3,

  Building2,

  CalendarClock,

  CircleDollarSign,

  Compass,

  Factory,

  FileSearch,

  Gauge,

  LoaderCircle,

  MapPinned,

  Search,

  ShieldCheck,

  Target,

  Users,

} from "lucide-react";


import type {

  LucideIcon,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link from "next/link";


import {

  useCallback,

  useEffect,

  useMemo,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


import {

  formatDate,

  formatEnum,

  formatMoney,

  formatValueRange,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-format";


import type {

  MarketExplorer,

} from "@/features/market-analytics/market-analytics-types";


export default function MarketExplorerPage() {

  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    market,

    setMarket,

  ] = useState<
    MarketExplorer
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    query,

    setQuery,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    country,

    setCountry,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    region,

    setRegion,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    cpv,

    setCpv,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    status,

    setStatus,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    dateFrom,

    setDateFrom,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    dateTo,

    setDateTo,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const load =
    useCallback(
      async () => {

        setLoading(
          true,
        );


        setError(
          null,
        );


        const params =
          new URLSearchParams();


        if (
          query.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "q",
            query.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          country.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "country",
            country.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          region.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "region",
            region.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          cpv.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "cpv",
            cpv.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          status.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "status",
            status.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          dateFrom !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "dateFrom",
            dateFrom,
          );

        }


        if (
          dateTo !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "dateTo",
            dateTo,
          );

        }


        try {

          const result =
            await api<MarketExplorer>(
              `/api/v1/market/explorer?${params.toString()}`,
            );


          setMarket(
            result,
          );


        } catch (
          cause
        ) {

          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ? cause.message
              : "Unable to load procurement market analytics.",
          );


        } finally {

          setLoading(
            false,
          );

        }

      },
      [
        api,
        country,
        cpv,
        dateFrom,
        dateTo,
        query,
        region,
        status,
      ],
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<MarketExplorer>(
        "/api/v1/market/explorer",
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setMarket(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load procurement market analytics.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  const maximumMonth =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        Math.max(
          1,
          ...(
            market?.monthlyTrend.map(
              (
                item,
              ) =>
                item.noticeCount,
            )
            ??
            []
          ),
        ),
      [
        market,
      ],
    );


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1500px]
      "
    >

      <div>

        <p
          className="
            text-xs
            font-semibold
            uppercase
            tracking-[0.18em]
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        >
          Shared procurement intelligence
        </p>


        <h1
          className="
            mt-3
            text-4xl
            font-semibold
            tracking-[-0.03em]
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          Procurement market explorer
        </h1>


        <p
          className="
            mt-3
            max-w-3xl
            text-sm
            leading-6
            text-slate-500
          "
        >
          Explore market activity across the normalized public
          procurement corpus by geography, CPV, publication
          period and status. Compare buyer concentration,
          observed supplier concentration, award coverage and
          procurement mix.
        </p>

      </div>


      <section
        className="
          mt-7
          rounded-3xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          p-5
        "
      >

        <div
          className="
            grid
            gap-3
            md:grid-cols-2
            xl:grid-cols-4
          "
        >

          <div
            className="
              relative
              xl:col-span-2
            "
          >

            <Search
              className="
                absolute
                left-3
                top-3.5
                size-4
                text-slate-400
              "
            />


            <input
              value={
                query
              }
              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  setQuery(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              placeholder="Opportunity or buyer"
              className="
                h-11
                w-full
                rounded-xl
                border
                border-slate-200
                pl-10
                pr-3
                text-sm
              "
            />

          </div>


          <input
            value={
              country
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setCountry(
                  event.target.value
                    .toUpperCase(),
                )
            }
            maxLength={2}
            placeholder="Country e.g. FR"
            className="
              h-11
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              px-3
              text-sm
              uppercase
            "
          />


          <input
            value={
              region
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setRegion(
                  event.target.value,
                )
            }
            placeholder="Region e.g. IDF"
            className="
              h-11
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              px-3
              text-sm
            "
          />


          <input
            value={
              cpv
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setCpv(
                  event.target.value
                    .replace(
                      /\D/g,
                      "",
                    )
                    .slice(
                      0,
                      8,
                    ),
                )
            }
            placeholder="CPV prefix"
            className="
              h-11
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              px-3
              text-sm
            "
          />


          <input
            value={
              status
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setStatus(
                  event.target.value
                    .toUpperCase(),
                )
            }
            placeholder="Status e.g. PUBLISHED"
            className="
              h-11
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              px-3
              text-sm
              uppercase
            "
          />


          <input
            type="date"
            value={
              dateFrom
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setDateFrom(
                  event.target.value,
                )
            }
            className="
              h-11

              border

            "
          />


          <input

              dateTo
            }
            onChange={
              (

                setDateTo(
                  event.target.value,
                )
            }

              h-11

              border
              border-slate-200

              font-semibold

                );

                setRegion(
                  "",
                );

                setCpv(
                  "",
                );

                setStatus(
                  "",
                );

                setDateFrom(
                  "",
                );

                setDateTo(
                  "",
                );

              }
            }
            className="
              h-10
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              px-4

function parseGrade(
  value:
    string,
):
  TenderMatchGrade
  |
  "" {

  switch (
    value
  ) {

    case "EXCELLENT":
      return "EXCELLENT";

    case "STRONG":
      return "STRONG";

    case "GOOD":
      return "GOOD";

    case "WEAK":
      return "WEAK";

    case "POOR":
      return "POOR";

    case "BLOCKED":
      return "BLOCKED";

    default:
      return "";

  }

}


function formatDateTime(
  value:
    string
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {

    return "Never";

  }


  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      value,
    ),
  );

}

  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      fetchMatchData()
        .then(
          (
            [
              matchResult,
              overviewResult,
            ],
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {

              return;

            }


            setMatches(
              matchResult,
            );


            setOverview(
              overviewResult,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load opportunity matches.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      fetchMatchData,
    ],
  );


  async function recalculate() {

    setRecalculating(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );

    setRecalculated(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<TenderMatchRecalculation>(
          "/api/v1/matches/recalculate",
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setRecalculated(
        result,
      );


      const [
        matchResult,
        overviewResult,
      ] =
        await fetchMatchData();


      setMatches(
        matchResult,
      );


      setOverview(
        overviewResult,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to recalculate opportunity matches.",
      );


    } finally {

      setRecalculating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  const canRecalculate =
    user?.role ===
      "OWNER"
    ||
    user?.role ===
      "BID_MANAGER"
    ||
    user?.role ===
      "ANALYST";


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Bid intelligence
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Opportunity matches
          </h1>


          <p
            className="
              mt-3
              max-w-3xl
              text-sm
              leading-6
              text-slate-500
            "
          >
            Explainable company-to-tender scoring across
            CPV fit, geography, contract value, buyer
            preference, capabilities, response time and
            procurement-data quality.
          </p>

        </div>


        {
          canRecalculate

            ? (

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={
                  () => {
                    void recalculate();
                  }
                }
                disabled={
                  recalculating
                }
                className="
                  inline-flex
                  h-11
                  items-center
                  justify-center
                  gap-2
                  rounded-xl
                  bg-[#14213d]
                  px-5
                  text-sm
                  font-semibold
                  text-white
                  disabled:opacity-50
                "
              >

                {
                  recalculating

                    ? (

                      <LoaderCircle
                        className="
                          size-4
                          animate-spin
                        "
                      />

                    )

                    : (

                      <RefreshCw
                        className="size-4"
                      />

                    )
                }

                {
                  recalculating
                    ? "Recalculating..."
                    : "Recalculate matches"
                }

              </button>

            )

            : null
        }

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          mt-5
        "
      >

        <Link
          href="/bid-decisions"
          className="
            inline-flex
            h-10
            items-center
            rounded-xl
            border
            border-slate-200
            bg-white
            px-4
            text-sm
            font-semibold
            text-slate-700
            hover:bg-slate-50
          "
        >
          Open Go / No-Go workspace
        </Link>

      </div>


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >
              {
                error
              }
            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        recalculated

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                items-start
                gap-3
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-emerald-200
                bg-emerald-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-emerald-800
              "
            >

              <CheckCircle2
                className="
                  mt-0.5
                  size-5
                  shrink-0
                "
              />


              <div>

                <p
                  className="font-semibold"
                >
                  Matching recalculated
                </p>


                <p
                  className="mt-1"
                >
                  {
                    recalculated.evaluatedCount
                  }
                  {" "}
                  opportunities evaluated:
                  {" "}
                  {
                    recalculated.excellentCount
                  }
                  {" "}
                  excellent,
                  {" "}
                  {
                    recalculated.strongCount
                  }
                  {" "}
                  strong and
                  {" "}
                  {
                    recalculated.blockedCount
                  }
                  {" "}
                  blocked.
                </p>

              </div>

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        overview

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-7
                grid
                gap-4
                md:grid-cols-2
                xl:grid-cols-4
              "
            >

              <Metric

              <Metric

      <section
