      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  const activeNotifications =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        center?.notifications.filter(
          (
            notification,
          ) =>
            notification.active
            &&
            notification.status !==
              "DISMISSED",
        )
        ??
        [],
      [
        center,
      ],
    );


  const history =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        center?.notifications.filter(
          (
            notification,
          ) =>
            !notification.active
            ||
            notification.status ===
              "DISMISSED",
        )
        ??
        [],
      [
        center,
      ],
    );


  async function refreshAlerts() {

    setRefreshing(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          "/api/v1/notifications/refresh",
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to refresh alerts.",
      );


    } finally {

      setRefreshing(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function createWatchlistItem() {

    if (
      targetKey.trim() ===
      ""
    ) {

      setError(
        "Enter a watchlist target.",
      );

      return;

    }


    setMutating(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          "/api/v1/notifications/watchlist",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                type:
                  watchType,

                targetKey:
                  targetKey.trim(),

                label:
                  watchLabel.trim() ===
                  ""
                    ? null
                    : watchLabel.trim(),
              }),
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );

      setTargetKey(
        "",
      );

      setWatchLabel(
        "",
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to add watchlist item.",
      );


    } finally {

      setMutating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function deleteWatchlistItem(
    id:
      string,
  ) {

    setMutating(
      true,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          `/api/v1/notifications/watchlist/${id}`,
          {
            method:
              "DELETE",
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to remove watchlist item.",
      );


    } finally {

      setMutating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function acknowledge(
    id:
      string,
  ) {

    setMutating(
      true,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          `/api/v1/notifications/${id}/acknowledge`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to acknowledge notification.",
      );


    } finally {

      setMutating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function dismiss(
    id:
      string,
  ) {

    setMutating(
      true,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          `/api/v1/notifications/${id}/dismiss`,
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to dismiss notification.",
      );


    } finally {

      setMutating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function markAllRead() {

    setMutating(
      true,
    );


    try {

      const result =
        await api<NotificationCenter>(
          "/api/v1/notifications/read-all",
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setCenter(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to mark notifications as read.",
      );


    } finally {

      setMutating(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]
          place-items-center
        "
      >

        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1500px]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Organization-private alerting
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Notifications & watchlists
          </h1>


          <p
            className="
              mt-3
              max-w-3xl
              text-sm
              leading-6
              text-slate-500
            "
          >
            Track deadlines, high-fit opportunities,
            compliance gaps, overdue bid work, submission
            readiness, strategic buyers and CPV market
            activity.
          </p>

        </div>


        <div
          className="
            flex
            flex-wrap
            gap-2
          "
        >

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={
              refreshing
            }
            onClick={
              () => {
                void refreshAlerts();
              }
            }
            className="
              inline-flex
              h-10
              items-center
              gap-2
              rounded-xl
              bg-[#14213d]
              px-4
              text-sm
              font-semibold
              text-white
              disabled:opacity-50
            "
          >

            {
              refreshing

                ? (

                  <LoaderCircle
                    className="
                      size-4
                      animate-spin
                    "
                  />

                )

                : (

                  <RefreshCcw
                    className="size-4"
                  />

                )
            }

            Refresh alerts

          </button>


          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={
              mutating
            }
            onClick={
              () => {
                void markAllRead();
              }
            }
            className="
              inline-flex
              h-10
              items-center
              gap-2
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              bg-white
              px-4
              text-sm
              font-semibold
              text-slate-700
            "
          >
            <CheckCheck
              className="size-4"
            />

            Mark all read
          </button>

        </div>

      </div>


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >
              {
                error
              }
            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        center

          ? (

            <>

              <div
                className="
                  mt-7
                  grid
                  gap-4
                  md:grid-cols-2
                  xl:grid-cols-5
                "
              >

                <Metric
                  icon={BellRing}
                  label="Active alerts"
                  value={
                    center.summary.activeCount
                  }
                />


                <Metric
                  icon={Bell}
                  label="Unread"
                  value={
                    center.summary.unreadCount
                  }
                />


                <Metric
                  icon={AlertOctagon}
                  label="Critical"
                  value={
                    center.summary.criticalCount
                  }
                />


                <Metric
                  icon={TriangleAlert}
                  label="High"
                  value={
                    center.summary.highCount
                  }
                />


                <Metric
                  icon={Eye}
                  label="Watchlist"
                  value={
                    center.summary.watchlistCount
                  }
                />

              </div>


              <div
                className="
                  mt-6
                  grid
                  gap-6
                  xl:grid-cols-[1fr_0.72fr]
                "
              >

                <section
                  className="
                    rounded-3xl
                    border
                    border-slate-200
                    bg-white
                    p-6
                  "
                >

                  <div
                    className="
                      flex
                      items-center
                      justify-between
                      gap-4
                    "
                  >

                    <div>

                      <p
                        className="
                          text-xs
                          font-semibold
                          uppercase
                          tracking-[0.12em]
                          text-[#2f6fed]
                        "
                      >
                        Action center
                      </p>


                      <h2
                        className="
                          mt-2
                          text-xl
                          font-semibold
                          text-slate-950
                        "
                      >
                        Active notifications
                      </h2>

                    </div>


                    <BellRing
                      className="
                        size-5
                        text-slate-400
                      "
                    />

                  </div>


                  <div
                    className="
                      mt-6
                      space-y-3
                    "
                  >

                    {
                      activeNotifications.map(
                        (
                          notification,
                        ) => (

                          <article
                            key={
                              notification.id
                            }
                            className="
                              rounded-2xl
                              border
                              border-slate-200
                              p-4
                            "
                          >

                            <div
                              className="
                                flex
                                items-start
                                gap-4
                              "
                            >

                              <SeverityIcon
                                severity={
                                  notification.severity
                                }
                              />


                              <div
                                className="
                                  min-w-0
                                  flex-1
                                "
                              >

                                <div
                                  className="
                                    flex
                                    flex-wrap
                                    items-center
                                    gap-2
                                  "
                                >

                                  <SeverityBadge
                                    severity={
                                      notification.severity
                                    }
                                  />


                                  <span
                                    className="
                                      text-[10px]
                                      font-semibold
                                      uppercase
                                      tracking-[0.08em]
                                      text-slate-400
                                    "
                                  >
                                    {
                                      formatEnum(
                                        notification.type,
                                      )
                                    }
                                  </span>


                                  {
                                    notification.status ===
                                    "UNREAD"

                                      ? (

                                        <span
                                          className="
                                            rounded-full
                                            bg-blue-50
                                            px-2
                                            py-0.5
                                            text-[9px]
                                            font-semibold
                                            text-blue-700
                                          "
                                        >
                                          New
                                        </span>

                                      )

                                      : null
                                  }

                                </div>


                                <p
                                  className="
                                    mt-2
                                    text-sm
                                    font-semibold
                                    text-slate-950
                                  "
                                >
                                  {
                                    notification.title
                                  }
                                </p>


                                <p
                                  className="
                                    mt-1
                                    text-xs
                                    leading-5
                                    text-slate-500
                                  "
                                >
                                  {
                                    notification.detail
                                  }
                                </p>


                                <p
                                  className="
                                    mt-2
                                    text-[10px]
                                    text-slate-400
                                  "
                                >
                                  Last observed
                                  {" "}
                                  {
                                    formatDate(
                                      notification.lastObservedAt,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </p>


                                <div
                                  className="
                                    mt-4
                                    flex
                                    flex-wrap
                                    gap-2
                                  "
                                >

                                  <Link
                                    href={
                                      notification.href
                                    }
                                    className="
                                      inline-flex
                                      h-8
                                      items-center
                                      rounded-lg
                                      bg-[#14213d]
                                      px-3
                                      text-xs
                                      font-semibold
                                      text-white
                                    "
                                  >
                                    Open
                                  </Link>


                                  {
                                    notification.status ===
                                    "UNREAD"

                                      ? (

                                        <button
                                          type="button"
                                          disabled={
                                            mutating
                                          }
                                          onClick={
                                            () => {
                                              void acknowledge(
                                                notification.id,
                                              );
                                            }
                                          }
                                          className="
                                            inline-flex
                                            h-8
                                            items-center
                                            gap-1.5
                                            rounded-lg
                                            border
                                            border-slate-200
                                            px-3
                                            text-xs
                                            font-semibold
                                            text-slate-600
                                          "
                                        >
                                          <Check
                                            className="size-3.5"
                                          />

                                          Acknowledge
                                        </button>

                                      )

                                      : null
                                  }


                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    disabled={
                                      mutating
                                    }
                                    onClick={
                                      () => {
                                        void dismiss(
                                          notification.id,
                                        );
                                      }
                                    }
                                    className="
                                      inline-flex
                                      h-8
                                      items-center
                                      gap-1.5
                                      rounded-lg
                                      border
                                      border-slate-200
                                      px-3
                                      text-xs
                                      font-semibold
                                      text-slate-500
                                    "
                                  >
                                    <X
                                      className="size-3.5"
                                    />

                                    Dismiss
                                  </button>

                                </div>

                              </div>

                            </div>

                          </article>

                        ),
                      )
                    }


                    {
                      activeNotifications.length ===
                      0

                        ? (

                          <div
                            className="
                              rounded-2xl
                              border
                              border-dashed
                              border-slate-300
                              p-10
                              text-center
                            "
                          >

                            <CheckCheck
                              className="
                                mx-auto
                                size-7
                                text-emerald-500
                              "
                            />


                            <p
                              className="
                                mt-3
                                text-sm
                                font-semibold
                                text-slate-900
                              "
                            >
                              No active alerts
                            </p>


                            <p
                              className="
                                mt-1
                                text-xs
                                text-slate-400
                              "
                            >
                              Refresh alerts after your bid
                              portfolio or watchlist changes.
                            </p>

                          </div>

                        )

                        : null
                    }

                  </div>

                </section>


                <section
                  className="
                    rounded-3xl
                    border
                    border-slate-200
                    bg-white
                    p-6
                  "
                >

                  <BookmarkPlus
                    className="
                      size-5
                      text-[#2f6fed]
                    "
                  />


                  <h2
                    className="
                      mt-4
                      text-xl
                      font-semibold
                      text-slate-950
                    "
                  >
                    Watchlist
                  </h2>


                  <p
                    className="
                      mt-2
                      text-xs
                      leading-5
                      text-slate-500
                    "
                  >
                    Watch a tender UUID, buyer UUID, or a
                    1–8 digit CPV prefix.
                  </p>


                  <div
                    className="
                      mt-5
                      space-y-3
                    "
                  >

                    <select
                      value={
                        watchType
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setWatchType(
                            event.target.value as WatchlistTargetType,
                          )
                      }
                      className="
                        h-11
                        w-full
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    >
                      <option value="TENDER">
                        Tender
                      </option>

                      <option value="BUYER">
                        Buyer
                      </option>

                      <option value="CPV">
                        CPV prefix
                      </option>
                    </select>


                    <input
                      value={
                        targetKey
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setTargetKey(
                            event.target.value,
                          )
                      }
                      placeholder={
                        watchType ===
                        "CPV"
                          ? "e.g. 4545"
                          : "UUID"
                      }
                      className="
                        h-11
                        w-full
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    />


                    <input
                      value={
                        watchLabel
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setWatchLabel(
                            event.target.value,
                          )
                      }
                      placeholder="Optional label"
                      className="
                        h-11
                        w-full
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        px-3
                        text-sm
                      "
                    />


                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={
                        mutating
                      }
                      onClick={
                        () => {
                          void createWatchlistItem();
                        }
                      }
                      className="
                        inline-flex
                        h-10
                        w-full
                        items-center
                        justify-center
                        gap-2
                        rounded-xl
                        bg-[#14213d]
                        px-4
                        text-sm
                        font-semibold
                        text-white
                        disabled:opacity-50
                      "
                    >
                      <BookmarkPlus
                        className="size-4"
                      />

                      Add to watchlist
                    </button>

                  </div>


                  <div
                    className="
                      mt-6
                      space-y-2
                    "
                  >

                    {
                      center.watchlist.map(
                        (
                          item,
                        ) => (

                          <div
                            key={
                              item.id
                            }
                            className="
                              rounded-2xl
                              bg-slate-50
                              p-4
                            "
                          >

                            <div
                              className="
                                flex
                                items-start
                                justify-between
                                gap-3
                              "
                            >

                              <div
                                className="
                                  min-w-0
                                "
                              >

                                <span
                                  className="
                                    rounded-full
                                    bg-white
                                    px-2
                                    py-1
                                    text-[9px]
                                    font-semibold
                                    text-slate-500
                                  "
                                >
                                  {
                                    item.type
                                  }
                                </span>


                                <p
                                  className="
                                    mt-2
                                    truncate
                                    text-sm
                                    font-semibold
                                    text-slate-900
                                  "
                                >
                                  {
                                    item.label
                                    ??
                                    item.targetKey
                                  }
                                </p>


                                {
                                  item.label

                                    ? (

                                      <p
                                        className="
                                          mt-1
                                          break-all
                                          text-[10px]
                                          text-slate-400
                                        "
                                      >
                                        {
                                          item.targetKey
                                        }
                                      </p>

                                    )

                                    : null
                                }

                              </div>


                              <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={
                                  mutating
                                }
                                onClick={
                                  () => {
                                    void deleteWatchlistItem(
                                      item.id,
                                    );
                                  }
                                }
                                className="
                                  grid
                                  size-8
                                  shrink-0
                                  place-items-center
                                  rounded-lg
                                  text-slate-400
                                  hover:bg-white
                                  hover:text-red-600
                                "
                                aria-label="Remove watchlist item"
                              >
                                <Trash2
                                  className="size-4"
                                />
                              </button>

                            </div>

                          </div>

                        ),
                      )
                    }


                    {
                      center.watchlist.length ===
                      0

                        ? (

                          <p
                            className="
                              rounded-2xl
                              border
                              border-dashed
                              border-slate-300
                              p-8
                              text-center
                              text-xs
                              text-slate-400
                            "
                          >
                            Your organization watchlist is empty.
                          </p>

                        )

                        : null
                    }

                  </div>

                </section>

              </div>


              {
                history.length >
                0

                  ? (

                    <section
                      className="
                        mt-6
                        rounded-3xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        p-6
                      "
                    >

                      <div
                        className="
                          flex
                          items-center
                          gap-3
                        "
                      >

                        <Clock3
                          className="
                            size-5
                            text-slate-400
                          "
                        />


                        <h2
                          className="
                            text-lg
                            font-semibold
                            text-slate-950
                          "
                        >
                          Alert history
                        </h2>

                      </div>


                      <div
                        className="
                          mt-5
                          divide-y
                          divide-slate-100
                        "
                      >

                        {
                          history
                            .slice(
                              0,
                              20,
                            )
                            .map(
                              (
                                notification,
                              ) => (

                                <div
                                  key={
                                    notification.id
                                  }
                                  className="
                                    py-4
                                  "
                                >

                                  <div
                                    className="
                                      flex
                                      flex-col
                                      gap-2
                                      md:flex-row
                                      md:items-start
                                      md:justify-between
                                    "
                                  >

                                    <div>

                                      <p
                                        className="
                                          text-sm
                                          font-semibold
                                          text-slate-700
                                        "
                                      >
                                        {
                                          notification.title
                                        }
                                      </p>


                                      <p
                                        className="
                                          mt-1
                                          text-xs
                                          text-slate-400
                                        "
                                      >
                                        {
                                          formatEnum(
                                            notification.type,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        {" · "}
                                        {
                                          formatDate(
                                            notification.lastObservedAt,
                                          )
                                        }
                                      </p>

                                    </div>


                                    <span
                                      className="
                                        text-[10px]
                                        font-semibold
                                        text-slate-400
                                      "
                                    >
                                      {
                                        notification.status
                                      }
                                    </span>

                                  </div>

                                </div>

                              ),
                            )
                        }

                      </div>

                    </section>

                  )

                  : null
              }


              <div
                className="
                  mt-6
                  flex
                  items-start
                  gap-3
                  rounded-2xl
                  bg-slate-50
                  p-4
                  text-xs
                  leading-5
                  text-slate-500
                "
              >

                <ShieldCheck
                  className="
                    mt-0.5
                    size-4
                    shrink-0
                  "
                />

                Notifications and watchlists are private to the
                current organization. Alert refresh is
                deterministic and read-only against bid state:
                it never changes GO/HOLD/NO-GO decisions,
                compliance verdicts, tasks, or submission status.

              </div>

            </>

          )

          : null
      }

    </div>

  );

}


function Metric({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

}: {

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    number;

}) {

  return (

    <article
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="
          size-4
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      />


      <p
        className="
          mt-4
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.12em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-2xl
          font-semibold
          text-slate-950
        "
      >
        {
          value.toLocaleString()
        }
      </p>

    </article>

  );

}


function SeverityIcon({

  severity,

}: {

  severity:
    NotificationSeverity;

}) {

  const config =
    severity ===
    "CRITICAL"

      ? {
          className:
            "bg-red-50 text-red-600",

          icon:
            AlertOctagon,
        }

      : severity ===
        "HIGH"

        ? {
            className:
              "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600",

            icon:
              TriangleAlert,
          }

        : {
            className:
              "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600",

            icon:
              Bell,
          };


  const Icon =
    config.icon;


  return (

    <div
      className={
        `
          grid
          size-9
          shrink-0
          place-items-center
          rounded-xl
          ${config.className}
        `
      }
    >
      <Icon
        className="size-4"
      />
    </div>

  );

}


function SeverityBadge({

  severity,

}: {

  severity:
    NotificationSeverity;

}) {

  const className =
    severity ===
    "CRITICAL"
      ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
      : severity ===
        "HIGH"
        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
        : severity ===
          "MEDIUM"
          ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"
          : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${className}
        `
      }
    >
      {
        severity
      }
    </span>

  );

}

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";

  formatDate,

  formatEnum,

  formatMoney,

  formatValueRange,

import type {

  OpportunityDetail,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-types";


export default function OpportunityDetailPage() {

  const params =
    useParams<{
      id:
        string;
    }>();


  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    opportunity,

    setOpportunity,

  ] = useState<
    OpportunityDetail
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<OpportunityDetail>(

        `/api/v1/opportunities/${params.id}`,

      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setOpportunity(
                result,
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(

                cause instanceof Error

                  ? cause.message

                  : "Unable to load opportunity.",

              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },

    [
      api,
      params.id,
    ],

  );


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[65vh]
          place-items-center

          className="
            size-6

        />

type FilterState = {

  query:
    string;

  status:
    ""
    |
    ProcurementStatus;

  source:
    ""
    |
    ProcurementSource;

};


const EMPTY_FILTERS:
FilterState = {

  query:
    "",

  status:
    "",

  source:
    "",

};


const STATUS_OPTIONS:
ProcurementStatus[] = [

  "PUBLISHED",

  "UPDATED",

  "CLOSED",

  "AWARDED",

  "CANCELLED",

  "ARCHIVED",

];


const SOURCE_OPTIONS:
ProcurementSource[] = [

  "TED",

  "BOAMP",

  "DECP",

  "MANUAL_DEMO",

];


function pathFor(
  filters:
    FilterState,
) {

  const parameters =

    new URLSearchParams();


  if (
    filters.query.trim() !==
    ""
  ) {

    parameters.set(

      "q",

      filters.query.trim(),

    );

  }


  if (
    filters.status !==
    ""
  ) {

    parameters.set(

      "status",

      filters.status,

    );

  }


  if (
    filters.source !==
    ""
  ) {

    parameters.set(

      "source",

      filters.source,

    );

  }


  const query =
    parameters.toString();


  return query ===
    ""

    ? "/api/v1/opportunities"

    : `/api/v1/opportunities?${query}`;

}


export default function OpportunitiesPage() {

  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    opportunities,

  ] = useState<
    OpportunitySummary[]
  >(
    [],
  );

    filters,

    setFilters,

  ] = useState<FilterState>(
    EMPTY_FILTERS,

    true,

    () => {

        false;

            result,

              !cancelled

        .catch(
          (
            cause,

              !cancelled

                  : "Unable to load opportunities.",

              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

        );

        cancelled =
          true;

      api,
    ],

  );


  async function searchOpportunities(
    event:
      FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =

        await api<OpportunitySummary[]>(

          pathFor(
            filters,
          ),

        );


      setOpportunities(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(

        cause instanceof Error

          ? cause.message

          : "Unable to search opportunities.",

      );


    } finally {

      setLoading(
        false,
      );

    }

  }

      true,
    );

      null,

        );

        result,

      cause
    ) {

        false,
      );

                              }

                              value={
                                opportunity.awardedAmount !==
                                null

                              }

                                CalendarDays
                              }

                                Deadline
                              "

                                formatDateTime(
                                  opportunity.submissionDeadline,
                                )
                              }

                            />


                            <SmallMetric

                                Layers3
                              }

                              label="

                                opportunity.lotCount ===
                                0

                              }

                            border-slate-100
                            pt-4
                          "
                        >

                          <p
                            className="

                              text-slate-400

    );

"use client";


import {

  ArrowRight,

  CheckCircle2,

  Database,

  Gauge,

  LoaderCircle,

  RefreshCw,

  Search,

  Server,

  ShieldCheck,

  Sparkles,

  TriangleAlert,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link from "next/link";


import {

  type FormEvent,

  useEffect,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


import {

  formatDate,

  formatEnum,

  formatMoney,

  formatValueRange,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-format";


import type {

  ContractNature,

  ProcurementSource,

  ProcurementStatus,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-types";


import type {

  ProcurementSearchResponse,

  SearchProjectionStatus,

  SearchReindexResponse,

} from "@/features/search/search-types";


type SearchFilters = {

  status:
    ProcurementStatus
    |
    "";

  source:
    ProcurementSource
    |
    "";

  contractNature:
    ContractNature
    |
    "";

  minimumQualityScore:
    string;

};


const EMPTY_FILTERS: SearchFilters = {

  status:
    "",

  source:
    "",

  contractNature:
    "",

  minimumQualityScore:
    "",

};


export default function ProcurementSearchPage() {

  const {

    api,

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    query,

    setQuery,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    filters,

    setFilters,

  ] = useState<SearchFilters>(
    EMPTY_FILTERS,
  );


  const [

    result,

    setResult,

  ] = useState<
    ProcurementSearchResponse
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    status,

    setStatus,

  ] = useState<
    SearchProjectionStatus
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    searching,

    setSearching,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    rebuilding,

    setRebuilding,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    rebuildResult,

    setRebuildResult,

  ] = useState<
    SearchReindexResponse
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      Promise.all([

        api<SearchProjectionStatus>(
          "/api/v1/search/status",
        ),

        api<ProcurementSearchResponse>(
          "/api/v1/search/opportunities?size=25",
        ),

      ])
        .then(
          (
            [
              projectionStatus,
              initialResult,
            ],
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setStatus(
              projectionStatus,
            );

            setResult(
              initialResult,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to initialize procurement search.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  function buildParameters() {

    const params =
      new URLSearchParams();


    if (
      query.trim()
    ) {

      params.set(
        "q",
        query.trim(),
      );

    }


    if (
      filters.status
    ) {

      params.set(
        "status",
        filters.status,
      );

    }


    if (
      filters.source
    ) {

      params.set(
        "source",
        filters.source,
      );

    }


    if (
      filters.contractNature
    ) {

      params.set(
        "contractNature",
        filters.contractNature,
      );

    }


    if (
      filters.minimumQualityScore
    ) {

      params.set(
        "minQualityScore",
        filters.minimumQualityScore,
      );

    }


    params.set(
      "size",
      "50",
    );


    return params;

  }


  async function executeSearch(
    event?:
      FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event?.preventDefault();


    setSearching(
      true,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const response =
        await api<ProcurementSearchResponse>(
          `/api/v1/search/opportunities?${buildParameters().toString()}`,
        );


      setResult(
        response,
      );


      const projectionStatus =
        await api<SearchProjectionStatus>(
          "/api/v1/search/status",
        );


      setStatus(
        projectionStatus,
      );


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Procurement search failed.",
      );

    } finally {

      setSearching(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  async function rebuildIndex() {

    setRebuilding(
      true,
    );

    setRebuildResult(
      null,
    );

    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const response =
        await api<SearchReindexResponse>(
          "/api/v1/search/reindex",
          {
            method:
              "POST",
          },
        );


      setRebuildResult(
        response,
      );


      const projectionStatus =
        await api<SearchProjectionStatus>(
          "/api/v1/search/status",
        );


      setStatus(
        projectionStatus,
      );


      await executeSearch();


    } catch (
      cause
    ) {

      setError(
        cause instanceof Error
          ? cause.message
          : "Unable to rebuild the search projection.",
      );

    } finally {

      setRebuilding(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  if (
    loading
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-[60vh]
          place-items-center
        "
      >

        <LoaderCircle
          className="
            size-6
            animate-spin
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          flex-col
          gap-5
          xl:flex-row
          xl:items-end
          xl:justify-between
        "
      >

        <div>

          <p
            className="
              text-xs
              font-semibold
              uppercase
              tracking-[0.18em]
              text-[#2f6fed]
            "
          >
            Procurement discovery
          </p>


          <h1
            className="
              mt-3
              text-4xl
              font-semibold
              tracking-[-0.03em]
              text-slate-950
            "
          >
            Search intelligence
          </h1>


          <p
            className="
              mt-3
              max-w-3xl
              text-sm
              leading-6
              text-slate-500
            "
          >
            Full-text and structured procurement search across
            titles, buyers, CPVs, lots and awarded suppliers,
            backed by a rebuildable OpenSearch projection.
          </p>

        </div>


        {
          user?.role ===
          "OWNER"

            ? (

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={
                  () => {
                    void rebuildIndex();
                  }
                }
                disabled={
                  rebuilding
                }
                className="
                  inline-flex
                  h-11
                  items-center
                  gap-2
                  rounded-xl
                  bg-[#14213d]
                  px-5
                  text-sm
                  font-semibold
                  text-white
                  disabled:opacity-50
                "
              >

                {
                  rebuilding

                    ? (

                      <LoaderCircle
                        className="
                          size-4
                          animate-spin
                        "
                      />

                    )

                    : (

                      <RefreshCw
                        className="size-4"
                      />

                    )
                }

                {
                  rebuilding
                    ? "Rebuilding..."
                    : "Rebuild search index"
                }

              </button>

            )

            : null
        }

      </div>


      {
        status

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-7
                grid
                gap-4
                md:grid-cols-2
                xl:grid-cols-4
              "
            >

              <StatusCard
                icon={Server}
                label="Search engine"
                value={
                  status.reachable
                    ? "OpenSearch"
                    : "PostgreSQL fallback"
                }
                detail={
                  status.reachable
                    ? "Projection reachable"
                    : "Core search remains available"
                }
              />


              <StatusCard
                icon={Database}
                label="Search documents"
                value={
                  status.indexedDocuments
                    .toLocaleString()
                }
                detail={
                  status.indexName
                }
              />


              <StatusCard
                icon={ShieldCheck}
                label="Source of truth"
                value={
                  status.authority
                }
                detail="Search projection is disposable"
              />


              <StatusCard
                icon={Sparkles}
                label="Projection state"
                value={
                  status.indexExists
                    ? "Indexed"
                    : "Not built"
                }
                detail={
                  status.enabled
                    ? "Search projection enabled"
                    : "Projection disabled"
                }
              />

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                flex
                gap-3

        }

          text-sm

        "

        }
      </p>

  );

}

function SectionHeader({

  eyebrow,

  title,

  detail,

  icon:
    Icon,

}: {

    string;

  title:
    string;

  detail:
    string;

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

}) {

  return (

    <div
      className="
        flex
        flex-col
        gap-4
        md:flex-row
        md:items-end
        md:justify-between
      "
    >

      <div>

        <p
          className="
            text-xs
            font-semibold
            uppercase
            tracking-[0.12em]
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        >
          {
            eyebrow
          }
        </p>


        <h2
          className="
            mt-2
            text-2xl
            font-semibold
            tracking-[-0.02em]
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          {
            title
          }
        </h2>


        <p
          className="
            mt-2
            max-w-3xl
            text-sm
            text-slate-500
          "
        >
          {
            detail
          }
        </p>

      </div>


      <div
        className="
          grid
          size-11
          shrink-0
          place-items-center
          rounded-2xl
          bg-blue-50
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      >
        <Icon
          className="size-5"
        />
      </div>

    </div>

  );

}


function Metric({

  icon:
    Icon,

  label,

  value,

  detail,

  icon:
    LucideIcon;

  label:
    string;

  value:
    number;

  detail:
    string;

}) {

  return (

    <article
      className="
        rounded-2xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-5
      "
    >

      <Icon
        className="
          size-4
          text-[#2f6fed]
        "
      />


      <p
        className="
          mt-4
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          uppercase
          tracking-[0.1em]
          text-slate-400
        "
      >
        {

        }
      </p>


      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-2xl
          font-semibold

        "
      >

        }

      <p
        className="
          mt-1
          text-xs
          leading-5
          text-slate-500
        "
      >
        {
          detail
        }
      </p>

    </article>

  );

}


function DecisionBadge({

  decision,

}: {

  decision:
    string;

}) {

  const className =
    decision ===
    "GO"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
      : decision ===
        "HOLD"
        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
        : decision ===
          "NO_GO"
          ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
          : "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${className}
        `
      }
    >
      {
        decision.replace(
          "_",
          "-",
        )
      }
    </span>

  );

}


function ReadinessBadge({

  readiness,

  label,

}: {

  readiness:
    string;

  label:
    string;

}) {

  const className =
    readiness ===
    "READY"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
      : readiness ===
        "AT_RISK"
        ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700"
        : readiness ===
          "REVIEW"
          ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
          : readiness ===
            "DECISION"
            ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"
            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600";


  return (

    <span
      className={
        `
          whitespace-nowrap
          rounded-full
          px-2.5
          py-1
          text-[10px]
          font-semibold
          ${className}
        `
      }
    >
      {
        label
      }
    </span>

  );

}


function CaptureLink({

  href,

  label,

}: {

  href:
    string;

  label:
    string;

}) {

  return (

      }

        rounded-xl
        border
        border-white/15
        bg-white/5
        px-3
        py-2
        text-xs
        font-semibold
        text-slate-200
        transition
        hover:bg-white/10
      "
    >
      {
        label
      }
    </a>

  );

}

export default function SupplierDetailPage() {

  const params =
    useParams<{
      supplierKey:
        string;
    }>();


  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    detail,

    setDetail,

  ] = useState<
    SupplierIntelligenceDetail
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<SupplierIntelligenceDetail>(
        `/api/v1/suppliers/${params.supplierKey}`,
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setDetail(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

              !cancelled
            ) {

                cause instanceof Error

                  : "Unable to load supplier intelligence.",
              );

          () => {

              !cancelled

          true;

"use client";


import {

  Building2,

  ChevronRight,

  CircleDollarSign,

  Factory,

  LoaderCircle,

  Repeat2,

  Search,

  ShieldCheck,

  Target,

  Users,

} from "lucide-react";


import type {

  LucideIcon,

} from "lucide-react";


import Link from "next/link";


import {

  useCallback,

  useEffect,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


import {

  formatDate,

  formatEnum,

  formatMoney,

} from "@/features/procurement/procurement-format";


import type {

  SupplierIntelligenceSummary,

} from "@/features/supplier-intelligence/supplier-intelligence-types";


export default function SuppliersPage() {

  const {

    api,

  } = useAuth();


  const [

    suppliers,

    setSuppliers,

  ] = useState<
    SupplierIntelligenceSummary[]
  >(
    [],
  );


  const [

    query,

    setQuery,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    country,

    setCountry,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const load =
    useCallback(
      async () => {

        setLoading(
          true,
        );


        setError(
          null,
        );


        const params =
          new URLSearchParams();


        if (
          query.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "q",
            query.trim(),
          );

        }


        if (
          country.trim() !==
          ""
        ) {

          params.set(
            "country",
            country.trim(),
          );

        }


        params.set(
          "limit",
          "60",
        );


        try {

          const result =
            await api<SupplierIntelligenceSummary[]>(
              `/api/v1/suppliers?${params.toString()}`,
            );


          setSuppliers(
            result,
          );


        } catch (
          cause
        ) {

          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ? cause.message
              : "Unable to load supplier intelligence.",
          );


        } finally {

          setLoading(
            false,
          );

        }

      },
      [
        api,
        country,
        query,
      ],
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      let cancelled =
        false;


      api<SupplierIntelligenceSummary[]>(
        "/api/v1/suppliers?limit=60",
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              cancelled
            ) {
              return;
            }


            setSuppliers(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause,
          ) => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setError(
                cause instanceof Error
                  ? cause.message
                  : "Unable to load supplier intelligence.",
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !cancelled
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        cancelled =
          true;

      };

    },
    [
      api,
    ],
  );


  return (

    <div
      className="
        mx-auto
        max-w-[1450px]
      "
    >

      <div>

        <p
          className="
            text-xs
            font-semibold
            uppercase
            tracking-[0.18em]
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        >
          Shared public award intelligence
        </p>


        <h1
          className="
            mt-3
            text-4xl
            font-semibold
            tracking-[-0.03em]
            text-slate-950
          "
        >
          Supplier intelligence
        </h1>


        <p
          className="
            mt-3
            max-w-3xl
            text-sm
            leading-6
            text-slate-500
          "
        >
          Explore suppliers observed in the canonical public
          award corpus, their buyer relationships, CPV
          specialization, award-value footprint and co-award
          relationships.
        </p>

      </div>


      <section
        className="
          mt-7
          grid
          gap-3
          rounded-2xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          p-4
          md:grid-cols-[1fr_180px_auto]
        "
      >

        <div
          className="
            relative
          "
        >

          <Search
            className="
              absolute
              left-3
              top-3.5
              size-4
              text-slate-400
            "
          />


          <input
            value={
              query
            }
            onChange={
              (
                event,
              ) =>
                setQuery(
                  event.target.value,
                )
            }
            placeholder="Search supplier name"
            className="
              h-11
              w-full
              rounded-xl
              border
              border-slate-200
              pl-10
              pr-3
              text-sm
            "
          />

        </div>


        <input
          value={
            country
          }
          onChange={
            (
              event,
            ) =>
              setCountry(
                event.target.value
                  .toUpperCase(),
              )
          }
          maxLength={2}
          placeholder="Buyer country"
          className="
            h-11
            rounded-xl
            border
            border-slate-200
            px-3
            text-sm
            uppercase
          "
        />


        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={
            () => {
              void load();
            }
          }
          className="
            h-11
            rounded-xl
            bg-[#14213d]
            px-5
            text-sm
            font-semibold
            text-white
          "
        >
          Search
        </button>

      </section>


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >
              {
                error
              }
            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        loading

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                grid
                min-h-[40vh]
                place-items-center
              "
            >

              <LoaderCircle
                className="
                  size-6
                  animate-spin
                  text-[#2f6fed]
                "
              />

            </div>

          )

          : (

            <div
              className="
                mt-6
                grid
                gap-4
                xl:grid-cols-2
              "
            >

              {
                suppliers.map(
                  (
                    supplier,
                  ) => (

                    <Link
                      key={
                        supplier.supplierKey
                      }
                      href={
                        `/suppliers/${supplier.supplierKey}`
                      }
                      className="
                        group
                        rounded-3xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-white
                        p-6
                        transition
                        hover:border-slate-300
                        hover:shadow-sm
                      "
                    >

                      <div
                        className="
                          flex
                          items-start
                          justify-between
                          gap-4
                        "
                      >

                        <div
                          className="
                            min-w-0
                          "
                        >

                          <Factory
                            className="
                              size-5
                              text-[#2f6fed]
                            "
                          />


                          <h2
                            className="
                              mt-4
                              text-lg
                              font-semibold
                              text-slate-950
                            "
                          >
                            {
                              supplier.name
                            }
                          </h2>


                          <p
                            className="
                              mt-2
                              text-xs
                              text-slate-400
                            "
                          >
                            Observed in
                            {" "}
                            {

                            }

                            buyer

export function CompanyProfileEditor({

  form,

  setForm,

  pending,

  error,

  onSubmit,

  onCancel,

}: {

  form:
    CompanyFormState;

  setForm:
    Dispatch<
      SetStateAction<CompanyFormState>
    >;

  pending:
    boolean;

  error:
    string
    |
    null;

  onSubmit:
    (
      event:
        FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
    ) => void;

  onCancel:
    () => void;

}) {

  function update<K extends keyof CompanyFormState>(

    key:
      K,

    value:
      CompanyFormState[K],

  ) {

    setForm(
      (
        current,
      ) => ({

        ...current,

        [key]:
          value,

      }),
    );

  }


  function toggleBuyerType(
    buyerType:
      BuyerType,
  ) {

    const next =

      form.preferredBuyerTypes.includes(
        buyerType,
      )

        ? form.preferredBuyerTypes.filter(
            (
              value,
            ) =>
              value !==
              buyerType,
          )

        : [
            ...form.preferredBuyerTypes,
            buyerType,
          ];


    update(
      "preferredBuyerTypes",
      next,
    );

  }


  return (

    <form
      onSubmit={
        onSubmit
      }
      className="
        mt-7
        space-y-6
      "
    >

      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-red-200
                bg-red-50
                p-4
                text-sm
                text-red-700
              "
            >

              {
                error
              }

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      <FormSection

        title="
          Company identity
        "

        description="
          Core information used to understand what the organization does.
        "

      >

        <div
          className="
            grid
            gap-4
            md:grid-cols-2
          "
        >

          <Field
            label="Legal name"
            required
          >

            <input
              required
              value={
                form.legalName
              }
              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  update(
                    "legalName",
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              className={
                inputClass()
              }
            />

          </Field>


          <Field
            label="Trading name"
          >

            <input
              value={
                form.tradingName
              }
              onChange={

                  event,
                ) =>
                  update(
                    "tradingName",
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              className={
                inputClass()
              }
            />

          </Field>


          <Field
            label="Industry"
            required
          >

            <input
              required
              placeholder="Building renovation"
              value={
                form.industry
              }
              onChange={
                (

                  update(

                    event.target.value,

              }

              }

            />

                              option.value,
                            )
                        }

                        className={[

                          "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition",

                          selected

                            ? "border-[#2f6fed] bg-[#edf4ff] text-[#245fcd]"

                            : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50",

                        ].join(
                          " ",
                        )}

                      >

                        {
                          selected

                            ? (

                              <Check
                                className="
                                  size-3
                                "
                              />

                            )

                            : null
                        }

                        {
                          option.label
                        }

                      </button>

                    );

                  },
                )
              }

            </div>

          </div>


          <Field
            label="Excluded keywords"
            help="One keyword or phrase per line."
          >

            <textarea
              rows={
                7
              }
              value={
                form.excludedKeywords
              }
              onChange={
                (
                  event,
                ) =>
                  update(
                    "excludedKeywords",
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              className={
                textareaClass()
              }
            />

          </Field>

        </div>

      </FormSection>


      <div
        className="
          sticky
          bottom-5
          flex
          justify-end
          gap-3
          rounded-2xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white/95
          p-4

        "

function formatDateTime(
  value:
    string
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return "Never";
  }

  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(value),
  );
}
