"use client";


import {

  Building2,

  ShieldCheck,

  UserRound,

} from "lucide-react";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "@/features/auth/auth-context";


function roleLabel(
  role:
    string,
) {

  return role
    .replaceAll(
      "_",
      " ",
    )
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /\b\w/g,
      (
        character,
      ) =>
        character.toUpperCase(),
    );

}


export function IdentitySummary() {

  const {

    user,

  } = useAuth();


  if (
    user === null
  ) {

    return null;

  }


  const items = [

    {

      icon:
        UserRound,

      label:
        "Signed in as",

      value:
        user.fullName,

      detail:
        user.email,

    },

    {

      icon:
        Building2,

      label:
        "Active organization",

      value:
        user.organization.name,

      detail:
        user.organization.slug,

    },

    {

      icon:
        ShieldCheck,

      label:
        "Workspace role",

      value:
        roleLabel(
          user.role,
        ),

      detail:
        "Tenant-scoped access",

    },

  ];


  return (

    <section
      className="
        mt-6
        grid
        gap-4
        md:grid-cols-3
      "
    >

      {
        items.map(
          (
            item,
          ) => {

            const Icon =
              item.icon;


            return (

              <div

                key={
                  item.label
                }

                className="
                  rounded-2xl
                  border
                  border-slate-200
                  bg-white
                  p-4
                  shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04)]
                "

              >

                <div
                  className="
                    flex
                    items-center
                    gap-3

                      className="
                        text-[10px]

function isAbortError(

  cause:
    unknown,

): boolean {

  return (

    cause instanceof DOMException
    &&
    cause.name ===
      "AbortError"

  );

}


function describeError(

  cause:
    unknown,

): string {

  if (
    cause instanceof Error
  ) {

    return cause.message;

  }


  return "Unable to reach the TenderPilot backend";

}


function DependencyRow({

export function SystemStatusPanel() {

  const [

    status,

    setStatus,

  ] = useState<
    SystemStatus
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    error,

    setError,

  ] = useState<
    string
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const [

    loading,

    setLoading,

  ] = useState(
    true,
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      const controller =

        new AbortController();


      fetchSystemStatus(
        controller.signal,
      )
        .then(
          (
            result,
          ) => {

            if (
              controller.signal.aborted
            ) {

              return;

            }


            setStatus(
              result,
            );


            setError(
              null,
            );

          },
        )
        .catch(
          (
            cause:
              unknown,
          ) => {

            if (
              controller.signal.aborted
              ||
              isAbortError(
                cause,
              )
            ) {

              return;

            }


            setStatus(
              null,
            );


            setError(
              describeError(
                cause,
              ),
            );

          },
        )
        .finally(
          () => {

            if (
              !controller.signal.aborted
            ) {

              setLoading(
                false,
              );

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        controller.abort();

      };

    },

    [],

  );


  async function refreshStatus() {

    setLoading(
      true,
    );


    setError(
      null,
    );


    try {

      const result =

        await fetchSystemStatus();


      setStatus(
        result,
      );


    } catch (
      cause:
        unknown
    ) {

      setStatus(
        null,
      );


      setError(
        describeError(
          cause,
        ),
      );


    } finally {

      setLoading(
        false,
      );

    }

  }


  return (

    <section
      className="
        rounded-3xl
        border
        border-slate-200
        bg-white
        p-6
        shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)]
      "
    >

      <div
        className="
          flex
          items-center
          justify-between
          gap-4
        "
      >

        <div>

          <div
            className="
              flex
              items-center
              gap-2
              text-slate-500
            "
          >

            <Server
              className="
                size-4
              "
            />


            <p
              className="
                text-xs
                font-semibold
                uppercase
                tracking-[0.16em]
              "
            >

              Runtime health

            </p>

          </div>


          <h2
            className="
              mt-2
              text-lg
              font-semibold
              text-slate-950
            "
          >

            Local development services

          </h2>

        </div>


        <button

          type="button"

          onClick={
            () => {

              void refreshStatus();

            }
          }

          disabled={
            loading
          }

          className="
            grid
            size-9
            place-items-center
            rounded-xl
            border
            border-slate-200
            text-slate-500
            transition
            hover:bg-slate-50
            disabled:cursor-not-allowed
            disabled:opacity-50
          "

          aria-label="
            Refresh system status
          "

        >

          <RefreshCw
            className={

              loading

                ? "size-4 animate-spin"

                : "size-4"

            }
          />

        </button>

      </div>


      {
        loading
        &&
        !status

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-5
                space-y-3
              "
            >

              {
                [
                  0,
                  1,
                  2,
                ].map(
                  (
                    item,
                  ) => (

                    <div

                      key={
                        item
                      }

                      className="
                        h-14
                        animate-pulse
                        rounded-xl
                        bg-slate-100
                      "

                    />

                  ),
                )
              }

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        error

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                mt-5
                rounded-2xl
                border
                border-amber-200
                bg-amber-50
                p-4
              "
            >

              <p
                className="
                  text-sm
                  font-semibold
                  text-amber-900
                "
              >

                Backend is not running

              </p>


              <p
                className="
                  mt-1
                  text-xs
                  leading-5
                  text-amber-800
                "
              >

                {
                  error
                }

              </p>

            </div>

          )

          : null
      }


      {
        status

          ? (

            <>

              <div
                className="
                  mt-5
                  divide-y
                  divide-slate-100
                "
              >

                {

===== FILE: ./frontend/src/features/auth/auth-api.ts =====
import type {

  AuthSession,

  LoginInput,

  RegisterInput,

} from "./auth-types";


export const API_BASE_URL =

  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
  ??
  "http://localhost:8080";


type ApiErrorBody = {

  message?:
    string;

  violations?: Array<{

    field:
      string;

    message:
      string;

  }>;

};


export class ApiHttpError
  extends Error {

  readonly status:
    number;


  readonly violations:
    ApiErrorBody["violations"];


  constructor(

    status:
      number,

    message:
      string,

    violations?:
      ApiErrorBody["violations"],

  ) {

    super(
      message,
    );


    this.name =
      "ApiHttpError";


    this.status =
      status;


    this.violations =
      violations;

  }

}


async function readJson<T>(

  response:
    Response,

): Promise<T> {

  const body:
    unknown =

    await response.json();


  return body as T;

}


async function throwApiError(

  response:
    Response,

): Promise<never> {

  let body:
    ApiErrorBody
    |
    null = null;


  try {

    body =

      await readJson<ApiErrorBody>(
        response,
      );


  } catch {

    body =
      null;

  }


  throw new ApiHttpError(

    response.status,

    body?.message
    ??
    `Request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`,

    body?.violations,

  );

}


async function sessionRequest(

  path:
    string,

  body:
    LoginInput
    |
    RegisterInput,

): Promise<AuthSession> {

  const response =

    await fetch(

      `${API_BASE_URL}${path}`,

      {

        method:
          "POST",

        credentials:
          "include",

        cache:
          "no-store",

        headers: {

          "Content-Type":
            "application/json",

        },

        body:
          JSON.stringify(
            body,
          ),

      },

    );


  if (
    !response.ok
  ) {

    return throwApiError(
      response,
    );

  }


  return readJson<AuthSession>(
    response,
  );

}


export function loginSession(

  input:
    LoginInput,

): Promise<AuthSession> {

  return sessionRequest(

    "/api/v1/auth/login",

    input,

  );

}


export function registerSession(

  input:
    RegisterInput,

): Promise<AuthSession> {

  return sessionRequest(

    "/api/v1/auth/register",

    input,

  );

}


export async function refreshSession(

  signal?:
    AbortSignal,

): Promise<AuthSession> {

  const response =

    await fetch(

      `${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`,

      {

        method:
          "POST",

        credentials:
          "include",

        cache:
          "no-store",

        signal,

      },

    );


  if (
    !response.ok
  ) {

    return throwApiError(
      response,
    );

  }


  return readJson<AuthSession>(
    response,
  );

}


export async function logoutSession():
Promise<void> {

  const response =

    await fetch(

      `${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/logout`,

      {

        method:
          "POST",

        credentials:
          "include",

        cache:
          "no-store",

      },

    );


  if (
    !response.ok
    &&
    response.status !==
      401
  ) {

    await throwApiError(
      response,
    );

  }

}


export async function parseAuthorizedResponse<T>(

  response:
    Response,

): Promise<T> {

  if (
    !response.ok
  ) {

    return throwApiError(
      response,
    );

  }


  if (
    response.status ===
    204
  ) {

    return undefined as T;

  }


  return readJson<T>(
    response,
  );

}

===== FILE: ./frontend/src/features/auth/auth-context.tsx =====
"use client";


import {

  createContext,

  useCallback,

  useContext,

  useEffect,

  useMemo,

  useRef,

  useState,

  type ReactNode,

} from "react";


import {

  API_BASE_URL,

  loginSession,

  logoutSession,

  parseAuthorizedResponse,

  refreshSession,

  registerSession,

} from "./auth-api";


import type {

  AuthSession,

  AuthUser,

  LoginInput,

  RegisterInput,

} from "./auth-types";


type AuthStatus =

  | "loading"
  | "authenticated"
  | "unauthenticated";


type AuthContextValue = {

  status:
    AuthStatus;

  user:
    AuthUser
    |
    null;

  login:
    (
      input:
        LoginInput,
    ) => Promise<void>;

  register:
    (
      input:
        RegisterInput,
    ) => Promise<void>;

  logout:
    () => Promise<void>;

  api:
    <T>(
      path:
        string,
      init?:
        RequestInit,
    ) => Promise<T>;

};


const AuthContext =

  createContext<
    AuthContextValue
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


export function AuthProvider({

  children,

}: {

  children:
    ReactNode;

}) {

  const [

    status,

    setStatus,

  ] = useState<AuthStatus>(
    "loading",
  );


  const [

    user,

    setUser,

  ] = useState<
    AuthUser
    |
    null
  >(
    null,
  );


  const accessTokenRef =

    useRef<
      string
      |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const refreshInFlightRef =

    useRef<
      Promise<AuthSession>
      |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const applySession =

    useCallback(
      (
        session:
          AuthSession,
      ) => {

        accessTokenRef.current =
          session.accessToken;


        setUser(
          session.user,
        );


        setStatus(
          "authenticated",
        );

      },

      [],

    );


  const clearSession =

    useCallback(
      () => {

        accessTokenRef.current =
          null;


        setUser(
          null,
        );


        setStatus(
          "unauthenticated",
        );

      },

      [],

    );


  const refreshAccessToken =

    useCallback(
      async () => {

        let inFlight =
          refreshInFlightRef.current;


        if (
          inFlight ===
          null
        ) {

          inFlight =

            refreshSession()
              .finally(
                () => {

                  refreshInFlightRef.current =
                    null;

                },
              );


          refreshInFlightRef.current =
            inFlight;

        }


        const session =

          await inFlight;


        applySession(
          session,
        );


        return session.accessToken;

      },

      [
        applySession,
      ],

    );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      const controller =

        new AbortController();


      refreshSession(
        controller.signal,
      )
        .then(
          (
            session,
          ) => {

            if (
              !controller.signal.aborted
            ) {

              applySession(
                session,
              );

            }

          },
        )
        .catch(
          () => {

            if (
              !controller.signal.aborted
            ) {

              clearSession();

            }

          },
        );


      return () => {

        controller.abort();

      };

    },

    [
      applySession,
      clearSession,
    ],

  );


  const login =

    useCallback(
      async (
        input:
          LoginInput,
      ) => {

        const session =

          await loginSession(
            input,
          );


        applySession(
          session,
        );

      },

      [
        applySession,
      ],

    );


  const register =

    useCallback(
      async (
        input:
          RegisterInput,
      ) => {

        const session =

          await registerSession(
            input,
          );


        applySession(
          session,
        );

      },

      [
        applySession,
      ],

    );


  const logout =

    useCallback(
      async () => {

        try {

          await logoutSession();


        } finally {

          clearSession();

        }

      },

      [
        clearSession,
      ],

    );


  const api =

    useCallback(
      async <T,>(

        path:
          string,

        init?:
          RequestInit,

      ): Promise<T> => {

        let token =
          accessTokenRef.current;


        if (
          token === null
        ) {

          token =
            await refreshAccessToken();

        }


        const request =

          async (
            accessToken:
              string,
          ) => {

            const headers =

              new Headers(
                init?.headers,
              );


            headers.set(

              "Authorization",

              `Bearer ${accessToken}`,

            );


            return fetch(

              `${API_BASE_URL}${path}`,

              {

                ...init,

                credentials:
                  "include",

                cache:
                  "no-store",

                headers,

              },

            );

          };


        let response =

          await request(
            token,
          );


        if (
          response.status ===
          401
        ) {

          try {

            const refreshedToken =

              await refreshAccessToken();


            response =

              await request(
                refreshedToken,
              );


          } catch (
            cause
          ) {

            clearSession();

            throw cause;

          }

        }


        return parseAuthorizedResponse<T>(
          response,
        );

      },

      [
        clearSession,
        refreshAccessToken,
      ],

    );


  const value =

    useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
      () => ({

        status,

        user,

        login,

        register,

        logout,

        api,

      }),

      [
        status,
        user,
        login,
        register,
        logout,
        api,
      ],

    );


  return (

    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={
        value
      }
    >

      {
        children
      }

    </AuthContext.Provider>

  );

}


export function useAuth() {

  const context =

    useContext(
      AuthContext,
    );


  if (
    context === null
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider",
    );

  }


  return context;

}

"use client";


import {

  useEffect,

  type ReactNode,

} from "react";


import {

  LoaderCircle,

  ShieldCheck,

} from "lucide-react";


import {

  useRouter,

} from "next/navigation";


import {

  AppShell,

} from "@/components/shell/app-shell";


import {

  useAuth,

} from "./auth-context";


export function ProtectedWorkspace({

  children,

}: {

  children:
    ReactNode;

}) {

  const {

    status,

  } = useAuth();


  const router =
    useRouter();


  useEffect(
    () => {

      if (
        status ===
        "unauthenticated"
      ) {

        router.replace(
          "/login",
        );

      }

    },

    [
      status,
      router,
    ],

  );


  if (
    status !==
    "authenticated"
  ) {

    return (

      <div
        className="
          grid
          min-h-screen
          place-items-center
          bg-[#f5f7fb]
          px-6
        "
      >

        <div
          className="
            text-center
          "
        >

          <div
            className="
              mx-auto
              grid
              size-14
              place-items-center
              rounded-2xl
              bg-[#14213d]
              text-white
              shadow-lg
            "
          >

            {
              status ===
              "loading"

                ? (

                  <LoaderCircle
                    className="
                      size-5
                      animate-spin
                    "
                  />

                )

                : (

                  <ShieldCheck
                    className="
                      size-5
                    "
                  />

                )
            }

          </div>


          <p
            className="
              mt-5
              text-sm
              font-semibold
              text-slate-800
            "
          >

            {
              status ===
              "loading"

                ? "Restoring your TenderPilot session..."

                : "Redirecting to sign in..."
            }

          </p>

        </div>

      </div>

    );

  }


  return (

    <AppShell>

      {
        children
      }

    </AppShell>

  );

}

function lines(
  value:
    string,
) {

  return value
    .split(
      "\n",
    )
    .map(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        item.trim(),
    )
    .filter(
      Boolean,
    );

}


function nullable(
  value:
    string,
) {

  const cleaned =
    value.trim();


  return cleaned ===
    ""

    ? null

    : cleaned;

}


function nullableNumber(
  value:
    string,
) {

  const cleaned =
    value.trim();


  return cleaned ===
    ""

    ? null

    : Number(
        cleaned,
      );

}

  return {

      "NOT_DISCLOSED",

    annualRevenueBand:
      profile.annualRevenueBand
      ??
      "NOT_DISCLOSED",

    preferredMinContractValue:
      profile.preferredMinContractValue?.toString()
      ??
      "",

    preferredMaxContractValue:
      profile.preferredMaxContractValue?.toString()
      ??
      "",

    preferredCurrency:
      profile.preferredCurrency
      ??
      "EUR",

    yearsExperience:
      profile.yearsExperience?.toString()
      ??
      "",

    minimumNoticeDays:
      profile.minimumNoticeDays?.toString()
      ??
      "",

    capabilities:
      profile.capabilities.join(
        "\n",
      ),

    operatingRegions:
      profile.operatingRegions
        .map(
          (
            region,
          ) =>
            `${region.countryCode}|${region.regionCode}|${region.regionName}`,
        )
        .join(
          "\n",
        ),

    targetCpvs:
      profile.targetCpvs
        .map(
          (
            cpv,
          ) =>
            `${cpv.code}|${cpv.label}`,
        )
        .join(
          "\n",
        ),

    certifications:
      profile.certifications
        .map(
          (
            certification,
          ) =>
            [

              certification.name,

              certification.issuer,

              certification.certificateNumber
              ??
              "",

              certification.validFrom
              ??
              "",

              certification.expiresOn
              ??
              "",

            ].join(
              "|",
            ),
        )
        .join(
          "\n",
        ),

    referenceProjects:
      profile.referenceProjects
        .map(
          (
            project,
          ) =>
            [

              project.projectName,

              project.clientName,

              project.countryCode,

              project.regionName
              ??
              "",

              project.contractValue?.toString()
              ??
              "",

              project.currency
              ??
              "",

              project.startedOn
              ??
              "",

              project.completedOn
              ??
              "",

              project.description,

            ].join(
              "|",
            ),
        )
        .join(
          "\n",
        ),

    preferredBuyerTypes:
      profile.preferredBuyerTypes,

    excludedKeywords:
      profile.excludedKeywords.join(
        "\n",
      ),

  };

}


export function formToInput(

  form:
    CompanyFormState,

): CompanyProfileInput {

  const operatingRegions =

    lines(
      form.operatingRegions,
    )
      .map(
        (
          line,
        ) => {

          const [
            countryCode,
            regionCode,
            regionName,
          ] =
            line
              .split(
                "|",
              )
              .map(
                (
                  value,
                ) =>
                  value.trim(),
              );


          if (
            !countryCode
            ||
            !regionCode
            ||
            !regionName
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              `Invalid region line: ${line}`,
            );

          }


          return {

            countryCode,

            regionCode,

            regionName,

          };

        },
      );


  const targetCpvs =

    lines(
      form.targetCpvs,
    )
      .map(
        (
          line,
        ) => {

          const separator =
            line.indexOf(
              "|",
            );


          if (
            separator <
            1
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              `Invalid CPV line: ${line}`,
            );

          }


          return {

            code:
              line
                .slice(
                  0,
                  separator,
                )
                .trim(),

            label:
              line
                .slice(
                  separator + 1,
                )
                .trim(),

          };

        },
      );


  const certifications =

    lines(
      form.certifications,
    )
      .map(
        (
          line,
        ) => {

          const fields =
            line
              .split(
                "|",
              )
              .map(
                (
                  value,
                ) =>
                  value.trim(),
              );


          if (
            fields.length <
            2
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              `Invalid certification line: ${line}`,
            );

          }


          return {

            name:
              fields[0]
              ??
              "",

            issuer:
              fields[1]
              ??
              "",

            certificateNumber:
              nullable(
                fields[2]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            validFrom:
              nullable(
                fields[3]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            expiresOn:
              nullable(
                fields[4]
                ??
                "",
              ),

          };

        },
      );


  const referenceProjects =

    lines(
      form.referenceProjects,
    )
      .map(
        (
          line,
        ) => {

          const fields =
            line
              .split(
                "|",
              )
              .map(
                (
                  value,
                ) =>
                  value.trim(),
              );


          if (
            fields.length <
            9
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              `Invalid reference-project line: ${line}`,
            );

          }


          return {

            projectName:
              fields[0]
              ??
              "",

            clientName:
              fields[1]
              ??
              "",

            countryCode:
              fields[2]
              ??
              "",

            regionName:
              nullable(
                fields[3]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            contractValue:
              nullableNumber(
                fields[4]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            currency:
              nullable(
                fields[5]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            startedOn:
              nullable(
                fields[6]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            completedOn:
              nullable(
                fields[7]
                ??
                "",
              ),

            description:
              fields
                .slice(
                  8,
                )
                .join(
                  " | ",
                ),

          };

        },
      );


  return {

    legalName:
      form.legalName.trim(),

    tradingName:
      nullable(
        form.tradingName,
      ),

    industry:
      form.industry.trim(),

    description:
      form.description.trim(),

    websiteUrl:
      nullable(
        form.websiteUrl,
      ),

    countryCode:
      form.countryCode
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase(),

    headquartersCity:
      form.headquartersCity.trim(),

    employeeBand:
      form.employeeBand,

    annualRevenueBand:
      form.annualRevenueBand,

    preferredMinContractValue:
      nullableNumber(
        form.preferredMinContractValue,
      ),

    preferredMaxContractValue:
      nullableNumber(
        form.preferredMaxContractValue,
      ),

    preferredCurrency:
      nullable(
        form.preferredCurrency,
      )?.toUpperCase()
      ??
      null,

    yearsExperience:
      nullableNumber(
        form.yearsExperience,
      ),

    minimumNoticeDays:
      nullableNumber(
        form.minimumNoticeDays,
      ),

    capabilities:
      lines(
        form.capabilities,
      ),

    operatingRegions,

    targetCpvs,

    certifications,

    referenceProjects,

    preferredBuyerTypes:
      form.preferredBuyerTypes,

    excludedKeywords:
      lines(
        form.excludedKeywords,
      ),

  };

}

"use client";


import {

  Activity,

  ArrowRight,

  BarChart3,

  BellRing,

  Building2,

  Command,

  Factory,

  FileSearch,

  Gauge,

  Grid2X2,

  LayoutDashboard,

  Scale,

  Search,

  Target,

  X,

} from "lucide-react";


import type {

  LucideIcon,

} from "lucide-react";


import {

  usePathname,

  useRouter,

} from "next/navigation";


import {

  useEffect,

  useMemo,

  useRef,

  useState,

} from "react";


import {

  productContextForPath,

  productNavigationItems,

} from "@/features/navigation/product-navigation";


import type {

  ProductNavigationIcon,

} from "@/features/navigation/product-navigation";


const icons:
Record<
  ProductNavigationIcon,
  LucideIcon
> = {

  workspace:
    Grid2X2,

  dashboard:
    LayoutDashboard,

  opportunities:
    FileSearch,

  matches:
    Target,

  decisions:
    Scale,

  notifications:
    BellRing,

  market:
    BarChart3,

  buyers:
    Building2,

  suppliers:
    Factory,

  intelligence:
    Gauge,

  operations:
    Activity,

};


export function ProductExperienceLayer() {

  const pathname =
    usePathname();


  const router =
    useRouter();


  const inputRef =
    useRef<HTMLInputElement>(
      null,
    );


  const [

    open,

    setOpen,

  ] = useState(
    false,
  );


  const [

    query,

    setQuery,

  ] = useState(
    "",
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      function onKeyDown(
        event:
          KeyboardEvent,
      ) {

        if (
          (
            event.metaKey
            ||
            event.ctrlKey
          )
          &&
          event.key
            .toLowerCase() ===
            "k"
        ) {

          event.preventDefault();


          setOpen(
            (
              current,
            ) =>
              !current,
          );

        }


        if (
          event.key ===
          "Escape"
        ) {

          setOpen(
            false,
          );

        }

      }


      document.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        onKeyDown,
      );


      return () => {

        document.removeEventListener(
          "keydown",
          onKeyDown,
        );

      };

    },
    [],
  );


  useEffect(
    () => {

      if (
        !open
      ) {
        return;
      }


      const frame =
        window.requestAnimationFrame(
          () => {

            inputRef.current?.focus();

          },
        );


      return () => {

        window.cancelAnimationFrame(
          frame,
        );

      };

    },
    [
      open,
    ],
  );


  const context =
    productContextForPath(
      pathname,
    );


  const results =
    useMemo(
      () => {

        const normalized =
          query
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();


        if (
          normalized ===
          ""
        ) {

          return productNavigationItems;

        }


        return productNavigationItems.filter(
          (
            item,
          ) => {

            const searchable =
              [
                item.title,
                item.shortTitle,
                item.description,
                ...item.keywords,
              ]
                .join(
                  " ",
                )
                .toLowerCase();


            return searchable.includes(
              normalized,
            );

          },
        );

      },
      [
        query,
      ],
    );


  function navigate(
    href:
      string,
  ) {

    setOpen(
      false,
    );


    setQuery(
      "",
    );


    router.push(
      href,
    );

  }


  return (

    <>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={
          () =>
            setOpen(
              true,
            )
        }
        className="
          fixed
          bottom-5
          right-5
          z-40
          inline-flex
          h-11
          items-center
          gap-2
          rounded-2xl
          border
          border-slate-200
          bg-white
          px-4
          text-xs
          font-semibold
          text-slate-700
          shadow-lg
          shadow-slate-900/10
          transition
          hover:-translate-y-0.5
          hover:border-slate-300
          hover:shadow-xl
        "
        aria-label="Open TenderPilot navigation"
      >

        <Command
          className="
            size-4
            text-[#2f6fed]
          "
        />

        <span
          className="
            hidden
            sm:inline
          "
        >
          Navigate
        </span>


        <span
          className="
            rounded-md
            bg-slate-100
            px-1.5
            py-0.5
            font-mono
            text-[9px]
            text-slate-400
          "
        >
          ⌘K
        </span>

      </button>


      {
        open

          ? (

            <div
              className="
                fixed
                inset-0
                z-50
                flex
                items-start
                justify-center
                bg-slate-950/40
                px-4
                pt-[8vh]
                backdrop-blur-sm
              "
              role="dialog"
              aria-modal="true"
              aria-label="TenderPilot navigation"
            >

              <div
                className="
                  w-full
                  max-w-2xl
                  overflow-hidden
                  rounded-3xl
                  border
                  border-slate-200
                  bg-white
                  shadow-2xl
                "
              >

                <div
                  className="
                    border-b
                    border-slate-100
                    p-4
                  "
                >

                  <div
                    className="
                      flex
                      items-center
                      justify-between
                      gap-4
                    "
                  >

                    <div
                      className="
                        min-w-0
                      "
                    >

                      <p
                        className="
                          text-[9px]
                          font-semibold
                          uppercase
                          tracking-[0.12em]
                          text-slate-400
                        "
                      >
                        Current context
                      </p>


                      <p
                        className="
                          mt-1
                          truncate
                          text-xs
                          font-semibold
                          text-slate-700
                        "
                      >
                        TenderPilot
                        {" / "}
                        {
                          context.group
                        }
                        {" / "}
                        {
                          context.title
                        }
                      </p>

                    </div>


                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={
                        () =>
                          setOpen(
                            false,
                          )
                      }
                      className="
                        grid
                        size-9
                        shrink-0
                        place-items-center
                        rounded-xl
                        text-slate-400
                        hover:bg-slate-100
                        hover:text-slate-700
                      "
                      aria-label="Close TenderPilot navigation"
                    >

                      <X
                        className="size-4"
                      />

                    </button>

                  </div>


                  <div
                    className="
                      relative
                      mt-4
                    "
                  >

                    <Search
                      className="
                        absolute
                        left-3
                        top-3.5
                        size-4
                        text-slate-400
                      "
                    />


                    <input
                      ref={
                        inputRef
                      }
                      value={
                        query
                      }
                      onChange={
                        (
                          event,
                        ) =>
                          setQuery(
                            event.target.value,
                          )
                      }
                      placeholder="Search TenderPilot…"
                      aria-label="Search TenderPilot sections"
                      className="
                        h-11
                        w-full
                        rounded-xl
                        border
                        border-slate-200
                        bg-slate-50
                        pl-10
                        pr-3
                        text-sm
                        outline-none
                        transition
                        focus:border-blue-300
                        focus:bg-white
                        focus:ring-4
                        focus:ring-blue-50
                      "
                    />

                  </div>

                </div>


                <div
                  className="
                    max-h-[62vh]
                    overflow-y-auto
                    p-3
                  "
                >

                  {
                    results.map(
                      (
                        item,
                      ) => {

                        const Icon =
                          icons[
                            item.icon
                          ];


                        const active =
                          pathname ===
                            item.href
                          ||
                          (
                            item.href !==
                              "/workspace"
                            &&
                            pathname.startsWith(
                              `${item.href}/`,
                            )
                          );


                        return (

                          <button
                            key={
                              item.href
                            }
                            type="button"
                            onClick={
                              () =>
                                navigate(
                                  item.href,
                                )
                            }
                            className={
                              `
                                group
                                flex
                                w-full
                                items-start
                                gap-4
                                rounded-2xl
                                p-4
                                text-left
                                transition
                                ${
                                  active
                                    ? "bg-blue-50"
                                    : "hover:bg-slate-50"
                                }
                              `
                            }
                          >

                            <div
                              className={
                                `
                                  grid
                                  size-10
                                  shrink-0
                                  place-items-center
                                  rounded-xl
                                  ${
                                    active
                                      ? "bg-white text-[#2f6fed]"
                                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
                                  }
                                `
                              }
                            >

                              <Icon
                                className="size-4"
                              />

                            </div>


                            <div
                              className="
                                min-w-0
                                flex-1
                              "
                            >

                              <div
                                className="
                                  flex
                                  items-center
                                  gap-2
                                "
                              >

                                <p
                                  className="
                                    text-sm
                                    font-semibold
                                    text-slate-900
                                  "
                                >
                                  {
                                    item.title
                                  }
                                </p>


                                {
                                  active

                                    ? (

                                      <span
                                        className="
                                          rounded-full
                                          bg-white
                                          px-2
                                          py-0.5
                                          text-[9px]
                                          font-semibold
                                          text-[#2f6fed]
                                        "
                                      >
                                        Current
                                      </span>

                                    )

                                    : null
                                }

                              </div>


                              <p
                                className="
                                  mt-1
                                  text-xs
                                  leading-5
                                  text-slate-500
                                "
                              >
                                {
                                  item.description
                                }
                              </p>

                            </div>


                            <ArrowRight
                              className="
                                mt-3
                                size-4
                                shrink-0
                                text-slate-300
                                transition
                                group-hover:translate-x-0.5
                              "
                            />

                          </button>

                        );

                      },
                    )
                  }


                  {
                    results.length ===
                    0

                      ? (

                        <div
                          className="
                            py-14
                            text-center
                          "
                        >

                          <Search
                            className="
                              mx-auto
                              size-7
                              text-slate-300
                            "
                          />


                          <p
                            className="
                              mt-3
                              text-sm
                              font-semibold
                              text-slate-800
                            "
                          >
                            No matching TenderPilot section
                          </p>


                          <p
                            className="
                              mt-1
                              text-xs
                              text-slate-400
                            "
                          >
                            Try bids, market, buyers, alerts,
                            opportunities or operations.
                          </p>

                      : null
                  }

                </div>


                <div
                  className="
                    flex

                    justify-between

                    px-4

                    text-slate-400
                  "
                >

                  <span>
                    ⌘K / Ctrl+K to toggle
                  </span>


                  <span>
                    Esc to close
                  </span>

                </div>

          )

          : null
      }

    </>

  );

export function productContextForPath(
  pathname:
    string,
) {

  if (
    pathname.startsWith(
      "/bid-workspaces/",
    )
  ) {

    return {
      group:
        "Pursuit",

      title:
        "Bid workspace",
    };

  }


  if (
    pathname.startsWith(
      "/opportunities/",
    )
  ) {

    return {
      group:
        "Pursuit",

      title:
        "Opportunity detail",
    };

  }


  if (
    pathname.startsWith(
      "/buyers/",
    )
  ) {

    return {
      group:
        "Market intelligence",

      title:
        "Buyer detail",
    };

  }


  if (
    pathname.startsWith(
      "/suppliers/",
    )
  ) {

    return {
      group:
        "Market intelligence",

      title:
        "Supplier detail",
    };

  }


  for (
    const group
    of
    productNavigationGroups
  ) {

    for (
      const item
      of
      group.items
    ) {

      if (
        pathname ===
        item.href
      ) {

        return {
          group:
            group.title,

          title:
            item.shortTitle,
        };

      }

    }

  }


  return {
    group:
      "TenderPilot",

    title:
      "Workspace",
  };

}

===== FILE: ./frontend/src/features/procurement/procurement-format.ts =====
export function formatEnum(
  value:
    string,
) {

  return value
    .replaceAll(
      "_",
      " ",
    )
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /\b\w/g,
      (
        character,
      ) =>
        character.toUpperCase(),
    );

}


export function formatMoney(

  value:
    number
    |
    null,

  currency:
    string
    |
    null,

) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {

    return "—";

  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(

    "en",

    {

      style:
        "currency",

      currency:
        currency
        ??
        "EUR",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        0,

    },

  ).format(
    value,
  );

}


export function formatValueRange(

  minimum:
    number
    |
    null,

  maximum:
    number
    |
    null,

  currency:
    string
    |
    null,

) {

  if (
    minimum ===
    null
    &&
    maximum ===
    null
  ) {

    return "Value not disclosed";

  }


  if (
    minimum !==
    null
    &&
    maximum !==
    null
  ) {

    return `${formatMoney(minimum, currency)} – ${formatMoney(maximum, currency)}`;

  }


  if (
    minimum !==
    null
  ) {

    return `From ${formatMoney(minimum, currency)}`;

  }


  return `Up to ${formatMoney(maximum, currency)}`;

}


export function formatDate(
  value:
    string
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {

    return "Not specified";

  }


  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(

    "en",

    {

      dateStyle:
        "medium",

    },

  ).format(
    new Date(
      value,
    ),
  );

}


export function formatDateTime(
  value:
    string
    |
    null,
) {

  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {

    return "Not specified";

  }


  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(

    "en",

    {

      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",

    },

  ).format(
    new Date(
      value,
    ),
  );

}

===== FILE: ./frontend/src/lib/api.ts =====
export type DependencyStatus = {

  name:
    string;

  status:
    | "UP"
    | "DOWN";

  detail:
    string;

};


export type SystemStatus = {

  application:
    string;

  version:
    string;

  environment:
    string;

  timestamp:
    string;

  dependencies:
    DependencyStatus[];

};


const API_BASE_URL =

  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
  ??
  "http://localhost:8080";


export async function fetchSystemStatus(

  signal?: AbortSignal,

): Promise<SystemStatus> {

  const response = await fetch(

    `${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/system/status`,

    {

      method:
        "GET",

      cache:
        "no-store",

      signal,

    },

  );


  if (!response.ok) {

    throw new Error(

      `Backend returned HTTP ${response.status}`,

    );

  }


  const body =

    await response.json();


  return body as SystemStatus;

}

===== FILE: ./scripts/export-context.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bundles the project's source into a single text file to share with Claude.
set -e
OUT="${1:-tenderpilot-context.txt}"

EXCLUDES=( -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/target/*" \
  -not -path "*/build/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" -not -path "*/dist/*" -not -path "*/.idea/*" \
  -not -path "*/.vscode/*" -not -path "*/.mvn/*" -not -path "*/uploads/*" \
  -not -name ".DS_Store" -not -name "*.log" -not -name "package-lock.json" \
  -not -name "*.min.*" -not -name "$OUT" -not -name ".env*" )

{
  echo "##### PROJECT TREE #####"
  find . -type f "${EXCLUDES[@]}" | sort
  echo
  echo "##### FILE CONTENTS #####"
  find . -type f \( -name "*.java" -o -name "*.kt" -o -name "pom.xml" -o -name "*.gradle" \
    -o -name "*.properties" -o -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.sql" \
    -o -name "*.html" -o -name "*.css" -o -name "*.scss" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" \
    -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" -o -name "*.sh" \
    -o -name "Dockerfile" -o -name "docker-compose*" \) "${EXCLUDES[@]}" | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do
    echo; echo "===== FILE: $f ====="
    case "$f" in
      *.properties|*.yml|*.yaml)
        # mask passwords / secrets / keys in config files
        perl -pe 's/^(.*(password|secret|token|api[-_.]?key|private[-_.]?key|credentials).*?[=:]\s*).*/$1***REDACTED***/i' "$f" ;;
      *) cat "$f" ;;
    esac
  done
} > "$OUT"

echo "Done: $OUT ($(wc -l < "$OUT") lines, $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1))"

===== FILE: ./scripts/infra-up.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

cd "${ROOT_DIR}"

POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-tenderpilot}"
POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-tenderpilot}"
OPENSEARCH_URL="${OPENSEARCH_URL:-http://localhost:19200}"

if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '[FAIL] Docker is required.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '[FAIL] curl is required.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '[FAIL] Docker Compose v2 is required.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

printf '\n'
printf '================================================================================\n'
printf 'TENDERPILOT — START LOCAL INFRASTRUCTURE\n'
printf '================================================================================\n'

docker compose up -d postgres opensearch

printf '\nWaiting for PostgreSQL...\n'

POSTGRES_READY=0

for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do

  if docker compose exec -T postgres \
    pg_isready \
    -U "${POSTGRES_USER}" \
    -d "${POSTGRES_DB}" \
    >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    POSTGRES_READY=1
    break

  fi

  sleep 1

done

if [[ "${POSTGRES_READY}" -ne 1 ]]; then

  printf '[FAIL] PostgreSQL did not become ready.\n' >&2

  docker compose logs \
    --tail=100 \
    postgres \
    || true

  exit 1

fi

printf '[PASS] POSTGRES_READY\n'

printf '\nWaiting for OpenSearch...\n'

OPENSEARCH_READY=0

for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do

  if curl \
    --fail \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    "${OPENSEARCH_URL}" \
    >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    OPENSEARCH_READY=1
    break

  fi

  sleep 1

done

if [[ "${OPENSEARCH_READY}" -ne 1 ]]; then

  printf '[FAIL] OpenSearch did not become ready.\n' >&2

  docker compose logs \
    --tail=150 \
    opensearch \
    || true

  exit 1

fi

printf '[PASS] OPENSEARCH_READY\n'

printf '\n'
printf 'POSTGRES_STATUS=UP\n'
printf 'OPENSEARCH_STATUS=UP\n'
printf 'INFRASTRUCTURE_STATUS=READY\n'

===== FILE: ./scripts/prepare-local-ai.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

GENERATION_MODEL="${OLLAMA_MODEL:-qwen3:4b}"
EMBEDDING_MODEL="${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL:-nomic-embed-text-v2-moe}"
BASE_URL="${OLLAMA_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:11434}"

echo "============================================================"
echo "TenderPilot Local AI Preparation"
echo "============================================================"
echo "GENERATION_MODEL=${GENERATION_MODEL}"
echo "EMBEDDING_MODEL=${EMBEDDING_MODEL}"
echo "OLLAMA_BASE_URL=${BASE_URL}"

if ! command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  echo "[FAIL] Ollama command is not installed."
  exit 1

fi

if ! curl -fsS "${BASE_URL}/api/tags" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  echo "[FAIL] Ollama API is not reachable at ${BASE_URL}"
  exit 1

fi

ensure_model() {

  local model="$1"

  if ollama list 2>/dev/null \
    | awk 'NR > 1 {print $1}' \
    | grep -Fxq "${model}"; then

    echo "[PASS] MODEL_ALREADY_AVAILABLE=${model}"

  else

    echo "[INFO] Pulling local model ${model}"

    ollama pull "${model}"

  fi
}

ensure_model "${GENERATION_MODEL}"
ensure_model "${EMBEDDING_MODEL}"

echo "[PASS] LOCAL_GENERATION_MODEL_READY=${GENERATION_MODEL}"
echo "[PASS] LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_READY=${EMBEDDING_MODEL}"
echo "[PASS] TENDERPILOT_LOCAL_RAG_READY"

===== FILE: ./scripts/release-gate.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

###############################################################################
# TENDERPILOT LOCAL RELEASE GATE
#
# Free/local only.
# No CI/CD.
# No network dependency.
#
# Normal release usage:
#
#   ./scripts/release-gate.sh
#
# During an uncommitted development step:
#
#   TENDERPILOT_RELEASE_ALLOW_DIRTY=1 ./scripts/release-gate.sh
###############################################################################

SCRIPT_DIR="$(
  cd "$(
    dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
  )" >/dev/null 2>&1
  pwd
)"

ROOT_DIR="$(
  cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." >/dev/null 2>&1
  pwd
)"

cd "${ROOT_DIR}"

ALLOW_DIRTY="${TENDERPILOT_RELEASE_ALLOW_DIRTY:-0}"

RELEASE_LOG_DIR="$(
  mktemp -d \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tenderpilot-release-gate.XXXXXX"
)"

STATIC_LOG="${RELEASE_LOG_DIR}/01-static.log"
QUALITY_LOG="${RELEASE_LOG_DIR}/02-quality.log"
DIFF_LOG="${RELEASE_LOG_DIR}/03-diff.log"

RESULT_FILE="${RELEASE_LOG_DIR}/TENDERPILOT_RELEASE_GATE_RESULT.txt"

###############################################################################
# HELPERS
###############################################################################

fail() {
  echo "[FAIL] $*"
  exit 1
}

###############################################################################
# REQUIRED COMMANDS
###############################################################################

for cmd in \
  git \
  java \
  mvn \
  node \
  npm \
  docker \
  python3
do

  command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
    fail "REQUIRED_COMMAND=${cmd}"

done

docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  fail "DOCKER_COMPOSE_V2_REQUIRED"

###############################################################################
# CLEANLINESS
###############################################################################

if [[ "${ALLOW_DIRTY}" != "1" ]] && \
   [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then

  echo "[FAIL] RELEASE_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN"

  git status --short

  exit 1

fi

###############################################################################
# STATIC RELEASE CONTRACT
###############################################################################

python3 <<'PY' 2>&1 | tee "${STATIC_LOG}"
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


root = Path.cwd()


###############################################################################
# VERSION SYNCHRONIZATION
###############################################################################

pom_path = root / "backend/pom.xml"

pom_text = pom_path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


application_text = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/resources/application.yml"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


pom_root = ET.parse(
    pom_path
).getroot()


namespace = ""


if pom_root.tag.startswith("{"):

    namespace = (
        pom_root.tag.split(
            "}"
        )[0]
        +
        "}"
    )


version_node = pom_root.find(
    f"{namespace}version"
)


if version_node is None:

    raise SystemExit(
        "Unable to determine Maven project version."
    )


version = (
    version_node.text
    or
    ""
).strip()


if version != "1.0.0":

    raise SystemExit(
        f"Unexpected Maven version: {version}"
    )


if f"version: {version}" not in application_text:

    raise SystemExit(
        "application.yml version does not match pom.xml"
    )


###############################################################################
# MIGRATION REGISTRATION
###############################################################################

changes_dir = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/resources/db/changelog/changes"
)


master = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/resources/db/changelog/db.changelog-master.yaml"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


change_files = sorted(
    path
    for path in changes_dir.glob(
        "*.yaml"
    )
    if path.is_file()
)


if not change_files:

    raise SystemExit(
        "No Liquibase change files found."
    )


numeric_prefixes = []


for path in change_files:

    filename = path.name


    count = master.count(
        filename
    )


    if count != 1:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Liquibase registration count for {filename}: {count}"
        )


    match = re.match(
        r"^(\d+)-",
        filename
    )


    if match:

        numeric_prefixes.append(
            int(
                match.group(
                    1
                )
            )
        )


if len(
    numeric_prefixes
) != len(
    set(
        numeric_prefixes
    )
):

    raise SystemExit(
        "Duplicate numeric Liquibase migration prefix detected."
    )


if max(
    numeric_prefixes,
    default=0
) != 15:

    raise SystemExit(
        "Unexpected latest migration number; Step 24 expects 015."
    )


###############################################################################
# FRONTEND PRODUCT ROUTES
###############################################################################

routes = {


    "/showcase/capture":
        "frontend/src/app/(capture)/showcase/capture/page.tsx",

    "/workspace":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/workspace/page.tsx",


    "/showcase":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/showcase/page.tsx",

    "/dashboard":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/dashboard/page.tsx",

    "/notifications":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/notifications/page.tsx",

    "/opportunities":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/opportunities/page.tsx",

    "/matches":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/matches/page.tsx",

    "/bid-decisions":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/bid-decisions/page.tsx",

    "/market":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/market/page.tsx",

    "/buyers":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/buyers/page.tsx",

    "/suppliers":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/suppliers/page.tsx",

    "/intelligence":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/intelligence/page.tsx",

    "/data-operations":
        "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/data-operations/page.tsx",

}


registry = (
    root
    /
    "frontend/src/features/navigation/product-navigation.ts"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


for route, raw_path in routes.items():

    if f'"{route}"' not in registry:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Navigation registry missing {route}"
        )


    if not (
        root
        /
        raw_path
    ).is_file():

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Frontend route page missing: {route}"
        )


###############################################################################
# WORKSPACE TEMPLATE / GLOBAL COMMAND PALETTE
###############################################################################

template = (
    root
    /
    "frontend/src/app/(workspace)/template.tsx"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


experience = (
    root
    /
    "frontend/src/features/navigation/product-experience-layer.tsx"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


for required in [
    "ProductExperienceLayer",
    "<ProductExperienceLayer />",
]:

    if required not in template:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Workspace template contract missing: {required}"
        )


for required in [
    "metaKey",
    "ctrlKey",
    "Escape",
    "Search TenderPilot",
]:

    if required not in experience:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Command-palette contract missing: {required}"
        )


###############################################################################
# CRITICAL API SURFACES
###############################################################################

java_root = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/java"
)


java_text = "\n".join(
    path.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )
    for path in java_root.rglob(
        "*.java"
    )
)


for required in [
    '"/api/v1/dashboard"',
    '"/api/v1/notifications"',
    '"/api/v1/data-operations"',
    '"/api/v1/market"',
    '"/api/v1/buyers"',
    '"/api/v1/suppliers"',
    '"/api/v1/matches"',
    '"/api/v1/bid-decisions"',
    '"/api/v1/bid-workspaces"',
]:

    if required not in java_text:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Critical API surface missing: {required}"
        )


###############################################################################
# PRIVATE DATA MUST NOT ENTER GLOBAL SEARCH
###############################################################################

search_root = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/search"
)


if search_root.is_dir():

    search_text = "\n".join(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
        for path in search_root.rglob(
            "*.java"
        )
    )


    for forbidden in [
        "com.tenderpilot.dashboard",
        "com.tenderpilot.notification",
        "organization_notifications",
        "organization_watchlist_items",
        "organization_bid_documents",
        "organization_bid_rag_chunks",
        "organization_bid_compliance_reviews",
        "organization_bid_tasks",
    ]:

        if forbidden in search_text:

            raise SystemExit(
                f"Private data leaked to global search: {forbidden}"
            )


###############################################################################
# PUBLIC MARKET MUST REMAIN PRIVATE-DATA FREE
###############################################################################

market_root = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/java/com/tenderpilot/marketanalytics"
)


market_text = "\n".join(
    path.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )
    for path in market_root.rglob(
        "*.java"
    )
)


for forbidden in [
    "CurrentOrganizationResolver",
    "organizationId",
    "com.tenderpilot.company",
    "com.tenderpilot.bidworkspace",
    "com.tenderpilot.biddecision",
    "com.tenderpilot.compliance",

    "com.tenderpilot.notification",
    "com.tenderpilot.dashboard",
]:

    if forbidden in market_text:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Private dependency in public market analytics: {forbidden}"
        )


###############################################################################
# NO OBVIOUS TRACKED SECRETS
###############################################################################

tracked = subprocess.run(
    [
        "git",
        "ls-files",
    ],
    check=True,
    text=True,
    capture_output=True,
).stdout.splitlines()


secret_patterns = [

    re.compile(
        r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----"
    ),

    re.compile(
        r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b"
    ),

    re.compile(
        r"\bghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}\b"
    ),

    re.compile(
        r"\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{20,}\b"
    ),

]


for raw_path in tracked:

    path = root / raw_path


    if not path.is_file():

        continue


    if any(
        part in {
            "target",
            "node_modules",
            ".next",
        }
        for part in path.parts
    ):

        continue


    try:

        text = path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    except UnicodeDecodeError:

        continue


    for pattern in secret_patterns:

        if pattern.search(
            text
        ):

            raise SystemExit(
                f"Potential tracked secret detected in {raw_path}"
            )


###############################################################################
# NO GENERATED BUILD DIRECTORIES TRACKED
###############################################################################

for raw_path in tracked:

    normalized = raw_path.replace(
        "\\",
        "/"
    )


    if (
        "/node_modules/" in f"/{normalized}/"
        or
        "/.next/" in f"/{normalized}/"
        or
        "/target/" in f"/{normalized}/"
    ):

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Generated build output is tracked: {raw_path}"
        )

###############################################################################

for required in [

    "ReleaseProductSurfaceTest.java",

    "ReleaseSecurityBoundaryTest.java",
]:

    if not (
        root
        /
        required
    ).is_file():

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Release test missing: {required}"
        )


print(

#!/usr/bin/env bash

export DB_PASSWORD="${DB_PASSWORD:-tenderpilot_dev}"

export OLLAMA_URL="${OLLAMA_URL:-http://localhost:11434}"

export CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:3000}"

export ACCESS_TOKEN_ISSUER="${ACCESS_TOKEN_ISSUER:-tenderpilot-local}"

export ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET="${ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET:-tenderpilot-development-access-token-secret-2026-change-before-production}"

export ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL="${ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL:-PT15M}"

export REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL="${REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL:-P7D}"

export REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME="${REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME:-tenderpilot_refresh}"

export REFRESH_COOKIE_SECURE="${REFRESH_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}"

cd "${ROOT_DIR}/backend"

printf '\n'
printf '================================================================================\n'
printf 'TENDERPILOT — BACKEND DEVELOPMENT SERVER\n'
printf '================================================================================\n'
printf 'Backend URL: http://localhost:8080\n'

printf '================================================================================\n'

exec mvn spring-boot:run

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

###############################################################################
# TENDERPILOT — V1.0 READINESS GATE
#
# Final local release-certification authority.
#
# Normal final usage:
#
#   ./scripts/v1-readiness-gate.sh
#
# Development/pre-commit usage:
#
#   TENDERPILOT_V1_ALLOW_DIRTY=1 \
#   TENDERPILOT_V1_REQUIRE_TAG=0 \
#   ./scripts/v1-readiness-gate.sh
###############################################################################

SCRIPT_DIR="$(
  cd "$(
    dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
  )" >/dev/null 2>&1
  pwd
)"

ROOT_DIR="$(
  cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." >/dev/null 2>&1
  pwd
)"

RELEASE_VERSION="1.0.0"
RELEASE_TAG="v1.0.0"
EXPECTED_LATEST_MIGRATION="015"

ALLOW_DIRTY="${TENDERPILOT_V1_ALLOW_DIRTY:-0}"
REQUIRE_TAG="${TENDERPILOT_V1_REQUIRE_TAG:-1}"

LOG_DIR="$(
  mktemp -d \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tenderpilot-v1-readiness.XXXXXX"
)"

STATIC_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/01-static.log"
RELEASE_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/02-release-gate.log"
RESULT_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/TENDERPILOT_V1_READINESS_RESULT.txt"

###############################################################################
# HELPERS
###############################################################################

fail() {

  echo "[FAIL] $*"
  exit 1

}

###############################################################################
# COMMANDS
###############################################################################

for cmd in \
  git \
  java \
  mvn \
  node \
  npm \
  docker \
  python3
do

  command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
    fail "REQUIRED_COMMAND=${cmd}"

done

docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  fail "DOCKER_COMPOSE_V2_REQUIRED"

###############################################################################
# WORKTREE
###############################################################################

if [[ "${ALLOW_DIRTY}" != "1" ]] && \
   [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then

  echo "[FAIL] V1_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN"

  git status --short

  exit 1

fi

###############################################################################
# STATIC V1 CERTIFICATION
###############################################################################

python3 <<'PY' 2>&1 | tee "${STATIC_LOG}"
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


root = Path.cwd()


###############################################################################
# MAVEN PROJECT VERSION
###############################################################################

pom_path = (
    root
    /
    "backend/pom.xml"
)


tree = ET.parse(
    pom_path
)


pom_root = tree.getroot()


namespace = ""


if pom_root.tag.startswith("{"):

    namespace = (
        pom_root.tag.split(
            "}"
        )[0]
        +
        "}"
    )


version_node = pom_root.find(
    f"{namespace}version"
)


if (
    version_node is None
    or
    (
        version_node.text
        or
        ""
    ).strip()
    !=
    "1.0.0"
):

    raise SystemExit(
        "Maven project version is not 1.0.0."
    )


###############################################################################
# RUNTIME VERSION
###############################################################################

application = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/resources/application.yml"
).read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)


if "version: 1.0.0" not in application:

    raise SystemExit(
        "Runtime application version is not 1.0.0."
    )


###############################################################################
# RELEASE MANIFEST
###############################################################################

manifest_path = (
    root
    /
    "release/tenderpilot-v1-release.json"
)


if not manifest_path.is_file():

    raise SystemExit(
        "V1 release manifest is missing."
    )


manifest = json.loads(
    manifest_path.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )
)


expected = {

    "product":
        "TenderPilot",

    "version":
        "1.0.0",

    "releaseTag":
        "v1.0.0",

    "releaseType":
        "stable",

    "featureFreezeBase":
        "60a2459",

    "latestLiquibaseMigration":
        "015",

    "minimumBackendTests":
        222,

    "releaseContractTests":
        26,

    "featureDevelopmentComplete":
        True,

    "productionBackendFeatureChange":
        False,

    "databaseMigrationChange":
        False,

    "syntheticShowcaseDataset":
        "tenderpilot-portfolio-showcase-v1",

    "showcaseRoute":
        "/showcase",

    "captureRoute":
        "/showcase/capture",

    "captureFrames":
        6,

    "captureResolution":
        "1440x900",

    "ciCdRequired":
        False,

    "paidServiceRequired":
        False,

}


for key, value in expected.items():

    if manifest.get(
        key
    ) != value:

        raise SystemExit(
            f"Release manifest mismatch: "
            f"{key}={manifest.get(key)!r}"
        )


###############################################################################
# MIGRATION FREEZE
###############################################################################

changes = (
    root
    /
    "backend/src/main/resources/db/changelog/changes"
)


prefix_pattern = re.compile(
    r"^(\d+)-"
)


numbers = []


for path in changes.glob(

):

    match = prefix_pattern.match(
        path.name
    )


    if match:

        numbers.append(

                    1
                )
            )
        )


if not numbers:

    raise SystemExit(

    )


if max(
    numbers

    raise SystemExit(

    )

for forbidden in [

]:

    if forbidden in capture:

        raise SystemExit(

        )

###############################################################################

release_gate = (

for required in [

###############################################################################

print(

###############################################################################

TENDERPILOT_RELEASE_ALLOW_DIRTY="${ALLOW_DIRTY}" \

  echo "V1_CAPTURE_BOUNDARY=PASS"
  echo
  echo "BACKEND_TESTS=${BACKEND_TEST_TOTAL}/${BACKEND_TEST_TOTAL}_PASS"
  echo "FRONTEND_LINT=PASS"
  echo "FRONTEND_TYPECHECK=PASS"
  echo "FRONTEND_BUILD=PASS"
  echo "COMPOSE_VALIDATION=PASS"
  echo
  echo "LOCAL_RELEASE_GATE=PASS"
  echo "V1_TAG_CERTIFICATION=${TAG_STATUS}"
  echo

  if [[ "${ALLOW_DIRTY}" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "WORKTREE_MODE=DIRTY_ALLOWED_FOR_PRECOMMIT_CERTIFICATION"
  else
    echo "WORKTREE_MODE=CLEAN_REQUIRED"
    echo "WORKTREE_CLEAN=YES"
  fi

  echo
  echo "V1_READINESS_STATUS=PASS"
  echo
  echo "LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR}"
  echo "================================================================================"

} | tee "${RESULT_FILE}"


if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  pbcopy < "${RESULT_FILE}"

  echo
  echo "[PASS] V1_READINESS_RESULT_COPIED_TO_CLIPBOARD"

fi
